local getgenv = getgenv or function() return _G end
local function PulseFC(instance, name, recursive)
    return instance:FindFirstChild(name, recursive)
end
local function PulseFCC(instance, name)
    return instance:FindFirstChildOfClass(name)
end
local function PulsePlayers()
    return game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
end
local function PULSE_NV(callback)
    assert(type(callback) == "function", "PULSE_NV expects a function")
    return callback
end

local function createNativeLibrary()
    local packValues = table.pack
    local unpackValues = unpack
    local moveValues = table.move
    local xorBits, orBits = bit32.bxor, bit32.bor
    local shiftLeft, shiftRight, andBits = bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift, bit32.band
    local readUint8, writeUint32, readUint32 = buffer.readu8, buffer.writeu32, buffer.readu32
    local writeUint8, createBuffer, fillBuffer = buffer.writeu8, buffer.create, buffer.fill
    local bufferLength = buffer.len
    
    local function unpackTuple(values)
        return unpackValues(values, 1, values.n)
    end
    
    local function appendValues(destination, offset, ...)
        local values = packValues(...)
        moveValues(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    end
    
    local function readCapturedOffset(cell, offset)
        return cell[6][cell[5] + offset]
    end

                pulseKillFX.context = function(a, killer)
                    local calculatedValue = a:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        or a:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                        or a:FindFirstChild("Torso")

                        return nil
                    end

                    local entries = {
                        char = a,
                        root = calculatedValue.Position,
                        chest = chest,
                        head = calculatedValue2.Position,
                        killer = killer,
                        ignore = { a = a, b = localPlayer.Character, c = workspace.CurrentCamera },
                    }
                    return entries
                end

                pulseKillFX.play = function(argument2, result, result2, argument3)
                    argument2 = if argument2 == "Random" or not fx[argument2]
                        then result[math.random(1, #result)]
                        else argument2
                    local entry, calculatedValue = fx[argument2], result2 and pulseKillFX.context(result2, argument3)
                    if entry then
                        if not calculatedValue then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    calculatedValue.orig = pulseKillFX.origOf[result2]
                    calculatedValue.ignore.d = calculatedValue.orig
                    calculatedValue.ghostTakes = entries[argument2] or false
                    if calculatedValue.orig then
                        pulseKillFX.ctxOf[result2] = calculatedValue
                    end
                    result, result2 = pcall(entry, calculatedValue)
                    if not result then
                        pulseKillFX.lastError = tostring(result2)
                    end
                end
                local function callback10(instance)
                    local success, result = pcall(function()
                        local upperTorso, shirt, pants =
                            instance:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"),
                            instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt"),
                            instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
                        return table.concat(
                            {
                                upperTorso and (upperTorso:IsA("MeshPart")) and upperTorso.MeshId or "",
                                shirt and shirt.ShirtTemplate or "",
                                pants and pants.PantsTemplate or "",
                            },
                            "|"
                        )
                    end)
                    return success and result or "||"
                end
                pulseKillFX.conns[#pulseKillFX.conns + 1] = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(m)
                    if m.Name ~= "Raggy" then

                        return
                    end
                    local now, raggies = os.clock(), {}
                    for unused, item in ipairs(pulseKillFX.raggies) do

                            if item.m.Parent then
                                raggies[#raggies + 1] = item
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    raggies[#raggies + 1] = { m = m, t = now }
                    pulseKillFX.raggies = raggies
                end)

                                                else
                                                    local m = item.m
                                                    value, value2 = magnitude, m
                                                end
                                            else
                                            end

                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end

                end

                    for key, item in pairs(argument2) do

                            localPlayer3 = instance and (instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))

                                if entry then
                                    if (localPlayer3.Position - entry.Position).Magnitude < 12 then
                                        return "knife"
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if instance then
                                if instance:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
                                    return "knife"
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for unused, localPlayer3 in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if localPlayer3 ~= localPlayer2 then
                            if localPlayer3.Character then
                                if localPlayer3.Character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
                                    return "gun"
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return "knife"
                end

                entries.hatDef = function(argument2)
                    local entry = entries.HATDEF[argument2]
                    return entry and entry[1] or "None", entry and entry[2] or "None"
                end
                entries.hats = {}
                entries.hidden = {}
                entries.crownOf = function(instance)
                    local hatAttachment = instance:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment")
                    if hatAttachment then
                        if hatAttachment:IsA("Attachment") then
                            return hatAttachment.CFrame
                        end
                    end
                    return CFrame.new(0, instance.Size.Y / 2, 0)
                end
                entries.headW = function(instance)
                    if instance:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        return (instance.Size.X + instance.Size.Z) / 2
                    end
                    return math.min(instance.Size.X, instance.Size.Z) * 1.2
                end
                entries.hideOf = function(argument2)
                    local hat, hair =
                        type(argument2) ~= "table" or argument2.hideHat ~= false,
                        type(argument2) == "table" and argument2.hideHair == true
                    if hat then
                    elseif hair then
                    else
                        return nil
                    end
                    return { hat = hat, hair = hair }
                end
                entries.accKind = function(instance)
                    local text
                    pcall(function()
                        local accessoryType = instance.AccessoryType
                        if accessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then
                            text = "hair"
                        elseif accessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hat then
                            text = "hat"
                        end
                    end)
                    if text then
                        return text
                    end
                    local handle = instance:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                    if handle then
                        if handle:FindFirstChild("HairAttachment") then
                            return "hair"
                        end
                        if handle:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment") then
                            return "hat"
                        end
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                entries.hideList = function(argument2, argument3)
                    local entries2 = {}
                    for accKindResult, instance in ipairs(argument2:GetChildren()) do
                        if instance:IsA("Accessory") then
                            accKindResult = entries.accKind(instance)
                            if accKindResult == "hat" and argument3.hat or accKindResult == "hair" and argument3.hair then
                                for unused, instance2 in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if instance2:IsA("BasePart") then
                                        entries2[#entries2 + 1] = instance2
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return entries2
                end
                entries.hairLift = function(argument2, argument3, argument4)
                    local value
                    for handle, instance in ipairs(argument2:GetChildren()) do
                        if instance:IsA("Accessory") then
                            if entries.accKind(instance) == "hair" then
                                handle = instance:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                                if handle then
                                    if handle:IsA("MeshPart") then
                                        if handle.Transparency < 0.95 then
                                            local interpolatedValue, size =
                                                argument3.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(handle.CFrame), handle.Size
                                            local calculatedValue = interpolatedValue.Y
                                                + math.abs(interpolatedValue.XVector.Y) * size.X / 2
                                                + math.abs(interpolatedValue.YVector.Y) * size.Y / 2
                                                + math.abs(interpolatedValue.ZVector.Y) * size.Z / 2
                                            value = if math.abs(interpolatedValue.X) < argument3.Size.X
                                                then if math.abs(interpolatedValue.Z) < argument3.Size.Z
                                                    then if value
                                                        then if calculatedValue > value then calculatedValue else value
                                                        else calculatedValue
                                                    else value
                                                else value
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if not value then
                        return 0
                    end
                    return math.clamp((value - argument4.Y) * 0.7, 0, 0.9)
                end
                entries.hatCollect = function(argument2, transform)
                    local entries2 = {}
                    for unused, item in ipairs(transform) do
                        entries2[#entries2 + 1] = item
                        for unused, item2 in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                            entries2[#entries2 + 1] = item2
                        end
                    end
                    transform = argument2.root.CFrame
                    for key, instance in ipairs(entries2) do
                        key = nil
                        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                            key = { instance, 1, o1 = instance.Color, tr = instance.Transparency }
                        else
                            if instance:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                                local calculatedValue = instance.Parent
                                    and instance.Parent:IsA("BasePart")
                                    and instance.Parent.Material
                                key = {
                                    instance,
                                    2,
                                    o1 = instance.VertexColor,
                                    mul = calculatedValue == Enum.Material.ForceField and 0
                                        or (calculatedValue == Enum.Material.Neon and 0.9 or 1.3),
                                }
                            else
                                key = if instance:IsA("Highlight")
                                    then {
                                        instance,
                                        3,
                                        o1 = instance.OutlineColor,
                                        o2 = instance.FillColor,
                                        tr = instance.FillTransparency,
                                        tr2 = instance.OutlineTransparency,
                                    }
                                    else if instance:IsA("Fire")
                                        then { instance, 4, o1 = instance.Color, o2 = instance.SecondaryColor }
                                        else if instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                                            then { instance, 5, o1 = instance.Color }
                                            else if instance:IsA("Beam")
                                                then { instance, 5, o1 = instance.Color }
                                                else if instance:IsA("Trail")
                                                    then { instance, 5, o1 = instance.Color }
                                                    else if instance:IsA("Light")
                                                        then { instance, 6, o1 = instance.Color }
                                                        else key
                            end
                        end
                        if key then
                            local calculatedValue = instance:IsA("BasePart") and instance
                                or instance:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
                            local calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue
                                    and transform:PointToObjectSpace(calculatedValue.Position)
                                or Vector3.zero
                            key.ph = math.atan2(calculatedValue2.Z, calculatedValue2.X) / 6.283185307179586 % 1
                            argument2.col[#argument2.col + 1] = key
                        end
                    end
                end
                entries.hatRestore = function(argument2)
                    for unused, localization2 in ipairs(argument2.col) do
                        local entry = localization2[1]
                        local entry2 = localization2[2]
                        pcall(function()
                            if entry2 == 1 then
                                entry.Color, entry.Transparency = localization2.o1, localization2.tr
                            elseif entry2 == 2 then
                                entry.VertexColor = localization2.o1
                            elseif entry2 == 3 then
                                entry.OutlineColor, entry.FillColor, entry.FillTransparency, entry.OutlineTransparency =
                                    localization2.o1, localization2.o2, localization2.tr, localization2.tr2
                            elseif entry2 == 4 then
                                entry.Color, entry.SecondaryColor = localization2.o1, localization2.o2
                            else
                                entry.Color = localization2.o1
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
                entries.hatPaint = function(argument2, argument3, argument4)
                    for unused, item in ipairs(argument2.col) do
                        local entry, entry2, color =
                            item[1], item[2], Color3.fromHSV((argument3 + (argument4 and item.ph or 0)) % 1, 0.78, 1)
                        if entry2 == 1 then
                            entry.Color = color
                        elseif entry2 == 2 then
                            if item.mul > 0 then
                                entry.VertexColor = Vector3.new(color.R, color.G, color.B) * item.mul
                            end
                        elseif entry2 == 3 then
                            entry.OutlineColor = color
                            entry.FillColor = color
                        elseif entry2 == 4 then
                            entry.Color = color
                            entry.SecondaryColor = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)
                        elseif entry2 == 5 then
                            entry.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
                        else
                            entry.Color = color
                        end
                    end
                end
                entries.hatPulse = function(argument2, argument3)
                    for unused, localization2 in ipairs(argument2.col) do
                        local entry, entry2 = localization2[1], localization2[2]
                        if entry2 == 1 and localization2.tr < 1 then
                            entry.Transparency = localization2.tr + (1 - localization2.tr) * 0.6 * argument3
                        elseif entry2 == 3 then
                            entry.FillTransparency = localization2.tr + (1 - localization2.tr) * 0.8 * argument3
                        end
                    end
                end
                entries.hatStep = function()
                    local now, hats, hidden = os.clock(), {}, {}
                    for key, item in ipairs(entries.hats) do
                        if item.root.Parent and item.w.Parent then
                            hats[#hats + 1] = item
                            local calculatedValue, fx, k, c0 = (now - item.t0) * item.spd, item.motion, item.k, item.base
                            if fx == "Spin" then
                                c0 *= CFrame.Angles(0, calculatedValue * 1.5, 0)
                            else
                                if fx == "Float" then
                                    c0 *= CFrame.new(0, (math.sin(calculatedValue * 2.2) + 1) * 0.08 * k, 0)
                                else
                                    if fx == "Spin + Float" then
                                        c0 = c0
                                            * CFrame.new(0, (math.sin(calculatedValue * 2.2) + 1) * 0.08 * k, 0)
                                            * CFrame.Angles(0, calculatedValue * 1.5, 0)
                                    else
                                        if fx == "Sway" then
                                            c0 *= CFrame.Angles(
                                                math.sin(calculatedValue * 1.7) * 0.1,
                                                0,
                                                math.sin(calculatedValue * 1.3 + 1.1) * 0.1
                                            )
                                        else
                                            if fx == "Wobble" then
                                                key = calculatedValue * 2.6
                                                c0 *= CFrame.fromAxisAngle(
                                                    Vector3.new(math.cos(key), 0, math.sin(key)),
                                                    0.13
                                                )
                                            else
                                                c0 = if fx == "Hover"
                                                    then c0 * CFrame.new(
                                                        0,
                                                        (0.45 + math.sin(calculatedValue * 1.8) * 0.1) * k,
                                                        0
                                                    ) * CFrame.Angles(
                                                        0,
                                                        calculatedValue * 0.9,
                                                        0
                                                    )
                                                    else if fx == "Bounce"
                                                        then c0 * CFrame.new(
                                                            0,
                                                            math.abs(math.sin(calculatedValue * 3.2)) * 0.2 * k,
                                                            0
                                                        )
                                                        else c0
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if fx ~= "None" then
                                item.w.C0 = c0
                                item.still = false
                            elseif not item.still then
                                item.w.C0 = c0
                                item.still = true
                            end
                            fx = item.fx
                            if fx ~= "None" then
                                if now - (item.fxAt or 0) >= 0.025 then
                                    item.fxAt = now
                                    if fx == "Rainbow" or fx == "Wave" then
                                        entries.hatPaint(item, calculatedValue * 0.22 % 1, fx == "Wave")
                                    elseif fx == "Pulse" then
                                        entries.hatPulse(item, 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(calculatedValue * 3.2))
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if item.hide then
                                if now - (item.hideAt or 0) > 0.5 then
                                    item.hideAt = now
                                    item.hideList = entries.hideList(item.ch, item.hide)
                                end
                                for unused, item2 in ipairs(item.hideList or {}) do
                                    hidden[item2] = true
                                    if item2.LocalTransparencyModifier < 1 then
                                        item2.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    entries.hats = hats
                    for key in pairs(entries.hidden) do
                        if not hidden[key] then
                            pcall(function()
                                key.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    entries.hidden = hidden
                end
                entries.hatLoop = function()
                    if entries.hatOn then
                        return
                    end
                    entries.hatOn = true
                    connectSignal(game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped, function()
                        if #entries.hats == 0 then
                            if next(entries.hidden) == nil then
                                return
                            end
                        end
                        local success, result = pcall(entries.hatStep)
                        if not success then
                            if not entries.hatErr then
                                entries.hatErr = true
                                warn("[Qwern] hat: " .. tostring(result))
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                entries.hatSet = function(argument2, argument3, fx)
                    local character = localPlayer.Character
                    local calculatedValue = entries.skinOf and entries.skinOf(character) or nil
                    for now, item in ipairs(entries.hats) do
                        if
                            item.key == argument2
                            and (item.ch == character or calculatedValue ~= nil and item.ch == calculatedValue)
                        then
                            if argument3 == "fx" then
                                if item.fx ~= "None" then
                                    entries.hatRestore(item)
                                end
                                item.fx = fx
                                if fx == "None" then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        getgenv().__pulseVFXTint()
                                    end)
                                end
                            elseif argument3 == "motion" then
                                item.motion = fx
                                item.still = false
                            elseif argument3 == "spd" then
                                now = os.clock()
                                local calculatedValue2 = (now - item.t0) * item.spd
                                item.spd = math.clamp(fx, 0.1, 3)
                                item.t0 = now - calculatedValue2 / item.spd
                            elseif argument3 == "hide" then
                                item.hide = fx
                                item.hideAt = 0
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                entries.putHat = function(parent2, hatDefResult, key, opt)
                    local head = parent2:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if head then
                        if not (head:IsA("BasePart")) then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    local size, hatK =
                        opt.size or 1, math.clamp(entries.headW(head) / 1.196, 0.5, 2.5) * (entries.HATFIT[key] or 1)
                    local k, pulseHatWeld, calculatedValue = hatK * size, entries.crownOf(head), 0
                    if opt.mine and opt.hideHair == true then
                    else
                        local success, result = pcall(entries.hairLift, parent2, head, pulseHatWeld)
                        calculatedValue = success and result or 0
                    end
                    local c0, pulseHatRoot =
                        pulseHatWeld * CFrame.new(0, (opt.lift or 0) + calculatedValue, 0), Instance.new("Part")
                    pulseHatRoot.Name = "PulseHatRoot"
                    pulseHatRoot.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
                    pulseHatRoot.Transparency = 1
                    pulseHatRoot.Anchored = false
                    pulseHatRoot.CanCollide = false
                    pulseHatRoot.CanQuery = false
                    pulseHatRoot.CanTouch = false
                    pulseHatRoot.Massless = true
                    pulseHatRoot.CastShadow = false
                    pulseHatRoot.CFrame = head.CFrame * c0
                    pulseHatWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
                    pulseHatWeld.Name = "PulseHatWeld"
                    pulseHatWeld.Part0 = head
                    pulseHatWeld.Part1 = pulseHatRoot
                    pulseHatWeld.C0 = c0
                    pulseHatWeld.Parent = pulseHatRoot
                    entries.mark(pulseHatRoot, key)
                    pulseHatRoot.Parent = parent2
                    local entries2 = { key = key, opt = opt }
                    entries2.off = opt.off or {}
                    entries2.size = size
                    entries2.ids = {}
                    entries2.links = {}
                    entries2.liftV = Vector3.zero
                    entries2.hatHost = pulseHatRoot
                    entries2.hatK = hatK
                    entries2.hatCrown = hatDefResult.crown or 0.6
                    entries2.hatTune = { size = k, density = opt.density or 1, bright = opt.bright or 1, alpha = opt.alpha
                        or 1 }
                    head = {}
                    for unused, item in ipairs(hatDefResult.h) do
                        for unused, item2 in ipairs(item.k) do
                            size = entries.build(item2, parent2, entries2)
                            if size then
                                head[#head + 1] = size
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for unused, item in ipairs(entries2.links) do
                        local entry = item[1]
                        local entry2 = item[2]
                        local entry3 = item[3]
                        pcall(function()
                            if entry2 then
                                if entries2.ids[entry2] then
                                    entry.Attachment0 = entries2.ids[entry2]
                                end
                            end
                            if entry3 then
                                if entries2.ids[entry3] then
                                    entry.Attachment1 = entries2.ids[entry3]
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    hatDefResult, size = entries.hatDef(key)
                    hatK = {
                        ch = parent2,
                        root = pulseHatRoot,
                        w = pulseHatWeld,
                        base = c0,
                        k = k,
                        key = key,
                        t0 = os.clock(),
                        still = true,
                        col = {},
                        motion = opt.motion or hatDefResult,
                        fx = opt.cfx or size,
                        spd = math.clamp(tonumber(opt.aspd) or 1, 0.1, 3),
                    }
                    if opt.mine then
                        hatK.hide = entries.hideOf({ hideHat = opt.hideHat, hideHair = opt.hideHair })
                    end
                    entries.hatCollect(hatK, head)
                    entries.hats[#entries.hats + 1] = hatK
                    entries.hatLoop()
                end
                entries.put = function(parent2, argument2, key, opt)
                    local entry = (entries.data() or {})[key]
                    if not entry then
                        return
                    end
                    opt = opt or {}
                    if entry.hat then
                        return entries.putHat(parent2, entry, key, opt)
                    end
                    local size = opt.size or 1
                    local calculatedValue = opt.lift or 0
                    local calculatedValue2 = parent2:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil
                    local calculatedValue3, entries2 =
                        calculatedValue2 and entries.fitOf(parent2, argument2) or nil, { key = key, opt = opt }
                    entries2.off = opt.off or {}
                    entries2.size = size
                    entries2.ids = {}
                    entries2.links = {}
                    entries2.liftV = Vector3.zero
                    local handleAction, position, callback5
                    if entry.rig and calculatedValue3 then
                        local upperTorso, head = parent2:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), parent2:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        local calculatedValue4, calculatedValue5 =
                            upperTorso and calculatedValue3.rest[upperTorso], head and calculatedValue3.rest[head]
                        if
                            calculatedValue4
                            and calculatedValue5
                            and calculatedValue5.Position.Y > calculatedValue4.Position.Y + 0.2
                        then
                            local rig = entry.rig
                            local calculatedValue6 = (calculatedValue5.Position.Y - calculatedValue4.Position.Y)
                                / (rig.hy - rig.ty)
                            local clampedValue = math.clamp(upperTorso.Size.X / rig.tx, 0.3, 2.5)
                            local clampedValue2 = math.clamp(upperTorso.Size.Z / rig.tz, 0.3, 2.5)
                            local y = calculatedValue4.Position.Y
                            position = Vector3.new(clampedValue, calculatedValue6, clampedValue2)
                            handleAction = function(argument3)
                                return Vector3.new(
                                    argument3.X * clampedValue,
                                    y + (argument3.Y - rig.ty) * calculatedValue6,
                                    argument3.Z * clampedValue2
                                )
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        callback5 = handleAction
                    else
                        callback5 = handleAction
                    end
                    for instance, item in ipairs(entry.h) do
                        entries2.mapA = nil
                        instance = parent2:FindFirstChild(item.n)
                        local value
                        if
                            instance
                            and instance:IsA("BasePart")
                            and (
                                calculatedValue2 and entries.R15[item.n]
                                or (if calculatedValue2 then not calculatedValue2 else entries.R6[item.n])
                            )
                        then
                            entries2.liftV = instance.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(0, calculatedValue, 0))
                            entries2.fit = instance == argument2 and calculatedValue3 or nil
                            if callback5 then
                                local liftV = entries2.liftV
                                if instance == argument2 then
                                    entries2.mapA = function(argument3)
                                        return callback5(argument3) * size + liftV
                                    end
                                else
                                    local calculatedValue2 = entries.dec(item.s) or instance.Size
                                    local position2 = Vector3.new(
                                        instance.Size.X / math.max(calculatedValue2.X, 0.01),
                                        instance.Size.Y / math.max(calculatedValue2.Y, 0.01),
                                        instance.Size.Z / math.max(calculatedValue2.Z, 0.01)
                                    )
                                    entries2.mapA = function(argument3)
                                        return Vector3.new(
                                            argument3.X * position2.X,
                                            argument3.Y * position2.Y,
                                            argument3.Z * position2.Z
                                        ) * size + liftV
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            value = instance
                        else
                            entries2.liftV = Vector3.zero
                            entries2.fit = nil
                            local calculatedValue4 = entries.dec(item.cf) or CFrame.new()
                            local value2 = calculatedValue4
                            local position2 = calculatedValue4.Position
                            position2 = if callback5
                                then (callback5(position2))
                                else if calculatedValue3
                                    then Vector3.new(
                                        position2.X * calculatedValue3.x,
                                        calculatedValue3.f + (position2.Y + 3) * calculatedValue3.y,
                                        position2.Z * calculatedValue3.z
                                    )
                                    else position2
                            calculatedValue4 = calculatedValue4
                                - calculatedValue4.Position
                                + position2 * size
                                + Vector3.new(0, calculatedValue, 0)
                            if callback5 then
                                local value3 = calculatedValue4
                                entries2.mapA = function(argument3)
                                    local calculatedValue2 = callback5(value2:PointToWorldSpace(argument3)) * size
                                        + Vector3.new(0, calculatedValue, 0)
                                    return value3:PointToObjectSpace(calculatedValue2)
                                end
                            end
                            local pulseAuraHost = Instance.new("Part")
                            pulseAuraHost.Name = "PulseAuraHost"
                            pulseAuraHost.Size = (entries.dec(item.s) or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)) * size
                            if position then
                                pulseAuraHost.Size = Vector3.new(
                                    pulseAuraHost.Size.X * position.X,
                                    pulseAuraHost.Size.Y * position.Y,
                                    pulseAuraHost.Size.Z * position.Z
                                )
                            end
                            pulseAuraHost.Transparency = 1
                            pulseAuraHost.CanCollide = false
                            pulseAuraHost.CanQuery = false
                            pulseAuraHost.CanTouch = false
                            pulseAuraHost.CastShadow = false
                            pulseAuraHost.Massless = true
                            local weld, part0, c0 = calculatedValue3
                                and entries.LIMB[item.n]
                                and parent2:FindFirstChild(entries.LIMB[item.n])
                            if weld then
                                if weld:IsA("BasePart") then
                                    if calculatedValue3.rest[weld] then
                                        local calculatedValue = calculatedValue3.rest[weld]:Inverse() * calculatedValue4
                                        part0, c0 = weld, calculatedValue
                                    else
                                        part0, c0 = argument2, calculatedValue4
                                    end
                                else
                                    part0, c0 = argument2, calculatedValue4

                pulseAuraUI.scrollTo = function()

                pulseAuraUI.layout = function(argument2)
                    if window.Scaling then
                        if window._scalingDefer then
                            window:_scalingDefer(function()
                                pulseAuraUI.layout(false)
                            end)
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    local grid2, drawer2 = pulseAuraUI.grid, pulseAuraUI.drawer
                    local gap, maximumValue = pulseAuraUI.GAP, math.max(window.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
                    local ease = grid2.AbsoluteSize.X / maximumValue
                    if ease < 40 then
                        return
                    end
                    pulseAuraUI.lastW = grid2.AbsoluteSize.X
                    maximumValue = math.clamp(math.floor((ease + gap) / (108 + gap)), 3, 7)
                    local roundedValue = math.floor((ease - gap * (maximumValue - 1)) / maximumValue)
                    local calculatedValue, entries, value = roundedValue + 24, {}
                    for unused, item in ipairs(pulseAuraUI.cards) do
                        if item.show then
                            entries[#entries + 1] = item
                            value = if item.key == pulseAuraUI.editKey
                                then math.floor((#entries - 1) / maximumValue)
                                else value
                        else
                            item.b.Visible = false
                            item.placed = false
                        end
                    end
                    if pulseAuraUI.editKey and not value then
                        ease = pulseAuraUI.editKey
                        pulseAuraUI.editKey = nil
                        for unused, item in ipairs(pulseAuraUI.cards) do
                            if item.key == ease then
                                item.paint()
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    ease = value and pulseAuraUI.drawerH() or 0
                    for key, item in ipairs(entries) do
                        local position, calculatedValue2 = math.floor((key - 1) / maximumValue), (key - 1) % maximumValue
                        key = position * (calculatedValue + gap) + (value and position > value and ease + gap or 0)
                        position = UDim2.fromOffset(calculatedValue2 * (roundedValue + gap), key)
                        item.b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(roundedValue, calculatedValue)
                        if argument2 then
                            if item.placed then
                                tweenInstance(item.b, pulseAuraUI.EASE, { Position = position })
                            else
                                item.b.Position = position
                            end
                        else
                            item.b.Position = position
                        end
                        item.b.Visible = true
                        item.placed = true
                    end
                    roundedValue = math.ceil(#entries / maximumValue)
                    maximumValue = (roundedValue > 0 and roundedValue * (calculatedValue + gap) - gap or 0)
                        + (value and ease + gap or 0)
                    if value then
                        local calculatedValue2, visible = (value + 1) * (calculatedValue + gap), drawer2.Visible
                        drawer2.Visible = true
                        if argument2 and visible then
                            tweenInstance(
                                drawer2,
                                pulseAuraUI.EASE,
                                { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, calculatedValue2), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ease) }
                            )
                        elseif argument2 then
                            drawer2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, calculatedValue2)
                            drawer2.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                            local ease2, entries3 = pulseAuraUI.EASE, {}
                            entries3.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ease)
                            tweenInstance(drawer2, ease2, entries3)
                        else
                            drawer2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, calculatedValue2)
                            drawer2.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ease)
                        end
                    elseif drawer2.Visible then
                        if argument2 then
                            local ease2, entries4 = pulseAuraUI.EASE, {}
                            entries4.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                            tweenInstance(drawer2, ease2, entries4)
                            pulseAuraUI.hideTok = (pulseAuraUI.hideTok or 0) + 1
                            local hideTok = pulseAuraUI.hideTok
                            task.delay(0.35, function()
