                    local entry = featureState.saved[argument2]
                    if entry then
                        if entry[argument3] ~= nil then
                            return entry[argument3]
                        end
                    end
                    local success, result = pcall(function()
                        return argument2[argument3]
                    end)
                    if not success then
                        return nil
                    end
                    entry = entry or {}
                    featureState.saved[argument2] = entry
                    entry[argument3] = { value = result }
                    return entry[argument3]
                end
                featureState.baseline = function(argument2, argument3)
                    local rememberResult = featureState.remember(argument2, argument3)
                    if rememberResult == nil then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local success, result = pcall(function()
                        return argument2[argument3]
                    end)
                    if success then
                        if rememberResult.hasWritten then
                            if result ~= rememberResult.written then
                                rememberResult.value = result
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return rememberResult.value
                end
                featureState.releaseProp = function(argument2, argument3)
                    local entry = featureState.saved[argument2]
                    local calculatedValue = entry and entry[argument3]
                    if calculatedValue == nil then
                        return
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        local value2 = argument2[argument3]
                        if calculatedValue.hasWritten then
                            if value2 ~= calculatedValue.written then
                                calculatedValue.value = value2
                            end
                        end
                        argument2[argument3] = calculatedValue.value
                    end)
                    entry[argument3] = nil
                    if next(entry) == nil then
                        featureState.saved[argument2] = nil
                    end
                end
                featureState.sync = function(argument2, argument3, argument4, written)
                    if argument2 == nil then
                        return
                    end
                    if not argument4 then
                        featureState.releaseProp(argument2, argument3)
                        return
                    end
                    local rememberResult = featureState.remember(argument2, argument3)
                    if rememberResult == nil then
                        return
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        local value2 = argument2[argument3]
                        if rememberResult.hasWritten then
                            if value2 ~= rememberResult.written then
                                rememberResult.value = value2
                            end
                        end
                        rememberResult.written = written
                        rememberResult.hasWritten = true
                        if value2 ~= written then
                            argument2[argument3] = written
                        end
                        rememberResult.written = argument2[argument3]
                    end)
                end
                featureState.drop = function(argument2)
                    local entry = featureState.effects[argument2]
                    featureState.effects[argument2] = nil
                    if entry ~= nil then
                        featureState.owned[entry] = nil
                        pcall(function()
                            entry:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                end
                featureState.ensure = function(argument2, argument3, parent2)
                    local entry = featureState.effects[argument2]
                    if entry ~= nil then
                        if entry.Parent == parent2 then
                            return entry
                        end
                    end
                    featureState.drop(argument2)
                    local success, result = pcall(function()
                        local instance = Instance.new(argument3)
                        featureState.owned[instance] = true
                        featureState.effects[argument2] = instance
                        instance.Name = "PulseVisual_" .. argument2
                        instance.Parent = parent2
                        return instance
                    end)
                    if not success then
                        featureState.drop(argument2)
                        return nil
                    end
                    return result
                end
                featureState.configure = function(argument2, argument3, argument4, argument5)
                    if not argument4 then
                        featureState.drop(argument2)
                        return
                    end
                    local ensureResult = featureState.ensure(argument2, argument3, workspace.CurrentCamera or lighting)
                    if ensureResult == nil then
                        return
                    end
                    for key, item in pairs(argument5) do
                        pcall(function()
                            ensureResult[key] = item
                        end)
                    end
                    ensureResult.Enabled = true
                end
                featureState.ours = function(argument2)
                    local name = argument2.Name
                    return name:sub(1, 5) == "Pulse" or name:sub(1, 4) == "Nova"
                end
                featureState.targets = function(argument2, argument3)
                    local entries, entries2 = {}, {}
                    if argument2 == nil then
                        return entries
                    end
                    for unused, instance in ipairs(argument2:GetChildren()) do
                        if instance:IsA(argument3) then
                            if not featureState.owned[instance] then
                                if not (featureState.ours(instance)) then
                                    entries[#entries + 1] = instance
                                    entries2[instance] = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for instance, item in pairs(featureState.saved) do
                        if not entries2[instance] then
                            if item.Parent then
                                if item.Parent.value == argument2 then
                                    if instance:IsA(argument3) then
                                        entries[#entries + 1] = instance
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return entries
                end
                featureState.prune = function()
                    for key, item in pairs(featureState.saved) do
                        if key.Parent == nil and item.Parent == nil then
                            for key2 in pairs(item) do
                                featureState.releaseProp(key, key2)
                            end
                            featureState.saved[key] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
                featureState.overlay = function()
                    if not featureState.vignetteOn then
                        if featureState.gui then
                            pcall(function()
                                featureState.gui:Destroy()
                            end)
                            featureState.gui = nil
                            featureState.screen = nil
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if featureState.gui == nil or featureState.gui.Parent == nil then
                        local pulseVisualScreen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
                        pulseVisualScreen.Name = "PulseVisualScreen"
                        pulseVisualScreen.ResetOnSpawn = false
                        pulseVisualScreen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                        pulseVisualScreen.DisplayOrder = 5
                        pcall(function()
                            pulseVisualScreen.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None
                        end)
                        pcall(function()
                            pulseVisualScreen.Parent = parent
                        end)
                        if pulseVisualScreen.Parent == nil then
                            pcall(function()
                                pulseVisualScreen.Parent = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                            end)
                        end
                        featureState.gui = pulseVisualScreen
                        local screen = { edges = {} }
                        featureState.screen = screen
                        for index = 1, 4, 1 do
                            local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
                            frame.Name = "Vignette" .. index
                            frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
                            frame.Active = false
                            frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                            frame.Parent = pulseVisualScreen
                            local uiGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                            uiGradient.Rotation = ({ 90, 270, 0, 180 })[index]
                            uiGradient.Parent = frame
                            screen.edges[index] = { frame = frame, gradient = uiGradient }
                        end
                        screen.edges[1].frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.28)
                        screen.edges[2].frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.28)
                        screen.edges[2].frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.72)
                        screen.edges[3].frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.23, 1)
                        screen.edges[4].frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.23, 1)
                        screen.edges[4].frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.77, 0)
                    end
                    for unused, item in ipairs(featureState.screen.edges) do
                        item.frame.Visible = true
                        item.gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1 - math.clamp(featureState.vignette / 100, 0, 0.8)),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                        })
                    end
                end
                featureState.apply = function()
                    if featureState.on then
                        if featureState.applying then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    featureState.applying = true
                    local success, result = pcall(function()
                        featureState.prune()
                        local entry
                        if featureState.tech ~= "Game" then
                            pcall(function()
                                entry = Enum.Technology[featureState.tech]
                            end)
                        end
                        featureState.sync(lighting, "Technology", entry ~= nil, entry)
                        local terrain = featureState.brightOn
                        local ambientOn = if terrain then not terrain else featureState.brightScale ~= 1
                        terrain = ambientOn and featureState.baseline(lighting, "Brightness")
                        featureState.sync(
                            lighting,
                            "Brightness",
                            featureState.brightOn or ambientOn,
                            featureState.brightOn and featureState.bright
                                or (tonumber(terrain) or 3) * featureState.brightScale
                        )
                        featureState.sync(lighting, "ClockTime", featureState.timeOn, featureState.time % 24)
                        local clampedValue = math.clamp(tonumber(featureState.ambientLift) or 0, 0, 1)
                        local calculatedValue = tonumber(featureState.ambientScale) or 1
                        local calculatedValue2 = typeof(featureState.ambientTint) == "Color3" and featureState.ambientTint
                            or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        ambientOn = featureState.ambientOn
                        local packedValues, fromRGBResult =
                            if ambientOn
                                then not ambientOn
                                else clampedValue > 0 or calculatedValue ~= 1 or calculatedValue2 ~= Color3.new(
                                    1,
                                    1,
                                    1
                                ),
                            Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
                        ambientOn, terrain =
                            packedValues and featureState.baseline(lighting, "Ambient"),
                            packedValues and featureState.baseline(lighting, "OutdoorAmbient")
                        local function clampedValue2(color)
                            local color2 = typeof(color) == "Color3" and color or fromRGBResult
                            color2 = Color3.new(
                                math.clamp(color2.R * calculatedValue * calculatedValue2.R, 0, 1),
                                math.clamp(color2.G * calculatedValue * calculatedValue2.G, 0, 1),
                                math.clamp(color2.B * calculatedValue * calculatedValue2.B, 0, 1)
                            )
                            color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                            return color2:Lerp(color, clampedValue)
                        end
                        featureState.sync(
                            lighting,
                            "Ambient",
                            featureState.ambientOn or packedValues,
                            featureState.ambientOn and featureState.ambient or clampedValue2(ambientOn)
                        )
                        featureState.sync(
                            lighting,
                            "OutdoorAmbient",
                            featureState.ambientOn or packedValues,
                            featureState.ambientOn and featureState.outdoorAmbient or clampedValue2(terrain)
                        )
                        featureState.sync(lighting, "ExposureCompensation", featureState.exposureOn, featureState.exposure)
                        featureState.sync(lighting, "GlobalShadows", featureState.noShadows, false)
                        featureState.sync(
                            lighting,
                            "ShadowSoftness",
                            featureState.shadowSoftOn,
                            featureState.shadowSoftness
                        )
                        featureState.sync(lighting, "EnvironmentDiffuseScale", featureState.envOn, featureState.envDiffuse)
                        featureState.sync(
                            lighting,
                            "EnvironmentSpecularScale",
                            featureState.envOn,
                            featureState.envSpecular
                        )
                        featureState.sync(lighting, "ColorShift_Top", featureState.shiftOn, featureState.shiftTop)
                        featureState.sync(lighting, "ColorShift_Bottom", featureState.shiftOn, featureState.shiftBottom)
                        featureState.sync(
                            lighting,
                            "FogStart",
                            featureState.fogOn,
                            math.clamp(featureState.fogStart, 0, 1999)
                        )
                        featureState.sync(
                            lighting,
                            "FogEnd",
                            featureState.fogOn,
                            math.clamp(math.max(featureState.fogEnd, featureState.fogStart + 1), 1, 2000)
                        )
                        featureState.sync(lighting, "FogColor", featureState.fogOn, featureState.fogColour)
                        terrain, packedValues = ipairs, { lighting, workspace.CurrentCamera }
                        for unused, item in terrain(packedValues) do
                            for unused, item2 in ipairs(featureState.targets(item, "PostEffect")) do
                                featureState.sync(item2, "Enabled", featureState.noPost, false)
                            end
                        end
                        local default = Enum.TonemapperPreset.Default
                        if featureState.toneOn then
                            pcall(function()
                                default = Enum.TonemapperPreset[featureState.tone] or default
                            end)
                        end
                        clampedValue2, terrain = ipairs, { lighting, workspace.CurrentCamera }
                        for unused, item in clampedValue2(terrain) do
                            ambientOn, packedValues = ipairs, packValues(featureState.targets(item, "ColorGradingEffect"))
                            for unused, item in ambientOn(unpackTuple(packedValues)) do
                                featureState.sync(item, "TonemapperPreset", true, default)
                            end
                        end
                        packedValues, terrain =
                            featureState.atmosphereOn and not featureState.noAtmosphere and not featureState.fogOn,
                            featureState.targets(lighting, "Atmosphere")
                        if packedValues then
                            if #terrain == 0 then
                                clampedValue2 = featureState.ensure("Air", "Atmosphere", lighting)
                                if clampedValue2 then
                                    terrain[1] = clampedValue2
                                end
                            else
                                featureState.drop("Air")
                            end
                        else
                            featureState.drop("Air")
                        end
                        for key, item in ipairs(terrain) do
                            if not featureState.owned[item] then
                                featureState.sync(item, "Parent", featureState.noAtmosphere or featureState.fogOn, nil)
                            end
                            ambientOn, clampedValue2, key =
                                (if packedValues then not packedValues else not featureState.owned[item])
                                    and featureState.airScale ~= 1,
                                pairs,
                                {
                                    Density = featureState.density,
                                    Offset = featureState.offset,
                                    Haze = featureState.haze,
                                    Glare = featureState.glare,
                                    Color = featureState.atmosphereColour,
                                    Decay = featureState.decay,
                                }
                            for key2, item2 in clampedValue2(key) do
                                if featureState.owned[item] then
                                    item[key2] = item2
                                elseif key2 == "Density" then
                                    if ambientOn then
                                        featureState.sync(
                                            item,
                                            key2,
                                            true,
                                            (tonumber(featureState.baseline(item, key2)) or featureState.density)
                                                * featureState.airScale
                                        )
                                    else
                                        featureState.sync(item, key2, packedValues, item2)
                                    end
                                else
                                    featureState.sync(item, key2, packedValues, item2)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        ambientOn = isActive and isActive()
                        packedValues = not ambientOn
                        local configure, calculatedValue3, gradeOn =
                            (if ambientOn then packedValues else featureState.skies[featureState.skybox]) or nil,
                            featureState.skyOn and packedValues,
                            featureState.targets(lighting, "Sky")
                        if calculatedValue3 or configure then
                            if #gradeOn == 0 then
                                terrain = featureState.ensure("Sky", "Sky", lighting)
                                if terrain then
                                    gradeOn[1] = terrain
                                end
                            else
                                featureState.drop("Sky")
                            end
                        else
                            featureState.drop("Sky")
                        end
                        for unused, item in ipairs(gradeOn) do
                            ambientOn, clampedValue2 =
                                pairs,
                                {
                                    StarCount = featureState.stars,
                                    SunAngularSize = featureState.sunSize,
                                    MoonAngularSize = featureState.moonSize,
                                    CelestialBodiesShown = featureState.celestial,
                                }
                            for key, item2 in ambientOn(clampedValue2) do
                                if featureState.owned[item] then
                                    item[key] = item2
                                else
                                    featureState.sync(item, key, calculatedValue3, item2)
                                end
                            end
                            for unused, item2 in ipairs(featureState.skyProps) do
                                terrain = configure and configure[item2]
                                if featureState.owned[item] then
                                    if terrain then
                                        item[item2] = terrain
                                    end
                                else
                                    featureState.sync(item, item2, terrain ~= nil, terrain)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if not featureState.lampShadows then
                            for key, item in pairs(featureState.saved) do
                                if item.Shadows ~= nil then
                                    featureState.releaseProp(key, "Shadows")
                                end
                            end
                            featureState.lights = nil
                            featureState.lightRoots = nil
                        end
                        terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
                        configure = featureState.targets(terrain, "Clouds")
                        if featureState.cloudsOn and terrain then
                            if #configure == 0 then
                                gradeOn = featureState.ensure("Clouds", "Clouds", terrain)
                                if gradeOn then
                                    configure[1] = gradeOn
                                end
                            else
                                featureState.drop("Clouds")
                            end
                        else
                            featureState.drop("Clouds")
                        end
                        for unused, item in ipairs(configure) do
                            terrain, packedValues =
                                pairs,
                                {
                                    Cover = featureState.cloudCover,
                                    Density = featureState.cloudDensity,
                                    Color = featureState.cloudColour,
                                    Enabled = true,
                                }
                            for key, item2 in terrain(packedValues) do
                                if featureState.owned[item] then
                                    item[key] = item2
                                else
                                    featureState.sync(item, key, featureState.cloudsOn, item2)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        clampedValue2, calculatedValue3 =
                            math.clamp(featureState.strength / 100, 0, 1), featureState.quality == "Full"
                        configure, gradeOn, packedValues =
                            featureState.configure,
                            featureState.gradeOn,
                            {
                                Brightness = featureState.gradeBrightness * clampedValue2,
                                Contrast = featureState.contrast * clampedValue2,
                                Saturation = featureState.saturation * clampedValue2,
                            }
                        packedValues.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(featureState.tint, clampedValue2)
                        configure("Color", "ColorCorrectionEffect", gradeOn, packedValues)
                        featureState.configure(
                            "Bloom",
                            "BloomEffect",
                            featureState.bloomOn,
                            {
                                Intensity = featureState.bloomIntensity * clampedValue2,
                                Size = featureState.bloomSize,
                                Threshold = featureState.bloomThreshold,
                            }
                        )
                        featureState.configure(
                            "Rays",
                            "SunRaysEffect",
                            featureState.raysOn and calculatedValue3,
                            { Intensity = featureState.raysIntensity * clampedValue2, Spread = featureState.raysSpread }
                        )
                        if featureState.toneOn then
                            local tonemapperPreset
                            pcall(function()
                                tonemapperPreset = Enum.TonemapperPreset[featureState.tone]
                            end)
                            if tonemapperPreset then
                                featureState.configure(
                                    "Tone",
                                    "ColorGradingEffect",
                                    true,
                                    { TonemapperPreset = tonemapperPreset }
                                )
                            end
                        else
                            featureState.drop("Tone")
                        end
                        featureState.sync(lighting, "GeographicLatitude", featureState.latOn, featureState.lat)
                        featureState.configure(
                            "DOF",
                            "DepthOfFieldEffect",
                            featureState.dofOn and calculatedValue3,
                            {
                                FarIntensity = featureState.dofFar * clampedValue2,
                                FocusDistance = featureState.dofFocus,
                                InFocusRadius = featureState.dofRadius,
                                NearIntensity = 0,
                            }
                        )
                        pcall(featureState.setMaterials, featureState.mats or "Game")
                        pcall(featureState.lampApply)
                        featureState.overlay()
                    end)
                    featureState.applying = false
                    if not success then
                        warn("[Qwern] shaders: " .. tostring(result))
                    end
                end
                featureState.mapRoots = function()
                    local entries, players = {}, game:GetService("Players")
                    for unused, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                        if
                            instance.ClassName == "Model"
                            and (instance:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") or string.find(instance.Name, "Lobby", 1, true))
                        then
                            if not (players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(instance)) then
                                entries[#entries + 1] = instance
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return entries
                end
                featureState.castShadows = function()
                    if not featureState.lampShadows then
                        return
                    end
                    local lightRoots = featureState.mapRoots()
                    local enabled = featureState.lightRoots ~= nil and #featureState.lightRoots == #lightRoots
                    if enabled then
                        for key, item in ipairs(lightRoots) do
                            if featureState.lightRoots[key] ~= item then
                                enabled = false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    local now = os.clock()
                    if if enabled then now > (featureState.lightScanAt or 0) else not enabled then
                        featureState.lightScanAt = enabled and math.huge or now + 5
                        featureState.lightRoots = lightRoots
                        featureState.lights = {}
                        for unused, item in ipairs(lightRoots) do
                            for className, item2 in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                                className = item2.ClassName
                                if className == "PointLight" or className == "SpotLight" or className == "SurfaceLight" then
                                    featureState.lights[#featureState.lights + 1] = item2
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for unused, item in ipairs(featureState.lights or {}) do
                        if item.Parent then
                            if not item.Shadows then
                                featureState.sync(item, "Shadows", true, true)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                featureState.request = function()
                    if featureState.batch then
                        return
                    elseif featureState.uiSyncing then
                        return
                    elseif featureState.queued then
                        return
                    end
                    featureState.queued = true
                    local epoch = featureState.epoch
                    task.defer(function()
                        if epoch ~= featureState.epoch then
                            return
                        end
                        featureState.queued = false
                        if pAlive() then
                            if featureState.on then
                                featureState.apply()
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                featureState.disconnect = function(argument2)
                    for unused, item in ipairs(argument2) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end
                    table.clear(argument2)
                end
                featureState.watchCamera = function()
                    featureState.disconnect(featureState.cameraConns)
                    local watchedCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if featureState.watchedCamera and featureState.watchedCamera ~= watchedCamera then
                        for unused, item in ipairs(featureState.targets(featureState.watchedCamera, "PostEffect")) do
                            featureState.releaseProp(item, "Enabled")
                        end
                    end
                    featureState.watchedCamera = watchedCamera
                    if watchedCamera then
                        featureState.cameraConns[1] = connectSignal(watchedCamera.ChildAdded, function(argument2)
                            if not featureState.owned[argument2] then
                                featureState.request()
                            end
                        end, true)
                    end
                    featureState.request()
                end
                featureState.watch = function()
                    if featureState.watching then
                        return
                    end
                    featureState.watching = true
                    featureState.conns[#featureState.conns + 1] =
                        connectSignal(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"), featureState.watchCamera, true)
                    featureState.conns[#featureState.conns + 1] = connectSignal(lighting.ChildAdded, function(argument2)
                        if not featureState.applying then
                            if not featureState.owned[argument2] then
                                featureState.request()
                            end
                        end
                    end, true)
                    featureState.conns[#featureState.conns + 1] = connectSignal(lighting.Changed, function(argument2)
                        if featureState.applying then
                            return
                        elseif not featureState.on then
                            return
                        end
                        local entry = featureState.saved[lighting]
                        if entry then
                            if entry[argument2] then
                                local success, result = pcall(function()
                                    return lighting[argument2]
                                end)
                                local entry2, entry3 = entry[argument2]
                                if success then
                                    local hasWritten = entry2.hasWritten
                                    entry3 = if hasWritten then result ~= entry2.written else not hasWritten
                                else
                                    entry3 = success
                                end
                                if entry3 then
                                    entry2.value = result
                                    featureState.request()
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end, true)
                    featureState.watchCamera()
                end
                featureState.unwatch = function()
                    featureState.epoch = featureState.epoch + 1
                    featureState.queued = false
                    featureState.disconnect(featureState.conns)
                    featureState.disconnect(featureState.cameraConns)
                    featureState.watching = false
                    featureState.watchedCamera = nil
                end
                featureState.restore = function()
                    featureState.applying = true
                    for key, item in pairs(featureState.saved) do
                        for key2 in pairs(item) do
                            featureState.releaseProp(key, key2)
                        end
                    end
                    table.clear(featureState.saved)
                    local entries = {}
                    for key in pairs(featureState.effects) do
                        entries[#entries + 1] = key
                    end
                    for unused, item in ipairs(entries) do
                        featureState.drop(item)
                    end
                    if featureState.gui then
                        pcall(function()
                            featureState.gui:Destroy()
                        end)
                        featureState.gui = nil
                        featureState.screen = nil
                    end
                    featureState.lights = nil
                    featureState.lightRoots = nil
                    for unused, item in pairs(featureState.neonLights or {}) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    featureState.neonLights = {}
                    pcall(function()
                        featureState.setMaterials("Game")
                    end)
                    featureState.applying = false
                end
                featureState.setEnabled = function(argument2)
                    if argument2 == true then
                        if not (pAlive()) then
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    featureState.on = argument2 == true
                    getgenv().__pulseVisOwns = featureState.on
                    if featureState.paintChips then
                        pcall(featureState.paintChips)
                    end
                    if featureState.on then
                        featureState.watch()
                        featureState.request()
                    else
                        featureState.unwatch()
                        featureState.restore()
                    end
                end
                featureState.presetNames = function()
                    local entries = { "Original" }
                    for unused, item in ipairs(featureState.order) do
                        entries[#entries + 1] = item
                    end
                    return entries
                end
                featureState.syncUI = function()
                    local uiSyncing = featureState.uiSyncing
                    featureState.uiSyncing = true
                    for key, item in pairs(featureState.controls) do
                        if featureState[key] ~= nil then
                            pcall(function()
                                if item.SetSilent then
                                    item.SetSilent(featureState[key])
                                else
                                    item.Set(featureState[key])
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    featureState.uiSyncing = uiSyncing
                end
                featureState.resetLook = function()
                    featureState.batch = true
                    featureState.setEnabled(false)
                    for key, item in pairs(featureState.defaults) do
                        featureState[key] = item
                    end
                    featureState.preset = "Original"
                    settings.visuals = settings.visuals or {}
                    settings.visuals.look = featureState.preset
                    featureState.syncUI()
                    if featureState.paintChips then
                        pcall(featureState.paintChips)
                    end
                    featureState.batch = false
                end
                featureState.applyPreset = function(look)
                    if look == "Original" then
                        featureState.resetLook()
                        return
                    end
                    local value2
                    for unused, item in ipairs(featureState.looks) do
                        if item.name == look then
                            value2 = item
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if value2 == nil then
                        return
                    end
                    featureState.batch = true
                    local featureState2 = { on = true, preset = true, quality = true, strength = true, tech = true }
                    for key, item in pairs(featureState.defaults) do
                        if not featureState2[key] then
                            featureState[key] = item
                        end
                    end
                    for key, item in pairs(value2.values) do
                        featureState[key] = item
                    end
                    featureState.preset = look
                    featureState.on = true
                    settings.visuals = settings.visuals or {}
                    settings.visuals.look = look
                    featureState.syncUI()
                    if featureState.paintChips then
                        pcall(featureState.paintChips)
                    end
                    featureState.batch = false
                    featureState.setEnabled(true)
                end
                preferences.visSnap = function()
                    local entries = {}
                    for key in pairs(featureState.defaults) do
                        local entry = featureState[key]
                        local valueType = typeof(entry)
                        if valueType == "Color3" then
                            entries[key] = {
                                c3 = {
                                    math.floor(entry.R * 1000000 + 0.5) / 1000000,
                                    math.floor(entry.G * 1000000 + 0.5) / 1000000,
                                    math.floor(entry.B * 1000000 + 0.5) / 1000000,
                                },
                            }
                        elseif valueType == "number" then
                            entries[key] = entry
                        elseif valueType == "string" then
                            entries[key] = entry
                        elseif valueType == "boolean" then
                            entries[key] = entry
                        end
                    end
                    return entries
                end
                preferences.visLook = function(look)
                    look = if type(look) ~= "string"
                        then "Original"
                        else if look == "Original"
                            then look
                            else if featureState.swatch[look] then look else "Original"
                    featureState.preset = look
                    settings.visuals = settings.visuals or {}

                end

                featureState.setMaterials = function(argument2)
                    if argument2 == featureState.matSet then
                        return
                    end
                    for key, item in pairs(featureState.matPrev) do
                        pcall(function()
                            materialService:SetBaseMaterialOverride(Enum.Material[key], item)
                        end)

                        pcall(function()
                            item:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    featureState.matMade = {}
                    local entry = entries[argument2]
                    if entry then
                        for key, item in pairs(entry) do
                            pcall(function()
                                local materialVariant = Instance.new("MaterialVariant")
                                materialVariant.Name = "PulseHD_" .. key
                                materialVariant.BaseMaterial = Enum.Material[key]
                                if item[1] ~= "" then
                                    materialVariant.ColorMap = "rbxassetid://" .. item[1]
                                end
                                if item[2] ~= "" then
                                    materialVariant.NormalMap = "rbxassetid://" .. item[2]
                                end
                                if item[3] ~= "" then
                                    materialVariant.RoughnessMap = "rbxassetid://" .. item[3]
                                end
                                if item[4] ~= "" then
                                    materialVariant.MetalnessMap = "rbxassetid://" .. item[4]
                                end
                                materialVariant.StudsPerTile = item[5]
                                materialVariant.Parent = materialService
                                featureState.matMade[#featureState.matMade + 1] = materialVariant
                                featureState.matPrev[key] = materialService:GetBaseMaterialOverride(Enum.Material[key])
                                materialService:SetBaseMaterialOverride(Enum.Material[key], materialVariant.Name)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    featureState.matSet = entry and argument2 or "Game"
                end
                featureState.neonLights = {}
                featureState.lampScan = function()
                    local lampRoots = featureState.mapRoots()
                    local enabled = featureState.lampRoots ~= nil and #featureState.lampRoots == #lampRoots
                    if enabled then
                        for key, item in ipairs(lampRoots) do
                            if featureState.lampRoots[key] ~= item then
                                enabled = false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    local now = os.clock()
                    if enabled then
                        if now < (featureState.lampScanAt or 0) then
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    featureState.lampScanAt = now + (enabled and 30 or 5)
                    featureState.lampRoots = lampRoots
                    featureState.lamps = {}
                    featureState.neons = {}
                    for unused, item in ipairs(lampRoots) do
                        for className, instance in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                            className = instance.ClassName
                            if className == "PointLight" or className == "SpotLight" or className == "SurfaceLight" then
                                if not featureState.owned[instance] then
                                    if instance.Name ~= "PulseNeonGlow" then
                                        featureState.lamps[#featureState.lamps + 1] = instance
                                    end
                                end
                            elseif instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                if instance.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
                                    if instance.Transparency < 0.6 then
                                        featureState.neons[#featureState.neons + 1] = instance
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                featureState.lampApply = function()
                    local parent2 = tonumber(featureState.lampBoost) or 1
                    local neonLights = featureState.on and math.abs(parent2 - 1) > 0.01
                    if neonLights then
                        pcall(featureState.lampScan)
                    elseif featureState.on then
                        if featureState.neonGlow then
                            pcall(featureState.lampScan)
                        end
                    end
                    for key, item in ipairs(featureState.lamps or {}) do
                        if item.Parent then
                            key = neonLights and featureState.baseline(item, "Brightness")
                            featureState.sync(item, "Brightness", neonLights, (tonumber(key) or 1) * parent2)
                            local calculatedValue = neonLights and featureState.baseline(item, "Range")
                            featureState.sync(
                                item,
                                "Range",
                                neonLights,
                                math.min(60, (tonumber(calculatedValue) or 8) * (1 + (parent2 - 1) * 0.5))
                            )
                        end
                    end
                    for key, item in pairs(featureState.neonLights) do
                        parent2 = key.Parent
                        if if parent2 then not item.Parent else not parent2 then
                            pcall(function()
                                item:Destroy()
                            end)
                            featureState.neonLights[key] = nil
                        end
                    end
                    if featureState.on and featureState.neonGlow then
                        local counter, callback5 = 0, pairs
                        neonLights = featureState.neonLights
                        for unused in callback5(neonLights) do
                            counter += 1
                        end
                        parent2, callback5 = ipairs, featureState.neons or {}
                        for size, parent3 in parent2(callback5) do
                            if counter >= 90 then
                                break
                            end
                            if parent3.Parent and not featureState.neonLights[parent3] then
                                size = parent3.Size
                                local maximumValue = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
                                if maximumValue >= 0.8 then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        local pulseNeonGlow = Instance.new("PointLight")
                                        pulseNeonGlow.Name = "PulseNeonGlow"
                                        pulseNeonGlow.Color = parent3.Color
                                        pulseNeonGlow.Brightness = 1.4
                                        pulseNeonGlow.Range = math.clamp(maximumValue * 1.6, 6, 18)
                                        pulseNeonGlow.Shadows = false
                                        pulseNeonGlow.Parent = parent3
                                        featureState.owned[pulseNeonGlow] = true
                                        featureState.neonLights[parent3] = pulseNeonGlow
                                        counter += 1
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        for key, item in pairs(featureState.neonLights) do
                            pcall(function()
                                item:Destroy()
                            end)
                            featureState.neonLights[key] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end

                    "Off",

                pulseTexPack.decode = function(argument2)
                    local callback5, entries =
                        ipairs, { crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode }
                    for unused, item in callback5(entries) do
                        if type(item) == "function" then
                            local success, result = pcall(item, argument2)
                            if success then
                                if type(result) == "string" then
                                    if #result > 0 then
                                        return result
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    entries = {}
                    for index = 1, 64, 1 do
                        entries[string.byte("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", index)] = index
                            - 1
                    end
                    local entries2, counter = {}, 0
                    for index = 1, #argument2 - 3, 4 do
                        local byteResult, byteResult2, byteResult3, byteResult4 = string.byte(argument2, index, index + 3)
                        index = (entries[byteResult] or 0) * 262144
                            + (entries[byteResult2] or 0) * 4096
                            + (entries[byteResult3] or 0) * 64
                            + (entries[byteResult4] or 0)
                        callback5, byteResult, byteResult2 =
                            math.floor(index / 65536) % 256, math.floor(index / 256) % 256, index % 256
                        counter += 1
                        if byteResult3 == 61 then
                            entries2[counter] = string.char(callback5)
                        elseif byteResult4 == 61 then
                            entries2[counter] = string.char(callback5, byteResult)
                        else
                            entries2[counter] = string.char(callback5, byteResult, byteResult2)
                        end
                    end
                    return table.concat(entries2)
                end
                pulseTexPack.asset = function(argument2, argument3)
                    local calculatedValue = argument2 .. "/" .. argument3
                    if pulseTexPack.assets[calculatedValue] then
                        return pulseTexPack.assets[calculatedValue]
                    end
                    local entry = pulseTexPack.PACKS[argument2]
                    if entry and (pulseTexPack.TEX[argument2] and pulseTexPack.TEX[argument2][argument3]) then
                        if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
                            return nil
                        elseif type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
                            return nil
                        end
                    else
                        return nil
                    end
                    local calculatedValue2 = "PulseHub/texpack/"
                        .. string.lower(argument2)
                        .. "_"
                        .. argument3
                        .. "_v1."
                        .. entry.ext
                    pcall(function()
                        if type(isfolder) == "function" then
                            if not (isfolder("PulseHub")) then
                                makefolder("PulseHub")
                            end
                            if not (isfolder("PulseHub/texpack")) then
                                makefolder("PulseHub/texpack")
                            end
                        end
                        if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(calculatedValue2)) then
                            local pulseData = getgenv().__pulseData
                            if argument3 ~= entry.icon and type(isfile) == "function" then
                                pulseTexPack.pre = pulseTexPack.pre or {}
                                if not pulseTexPack.pre[argument2] then
                                    pulseTexPack.pre[argument2] = true
                                    local entries = {}
                                    for key in pairs(pulseTexPack.TEX[argument2]) do
                                        if key ~= argument3 then
                                            if key ~= entry.icon then
                                                if
                                                    not (
                                                        isfile(
                                                            "PulseHub/texpack/"
                                                                .. string.lower(argument2)
                                                                .. "_"
                                                                .. key
                                                                .. "_v1."
                                                                .. entry.ext
                                                        )
                                                    )
                                                then
                                                    entries[#entries + 1] = "tex_" .. argument2 .. "_" .. key
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    pulseData.prefetch(entries)
                                end
                            end
                            local takeResult = pulseData.take("tex_" .. argument2 .. "_" .. argument3)
                            if takeResult then
                                writefile(calculatedValue2, pulseTexPack.decode(takeResult))
                            end
                        end
                        local getcustomassetResult = getcustomasset(calculatedValue2)
                        if type(getcustomassetResult) == "string" then
                            if #getcustomassetResult > 0 then
                                pulseTexPack.assets[calculatedValue] = getcustomassetResult
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    return pulseTexPack.assets[calculatedValue]
                end
                pulseTexPack.variant = function(colorMap, argument2, argument3)
                    local materialVariant = pulseTexPack.made[colorMap]
                    if materialVariant and materialVariant.Parent then
                    else
                        materialVariant = Instance.new("MaterialVariant")
                        materialVariant.Name = "PulseTP_" .. colorMap.Name
                        materialVariant.BaseMaterial = colorMap
                        materialVariant.Parent = pulseTexPack.MS
                        pulseTexPack.made[colorMap] = materialVariant
                    end
                    colorMap = pulseTexPack.asset(pulseTexPack.cfg.pack, argument2)
                    if colorMap then
                        if materialVariant.ColorMap ~= colorMap then
                            materialVariant.ColorMap = colorMap
                        end
                    end
                    materialVariant:SetAttribute("PulseKey", argument2)
                    materialVariant.StudsPerTile =
                        math.clamp((tonumber(pulseTexPack.cfg.scale) or 4) * (argument3.tile[argument2] or 1), 0.5, 32)
                    return materialVariant
                end
                pulseTexPack.eligible = function(instance)
                    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                        if instance:IsA("Terrain") then
                            return false
                        end
                    else
                        return false
                    end
                    if instance.Transparency >= 0.95 then
                        return false
                    elseif instance.MaterialVariant ~= "" then
                        return false
                    end
                    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if camera then
                        if instance:IsDescendantOf(camera) then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                    if string.sub(instance.Name, 1, 5) == "Pulse" then
                        return false
                    end
                    if instance:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        if instance.TextureID ~= "" then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                    camera = instance.Parent
                    while camera and camera ~= workspace do
                        if camera:IsA("Model") then
                            if camera:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                        if camera:IsA("Tool") then
                            return false
                        elseif camera:IsA("Accessory") then
                            return false
                        elseif camera.Name == "CoinContainer" then
                            return false
                        elseif string.sub(camera.Name, 1, 5) == "Pulse" then
                            return false
                        end
                        camera = camera.Parent
                    end
                    return true
                end
                pulseTexPack.applyPart = function(argument2, argument3)
                    if pulseTexPack.parts[argument2] then
                        return
                    end
                    local entry = argument3.map[argument2.Material.Name]
                    if entry then
                        if not (pulseTexPack.eligible(argument2)) then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    local entry2 = pulseTexPack.made[argument2.Material]
                    entry2 = if entry2 and entry2.Parent
                        then entry2
                        else pulseTexPack.variant(argument2.Material, entry, argument3)
                    local entries = { mat = argument2.Material, color = argument2.Color }
                    pulseTexPack.parts[argument2] = entries
                    argument2.MaterialVariant = entry2.Name
                    if pulseTexPack.cfg.mcColors then
                        if argument3.neutral[entry] then
                            argument2.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        end
                    end
                end
                pulseTexPack.restorePart = function(argument2, argument3)
                    pcall(function()
                        if argument2.Parent then
                            if string.sub(argument2.MaterialVariant, 1, 8) == "PulseTP_" then
                                argument2.MaterialVariant = ""
                            end
                            argument2.Color = argument3.color
                        end
                    end)
                end
                pulseTexPack.clear = function()
                    pulseTexPack.gen = (pulseTexPack.gen or 0) + 1
                    table.clear(pulseTexPack.queue)
                    for key, item in pairs(pulseTexPack.parts) do
                        pulseTexPack.restorePart(key, item)
                    end
                    pulseTexPack.parts = {}
                    for unused, item in pairs(pulseTexPack.made) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    pulseTexPack.made = {}
                    if pulseTexPack.oldUse ~= nil then
                        pcall(function()
                            pulseTexPack.MS.Use2022Materials = pulseTexPack.oldUse
                        end)
                        pulseTexPack.oldUse = nil
                    end
                end
                pulseTexPack.apply = function()
                    pulseTexPack.last = pulseTexPack.cfg.pack
                    pulseTexPack.clear()
                    local entry = pulseTexPack.PACKS[pulseTexPack.cfg.pack]
                    if not entry then
                        return
                    end
                    if pulseTexPack.oldUse == nil then
                        pulseTexPack.oldUse = pulseTexPack.MS.Use2022Materials
                        pcall(function()
                            pulseTexPack.MS.Use2022Materials = true
                        end)
                    end
                    local gen = pulseTexPack.gen
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local instances = workspace:GetDescendants()
                        local count = #instances
                        for index = 1, count, 1 do
                            if pulseTexPack.gen ~= gen then
                                return
                            elseif not (pAlive()) then
                                return
                            end
                            local instance = instances[index]
                            if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                pcall(pulseTexPack.applyPart, instance, entry)
                            end
                            if index % 600 == 0 then
                                task.wait()
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                pulseTexPack.refreshColors = function()
                    local entry = pulseTexPack.PACKS[pulseTexPack.cfg.pack]
                    if not entry then
                        return
                    end
                    for key, item in pairs(pulseTexPack.parts) do
                        pcall(function()
                            if key.Parent then
                                local entry2 = entry.map[item.mat.Name]
                                if pulseTexPack.cfg.mcColors then
                                    if entry2 then
                                        if entry.neutral[entry2] then
                                            key.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                                        else
                                            key.Color = item.color
                                        end
                                    else
                                        key.Color = item.color
                                    end
                                else
                                    key.Color = item.color
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
                pulseTexPack.rescale = function()
                    local entry = pulseTexPack.PACKS[pulseTexPack.cfg.pack]
                    if not entry then
                        return
                    end
                    for unused, item in pairs(pulseTexPack.made) do
                        pcall(function()
                            local pulseKey = item:GetAttribute("PulseKey")
                            item.StudsPerTile =
                                math.clamp((tonumber(pulseTexPack.cfg.scale) or 4) * (entry.tile[pulseKey] or 1), 0.5, 32)
                        end)
                    end
                end
                connectSignal(workspace.DescendantAdded, function(instance)
                    if pulseTexPack.cfg.pack ~= "Off" then
                        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                            pulseTexPack.queue[#pulseTexPack.queue + 1] = instance
                        end
                    end
                end)
                connectSignal(game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat, function()
                    if #pulseTexPack.queue == 0 then
                        return
                    end
                    local entry = pulseTexPack.PACKS[pulseTexPack.cfg.pack]
                    if not entry then
                        table.clear(pulseTexPack.queue)
                        return
                    end
                    local counter = 0
                    while #pulseTexPack.queue > 0 and counter < 300 do
                        local removeResult = table.remove(pulseTexPack.queue)
                        counter += 1
                        if removeResult then
                            if removeResult.Parent then
                                pcall(pulseTexPack.applyPart, removeResult, entry)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if os.clock() - (pulseTexPack.pruneAt or 0) > 5 then
                        pulseTexPack.pruneAt = os.clock()
                        for key in pairs(pulseTexPack.parts) do
                            if not key.Parent then
                                pulseTexPack.parts[key] = nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                callback2(function()
                    pcall(pulseTexPack.clear)
