                pulseWeather.grades = {
                    Snow = { tint = Color3.fromRGB(228, 240, 255), saturation = -0.14, contrast = 0.04, brightness = 0.02 },
                    Fireflies = { tint = Color3.fromRGB(205, 218, 255), saturation = -0.08, contrast = 0.05, brightness = -0.05 },
                    Embers = { tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 198), saturation = 0.05, contrast = 0.06, brightness = -0.02 },
                    Ash = { tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 205), saturation = -0.25, contrast = 0.06, brightness = -0.04 },
                }
                pulseWeather.number = function(numberValue, argument2, argument3, argument4)
                    numberValue = tonumber(numberValue)
                    numberValue = if numberValue == nil
                        then argument2
                        else if numberValue ~= numberValue
                            then argument2
                            else if numberValue == math.huge
                                then argument2
                                else if numberValue == -math.huge then argument2 else numberValue
                    return math.clamp(numberValue, argument3, argument4)
                end
                pulseWeather.validate = function()
                    if pulseWeather.recipes[pulseWeather.kind] == nil then
                        pulseWeather.kind = "Snow"
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.qualities[pulseWeather.quality] == nil then
                        pulseWeather.quality = "Balanced"
                    end
                    for key, item in pairs(pulseWeather.limits) do
                        pulseWeather[key] = pulseWeather.number(pulseWeather[key], item[1], item[2], item[3])
                    end
                    for unused, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.colourFields) do
                        if typeof(pulseWeather[item]) ~= "Color3" then
                            pulseWeather[item] = pulseWeather.defaults[item]
                        end
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.mapRoots = function()
                    local now = os.clock()
                    if pulseWeather.rootsAt then
                        if now - pulseWeather.rootsAt < 5 then
                            if pulseWeather.roots then
                                return pulseWeather.roots
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local roots = {}
                    for unused, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                        if instance.ClassName == "Model" then
                            if instance:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") then
                                roots[#roots + 1] = instance
                            elseif string.find(instance.Name, "Lobby", 1, true) then
                                roots[#roots + 1] = instance
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseWeather.roots = roots
                    pulseWeather.rootsAt = now
                    return roots
                end
                local b, entries3 = setmetatable, { __mode = "k" }
                pulseWeather.invisible = b({}, entries3)
                pulseWeather.splashes = {}
                pulseWeather.filter = function(argument2)
                    local filterDescendantsInstances = { argument2 }
                    for unused, localPlayer2 in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                        if localPlayer2.Character then
                            filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = localPlayer2.Character
                        end
                    end
                    for key in pairs(pulseWeather.invisible) do
                        if key.Parent then
                            filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = key
                        end
                    end
                    local params = RaycastParams.new()
                    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
                    params.IgnoreWater = true
                    pcall(function()
                        params.RespectCanCollide = true
                    end)
                    pulseWeather.params = params
                end
                pulseWeather.cast = function(argument2, argument3)
                    if not pulseWeather.params then
                        return nil, false
                    end
                    for unused = 1, 6, 1 do
                        local success, result = pcall(function()
                            local workspace2, params = workspace, pulseWeather.params
                            return workspace2:Raycast(argument2, argument3, params)
                        end)
                        if not success then
                            return nil, false
                        end
                        if not result then
                            return nil, true
                        end
                        local instance = result.Instance
                        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                            if instance.Transparency >= 0.95 then
                                pulseWeather.invisible[instance] = true
                                pcall(function()
                                    pulseWeather.params:AddToFilter(instance)
                                end)
                            else
                                return result, true
                            end
                        else
                            return result, true
                        end
                    end
                    return nil, true
                end
                pulseWeather.volume = function(parent2, name)
                    local part = Instance.new("Part")
                    part.Name = name
                    part.Anchored = true
                    part.CanCollide = false
                    part.CanTouch = false
                    part.CanQuery = false
                    part.CastShadow = false
                    part.Transparency = 1
                    part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    part.Parent = parent2
                    return part
                end
                pulseWeather.clear = function()
                    for unused, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.nodes) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item.emitter:Clear()
                        end)
                    end
                    for unused, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.splashes) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item.ripple:Clear()
                            item.spray:Clear()
                        end)
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.stop = function(argument2)
                    if not argument2 then
                        pulseWeather.wetLevel = 0
                        pulseWeather.wetPainted = 0
                        pcall(pulseWeather.wetRestore)
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.folder then
                        pcall(function()
                            pulseWeather.folder:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.flash then
                        pcall(function()
                            pulseWeather.flash:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.gradeFx then
                        pcall(function()
                            pulseWeather.gradeFx:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    pulseWeather.folder = nil
                    pulseWeather.flash = nil
                    pulseWeather.gradeFx = nil
                    pulseWeather.camera = nil
                    pulseWeather.character = nil
                    pulseWeather.lastPosition = nil
                    pulseWeather.params = nil
                    pulseWeather.builtKind = nil
                    pulseWeather.builtQuality = nil
                    pulseWeather.builtSound = nil
                    pulseWeather.boltPart = nil
                    pulseWeather.storm = nil
                    table.clear(pulseWeather.nodes)
                    pulseWeather.splashes = {}
                    table.clear(pulseWeather.voices)
                    pulseWeather.splashIndex = 0
                    pulseWeather.splashBudget = 0
                    pulseWeather.visibility = 0
                    pulseWeather.frameElapsed = 0
                    pulseWeather.probeElapsed = 1
                    pulseWeather.cameraCovered = nil
                    pulseWeather.suspended = nil
                    pulseWeather.dirty = true
                    pulseWeather.audioLevel = 0
                    pulseWeather.gradeLevel = 0
                    pulseWeather.coverBlend = 0
                end
                pulseWeather.destroy = function()
                    pulseWeather.stop()
                    pulseWeather.dead = true
                end
                pulseWeather.envStep = function()
                    local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
                    local clockTime = lighting.ClockTime
                    local calculatedValue, outdoorAmbient =
                        math.clamp((clockTime - 5.5) / 1.5, 0, 1) * math.clamp((19.5 - clockTime) / 1.5, 0, 1),
                        lighting.OutdoorAmbient
                    clockTime = (outdoorAmbient.R + outdoorAmbient.G + outdoorAmbient.B) / 3
                    lighting = math.clamp(1 - clockTime / 0.55, 0, 1)
                    pulseWeather.envDark = math.max(1 - calculatedValue, lighting * 0.8)
                end
                pulseWeather.audioBuild = function()
                    table.clear(pulseWeather.voices)
                    pulseWeather.audioLevel = 0
                    if not pulseWeather.sound then
                        return
                    end
                    for equalizerSoundEffect, spec in ipairs(pulseWeather.recipes[pulseWeather.kind].voices or {}) do
                        local voice = Instance.new("Sound")
                        voice.Name = "Voice"
                        voice.SoundId = spec.id
                        voice.Looped = true
                        voice.Volume = 0
                        voice.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
                        voice.Parent = pulseWeather.folder
                        equalizerSoundEffect = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
                        equalizerSoundEffect.LowGain = 0
                        equalizerSoundEffect.MidGain = 0
                        equalizerSoundEffect.HighGain = 0
                        equalizerSoundEffect.Parent = voice
                        pcall(function()
                            voice:Play()
                        end)
                        pulseWeather.voices[#pulseWeather.voices + 1] =
                            { sound = voice, eq = equalizerSoundEffect, spec = spec, level = 0 }
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.build = function(camera)
                    pulseWeather.stop(true)
                    pulseWeather.camera, pulseWeather.character = camera, localPlayer.Character
                    pulseWeather.builtKind, pulseWeather.builtQuality, pulseWeather.builtSound =
                        pulseWeather.kind, pulseWeather.quality, pulseWeather.sound
                    pulseWeather.folder = Instance.new("Folder")
                    pulseWeather.folder.Name = "PulseWeather_" .. tostring(argument)
                    pulseWeather.folder.Parent = camera
                    local entry = pulseWeather.recipes[pulseWeather.kind]
                    for key, layer in ipairs(entry.layers) do
                        local grid = layer.noShelter and 1 or 3
                        local calculatedValue = (grid + 1) / 2
                        for index = 1, grid, 1 do
                            for index2 = 1, grid, 1 do
                                local parent2, weatherParticles =
                                    pulseWeather.volume(
                                        pulseWeather.folder,
                                        "WeatherVolume" .. key .. "_" .. index .. index2
                                    ),
                                    Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                                weatherParticles.Name = "WeatherParticles"
                                weatherParticles.Enabled = false
                                weatherParticles.Rate = 0
                                weatherParticles.LockedToPart = false
                                weatherParticles.VelocityInheritance = 0
                                weatherParticles.EmissionDirection = layer.lift and Enum.NormalId.Top
                                    or Enum.NormalId.Bottom
                                pcall(function()
                                    weatherParticles.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
                                    weatherParticles.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
                                    weatherParticles.ShapeInOut = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward
                                end)
                                weatherParticles.Parent = parent2
                                local nodes, nodes2 = pulseWeather.nodes, pulseWeather.nodes
                                local calculatedValue2, entries3 =
                                    #nodes2 + 1,
                                    {
                                        part = parent2,
                                        emitter = weatherParticles,
                                        blocked = true,
                                        layer = layer,
                                        grid = grid,
                                        gx = index2 - calculatedValue,
                                        gz = index - calculatedValue,
                                        slots = grid * grid,
                                    }
                                entries3.seed, nodes[calculatedValue2] = math.random() * 6.2832, entries3
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if entry.ripples and pulseWeather.ripples then
                        local parent2 = pulseWeather.volume(pulseWeather.folder, "WeatherSplashes")
                        parent2.CFrame = CFrame.new()
                        for attachment = 1, pulseWeather.qualities[pulseWeather.quality].pool, 1 do
                            attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
                            attachment.Parent = parent2
                            local ripple = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                            ripple.Name = "Ripple"
                            ripple.Enabled = true
                            ripple.Rate = 0
                            ripple.LockedToPart = false
                            ripple.Parent = attachment
                            local spray = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                            spray.Name = "Spray"
                            spray.Enabled = true
                            spray.Rate = 0
                            spray.LockedToPart = false
                            spray.Parent = attachment
                            pulseWeather.splashes[#pulseWeather.splashes + 1] =
                                { attachment = attachment, ripple = ripple, spray = spray }
                        end
                    end
                    if entry.storm then
                        pulseWeather.flash = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
                        pulseWeather.flash.Name = "PulseWeatherFlash_" .. tostring(argument)
                        pulseWeather.flash.Brightness, pulseWeather.flash.Contrast, pulseWeather.flash.Saturation = 0, 0, 0
                        pulseWeather.flash.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        pulseWeather.flash.Parent = camera
                        pulseWeather.boltPart = pulseWeather.volume(pulseWeather.folder, "WeatherBolts")
                        pulseWeather.boltPart.CFrame = CFrame.new()
                        pulseWeather.storm =
                            { nextAt = os.clock() + 6 + math.random() * 10, active = nil, thunder = {}, flashPower = 0 }
                    end
                    pulseWeather.gradeFx = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
                    pulseWeather.gradeFx.Name = "PulseWeatherGrade_" .. tostring(argument)
                    pulseWeather.gradeFx.Brightness, pulseWeather.gradeFx.Contrast, pulseWeather.gradeFx.Saturation =
                        0, 0, 0
                    pulseWeather.gradeFx.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    pulseWeather.gradeFx.Parent = camera
                    pulseWeather.audioBuild()
                    pulseWeather.filter(camera)
                    pulseWeather.dirty = true
                end
                pulseWeather.flutter = NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.14, 0.75),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.29, -0.55),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.43, 0.65),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.57, -0.7),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.71, 0.5),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.86, -0.6),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2),
                })
                pulseWeather.stretchSquash = function()
                    local calculatedValue = settings.ui and tonumber(settings.ui.stretch) or 0
                    if calculatedValue <= 0 then
                        return 0
                    end
                    local maximumValue = math.max(0.1, 1 - calculatedValue / 100 * 0.6)
                    return math.floor(-math.log(maximumValue, 2) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
                end
                pulseWeather.squashFor = function(argument2, argument)
                    if argument2.flutter then
                        return pulseWeather.flutter
                    end
                    return NumberSequence.new(math.clamp(argument, -3, 3))
                end
                pulseWeather.spinFor = function(argument2, argument, argument3)
                    local calculatedValue = argument.rot and not (argument3 > 0 and not argument.flutter)
                    argument2.Rotation = calculatedValue and NumberRange.new(0, 360) or NumberRange.new(0)
                    argument2.RotSpeed = calculatedValue and NumberRange.new(-argument.rot, argument.rot)
                        or NumberRange.new(0)
                end
                pulseWeather.applySquash = function(squash)
                    pulseWeather.squash = squash
                    for unused, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.nodes) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item.emitter.Squash = pulseWeather.squashFor(item.layer, squash)
                            pulseWeather.spinFor(item.emitter, item.layer, squash)
                        end)
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.fadeSeq = function(argument2)
                    return NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1, 1 - argument2),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.78, 1 - argument2),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                    })
                end
                pulseWeather.pulseSeq = function(argument2)
                    local calculatedValue = 1 - argument2
                    return NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1, calculatedValue),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 1 - argument2 * 0.15),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, calculatedValue + (1 - calculatedValue) * 0.9),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.68, calculatedValue),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, 1 - argument2 * 0.25),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                    })
                end
                pulseWeather.pulseSize = function(argument2, argument)
                    local calculatedValue = (argument2 + argument) * 0.5
                    return NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.12, calculatedValue),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, argument * 0.45),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, argument),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.72, argument2 * 0.5),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.88, calculatedValue * 0.8),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
                    })
                end
                pulseWeather.layerRate = function(argument2)
                    local calculatedValue = pulseWeather.amount / 100
                    if argument2.from then
                        if calculatedValue < argument2.from then
                            return 0
                        end
                    end
                    local rate = argument2.rate
                    return (rate[1] + (rate[2] - rate[1]) * calculatedValue)
                        * pulseWeather.qualities[pulseWeather.quality].rate
                        * ((pulseWeather.effectiveRadius or pulseWeather.radius) / 30) ^ 2
                end
                pulseWeather.configure = function()
                    local envDark, calculatedValue, interpolatedValue =
                        pulseWeather.recipes[pulseWeather.kind], pulseWeather.opacity / 100, pulseWeather.speed / 100
                    local ripple = pulseWeather[envDark.colour]
                    pulseWeather.effectiveRadius = pulseWeather.radius
                    envDark = pulseWeather.envDark
                    for tile, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.nodes) do
                        local layer = item.layer
                        tile = pulseWeather.effectiveRadius * 2 * layer.reach / item.grid
                        item.tile = tile
                        item.part.Size = Vector3.new(tile, layer.h, tile)
                        item.rate = pulseWeather.layerRate(layer) / item.slots
                        local emitter = item.emitter
                        emitter.Texture = entries2[layer.tex]
                        local calculatedValue2, clampedValue, calculatedValue3 =
                            layer.col or ripple, layer.tint or 0.2, layer.col2 and pulseWeather[layer.col2] or ripple
                        if layer.fire then
                            local new, entries3, color3 = ColorSequence.new, {}, Color3
                            local colorSequenceKeypoint, colorSequenceKeypoint2, new2, fromRGB =
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, calculatedValue3:Lerp(color3.fromRGB(255, 246, 210), 0.65)),
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, calculatedValue3),
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new,
                                Color3.fromRGB
                            appendValues(
                                entries3,
                                0,
                                colorSequenceKeypoint,
                                colorSequenceKeypoint2,
                                new2(1, calculatedValue3:Lerp(fromRGB(140, 20, 6), 0.65))
                            )
                            emitter.Color = new(entries3)
                        elseif layer.pulse then
                            local new, entries3, color3 = ColorSequence.new, {}, Color3
                            appendValues(
                                entries3,
                                0,
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, calculatedValue2:Lerp(color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)),
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, calculatedValue2)
                            )
                            emitter.Color = new(entries3)
                        else
                            emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(
                                calculatedValue2:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), clampedValue),
                                calculatedValue2
                            )
                        end
                        emitter.LightInfluence = layer.light or 0.3
                        emitter.LightEmission = math.clamp((layer.glow or 0) * (0.4 + 0.6 * envDark), 0, 1)
                        emitter.Lifetime =
                            NumberRange.new(layer.life[1] / interpolatedValue, layer.life[2] / interpolatedValue)
                        emitter.Speed =
                            NumberRange.new(layer.speed[1] * interpolatedValue, layer.speed[2] * interpolatedValue)
                        item, calculatedValue2 = layer.size[1] * pulseWeather.scale, layer.size[2] * pulseWeather.scale
                        clampedValue, calculatedValue3 = (item + calculatedValue2) * 0.5, (calculatedValue2 - item) * 0.5
                        if layer.pulse then
                            emitter.Size = pulseWeather.pulseSize(item, calculatedValue2)
                        elseif layer.fire then
                            emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
                                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, clampedValue, calculatedValue3),
                                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, clampedValue * 0.75, calculatedValue3 * 0.7),
                                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, clampedValue * 0.2, 0),
                            })
                        else
                            emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
                                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, clampedValue * 0.9, calculatedValue3),
                                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, clampedValue, calculatedValue3),
                                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, clampedValue * 0.92, calculatedValue3),
                            })
                        end
                        clampedValue = math.clamp(calculatedValue * (layer.alpha or 1) * (0.9 + 0.2 * envDark), 0, 1)
                        if layer.pulse or layer.flicker then
                            emitter.Transparency = pulseWeather.pulseSeq(clampedValue)
                        else
                            emitter.Transparency = pulseWeather.fadeSeq(clampedValue)
                        end
                        emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(layer.spread or 5, layer.spread or 5)
                        emitter.Drag = layer.drag or 0
                        local stretchSquashResult = pulseWeather.stretchSquash()
                        pulseWeather.spinFor(emitter, layer, stretchSquashResult)
                        emitter.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
                        pcall(function()
                            emitter.Squash = pulseWeather.squashFor(layer, stretchSquashResult)
                        end)
                        pcall(function()
                            emitter.FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.None
                        end)
                        emitter.Enabled = true
                    end
                    interpolatedValue = ripple:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5)
                    for spray, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.splashes) do
                        ripple = item.ripple
                        ripple.Texture = entries2.ring
                        ripple.Color = ColorSequence.new(interpolatedValue)
                        ripple.LightInfluence = 0.5
                        ripple.LightEmission = 0.25
                        ripple.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.6)
                        ripple.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
                        ripple.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01, 0.02)
                        ripple.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(0, 0)
                        ripple.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                        ripple.Drag = 0
                        ripple.Size = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, 0.8 * pulseWeather.scale),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.2 * pulseWeather.scale),
                        })
                        ripple.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15, 1 - math.clamp(calculatedValue * 0.5, 0.15, 0.5)),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                        })
                        ripple.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-180, 180)
                        ripple.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0)
                        ripple.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular
                        spray = item.spray
                        spray.Texture = entries2.splash
                        spray.Color = ColorSequence.new(interpolatedValue)
                        spray.LightInfluence = 0.5
                        spray.LightEmission = 0.4
                        spray.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.45)
                        spray.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
                        spray.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.6)
                        spray.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(20, 20)
                        spray.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -6, 0)
                        spray.Drag = 0
                        spray.Size = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.9 * pulseWeather.scale),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.1 * pulseWeather.scale),
                        })
                        spray.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1, 0.35),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.78),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                        })
                        spray.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-360, 360)
                        spray.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0)
                        spray.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
                    end
                    pulseWeather.dirty = false
                end
                pulseWeather.covered = function(argument2, argument3)
                    local castResult, castResult2 =
                        pulseWeather.cast(argument2 + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), Vector3.new(0, argument3 or 40, 0))
                    return if castResult2 then castResult ~= nil else not castResult2
                end
                pulseWeather.probe = function(argument2)
                    pulseWeather.filter(pulseWeather.camera)
                    local cameraCovered = pulseWeather.shelter and pulseWeather.covered(argument2) or false
                    if cameraCovered and not pulseWeather.cameraCovered then
                        for unused, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.nodes) do
                            if not item.layer.noShelter then
                                pcall(function()
                                    item.emitter:Clear()
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseWeather.cameraCovered = cameraCovered
                    for blocked, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.nodes) do
                        blocked = if item.layer.noShelter
                            then false
                            else cameraCovered or (if pulseWeather.shelter
                                then pulseWeather.covered(
                                    Vector3.new(item.part.Position.X, argument2.Y, item.part.Position.Z),
                                    math.max(item.layer.h, 8) + 8
                                )
                                else cameraCovered)
                        if blocked then
                            if not item.blocked then
                                item.emitter:Clear()
                            end
                        end
                        item.blocked = blocked
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.splash = function(argument2, castResult)
                    local position, value =
                        pulseWeather.effectiveRadius or 30,
                        if math.random() < 0.7
                            then math.atan2(castResult.Z, castResult.X) + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2.2
                            else math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
                    castResult = 2.5 + math.sqrt(math.random()) * position * 0.85
                    position = Vector3.new(
                        argument2.X + math.cos(value) * castResult,
                        argument2.Y + 28,
                        argument2.Z + math.sin(value) * castResult
                    )
                    castResult = pulseWeather.cast(position, Vector3.new(0, -70, 0))
                    if castResult then
                        if castResult.Normal.Y < 0.55 then
                            return
                        elseif castResult.Position.Y > argument2.Y + 14 then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    pulseWeather.splashIndex = pulseWeather.splashIndex % #pulseWeather.splashes + 1
                    position = pulseWeather.splashes[pulseWeather.splashIndex]
                    position.attachment.WorldPosition = castResult.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0)
                    position.ripple:Emit(1)
                    if math.random() < 0.55 then
                        position.spray:Emit(1)
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.gustValue = function()
                    if not pulseWeather.gusts then
                        return 1
                    end
                    return 0.8
                        + math.sin(pulseWeather.phase * 0.7) * 0.2
                        + math.sin(pulseWeather.phase * 1.9) * 0.08
                        + math.sin(pulseWeather.phase * 0.23 + 1.3) * 0.1
                end
                pulseWeather.audioStep = function(calculatedValue)
                    if #pulseWeather.voices == 0 then
                        return
                    end
                    local calculatedValue2 = pulseWeather.amount > 0 and 1 or 0
                    pulseWeather.audioLevel = (pulseWeather.audioLevel or 0)
                        + (calculatedValue2 - (pulseWeather.audioLevel or 0)) * (1 - math.exp(-calculatedValue * 2.5))
                    calculatedValue2 = pulseWeather.cameraCovered and 1 or 0
                    pulseWeather.coverBlend = (pulseWeather.coverBlend or 0)
                        + (calculatedValue2 - (pulseWeather.coverBlend or 0)) * (1 - math.exp(-calculatedValue * 3))
                    local calculatedValue3, gustValueResult, calculatedValue4, calculatedValue5 =
                        pulseWeather.soundVolume / 100,
                        pulseWeather.gustValue(),
                        pulseWeather.amount / 100,
                        1 - math.exp(-calculatedValue * 3.5)
                    for spec, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.voices) do
                        spec = item.spec
                        calculatedValue2 = spec.lo + (spec.hi - spec.lo) * calculatedValue4
                        calculatedValue2 = if spec.from
                            then calculatedValue2 * math.clamp((calculatedValue4 - spec.from) / 0.2, 0, 1)
                            else calculatedValue2
                        calculatedValue = spec.base * calculatedValue2
                        calculatedValue = if spec.wind
                            then calculatedValue * (0.35 + 0.65 * math.clamp(pulseWeather.wind / 10, 0, 1.4) * gustValueResult)
                            else calculatedValue
                        local value = if spec.roof
                            then pulseWeather.coverBlend
                            else if spec.open
                                then 1 - pulseWeather.coverBlend * 0.75
                                else if spec.steady then 1 else 1 - pulseWeather.coverBlend * 0.55
                        local calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue3 * pulseWeather.audioLevel * calculatedValue * value
                        item.level = item.level + (calculatedValue2 - item.level) * calculatedValue5
                        item.sound.Volume = item.level
                        calculatedValue2 = pulseWeather.coverBlend > 0.5 and not spec.roof and -14 or 0
                        item.eq.HighGain = item.eq.HighGain + (calculatedValue2 - item.eq.HighGain) * calculatedValue5
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.gradeStep = function(gradeLevel)
                    local gradeFx = pulseWeather.gradeFx
                    if not gradeFx then
                        return
                    end
                    local calculatedValue = pulseWeather.grade
                            and pulseWeather.grades[pulseWeather.recipes[pulseWeather.kind].grade or ""]
                        or nil
                    local calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue and pulseWeather.amount > 0 and 0.35 + 0.65 * pulseWeather.amount / 100
                        or 0
                    pulseWeather.gradeLevel = (pulseWeather.gradeLevel or 0)
                        + (calculatedValue2 - (pulseWeather.gradeLevel or 0)) * (1 - math.exp(-gradeLevel * 1.5))
                    gradeLevel = pulseWeather.gradeLevel
                    if not calculatedValue then
                        gradeFx.Enabled = false
                        return
                    end
                    gradeFx.Enabled = true
                    gradeFx.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(calculatedValue.tint, gradeLevel)
                    gradeFx.Saturation = (calculatedValue.saturation or 0) * gradeLevel
                    gradeFx.Contrast = (calculatedValue.contrast or 0) * gradeLevel
                    gradeFx.Brightness = (calculatedValue.brightness or 0) * gradeLevel
                end
                pulseWeather.bolt = function(entries4, argument2, argument)
                    local entries2 = {}
                    for key, worldPosition in ipairs(entries4) do
                        local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
                        attachment.Parent = pulseWeather.boltPart
                        attachment.WorldPosition = worldPosition
                        entries2[key] = attachment
                    end
                    entries4 = {}
                    for index = 1, #entries2 - 1, 1 do
                        local calculatedValue, callback5, entries3 =
                            0.55 + 0.45 * index / #entries2,
                            ipairs,
                            { { 1, Color3.fromRGB(232, 240, 255) }, { 4.5, Color3.fromRGB(150, 178, 255) } }
                        for beam, item in callback5(entries3) do
                            beam = Instance.new("Beam")
                            beam.Attachment0, beam.Attachment1 = entries2[index], entries2[index + 1]
                            beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(item[2])
                            beam.Width0, beam.Width1 =
                                argument2 * item[1] * calculatedValue,
                                argument2 * item[1] * (0.55 + 0.45 * (index + 1) / #entries2)
                            beam.LightEmission = 1
                            beam.LightInfluence = 0
                            beam.FaceCamera = true
                            beam.Segments = 1
                            beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1)
                            beam.Parent = pulseWeather.boltPart
                            local calculatedValue2, entries5 = #entries4 + 1, { beam = beam }
                            entries5.weight, entries4[calculatedValue2] = item[1] == 1 and 1 or argument, entries5
                        end
                    end
                    return entries4
                end
                pulseWeather.strike = function(volume)
                    local storm, calculatedValue, beams = pulseWeather.storm, pulseWeather.stormPower / 100, math.random()
                    local text, calculatedValue2
                    if beams < 0.12 then
                        text, calculatedValue2 = "close", 110 + math.random() * 90
                    else
                        if beams < 0.55 then
                            text, calculatedValue2 = "mid", 260 + math.random() * 260
                        else
                            text, calculatedValue2 = "far", 560 + math.random() * 420
                        end
                    end
                    beams = pulseWeather.camera.CFrame.LookVector
                    local atan2Result = math.atan2(beams.Z, beams.X)
                    atan2Result = math.random() < 0.6 and atan2Result + (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.6
                        or math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
                    beams = volume
                        + Vector3.new(
                            math.cos(atan2Result) * calculatedValue2,
                            -6,
                            math.sin(atan2Result) * calculatedValue2
                        )
                    volume = beams
                        + Vector3.new(
                            (math.random() - 0.5) * calculatedValue2 * 0.15,
                            130 + calculatedValue2 * 0.55,
                            (math.random() - 0.5) * calculatedValue2 * 0.15
                        )
                    local magnitude = (volume - beams).Magnitude
                    local calculatedValue3 = magnitude * 0.045
                    local function callback5(argument, argument2, argument3, argument4)
                        local entries2 = { argument }
                        for index = 1, argument3 - 1, 1 do
                            local calculatedValue4 = index / argument3
                            entries2[#entries2 + 1] = argument:Lerp(argument2, calculatedValue4)
                                + Vector3.new(
                                    (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * argument4 * (1 - calculatedValue4 * 0.3),
                                    (math.random() - 0.5) * argument4 * 0.4,
                                    (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * argument4 * (1 - calculatedValue4 * 0.3)
                                )
                        end
                        entries2[#entries2 + 1] = argument2
                        return entries2
                    end
                    local value, clampedValue =
                        callback5(volume, beams, 16, calculatedValue3), math.clamp(calculatedValue2 * 0.0065, 0.7, 4.5)
                    beams = pulseWeather.bolt(value, clampedValue, 0.32)
                    for index = 1, 2, 1 do
                        volume = value[math.random(4, 11)]
                        index = volume
                            + Vector3.new(
                                (math.random() - 0.5) * magnitude * 0.35,
                                -magnitude * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.14),
                                (math.random() - 0.5) * magnitude * 0.35
                            )
                        for unused, item in
                            ipairs(
                                pulseWeather.bolt(
                                    callback5(volume, index, 6, calculatedValue3 * 0.6),
                                    clampedValue * 0.55,
                                    0.28
                                )
                            )
                        do
                            beams[#beams + 1] = item
                        end
                    end
                    clampedValue = text == "close" and 0.26 or text == "mid" and 0.16 or 0.09
                    storm.active = { t0 = os.clock(), beams = beams }
                    storm.flashPower = clampedValue * (0.35 + calculatedValue) * (pulseWeather.cameraCovered and 0.45 or 1)
                    calculatedValue, volume =
                        text == "far" and entries.thunderFar or entries.thunderClose,
                        text == "close" and 1 or text == "mid" and 0.8 or 0.6
                    storm.thunder[#storm.thunder + 1] = {
                        at = os.clock() + 0.3 + calculatedValue2 / 430,
                        id = calculatedValue[math.random(1, #calculatedValue)],
                        volume = volume,
                        crack = text == "close",
                    }
                end
                pulseWeather.playOnce = function(equalizerSoundEffect, argument2, argument)
                    if pulseWeather.sound then
                        if not pulseWeather.folder then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
                    sound.SoundId = equalizerSoundEffect
                    sound.Volume = argument2 * pulseWeather.soundVolume / 100
                    if argument then
                        equalizerSoundEffect = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
                        equalizerSoundEffect.HighGain = -16
                        equalizerSoundEffect.MidGain = -3
                        equalizerSoundEffect.Parent = sound
                    end
                    sound.Parent = pulseWeather.folder
                    pcall(function()
                        sound:Play()
                    end)
                    task.delay(16, function()
                        pcall(function()
                            sound:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end)
                end
                pulseWeather.stormStep = function(argument2, entry)
                    local storm = pulseWeather.storm
                    if not storm then
                        return
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.thunder then
                        if pulseWeather.stormPower > 0 then
                            if not storm.active then
                                if argument2 >= storm.nextAt then
                                    pulseWeather.strike(entry)
                                    storm.nextAt = argument2
                                        + (14 + math.random() * 30) * (1.9 - 1.6 * pulseWeather.stormPower / 100)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local calculatedValue, active = 0, storm.active
                    if active then
                        entry = argument2 - active.t0
                        if entry < 0.05 then
                            calculatedValue = 1
                        else
                            if entry < 0.1 then
                                calculatedValue = 0.25
                            else
                                if entry < 0.19 then
                                    calculatedValue = 0.9
                                else
                                    if entry < 0.55 then
                                        calculatedValue = 0.55 * (1 - (entry - 0.19) / 0.36)
                                    else
                                        for unused, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.boltPart:GetChildren()) do
                                            item:Destroy()
                                        end
                                        storm.active = nil
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if storm.active then
                            for unused, item in ipairs(active.beams) do
                                item.beam.Transparency =
                                    NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp(calculatedValue * item.weight * 1.6, 0, 1) * 0.96)
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.flash then
                        pulseWeather.flash.Brightness = calculatedValue * storm.flashPower
                        pulseWeather.flash.TintColor = Color3.new(1 - calculatedValue * 0.08, 1 - calculatedValue * 0.03, 1)
                    end
                    for index = #storm.thunder, 1, -1 do
                        entry = storm.thunder[index]
                        if argument2 >= entry.at then
                            pulseWeather.playOnce(entry.id, entry.volume, pulseWeather.cameraCovered)
                            if entry.crack then
                                pulseWeather.playOnce(
                                    entries.crack[math.random(1, #entries.crack)],
                                    0.5,
                                    pulseWeather.cameraCovered
                                )
                            end
                            table.remove(storm.thunder, index)
                        end
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.wetStore = function()
                    local pulseWetStore = getgenv().__pulseWetStore
                    if type(pulseWetStore) ~= "table" then
                        pulseWetStore = {}
                        getgenv().__pulseWetStore = pulseWetStore
                    else
                    end
                    return pulseWetStore
                end
                pulseWeather.wetRestore = function()
                    local wetStoreResult = pulseWeather.wetStore()
                    for key, item in pairs(wetStoreResult) do
                        if key.Parent then
                            pcall(function()
                                key.Color = item[1]
                                key.Reflectance = item[2]
                            end)
                        end
                        wetStoreResult[key] = nil
                    end
                    pulseWeather.wetSkip = {}
                end
                pulseWeather.wetFloor = function(argument2)
                    if argument2.Transparency >= 0.5 then
                        return false
                    end
                    local size, transform = argument2.Size, argument2.CFrame
                    local y, upVector, maximumValue = size.Y, transform.UpVector, math.max(size.X, size.Z)
                    if size.X < y then
                        y, upVector, maximumValue = size.X, transform.RightVector, math.max(size.Y, size.Z)
                    else
                    end
                    if size.Z < y then
                        y, upVector, maximumValue = size.Z, transform.LookVector, math.max(size.X, size.Y)
                    else
                    end
                    return math.abs(upVector.Y) > 0.9 and y <= 6 and y < maximumValue * 0.7 and maximumValue >= 3
                end
                pulseWeather.wetPaint = function(argument2, argument3, argument)
                    local calculatedValue = pulseWeather.wetness / 100 * argument
                    argument2.Color = argument3[1]:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.3 * calculatedValue)
                    argument2.Reflectance = math.min(argument3[2] + 0.26 * calculatedValue, 0.4)
                end
                pulseWeather.wetScan = function(argument2)
                    local filterDescendantsInstances = pulseWeather.mapRoots()
                    if #filterDescendantsInstances == 0 then
                        return
                    end
                    local wetStoreResult = pulseWeather.wetStore()
                    pulseWeather.wetSkip = pulseWeather.wetSkip or {}
                    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
                    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
                    overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
                    overlapParams.MaxParts = 1800
                    filterDescendantsInstances = {}
                    for unused, instance in ipairs((workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(argument2, 64, overlapParams))) do
                        filterDescendantsInstances[instance] = true
                        if not wetStoreResult[instance] then
                            if not pulseWeather.wetSkip[instance] then
                                if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                    if instance:IsA("MeshPart") then
                                        pulseWeather.wetSkip[instance] = true
                                    elseif pulseWeather.wetFloor(instance) then
                                        wetStoreResult[instance] = { instance.Color, instance.Reflectance }
                                        pulseWeather.wetPaint(instance, wetStoreResult[instance], pulseWeather.wetLevel)
                                    else
                                        pulseWeather.wetSkip[instance] = true
                                    end
                                else
                                    pulseWeather.wetSkip[instance] = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    overlapParams = 0
                    for key in pairs(pulseWeather.wetSkip) do
                        overlapParams += 1
                        if not key.Parent then
                            pulseWeather.wetSkip[key] = nil
                        end
                    end
                    if overlapParams > 6000 then
                        pulseWeather.wetSkip = {}
                    end
                    for key, item in pairs(wetStoreResult) do
                        if key.Parent then
                            if not filterDescendantsInstances[key] then
                                if (key.Position - argument2).Magnitude > 100 then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        key.Color = item[1]
                                        key.Reflectance = item[2]
                                    end)
                                    wetStoreResult[key] = nil
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            wetStoreResult[key] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.wetStep = function(argument2, argument3)
                    local calculatedValue = pulseWeather.on
                        and pulseWeather.wet
                        and pulseWeather.recipes[pulseWeather.kind].wet
                        and pulseWeather.wetness > 0
                    local calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue and 0.35 + 0.65 * pulseWeather.amount / 100 or 0
                    pulseWeather.wetLevel = (pulseWeather.wetLevel or 0)
                        + (calculatedValue2 - (pulseWeather.wetLevel or 0)) * (1 - math.exp(-argument2 / 7))
                    pulseWeather.wetClock = (pulseWeather.wetClock or 0) + argument2
                    if not calculatedValue then
                        if pulseWeather.wetLevel < 0.03 then
                            if next(pulseWeather.wetStore()) ~= nil then
                                pulseWeather.wetLevel = 0
                                pulseWeather.wetPainted = 0
                                pcall(pulseWeather.wetRestore)
                            end
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.wetClock < 1.3 then
                        return
                    end
                    pulseWeather.wetClock = 0
                    pcall(pulseWeather.wetScan, argument3)
                    if
                        math.abs(pulseWeather.wetLevel - (pulseWeather.wetPainted or 0)) > 0.04
                        or pulseWeather.wetnessPainted ~= pulseWeather.wetness
                    then
                        pulseWeather.wetPainted, pulseWeather.wetnessPainted = pulseWeather.wetLevel, pulseWeather.wetness
                        for key, item in pairs(pulseWeather.wetStore()) do
                            if key.Parent then
                                pcall(pulseWeather.wetPaint, key, item, pulseWeather.wetLevel)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.groundY = function(argument2)
                    local now = os.clock()
                    if pulseWeather.groundAt then
                        if now - pulseWeather.groundAt < 0.5 then
                            if pulseWeather.groundValue then
                                return pulseWeather.groundValue
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseWeather.groundAt = now
                    now = pulseWeather.cast(argument2 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -60, 0))
                    pulseWeather.groundValue = now and now.Position.Y or argument2.Y - 3
                    return pulseWeather.groundValue
                end
                pulseWeather.settingsChanged = function()
                    if pulseWeather.uiSyncing then
                        return
                    end
                    pulseWeather.validate()
                    pulseWeather.dirty = true
                    pulseWeather.probeElapsed = 1
                    if pulseWeather.renderedKind then
                        if pulseWeather.renderedKind ~= pulseWeather.kind then
                            pulseWeather.clear()
                        end
                    end
                    if not pulseWeather.on then
                        pulseWeather.stop()
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.setEnabled = function(argument2)
                    if pulseWeather.uiSyncing then
                        return
                    end
                    pulseWeather.on = argument2 == true
                    pulseWeather.settingsChanged()
                end
                pulseWeather.step = function(numberResult)
                    if pulseWeather.dead then
                        return
                    end
                    if not (pAlive()) then
                        pulseWeather.destroy()
                        return
                    end
                    if not pulseWeather.on then
                        if pulseWeather.folder then
                            pulseWeather.stop()
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if camera == nil then
                        if pulseWeather.folder then
                            pulseWeather.stop()
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    numberResult = pulseWeather.number(numberResult, 0.016666666666666666, 0, 0.1)
                    pulseWeather.frameElapsed = pulseWeather.frameElapsed + numberResult
                    if pulseWeather.frameElapsed < 0.03333333333333333 then
                        return
                    end
                    local frameElapsed = pulseWeather.frameElapsed
                    pulseWeather.frameElapsed = 0
                    pulseWeather.phase = pulseWeather.phase + frameElapsed
                    pulseWeather.validate()
                    pulseWeather.envClock = (pulseWeather.envClock or 0) + frameElapsed
                    if pulseWeather.envClock > 1 then
                        pulseWeather.envClock = 0
                        local envDark = pulseWeather.envDark
                        pulseWeather.envStep()
                        if math.abs(envDark - pulseWeather.envDark) > 0.08 then
                            pulseWeather.dirty = true
                        end
                    end
                    local entry = pulseWeather.qualities[pulseWeather.quality]
                    if pulseWeather.failureAt then
                        if os.clock() < pulseWeather.failureAt then
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    if
                        pulseWeather.camera ~= camera
                        or not pulseWeather.folder
                        or pulseWeather.folder.Parent ~= camera
                        or pulseWeather.builtKind ~= pulseWeather.kind
                        or pulseWeather.builtQuality ~= pulseWeather.quality
                        or pulseWeather.builtSound ~= pulseWeather.sound
                    then
                        local success, result = pcall(pulseWeather.build, camera)
                        if not success then
                            pulseWeather.stop()
                            pulseWeather.failureAt = os.clock() + 3
                            warn("[QwernHub] weather build failed: " .. tostring(result))
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    local transform, result = camera.CFrame, localPlayer.Character
                    local focus, result2 = transform.Position, result and (result:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                    focus = if result2
                        then if (result2.Position - focus).Magnitude < 70 then result2.Position else focus
                        else focus
                    result2 = Vector3.new(transform.LookVector.X, 0, transform.LookVector.Z)
                    focus = if result2.Magnitude > 0.05 then focus + result2.Unit * 4 else focus
                    pulseWeather.focus = focus
                    if
                        pulseWeather.character ~= result
                        or pulseWeather.lastPosition and (focus - pulseWeather.lastPosition).Magnitude > 48
                    then
                        pulseWeather.clear()
                        pulseWeather.visibility = 0
                        pulseWeather.probeElapsed = 1
                        pulseWeather.filter(camera)
                    end
                    pulseWeather.character = result
                    pulseWeather.lastPosition = focus
                    if pulseWeather.dirty then
                        result2, result = pcall(pulseWeather.configure)
                        if not result2 then
                            pulseWeather.stop()
                            pulseWeather.failureAt = os.clock() + 3
                            warn("[QwernHub] weather setup failed: " .. tostring(result))
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    pulseWeather.renderedKind = pulseWeather.kind
                    result2 = pulseWeather.stretchSquash()
                    if result2 ~= pulseWeather.squash then
                        pulseWeather.applySquash(result2)
                    end
                    camera, result = pulseWeather.gustValue(), math.rad(pulseWeather.windAngle)
                    result2 = Vector3.new(math.cos(result), 0, math.sin(result))
                    local position, minimumValue = Vector3.new(-result2.Z, 0, result2.X), pulseWeather.groundY(focus)
                    for key, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.nodes) do
                        result = item.layer
                        key = result.base == "ground" and minimumValue + result.y or focus.Y + result.y
                        item.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                            focus.X + (item.gx or 0) * (item.tile or 0),
                            key,
                            focus.Z + (item.gz or 0) * (item.tile or 0)
                        )
                    end
                    pulseWeather.probeElapsed = pulseWeather.probeElapsed + frameElapsed
                    if pulseWeather.probeElapsed >= entry.probeInterval then
                        pulseWeather.probeElapsed = 0
                        pulseWeather.probe(focus)
                    end
                    result = pulseWeather.amount == 0
                    if result then
                        if not pulseWeather.suspended then
                            pulseWeather.clear()
                        end
                    end
                    pulseWeather.suspended = result
                    minimumValue = result and 0 or 1
                    pulseWeather.visibility = pulseWeather.visibility
                        + (minimumValue - pulseWeather.visibility) * (1 - math.exp(-frameElapsed * 5))
                    if result then
                        pulseWeather.visibility = 0
                    end
                    minimumValue = pulseWeather.wind * 0.3 * camera * (pulseWeather.speed / 100) ^ 2
                    for emitter, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.nodes) do
                        local layer, calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 =
                            item.layer,
                            math.sin(pulseWeather.phase * 0.9 + item.seed) * 0.6 + math.sin(
                                pulseWeather.phase * 2.3 + item.seed * 1.7 + 1.7
                            ) * 0.4,
                            math.cos(pulseWeather.phase * 1.3 + item.seed * 0.7) * 0.5
                        local calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, calculatedValue5 =
                            layer.noWind and Vector3.zero or result2 * minimumValue * (layer.windK or 1),
                            layer.sway or 0,
                            (layer.lift or 0) - (layer.fall or 0)
                        if layer.still then
                            item.emitter.Acceleration = result2 * (layer.drift or 0.3) * pulseWeather.wind * 0.1
                        else
                            item.emitter.Acceleration = calculatedValue3
                                + position * (calculatedValue4 * calculatedValue)
                                + result2 * (calculatedValue4 * calculatedValue2 * 0.5)
                                + Vector3.new(0, calculatedValue5, 0)
                        end
                        camera, emitter = pulseWeather.cameraCovered and not layer.noShelter
                        emitter, camera = item.emitter, item.blocked or camera
                        emitter.Rate = camera and 0 or item.rate * pulseWeather.visibility
                    end
                    if #pulseWeather.splashes > 0 and not result and not pulseWeather.cameraCovered then
                        pulseWeather.splashBudget = pulseWeather.splashBudget
                            + frameElapsed * entry.splashes * (pulseWeather.amount / 100) * pulseWeather.visibility
                        minimumValue = math.min(math.floor(pulseWeather.splashBudget), 10)
                        pulseWeather.splashBudget = pulseWeather.splashBudget - minimumValue
                        position = transform.LookVector
                        for unused = 1, minimumValue, 1 do
                            pulseWeather.splash(focus, position)
                        end
                    else
                        pulseWeather.splashBudget = 0
                    end
                    pulseWeather.audioStep(frameElapsed)
                    pulseWeather.gradeStep(frameElapsed)
                    pulseWeather.stormStep(os.clock(), focus)
                    pulseWeather.wetStep(frameElapsed, focus)
                end
                pulseWeather.reset = function()
                    pulseWeather.scene = ""
                    pulseWeather.stop()
                    for key, item in pairs(pulseWeather.defaults) do
                        pulseWeather[key] = item
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.syncUI then
                        pulseWeather.syncUI()
                    end
                end
                pcall(pulseWeather.wetRestore)
                connectSignal(game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped, function(argument2)
                    local success, result = pcall(pulseWeather.step, argument2)
                    if not success then
                        pulseWeather.failureAt = os.clock() + 3
                        pcall(pulseWeather.stop)
                        warn("[QwernHub] weather step failed: " .. tostring(result))
                    end
                end)
                callback2(function()
                    pcall(pulseWeather.destroy)
                end)

                pulseWeather.b64 = function(argument)
                    local callback5, entries2 =
                        ipairs, { crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode }
                    for unused, item in callback5(entries2) do
                        if type(item) == "function" then
                            local success, result = pcall(item, argument)
                            if success then
                                if type(result) == "string" then
                                    if #result > 0 then
                                        return result
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    callback5, entries2 = {}, "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
                    for index = 1, 64, 1 do
                        callback5[entries2:byte(index)] = index - 1
                    end
                    local entries4, calculatedValue, counter = {}, 0, 0
                    for index = 1, #argument, 1 do
                        entries2 = callback5[argument:byte(index)]
                        if entries2 then
                            calculatedValue = calculatedValue * 64 + entries2
                            counter += 6
                            if counter >= 8 then
                                counter -= 8
                                entries4[#entries4 + 1] = string.char(math.floor(calculatedValue / 2 ^ counter) % 256)
                                calculatedValue = calculatedValue % 2 ^ counter
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    return table.concat(entries4)
                end
                pulseWeather.thumbAsset = function(argument)
                    if argument.asset ~= nil then
                        return argument.asset or nil
                    end
                    argument.asset = false
                    local callback5 = type(getcustomasset) == "function" and getcustomasset or nil
                    if not (callback5 and type(writefile) == "function") then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local success, result = pcall(function()
                        local text = "PulseHub"
                        local gmatch = string.gmatch
                        for key in gmatch("textures/weather", "[^/]+") do
                            text ..= "/" .. key
                            pcall(function()
                                if not (isfolder(text)) then
                                    makefolder(text)
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                        gmatch = text .. "/sky_" .. argument.key .. "-" .. tostring(argument.tlen) .. ".jpg"
                        if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(gmatch)) then
                            local takeResult = getgenv().__pulseData.take("wx_" .. argument.key)
                            if not takeResult then
                                argument.asset = nil
                                return ""
                            end
                            writefile(gmatch, pulseWeather.b64(takeResult))
                        end
                        return callback5(gmatch)
                    end)
                    if success then
                        if type(result) == "string" then
                            if result ~= "" then
                                argument.asset = result
                                return result
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return nil
                end

                pulseWeather.setSky = function(argument)
                    if not pulseSkyAPI then
                        return
                    end
                    if argument == nil then
                        pcall(pulseSkyAPI.clear)
                    elseif argument == "" then
                        pcall(pulseSkyAPI.clear)
                    else
                        pcall(pulseSkyAPI.activate, argument, true)
                    end
                    pulseWeather.skyKey = pulseSkyAPI.active and pulseSkyAPI.active() or nil
                    if pulseWeather.paintSkies then
                        pcall(pulseWeather.paintSkies)
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.takeLook = function(argument)
                    if not pulseWeather.lookByWeather then
                        pulseWeather.prevLook = { preset = featureState.preset, on = featureState.on }
                    end
                    pcall(featureState.applyPreset, argument)
                    pulseWeather.lookByWeather = true
                end
                pulseWeather.restoreLook = function()
                    if not pulseWeather.lookByWeather then
                        return
                    end
                    pulseWeather.lookByWeather = false
                    local prevLook = pulseWeather.prevLook
                    pulseWeather.prevLook = nil
                    if prevLook and prevLook.on and prevLook.preset and prevLook.preset ~= "Original" then
                        pcall(featureState.applyPreset, prevLook.preset)
                    else
                        pcall(featureState.resetLook)
                        pcall(featureState.setEnabled, false)
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.pickSky = function(argument)
                    if pulseSkyAPI then
                        if pulseSkyAPI.active then
                            if pulseSkyAPI.active() == argument then
                                pulseWeather.setSky(nil)
                                if pulseWeather.matchLight then
                                    pulseWeather.restoreLook()
                                end
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseWeather.setSky(argument)
                    if pulseWeather.matchLight then
                        for unused, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.skyList) do
                            if item.key == argument then
                                if item.look then
                                    pulseWeather.takeLook(item.look)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.applyScene = function(scene)
                    local value
                    for unused, item in ipairs(pulseWeather.scenes) do
                        if item.name == scene then
                            value = item
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not value then
                        return
                    end
                    pulseWeather.stop()
                    local entries14 = {
                        quality = true,
                        shelter = true,
                        sound = true,
                        soundVolume = true,
                        wet = true,
                        wetness = true,
                        grade = true,
                        matchLight = true,
                        radius = true,
                        scale = true,
                        ripples = true,
                        gusts = true,
                    }
                    for key, item in pairs(pulseWeather.defaults) do
                        if not entries14[key] then
                            if not (string.find(key, "olour", 1, true)) then
                                pulseWeather[key] = item
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseWeather.scene = scene
                    if value.weather then
                        pulseWeather.on = true
                        for key, item in pairs(value.weather) do
                            pulseWeather[key] = item
                        end
                    else
                        pulseWeather.on = false
                    end
                    pulseWeather.settingsChanged()
                    if value.sky then
                        pulseWeather.setSky(value.sky)
                    end
                    if value.look then
                        pulseWeather.takeLook(value.look)
                    end
                    scene = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseSkyFx")
                    if type(scene) == "table" then
                        if value.fx then
                            pcall(scene.scene, value.fx)
                        else
                            pcall(scene.sceneEnd)
                        end
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.syncUI then
                        pulseWeather.syncUI()
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.paintScenes then
                        pcall(pulseWeather.paintScenes)
                    end
                end
                pulseWeather.clearScene = function()
                    local rawgetResult = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseSkyFx")
                    if type(rawgetResult) == "table" then
                        pcall(rawgetResult.sceneEnd)

                    pulseWeather.scene = ""
