                    pulseWeather.settingsChanged()
                    pulseWeather.setSky(nil)
                    pulseWeather.restoreLook()
                    if pulseWeather.syncUI then
                        pulseWeather.syncUI()
                    end
                    if pulseWeather.paintScenes then
                        pcall(pulseWeather.paintScenes)
                    end
                end

                                                    - 3.141592653589793,
                                                asinResult - item.el

                                                calculatedValue * calculatedValue * math.cos(item.el) ^ 2
                                                    + calculatedValue2 * calculatedValue2

                            if entries.dead then
                                return
                            end
                            if not (isActive()) then
                                entries.destroy()
                                return
                            end
                            local enabled = false

                                if math.abs(r - entries.sq) > 0.02 then
                                    entries.sq = r
                                    entries.ky = 2 ^ -r
                                    entries.kb = 1 / entries.ky
                                    entries.dirtyAll()
                                end
                            end

                                        key.live = true
                                        key.dirty = true
                                    else
                                        key.failAt = entries.t + 5
                                        pcall(key.drop, key)

                                    end

                                elseif key.live then
                                    pcall(key.drop, key)
                                    key.live = false
                                end

                                    if key.dirty then

                        end

                    end
                    local function callback5(argument, argument2)
                        if typeof(argument) == "Color3" then
                            if typeof(argument2) == "Color3" then
                                return math.abs(argument.R - argument2.R) < 0.004
                                    and math.abs(argument.G - argument2.G) < 0.004
                                    and math.abs(argument.B - argument2.B) < 0.004
                            end
                        end
                        if type(argument) == "number" then
                            if type(argument2) == "number" then
                                return math.abs(argument - argument2) < 0.002
                            end
                        end
                        return argument == argument2
                    end
                    local function callback6(argument, argument2, argument3, callback8)
                        local entry, entry2 = argument[argument3], argument2.w[argument3]
                        if entry2 == nil then
                            argument2.o[argument3] = entry
                        elseif not (callback5(entry, entry2)) then
                            argument2.o[argument3] = entry
                        end
                        callback8 = if type(callback8) == "function" then callback8(argument2.o[argument3]) else callback8
                        if callback8 == nil then
                            argument2.w[argument3] = nil
                            return
                        end
                        if not (callback5(entry, callback8)) then
                            argument[argument3] = callback8
                        end
                        argument2.w[argument3] = callback8
                    end
                    local function callback8(argument, argument2, argument3)
                        if not (callback5(argument[argument2], argument3)) then
                            argument[argument2] = argument3
                        end
                    end
                    local function handleAction(argument, argument2)
                        if argument2.cloth then
                            if argument.Parent == nil then
                                if argument2.par then
                                    if argument2.par.Parent then
                                        argument.Parent = argument2.par
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            return
                        end
                        if not argument.Parent then
                            return
                        end
                        for key, item in pairs(argument2.o) do
                            local entry = argument2.w[key]
                            if entry ~= nil then
                                pcall(function()
                                    if callback5(argument[key], entry) then
                                        argument[key] = item
                                    end
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local function callback9(calculatedValue, calculatedValue2, argument)
                        local col, col2, anim, calculatedValue3 =
                            calculatedValue.col,
                            calculatedValue.col2,
                            calculatedValue.anim,
                            calculatedValue2 * calculatedValue.speed / 100
                        if anim == "Pulse" then
                            local toHSVResult, toHSVResult2, toHSVResult3 = col:ToHSV()
                            return Color3.fromHSV(
                                toHSVResult,
                                toHSVResult2,
                                toHSVResult3 * (0.35 + 0.65 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(calculatedValue3 * 4)))
                            ),
                                0
                        elseif anim == "Breathe" then
                            return col, 0.7 * (0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(calculatedValue3 * 3))
                        elseif anim == "Fade" then
                            calculatedValue = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(calculatedValue3 * 2.5)
                            return col:Lerp(col2, calculatedValue), 0
                        elseif anim == "Flash" then
                            return math.floor(calculatedValue3 * 5) % 2 == 0 and col or col2, 0
                        elseif anim == "Rainbow" or anim == "Wave" then
                            local unused, toHSVResult, toHSVResult2 = col:ToHSV()
                            calculatedValue2 = anim == "Wave" and calculatedValue3 * 0.35 - argument * 0.08
                                or calculatedValue3 * 0.25
                            return Color3.fromHSV(
                                calculatedValue2 % 1,
                                math.max(toHSVResult, 0.55),
                                math.max(toHSVResult2, 0.8)
                            ),
                                0
                        elseif anim == "Gradient" then
                            local calculatedValue4 = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(calculatedValue3 * 2.2 - argument * 0.8)
                            return col2:Lerp(col, calculatedValue4), 0
                        end
                        return col, 0
                    end
                    local function callback5(argument, argument2, argument3, argument4)
                        return 1 - (1 - argument) * (1 - (argument2 or 0)) * (1 - argument3.alpha / 100) * (1 - argument4)
                    end
                    local function isActive2()
                        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                        local instance = camera and (camera:FindFirstChild("PulseSkin"))
                        if instance then
                            if instance:IsA("Model") then
                                return instance
                            end
                        end
                        return nil
                    end
                    local function callback10(weaponDisplays)
                        local entries7, entries8 = {}, { "DisplayRefKnife", "DisplayRefGun" }
                        for instance, item in ipairs(entries8) do
                            instance = weaponDisplays:FindFirstChild(item)
                            item = instance and instance:IsA("ObjectValue") and instance.Value

                                end
                            end
                        end
                        return entries7
                    end
                    local function callback11(instance)
                        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                            return instance.Transparency < 0.99 and instance.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.99
                        end
                        return true
                    end
                    local function callback12(argument, argument2, argument3, argument4)
                        local function callback13(instance)
                            if instance:GetAttribute("PulseVFX") then
                                return
                            end
                            if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                if instance.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
                                    return
                                end

                                    if saved[instance] then
                                        entries4[instance] = argument2

                                    end

                                if argument3.wire then
                                    if instance.Transparency < 0.99 then
                                        entries6[instance] = argument2
                                    end
                                end
                            elseif argument3.clean then
                                if instance:IsA("Decal") then
                                    entries4[instance] = argument2
                                elseif instance:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                                    entries4[instance] = argument2
                                elseif argument4 then
                                    if instance:IsA("Clothing") then
                                        entries4[instance] = argument2
                                    elseif instance:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
                                        entries4[instance] = argument2
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        callback13(argument)
                        for unused, item in ipairs(argument:GetDescendants()) do
                            callback13(item)
                        end
                    end
                    local function handleAction2()
                        entries4, entries5, entries6 = {}, {}, {}
                        local character = localPlayer.Character
                        if not character then
                            return
                        end
                        local selfValue, tool = k.self, k.tool
                        if selfValue.on then
                            local entry, value = entries[selfValue.style], isActive2()
                            for unused, instance in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                                if not (instance:IsA("Tool")) then
                                    callback12(instance, "self", entry, true)
                                end
                            end
                            if value then
                                callback12(value, "self", entry, true)
                            end
                            if entry.fill or entry.edge then
                                entries5[value or character] = "self"
                                if not value then
                                    local callback13, packedValues = ipairs, packValues(character:GetChildren())
                                    for unused, instance in callback13(unpackTuple(packedValues)) do
                                        if instance:IsA("Tool") then
                                            entries5[instance] = "block"
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if tool.on then
                            local entry, callback13, packedValues =
                                entries[tool.style], ipairs, packValues(character:GetChildren())
                            for unused, instance in callback13(unpackTuple(packedValues)) do
                                if instance:IsA("Tool") then
                                    callback12(instance, "tool", entry, false)
                                    if entry.fill then
                                        entries5[instance] = "tool"
                                    elseif entry.edge then
                                        entries5[instance] = "tool"
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if tool.on then
                            local entry, callback13, packedValues =
                                entries[tool.style], ipairs, packValues(callback10(character))
                            for unused, item in callback13(unpackTuple(packedValues)) do
                                if callback11(item) then
                                    callback12(item, "tool", entry, false)
                                    if entry.fill then
                                        entries5[item] = "tool"
                                    elseif entry.edge then
                                        entries5[item] = "tool"
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local function handleAction3()

                    local function handleAction4(argument)
                        local calculatedValue = os.clock() - now
                        local character = localPlayer.Character
                        local calculatedValue2 = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                        local calculatedValue3 = calculatedValue2 and calculatedValue2.Position.Y or nil
                        local value = isActive2()
                        for key, item in pairs(saved) do
                            local entry = k[item.kind]
                            local entry2 = entries[entry.style]
                            if item.part then
                                if key.Parent and entry2.m and (argument or entry.anim ~= "None") then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        local value2, value3 = callback9(
                                            entry,
                                            calculatedValue,
                                            calculatedValue3 and key.Position.Y - calculatedValue3 or 0
                                        )
                                        callback6(key, item, "Material", entry2.m)
                                        callback6(key, item, "Color", value2)
                                        callback6(key, item, "Reflectance", entry2.r or 0)
                                        if argument then
                                            if entry2.clean then
                                                if item.mp then
                                                    callback6(key, item, "TextureID", "")
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                        local calculatedValue2 = entry2.t or 0
                                        if
                                            calculatedValue2 > 0
                                            or entry.alpha > 0
                                            or value3 > 0
                                            or item.w.Transparency ~= nil
                                        then
                                            callback6(key, item, "Transparency", function(argument2)
                                                if argument2 >= 0.99 then
                                                    return nil
                                                end
                                                return callback5(argument2, calculatedValue2, entry, value3)
                                            end)
                                        end
                                    end)
                                end
                            elseif argument and key.Parent then
                                if item.decal then
                                    pcall(callback6, key, item, "Transparency", 1)
                                elseif item.mesh then
                                    pcall(callback6, key, item, "TextureId", "")
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        for instance, item in pairs(hls) do
                            local entry = k[item.kind]
                            if item.kind == "block" then
                                pcall(function()
                                    callback8(item.h, "FillTransparency", 1)
                                    callback8(item.h, "OutlineTransparency", 1)
                                    if not item.h.Enabled then
                                        item.h.Enabled = true
                                    end
                                end)
                            else
                                pcall(function()
                                    local enabled2, value2, value3 =
                                        entries[entry.style], callback9(entry, calculatedValue, 0)
                                    local h, counter = item.h, 0
                                    if instance == character or instance == value then
                                        local head = instance:FindFirstChild("Head")
                                        counter = if head
                                            then if head:IsA("BasePart") then head.LocalTransparencyModifier else counter
                                            else counter
                                    else
                                    end
                                    callback8(h, "FillColor", value2)
                                    callback8(h, "OutlineColor", enabled2.fill == 0 and value2:Lerp(color, 0.4) or value2)
                                    callback8(
                                        h,
                                        "FillTransparency",
                                        enabled2.fill and 1 - (1 - callback5(0, enabled2.fill, entry, value3)) * (1 - counter)
                                            or 1
                                    )
                                    callback8(
                                        h,
                                        "OutlineTransparency",
                                        enabled2.edge and 1 - (1 - callback5(0, 0, entry, value3)) * (1 - counter) or 1
                                    )
                                    enabled2 = counter < 0.95 and callback11(instance)
                                    if h.Enabled ~= enabled2 then
                                        h.Enabled = enabled2
                                    end
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                        for key, item in pairs(boxes) do
                            local entry = k[item.kind]
                            pcall(function()
                                local value, visible = callback9(
                                    entry,
                                    calculatedValue,
                                    calculatedValue3 and key.Position.Y - calculatedValue3 or 0
                                )
                                local b, localTransparencyModifier = item.b, key.LocalTransparencyModifier
                                callback8(b, "Color3", value)
                                callback8(
                                    b,
                                    "Transparency",
                                    1 - (1 - callback5(0, 0, entry, visible)) * (1 - localTransparencyModifier)
                                )
                                visible = localTransparencyModifier < 0.95 and key.Transparency < 0.99
                                if b.Visible ~= visible then
                                    b.Visible = visible
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end

                local entries6, pulseTrail = { objs = {}, emitters = {}, stampFx = {} }
                local function isActive()
                    if pulseTrail then
                        if pulseTrail.Parent then
                            local value = pulseTrail
                            return value
                        end
                    end
                    pulseTrail = Instance.new("Folder")
                    pulseTrail.Name = "PulseTrail"
                    pulseTrail.Parent = workspaceInstance
                    local value = pulseTrail
                    return value
                end
                local function isActive2()
                    for unused, item in ipairs(entries6.objs) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    entries6.objs = {}
                    entries6.emitters = {}
                    entries6.stampFx = {}
                    if pulseTrail then
                        pcall(function()
                            pulseTrail:Destroy()
                        end)
                        pulseTrail = nil
                    end
                    entries6.ch = nil
                    entries6.sig = nil
                    entries6.lastPos = nil
                    entries6.moving = nil
                    entries6.stamp = nil
                end
                local function callback(
                    parent2,
                    localization2,
                    argument,
                    calculatedValue,
                    argument2,
                    life,
                    calculatedValue2
                )
                    local particleEmitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                    particleEmitter.Texture = localization2.tex
                    particleEmitter.Color = life(localization2.color)
                    particleEmitter.LightEmission = localization2.le or 1
                    particleEmitter.LightInfluence = localization2.li or 0
                    particleEmitter.Size = nseq({
                        { 0, localization2.size[1] * argument * (calculatedValue2 or 1) },
                        { 1, localization2.size[2] * argument * (calculatedValue2 or 1) },
                    })
                    calculatedValue2 = 1 - (1 - (localization2.tr or 0)) * calculatedValue
                    particleEmitter.Transparency =
                        nseq({ { 0, localization2.flat and 1 or calculatedValue2 }, { 0.15, calculatedValue2 }, { 1, 1 } })
                    life = localization2.life
                    if type(life) == "table" then
                        particleEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(life[1] * argument2, life[2] * argument2)
                    else
                        particleEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(life * argument2)
                    end
                    particleEmitter.Rate = 0
                    calculatedValue = localization2.speed or { 0.001, 0.001 }
                    particleEmitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(calculatedValue[1] * argument, calculatedValue[2] * argument)
                    particleEmitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(localization2.spread or 0, localization2.spread or 0)
                    particleEmitter.Acceleration = (localization2.acc or Vector3.zero) * argument
                    particleEmitter.Drag = localization2.drag or 0
                    particleEmitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
                    calculatedValue2 = localization2.rot or 0
                    particleEmitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-calculatedValue2, calculatedValue2)
                    if localization2.upright then
                        particleEmitter.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCameraWorldUp
                        particleEmitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-8, 8)
                    end
                    if localization2.par then
                        particleEmitter.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel
                        particleEmitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0)
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        particleEmitter.Brightness = 3
                    end)
                    particleEmitter.Parent = parent2
                    return particleEmitter
                end
                local function handleAction(attachment)
                    isActive2()
                    local calculatedValue, clampedValue, clampedValue2, clampedValue3, calculatedValue2 =
                        entries5[trail.mode] or entries5.Aurora,
                        math.clamp((tonumber(trail.scale) or 100) / 100, 0.3, 3),
                        math.clamp((tonumber(trail.alpha) or 100) / 100, 0, 1),
                        math.clamp((tonumber(trail.life) or 3) / 3, 0.4, 3),
                        trail.custom and Color3.fromRGB(
                            math.clamp(tonumber(trail.r) or 0, 0, 255),
                            math.clamp(tonumber(trail.g) or 200, 0, 255),
                            math.clamp(tonumber(trail.b) or 255, 0, 255)
                        ) or nil
                    local function callback4(argument)
                        return calculatedValue2 and entries3.recolor(argument, calculatedValue2) or argument
                    end
                    local function e(argument)
                        entries6.objs[#entries6.objs + 1] = argument
                        return argument
                    end
                    local pulseTrailStamp = { "Left", "Right" }
                    for parent2, attachment1 in ipairs(pulseTrailStamp) do
                        parent2 = attachment:FindFirstChild(attachment1 .. "Foot")
                            or attachment:FindFirstChild(attachment1 .. " Leg")
                        if parent2 then
                            local calculatedValue2, calculatedValue3, attachment0 =
                                -parent2.Size.Y / 2 + 0.08,
                                calculatedValue.width * clampedValue,
                                e(Instance.new("Attachment"))
                            attachment0.Position = Vector3.new(-calculatedValue3 / 2, calculatedValue2, 0)
                            attachment0.Parent = parent2
                            attachment1 = e(Instance.new("Attachment"))
                            attachment1.Position = Vector3.new(calculatedValue3 / 2, calculatedValue2, 0)
                            attachment1.Parent = parent2
                            local attachment02 = e(Instance.new("Attachment"))
                            attachment02.Position =
                                Vector3.new(-calculatedValue3 * (calculatedValue.glow or 2.6) / 2, calculatedValue2, 0)
                            attachment02.Parent = parent2
                            local attachment12 = e(Instance.new("Attachment"))
                            attachment12.Position =
                                Vector3.new(calculatedValue3 * (calculatedValue.glow or 2.6) / 2, calculatedValue2, 0)
                            attachment12.Parent = parent2
                            local lifetime, value = calculatedValue.ribLife * clampedValue3, e(Instance.new("Trail"))
                            value.Attachment0 = attachment0
                            value.Attachment1 = attachment1
                            value.Color = callback4(calculatedValue.rib)
                            value.Transparency =
                                nseq({ { 0, 1 - 0.95 * clampedValue2 }, { 0.5, 1 - 0.55 * clampedValue2 }, { 1, 1 } })
                            value.WidthScale = nseq({ { 0, 1 }, { 1, 0.2 } })
                            value.Lifetime = lifetime
                            value.LightEmission = 1
                            value.LightInfluence = 0
                            value.FaceCamera = false
                            value.MinLength = 0.05
                            pcall(function()
                                value.Brightness = 3
                            end)
                            value.Parent = parent2
                            local value2 = e(Instance.new("Trail"))
                            value2.Attachment0 = attachment02
                            value2.Attachment1 = attachment12
                            value2.Color = callback4(calculatedValue.rib)
                            value2.Transparency =
                                nseq({ { 0, 1 - 0.3 * clampedValue2 }, { 0.6, 1 - 0.12 * clampedValue2 }, { 1, 1 } })
                            value2.WidthScale = nseq({ { 0, 1 }, { 1, 0.3 } })
                            value2.Lifetime = lifetime * 0.8
                            value2.LightEmission = 1
                            value2.LightInfluence = 0
                            value2.FaceCamera = false
                            value2.MinLength = 0.05
                            pcall(function()
                                value2.Brightness = 2
                            end)
                            value2.Parent = parent2
                            calculatedValue3 = e(Instance.new("Attachment"))
                            calculatedValue3.Position = Vector3.new(0, calculatedValue2 + 0.15, 0)
                            calculatedValue3.Parent = parent2
                            for e2, item in ipairs(calculatedValue.foot or {}) do
                                e2, attachment12, attachment0 =
                                    callback(calculatedValue3, item, clampedValue, clampedValue2, clampedValue3, callback4),
                                    entries6.emitters,
                                    entries6.emitters
                                attachment02, lifetime = #attachment0 + 1, { e = e2 }
                                lifetime.rate, attachment12[attachment02] = item.rate or 10, lifetime
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseTrailStamp = Instance.new("Part")
                    pulseTrailStamp.Name = "PulseTrailStamp"
                    pulseTrailStamp.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
                    pulseTrailStamp.Transparency = 1
                    pulseTrailStamp.Anchored = true
                    pulseTrailStamp.CanCollide = false
                    pulseTrailStamp.CanQuery = false
                    pulseTrailStamp.CanTouch = false
                    pulseTrailStamp.CastShadow = false
                    pulseTrailStamp.Parent = isActive()
                    attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
                    attachment.Parent = pulseTrailStamp
                    for unused, item in ipairs(calculatedValue.step or {}) do
                        e = callback(attachment, item, clampedValue, clampedValue2, clampedValue3, callback4, 0.5)
                        e.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular
                        e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.001)
                        e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(0, 0)
                        e.Acceleration = Vector3.zero
                        local stampFx, stampFx2 = entries6.stampFx, entries6.stampFx
                        local calculatedValue2, entries3 = #stampFx2 + 1, { e = e }
                        entries3.n, stampFx[calculatedValue2] = item.n or 1, entries3
                    end
                    entries6.stamp = pulseTrailStamp
                end
                local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
                connectSignal(runService.Heartbeat, function()
                    if not trail.on then
                        if entries6.ch then
                            isActive2()
                        elseif pulseTrail then
                            isActive2()
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    local ch = localPlayer.Character
                    local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 =
                        ch and PulseFC(ch, "HumanoidRootPart"), ch and PulseFCC(ch, "Humanoid")
                    if calculatedValue then
                        if calculatedValue2 then
                            if not (calculatedValue2.Health > 0) then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    local sig = entries6.k
                    if
                        (if sig then sig[1] ~= trail.mode else not sig)
                        or sig[2] ~= trail.scale
                        or sig[3] ~= trail.alpha
                        or sig[4] ~= trail.life
                        or sig[5] ~= trail.custom
                        or sig[6] ~= trail.r
                        or sig[7] ~= trail.g
                        or sig[8] ~= trail.b
                    then
                        entries6.k =
                            { trail.mode, trail.scale, trail.alpha, trail.life, trail.custom, trail.r, trail.g, trail.b }
                        entries6.sigNow = table.concat(
                            {
                                trail.mode,
                                tostring(trail.scale),
                                tostring(trail.alpha),
                                tostring(trail.life),
                                tostring(trail.custom),
                                tostring(trail.r),
                                tostring(trail.g),
                                tostring(trail.b),
                            },
                            "|"
                        )
                    end
                    sig = entries6.sigNow
                    if entries6.ch ~= ch or entries6.sig ~= sig or not (entries6.stamp and entries6.stamp.Parent) then
                        local success, result = pcall(handleAction, ch)
                        if not success then
                            warn("[Qwern] trail: " .. tostring(result))
                        end
                        entries6.ch = ch
                        entries6.sig = sig
                    end
                    local calculatedValue3, assemblyLinearVelocity =
                        calculatedValue2.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air, calculatedValue.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    local moving = calculatedValue3
                        and assemblyLinearVelocity.X * assemblyLinearVelocity.X
                                + assemblyLinearVelocity.Z * assemblyLinearVelocity.Z
                            > 4
                    if moving ~= entries6.moving then
                        entries6.moving = moving
                        for unused, item in ipairs(entries6.emitters) do
                            pcall(function()
                                item.e.Rate = moving and item.rate or 0
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    if not calculatedValue3 then
                        entries6.lastPos = nil
                        return
                    end
                    if not moving then
                        return
                    end
                    local lastPos = calculatedValue.Position
                    if entries6.lastPos then
                        if (lastPos - entries6.lastPos).Magnitude < 3 then
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    entries6.lastPos = lastPos
                    local raycastResult
                    pcall(function()
                        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { ch, isActive() }
                        raycastResult = workspaceInstance:Raycast(lastPos, Vector3.new(0, -7, 0), raycastParams)
                    end)
                    if not raycastResult or not entries6.stamp then
                        return
                    end
                    entries6.stamp.CFrame = CFrame.new(raycastResult.Position + raycastResult.Normal * 0.06)
                    for unused, item in ipairs(entries6.stampFx) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item.e:Emit(item.n)
                        end)
                    end
                end)
                callback2(isActive2)
                pcall(function()
                    local entries3, callback4 =
                        {
                            ["Walk Trail"] = { ru = "Walk Trail", uk = "Walk Trail" },
                            ["Trail Style"] = { ru = "Trail Style", uk = "Trail Style" },
                            ["Trail Fade (s)"] = {
                                ru = "Trail Fade (s)",
                                uk = "Trail Fade (s)",
                            },
                            ["Trail Size"] = { ru = "Trail Size", uk = "Trail Size" },
                            ["Trail Opacity"] = {
                                ru = "Trail Opacity",
                                uk = "Trail Opacity",
                            },
                            ["Trail Custom Color"] = {
                                ru = "Trail Custom Color",
                                uk = "Trail Custom Color",
                            },
                            ["Trail Color"] = { ru = "Trail Color", uk = "Trail Color" },
                            Aurora = { ru = "Aurora", uk = "Aurora" },
                            Comet = { ru = "Comet", uk = "Comet" },
                            Inferno = { ru = "Inferno", uk = "Inferno" },
                            Frost = { ru = "Frostbite", uk = "Frostbite" },
                            Rainbow = { ru = "Rainbow", uk = "Rainbow" },
                            Neon = { ru = "Neon", uk = "Neon" },
                            Shadow = { ru = "Shadow", uk = "Shadow" },
                            Sakura = { ru = "Blossom", uk = "Blossom" },
                            Galaxy = { ru = "Galaxy", uk = "Galaxy" },
                            Electric = { ru = "Electric", uk = "Electric" },
                        },
                        pairs
                    for key, item in callback4(entries3) do
                        if localization.data.ru then
                            if localization.data.ru[key] == nil then
                                localization.data.ru[key] = item.ru
                            end
                        end
                        if localization.data.uk then
                            if localization.data.uk[key] == nil then
                                localization.data.uk[key] = item.uk
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                uiPage:Header("Trail")
                uiPage:Toggle({
                    Text = "Walk Trail",
                    Default = trail.on,
                    Callback = function(argument)
                        trail.on = argument and true or false
                        if not trail.on then
                            isActive2()
                        end
                    end,
                    Settings = function()
                        uiPage:Slider({
                            Text = "Trail Fade (s)",
                            Min = 1,
                            Max = 10,
                            Default = trail.life,
                            Decimals = 0,
                            Callback = function(life)
                                trail.life = life
                            end,
                        })
                        uiPage:Slider({
                            Text = "Trail Size",
                            Min = 30,
                            Max = 300,
                            Default = trail.scale,
                            Decimals = 0,
                            Suffix = "%",
                            Callback = function(scale)
                                trail.scale = scale
                            end,
                        })
                        uiPage:Slider({
                            Text = "Trail Opacity",
                            Min = 0,
                            Max = 100,
                            Default = trail.alpha,
                            Decimals = 0,
                            Suffix = "%",
                            Callback = function(alpha)
                                trail.alpha = alpha
                            end,
                        })
                        uiPage:Toggle({
                            Text = "Trail Custom Color",
                            Default = trail.custom,
                            Callback = function(argument)
                                trail.custom = argument and true or false
                            end,
                            Settings = function()
                                local colorpickerResult
                                table.insert(preferences.applyHooks, function()
                                    if colorpickerResult then
                                        pcall(
                                            colorpickerResult.Set,
                                            Color3.fromRGB(trail.r or 255, trail.g or 255, trail.b or 255)
                                        )
                                    end
                                end)
                                colorpickerResult = uiPage:Colorpicker({
                                    Text = "Trail Color",
                                    NoSave = true,
                                    Default = Color3.fromRGB(trail.r or 255, trail.g or 255, trail.b or 255),
                                    Callback = function(argument)
                                        if typeof(argument) ~= "Color3" then
                                            return
                                        end
                                        trail.r = math.floor(argument.R * 255 + 0.5)
                                        trail.g = math.floor(argument.G * 255 + 0.5)
                                        trail.b = math.floor(argument.B * 255 + 0.5)
                                    end,
                                })
                            end,
                        })
                    end,
                })
                do
                    local novaUI = sharedState.Nova
                    local bindTheme, tweenInstance = novaUI.Theme.bind, novaUI.Motion.tween
                    local paint = novaUI.paint
                    entries2 = createInstance(
                        "Frame",
                        { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1 },
                        uiPage:Container()
                    )
                    createInstance(
                        "UIGridLayout",
                        {
                            CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 36),
                            CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
                            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                        },
                        entries2
                    )
                    local entries3 = {}
                    local function isActive3()
                        for key, item in ipairs(entries3) do
                            key = trail.mode == item.key
                            paint(item.b, "BackgroundColor3", key and "Accent" or "Surface2", "Quick")
                            local b2, entries6 = item.b, {}
                            entries6.BackgroundTransparency = key and 0.82 or 0
                            tweenInstance(b2, "Quick", entries6)
                            paint(item.st, "Color", (key or item.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
                            tweenInstance(
                                item.st,
                                "Quick",
                                { Transparency = key and 0.1 or (item.hover and 0.45 or 0.86), Thickness = key and 1.5 or 1 }
                            )
                            paint(item.l, "TextColor3", (key or item.hover) and "Text" or "Muted", "Quick")
                        end
                    end
                    runService = ipairs
                    for layoutOrder, mode in runService(entries) do
                        entries4, b =
                            entries5[mode],
                            createInstance(
                                "TextButton",
                                { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = layoutOrder },
                                entries2
                            )
                        callback3(b, 10)
                        bindTheme(b, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface2")
                        st = createInstance(
                            "UIStroke",
                            { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.86, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border },
                            b
                        )
                        bindTheme(st, "Color", "Glass")
                        layoutOrder = createInstance(
                            "Frame",
                            {
                                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                                Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0),
                                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
                                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                            },
                            b
                        )
                        callback3(layoutOrder, 9)
                        createInstance(
                            "UIGradient",
                            { Color = ColorSequence.new(entries4.sw[1], entries4.sw[2]), Rotation = 45 },
                            layoutOrder
                        )
                        createInstance(
                            "UIStroke",
                            {
                                Thickness = 1,
                                Transparency = 0.7,
                                Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                                ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
                            },
                            layoutOrder
                        )
                        local l = novaUI.label({
                            Parent = b,
                            Text = localization.tr(mode),
                            Font = novaUI.Font.Semi(),
                            Size = 12,
                            Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 0),
                            Box = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0),
                            Truncate = true,
                            Color = "Muted",
                        })
                        pcall(function()
                            localization.bind(l, mode)
                        end)
                        local entries = { key = mode, b = b, st = st, l = l, hover = false }
                        entries3[#entries3 + 1] = entries
                        connectSignal(b.MouseButton1Click, function()
                            pcall(function()
                                novaUI.Sound.play("tick")
                            end)
                            trail.mode = mode
                            isActive3()
                        end)
                        connectSignal(b.MouseEnter, function()
                            entries.hover = true
                            isActive3()
                        end)
                        novaUI.U.leave(b, function()
                            entries.hover = false
                            isActive3()
                        end)
                    end
                    isActive3()
                end
            end
            uiPage:Header("Optimizer")
            settings.optim = settings.optim or {}
            local optim = settings.optim
            local function callback(argument2, argument3)
                if optim[argument2] == nil then
                    optim[argument2] = argument3
                end
            end
            callback("fpsunlock", false)
            callback("darken", 45)
            if optim.on == true then
                if optim.migrated2 == nil then
                    optim.gfxLow = optim.lowquality ~= false
                    optim.noShadows = optim.shadows ~= false
                    optim.noFx = optim.particles ~= false
                    optim.noTex = optim.textures ~= false
                    optim.stopAnims = optim.anims ~= false
                    optim.plastic = optim.materials == true
                    optim.antiGlare = true
                end
            end
            optim.migrated2 = true
            optim.on = false
            local cursor = {
                "gfxLow",
                "noShadows",
                "noLights",
                "noPost",
                "noFx",
                "noTex",
                "plastic",
                "simplePlayers",
                "stopAnims",
                "bgSaver",
                "antiGlare",
            }
            for unused, item in ipairs(cursor) do
                callback(item, false)
            end
            local players = game:GetService("Players")
            local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
            local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
            local userGameSettings, entries, entries2, entries3 =
                UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings"),
                { orig = {}, glob = {} },
                { ParticleEmitter = true, Beam = true, Trail = true, Fire = true, Smoke = true, Sparkles = true },
                { "shadow", "lshadow", "light", "fx", "tex", "mtex", "plastic", "acc", "wrap", "post" }
            for unused, item in ipairs(entries3) do
                entries.orig[item] = {}
            end
            entries.skip = function(argument)
                local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if camera then
                    if argument:IsDescendantOf(camera) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                camera = localPlayer.Character
                if camera then
                    if argument:IsDescendantOf(camera) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                camera = argument
                while camera and camera ~= workspace and camera ~= lighting do
                    if string.sub(camera.Name, 1, 5) == "Pulse" then
                        return true
                    end
                    camera = camera.Parent
                end
                return false
            end
            entries.save = function(argument, argument2, argument3)
                local entry = entries.orig[argument]
                if entry[argument2] == nil then
                    entry[argument2] = argument3
                end
            end
            entries.otherChar = function(getPlayerFromCharacterResult)
                local findFirstAncestorOfClassResult = (getPlayerFromCharacterResult:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"))
                while findFirstAncestorOfClassResult do
                    if findFirstAncestorOfClassResult:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                        getPlayerFromCharacterResult = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(findFirstAncestorOfClassResult)
                        return getPlayerFromCharacterResult ~= nil and getPlayerFromCharacterResult ~= localPlayer
                    end
                    findFirstAncestorOfClassResult = findFirstAncestorOfClassResult.Parent
                        and findFirstAncestorOfClassResult.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                end
                return false
            end
            entries.touch = function(instance)
                local className = instance.ClassName
                local isAResult = instance:IsA("BasePart")
                local calculatedValue = not isAResult and instance:IsA("Light")
                local calculatedValue2 = entries2[className] == true
                local calculatedValue3 = className == "Decal" or className == "Texture" or className == "SpecialMesh"
                local calculatedValue4 = className == "WrapLayer"
                if isAResult or calculatedValue then
                elseif calculatedValue2 then
                elseif calculatedValue3 then
                elseif calculatedValue4 then
                else
                    return
                end
                if entries.skip(instance) then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    if isAResult then
                        if optim.noShadows then
                            if instance.CastShadow then
                                entries.save("shadow", instance, true)
                                instance.CastShadow = false
                            end
                        end
                        if
                            optim.plastic and (
                                instance.Material ~= Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or instance.Reflectance ~= 0
                            )
                        then
                            if instance.Material ~= Enum.Material.ForceField then
                                if instance.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon then
                                    entries.save("plastic", instance, { instance.Material, instance.Reflectance })
                                    instance.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                                    instance.Reflectance = 0
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if optim.noTex then
                            if className == "MeshPart" then
                                if instance.TextureID ~= "" then
                                    entries.save("mtex", instance, instance.TextureID)
                                    instance.TextureID = ""
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if optim.simplePlayers then
                            if instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
                                if entries.otherChar(instance) then
                                    entries.save("acc", instance, instance.LocalTransparencyModifier)
                                    instance.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    elseif calculatedValue then
                        if optim.noLights then
                            if instance.Enabled then
                                entries.save("light", instance, true)
                                instance.Enabled = false
                            end
                        end
                        if optim.noShadows then
                            if instance.Shadows then
                                entries.save("lshadow", instance, true)
                                instance.Shadows = false
                            end
                        end
                    elseif calculatedValue2 then
                        if optim.noFx then
                            if instance.Enabled then
                                entries.save("fx", instance, true)
                                instance.Enabled = false
                            end
                        end
                    elseif calculatedValue3 then
                        if optim.noTex then
                            if className == "SpecialMesh" then
                                if instance.TextureId ~= "" then
                                    entries.save("tex", instance, instance.TextureId)
                                    instance.TextureId = ""
                                end
                            elseif instance.Transparency < 1 then
                                entries.save("tex", instance, instance.Transparency)
                                instance.Transparency = 1
                            end
                        end
                    elseif calculatedValue4 then
                        if optim.simplePlayers then
                            if instance.Enabled then
                                if entries.otherChar(instance) then
                                    entries.save("wrap", instance, true)
                                    instance.Enabled = false
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            entries.restore = function(argument)
                local entry = entries.orig[argument]
                entries.orig[argument] = {}
                for key, shadows in pairs(entry) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if not key.Parent then
                            return
                        end
                        if argument == "shadow" then
                            key.CastShadow = shadows
                        elseif argument == "lshadow" then
                            key.Shadows = shadows
                        elseif argument == "light" then
                            key.Enabled = shadows
                        elseif argument == "fx" then
                            key.Enabled = shadows
                        elseif argument == "wrap" then
                            key.Enabled = shadows
                        elseif argument == "tex" then
                            if key.ClassName == "SpecialMesh" then
                                key.TextureId = shadows
                            else
                                key.Transparency = shadows
                            end
                        elseif argument == "mtex" then
                            key.TextureID = shadows
                        elseif argument == "plastic" then
                            key.Material, key.Reflectance = shadows[1], shadows[2]
                        elseif argument == "acc" then
                            key.LocalTransparencyModifier = shadows
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            entries.sweep = function()
                if not optim.noShadows then
                    if not optim.noLights then
                        if not optim.noFx then
                            if not optim.noTex then
                                if not optim.plastic then
                                    if not optim.simplePlayers then
                                        return
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.spawn(function()
                    for key, item in ipairs((workspace:GetDescendants())) do
                        entries.touch(item)
                        if key % 600 == 0 then
                            task.wait()
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            entries.globals = function()
                pcall(function()
                    if optim.gfxLow then
                        if entries.glob.gfx == nil then
                            entries.glob.gfx = userGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel
                        end
                        if userGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel ~= Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1 then
                            userGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel = Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1
                        end
                    elseif entries.glob.gfx ~= nil then
                        userGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel = entries.glob.gfx
                        entries.glob.gfx = nil
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if optim.noShadows then
                        if entries.glob.shadows == nil then
                            entries.glob.shadows = lighting.GlobalShadows
                        end
                        lighting.GlobalShadows = false
                    elseif entries.glob.shadows ~= nil then
                        lighting.GlobalShadows = entries.glob.shadows
                        entries.glob.shadows = nil
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if optim.noPost then
                        for unused, instance in ipairs(lighting:GetChildren()) do
                            if string.sub(instance.Name, 1, 5) ~= "Pulse" then
                                if instance:IsA("PostEffect") and instance.Enabled then
                                    entries.save("post", instance, true)
                                    instance.Enabled = false
                                elseif instance:IsA("Atmosphere") then
                                    if instance.Density > 0 then
                                        entries.save("post", instance, instance.Density)
                                        instance.Density = 0
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        local post = entries.orig.post
                        entries.orig.post = {}
                        for instance, density in pairs(post) do
                            pcall(function()
                                if not instance.Parent then
                                    return
                                end
                                if instance:IsA("Atmosphere") then
                                    instance.Density = density
                                else
                                    instance.Enabled = density
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end)
                entries.glare()
            end
            entries.glare = function()
                if getgenv().__pulseVisOwns == true then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    if optim.antiGlare then
                        if not entries.glob.light then
                            entries.glob.light = { lighting.Brightness, lighting.Ambient, lighting.OutdoorAmbient }
                        end
                        local light, clampedValue, color =
                            entries.glob.light, math.clamp((tonumber(optim.darken) or 0) / 100, 0, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                        lighting.Brightness = light[1] * (1 - clampedValue * 0.8)
                        lighting.Ambient = light[2]:Lerp(color, clampedValue)
                        lighting.OutdoorAmbient = light[3]:Lerp(color, clampedValue)
                    elseif entries.glob.light then
                        local light = entries.glob.light
                        entries.glob.light = nil
                        lighting.Brightness, lighting.Ambient, lighting.OutdoorAmbient = light[1], light[2], light[3]
                    end
                end)
            end
            entries.restoreAll = function()
                for key in pairs(entries.orig) do
                    entries.restore(key)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    if entries.glob.gfx ~= nil then
                        userGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel = entries.glob.gfx
                        entries.glob.gfx = nil
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if entries.glob.shadows ~= nil then
                        lighting.GlobalShadows = entries.glob.shadows
                        entries.glob.shadows = nil
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if entries.glob.light then
                        local light = entries.glob.light
                        entries.glob.light = nil
                        lighting.Brightness, lighting.Ambient, lighting.OutdoorAmbient = light[1], light[2], light[3]
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if entries.bgOff then
                        entries.bgOff = false
                        game:GetService("RunService"):Set3dRenderingEnabled(true)
                        if entries.bgCap then
                            if type(setfpscap) == "function" then
                                setfpscap(entries.bgCap)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            callback2(function()
                pcall(entries.restoreAll)
            end)
            connectSignal(workspace.DescendantAdded, function(argument)
                if
                    optim.noShadows
                    or optim.noLights
                    or optim.noFx
                    or optim.noTex
                    or optim.plastic
                    or optim.simplePlayers
                then
                    task.defer(entries.touch, argument)
                end
            end)
            connectSignal(lighting.ChildAdded, function()
                if optim.noPost then
                    task.defer(entries.globals)
                end
            end)
            connectSignal(userGameSettings:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SavedQualityLevel"), function()
                if optim.gfxLow then
                    if userGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel ~= Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1 then
                        entries.glob.gfx = userGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel
                        task.defer(function()
                            if optim.gfxLow then
                                pcall(function()
                                    userGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel = Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1
                                end)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
            do
                local userInputService, runService = game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("RunService")
                connectSignal(userInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
                    if optim.bgSaver then
                        if entries.bgOff then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    entries.bgOff = true
                    pcall(function()
                        entries.bgCap = type(getfpscap) == "function" and getfpscap() or (optim.fpsunlock and 9999 or 240)
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        runService:Set3dRenderingEnabled(false)
                    end)
                    if type(setfpscap) == "function" then
                        pcall(function()
                            setfpscap(10)
                        end)
                    end
                end)
                connectSignal(userInputService.WindowFocused, function()
                    if not entries.bgOff then
                        return
                    end
                    entries.bgOff = false
                    pcall(function()
                        runService:Set3dRenderingEnabled(not optim.no3d)
                    end)
                    if type(setfpscap) == "function" then
                        pcall(function()
                            if optim.no3d then
                                setfpscap(math.clamp(tonumber(optim.no3dFps) or 15, 5, 60))
                            else
                                local callback4, calculatedValue =
                                    setfpscap, optim.fpsunlock and 9999 or (entries.bgCap or 240)
                                callback4(calculatedValue)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                while pAlive() do
                    task.wait(0.3)
                    if optim.stopAnims then
                        for humanoid, localPlayer2 in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                            if localPlayer2 ~= localPlayer and localPlayer2.Character then
                                humanoid = localPlayer2.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                local calculatedValue = humanoid and (humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator"))
                                if calculatedValue then
                                    for unused, item in ipairs(calculatedValue:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                                        pcall(function()
                                            item:Stop(0)
                                        end)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                while pAlive() do
                    task.wait(2)
                    if optim.fpsunlock then
                        if not entries.bgOff then
                            if type(setfpscap) == "function" then
                                pcall(function()
                                    setfpscap(9999)
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            local function color(text, argument, callback4)
                uiPage:Toggle({
                    Text = text,
                    Default = optim[argument] == true,
                    Callback = function(argument2)
                        local calculatedValue = optim[argument] == true
                        optim[argument] = argument2 and true or false
                        if callback4 then
                            callback4(optim[argument], calculatedValue)
                        end
                    end,
                })
            end
            local function callback4(argument)
                return function(argument2, argument3)
                    if argument2 and not argument3 then
                        entries.sweep()
                    elseif if argument2 then not argument2 else argument3 then
                        for unused, item in ipairs(argument) do
                            entries.restore(item)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            color("No Shadows", "noShadows", function(argument, argument2)
                entries.globals()
                callback4({ "shadow", "lshadow" })(argument, argument2)
            end)
            color("No Map Lights", "noLights", (callback4({ "light" })))
            color("No Post Effects", "noPost", function()
                entries.globals()
            end)
            color("No Particles", "noFx", (callback4({ "fx" })))
            color("No Textures", "noTex", (callback4({ "tex", "mtex" })))
            color("Plastic Materials", "plastic", (callback4({ "plastic" })))
            uiPage:Toggle({
                Text = "Anti-Glare",
                Default = optim.antiGlare == true,
                Callback = function(argument)
                    optim.antiGlare = argument and true or false
                    entries.glare()
                end,
                Settings = function()
                    uiPage:Slider({
                        Text = "Darken",
                        Min = 0,
                        Max = 100,
                        Default = optim.darken,
                        Decimals = 0,
                        Callback = function(darken)
                            optim.darken = darken
                            entries.glare()
                        end,
                    })
                end,
            })
            uiPage:Header("Performance")
            uiPage:Toggle({
                Text = "FPS Unlocker (9999)",
                Default = optim.fpsunlock,
                Callback = function(argument)
                    optim.fpsunlock = argument and true or false
                    if argument then
                        if type(setfpscap) == "function" then
                            pcall(function()
                                setfpscap(9999)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end,
            })
            color("Low Graphics", "gfxLow", function()
                entries.globals()
            end)
            color("Simple Players", "simplePlayers", (callback4({ "acc", "wrap" })))
            color("Stop Animations (others)", "stopAnims", nil)
            color("Background Saver", "bgSaver", nil)
            pcall(function()
                local entries4, callback4 =
                    {
                        ["Disable 3D Rendering"] = {
                            "Disable 3D Rendering",
                            "Disable 3D Rendering",
                        },
                        ["FPS Cap"] = { "FPS Cap", "FPS Cap" },
                    },
                    pairs
                for key, item in callback4(entries4) do
                    if localization.data.ru then
                        if localization.data.ru[key] == nil then
                            localization.data.ru[key] = item[1]
                        end
                    end
                    if localization.data.uk then
                        if localization.data.uk[key] == nil then
                            localization.data.uk[key] = item[2]
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            local function isActive()
                pcall(function()
                    game:GetService("RunService"):Set3dRenderingEnabled(not optim.no3d)
                end)
                if type(setfpscap) ~= "function" then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    if optim.no3d then
                        if entries.no3dCap == nil then
                            entries.no3dCap = type(getfpscap) == "function" and getfpscap() or nil
                        end
                        setfpscap(math.clamp(tonumber(optim.no3dFps) or 15, 5, 60))
                    else
                        local callback4, calculatedValue = setfpscap, optim.fpsunlock and 9999 or (entries.no3dCap or 240)
                        callback4(calculatedValue)
                        entries.no3dCap = nil
                    end
                end)
            end
            uiPage:Toggle({
                Text = "Disable 3D Rendering",
                Default = optim.no3d == true,
                Callback = function(argument)
                    local calculatedValue = optim.no3d == true
                    optim.no3d = argument and true or false
                    if optim.no3d then
                        isActive()
                    elseif calculatedValue then
                        isActive()
                    end
                end,
                Settings = function()
                    uiPage:Slider({
                        Text = "FPS Cap",
                        Min = 5,
                        Max = 60,
                        Default = math.clamp(tonumber(optim.no3dFps) or 15, 5, 60),
                        Decimals = 0,
                        Callback = function(no3dFps)
                            optim.no3dFps = no3dFps
                            if optim.no3d then
                                if type(setfpscap) == "function" then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        setfpscap(no3dFps)
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end,
                    })
                end,
            })
            callback2(function()
                if optim.no3d then
                    pcall(function()
