    constructors.createInvisibilityControls = function(connectSignal, localPlayer, argument, callback, callback2, argument2, uiPage)
        return function()
            local runService, enabled, humanoid, rootPart = game:GetService("RunService"), false
            local entries, entries2, entries3 = {}
            local enabled2, enabled3, transform, position = false, false
            local maximumValue, counter = 0
            local enabled4 = false
            local function callback3(argument3)
                maximumValue = math.max(maximumValue, os.clock() + (argument3 or 0.5))
                if counter then
                    return
                end
                counter = connectSignal(runService.Stepped, function()
                    local value, value2 = humanoid, rootPart
                    if os.clock() > maximumValue or not (value and value2 and value2.Parent) or value.Health <= 0 then
                        if counter then
                            pcall(function()
                                counter:Disconnect()
                            end)
                            counter = nil
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if value.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                        return
                    end
                    enabled4 = not enabled4
                    pcall(function()
                        value2.CFrame = value2.CFrame
                            * CFrame.new(0, enabled4 and 0.03 or -0.03, 0)
                            * CFrame.Angles(0, enabled4 and 0.01 or -0.01, 0)
                    end)
                end)
            end
            local function isActive()
                local character = localPlayer.Character
                if not character then
                    humanoid, rootPart, entries = nil, nil, {}
                    return
                end
                humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                rootPart, entries = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), {}
                local callback4, packedValues = ipairs, packValues(character:GetDescendants())
                for near, p in callback4(unpackTuple(packedValues)) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                        if p.Transparency == 0 then
                            near, character =
                                p.Name == "Head" or p.Parent ~= nil and p.Parent:IsA("Accessory") or false, entries
                            character[#entries + 1] = { p = p, near = near }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function callback4(argument3)
                pcall(function()
                    local value = entries
                    for unused, item in ipairs(value) do
                        if item.p then
                            if item.p.Parent then
                                item.p.LocalTransparencyModifier = argument3 and 0.5 or 0
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function isActive2()
                local camera = argument.CurrentCamera
                if not camera then
                    return false, nil
                end
                local position2 = camera.CFrame.Position
                if localPlayer.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then
                    return true, position2
                end
                camera = localPlayer.Character
                local calculatedValue = camera and (camera:FindFirstChild("Head"))
                if calculatedValue then
                    if (calculatedValue.Position - position2).Magnitude < 1.5 then
                        return true, position2
                    end
                end
                return false, position2
            end
            local function isActive3()
                if not enabled then
                    return
                end
                enabled, enabled3 = false, false
                pcall(function()
                    if getgenv().__pulseInvis then
                        getgenv().__pulseInvis.active, getgenv().__pulseInvis.real = false, nil
                    end
                end)
                if entries2 then
                    pcall(function()
                        entries2:Disconnect()
                    end)
                    entries2 = nil
                end
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseInvisRestore")
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseInvisGhost")
                end)
                callback4(false)
                local value = rootPart
                if value and value.Parent then
                    local transform2 = entries3 or value.CFrame
                    pcall(function()
                        value.CFrame = transform2
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        value.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        value.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    end)
                    callback3(0.5)
                end
            end
            callback(function()
                pcall(isActive3)
            end)
            local raycastParams, value
            local position2 = Vector3.new(0, -5, 0)
            local function isActive4()
                if enabled then
                    return
                end
                isActive()
                if humanoid then
                    if not rootPart then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                enabled, enabled3 = true, false
                callback4(true)
                entries2 = connectSignal(runService.Heartbeat, function()
                    if not enabled then
                        return
                    end
                    local value2, value3 = humanoid, rootPart
                    local calculatedValue = value2 and value3 and value3.Parent
                    if
                        (if calculatedValue then value3.Parent ~= localPlayer.Character else not calculatedValue)
                        or value2.Health <= 0
                    then
                        local pulseInvis = getgenv().__pulseInvis
                        if pulseInvis then
                            pulseInvis.active = false
                            pulseInvis.real = nil
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        local rawgetResult = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseAfRevert")
                        if rawgetResult then
                            pcall(rawgetResult)
                        end
                        rawgetResult = value2.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01
                        if not raycastParams then
                            raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                            local value4 = raycastParams
                            value4.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        end
                        local character = localPlayer.Character
                        if value ~= character then
                            value = character
                            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
                        end
                        local grounded, pulseInvis =
                            argument:Raycast(value3.Position, position2, raycastParams) ~= nil, getgenv().__pulseInvis or {}
                        pulseInvis.active = true
                        pulseInvis.grounded = grounded
                        getgenv().__pulseInvis = pulseInvis
                        local real, value = value3.CFrame, -200000
                        if grounded then
                            if rawgetResult then
                            else
                                enabled2 = not enabled2
                                value = if enabled2 then -199999.5 else value
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        transform, entries3 = real, real
                        pulseInvis.real = real
                        pulseInvis.realAt = os.clock()
                        if (tonumber(getgenv().__pulseInvisPause) or 0) > os.clock() then
                            return
                        end
                        value3.CFrame = real * CFrame.new(0, value, 0)
                        position, enabled3 = value3.Position, true
                    end)
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    callback2("PulseInvisRestore", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
                        if enabled3 then
                            if rootPart then
                                if rootPart.Parent then
                                    if transform then
                                        if
                                            if position then (rootPart.Position - position).Magnitude < 2 else not position
                                        then
                                            pcall(function()
                                                rootPart.CFrame = transform
                                            end)
                                        end
                                        enabled3 = false
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end)
                callback3(0.5)
                pcall(function()
                    callback2("PulseInvisGhost", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
                        if not enabled then
                            return
                        end
                        local value2, value3 = isActive2()
                        pcall(function()
                            local value4 = entries
                            for p, item in ipairs(value4) do
                                p = item.p
                                if p then
                                    if p.Parent then
                                        local localTransparencyModifier = 0.5
                                        if value2 then
                                            if item.near then
                                                localTransparencyModifier = 1
                                            else
                                                local calculatedValue = value3 and (p.Position - value3).Magnitude or 99
                                                localTransparencyModifier = if calculatedValue < 1.2
                                                    then 1

            local function load(argument2)

                end

                    end

                            )

                        end

            end

            local function callback2(argument2)
                local callback3, entries4 =
                    ipairs, { crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode }
                for unused, item in callback3(entries4) do
                    if type(item) == "function" then
                        local success, result = pcall(item, argument2)
                        if success then
                            if type(result) == "string" then
                                if #result > 0 then
                                    return result
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                callback3 = {}
                for index = 1, 64, 1 do
                    callback3[string.byte("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", index)] = index
                        - 1
                end
                local entries5, counter = {}, 0
                for index = 1, #argument2 - 3, 4 do
                    local byteResult, byteResult2, byteResult3, byteResult4 = string.byte(argument2, index, index + 3)
                    entries4 = (callback3[byteResult] or 0) * 262144
                        + (callback3[byteResult2] or 0) * 4096
                        + (callback3[byteResult3] or 0) * 64
                        + (callback3[byteResult4] or 0)
                    counter += 1
                    if byteResult3 == 61 then
                        entries5[counter] = string.char(math.floor(entries4 / 65536) % 256)
                    elseif byteResult4 == 61 then
                        entries5[counter] =
                            string.char(math.floor(entries4 / 65536) % 256, math.floor(entries4 / 256) % 256)
                    else
                        entries5[counter] = string.char(
                            math.floor(entries4 / 65536) % 256,
                            math.floor(entries4 / 256) % 256,
                            entries4 % 256
                        )
                    end
                end
                return table.concat(entries5)
            end

                if entries4[argument2] then

                task.delay(8, function()
                    pcall(function()
                        sound:Destroy()
                    end)
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    connectSignal(sound.Ended, function()
                        pcall(function()
                            sound:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end)
                end)
            end

            local function callback2(argument2)
                local lowerResult = string.lower(argument2.Name)
                if settings.sheriff.shotSnd ~= "Off" then
                    if lowerResult == "gunshot" then
                        return true
                    elseif lowerResult == "reload" then
                        return true
                    elseif lowerResult == "gunkill" then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                if settings.sheriff.killSnd ~= "Off" then
                    if lowerResult == "gunkill" then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local function callback3(instance)
                if not (instance:IsA("Sound")) then
                    return
                end
                if callback2(instance) then
                    if not entries3[instance] then
                        local value = entries3
                        value[instance] = { vol = instance.Volume }
                    end
                    if not entries4[instance] then
                        entries4[instance] = true
                        pcall(function()
                            connectSignal(instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Volume"), function()
                                local entry = entries3[instance]
                                if entry then
                                    if instance.Volume ~= 0 then
                                        entry.vol = instance.Volume
                                        instance.Volume = 0
                                    end
                                end
                            end)
                        end)
                    end
                    if instance.Volume ~= 0 then
                        pcall(function()
                            instance.Volume = 0
                        end)
                    end
                elseif entries3[instance] then
                    local entry = entries3[instance]
                    entries3[instance] = nil
                    pcall(function()
                        instance.Volume = entry.vol
                    end)
                end
            end
            local value, value2
            local function handleAction()
                local value3 = entries3
                for key, item in pairs(value3) do
                    if key.Parent then
                        if not (callback2(key)) then
                            entries3[key] = nil
                            pcall(function()
                                key.Volume = item.vol
                            end)
                        end
                    else
                        entries3[key] = nil
                        entries4[key] = nil
                    end
                end
                for key in pairs(entries4) do
                    if not key.Parent then
                        entries4[key] = nil
                    end
                end
                value3 = isActive3()
                if not value3 then
                    return
                end
                if value ~= value3 then
                    if value2 then
                        pcall(function()
                            value2:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end
                    value = value3
                    value2 = connectSignal(value3.DescendantAdded, function(instance)
                        if instance:IsA("Sound") then
                            callback3(instance)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                for unused, instance in ipairs(value3:GetDescendants()) do
                    if instance:IsA("Sound") then
                        callback3(instance)
                    end
                end
            end
            local function callback5()
                pcall(handleAction)
            end
            callback(function()
                local value3 = entries3
                for key, item in pairs(value3) do
                    pcall(function()
                        key.Volume = item.vol
                    end)
                end
                entries3 = {}
            end)

                while isActive() do
                    task.wait(0.25)
                    if settings.sheriff.shotSnd ~= "Off" then
                        pcall(handleAction)
                    elseif settings.sheriff.killSnd ~= "Off" then
                        pcall(handleAction)
                    elseif next(entries3) then
                        pcall(handleAction)
                    end
                end
            end)
            local counter = 0
            task.spawn(function()
                local clientServices = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ClientServices", 30)
                local calculatedValue = clientServices and (clientServices:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 30))
                clientServices = calculatedValue and (calculatedValue:WaitForChild("GunFired", 30))

                        if not (isActive()) then
                            return
                        end

                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                connectSignal(clientServices.OnClientEvent, function(argument2, now, unused, argument3)

                    pcall(function()
                        local parent = typeof(argument2) == "Instance" and argument2 or nil
                        while parent and not (parent:IsA("Model") and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do
                            parent = parent.Parent

                        enabled = parent ~= nil and parent == localPlayer.Character

                        return

                        if now - counter > 0.15 then

                                parent = parent.Parent
                            end

                                    if game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(parent) then

                                    end
                                end
                            end

                                pulsePreviewSound(callback4(entries2, settings.sheriff.killSnd))

    constructors.createTeleportTab = function(localPlayer, isActive, uiWindow, localization)
        return function()
            local players = game:GetService("Players")
            pcall(function()
                return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.CurrentRoundClient)
            end)
            local function isActive2()
                local character = localPlayer.Character
                return character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            end
            local function isActive3()
                return isActive()
            end
            local function callback(argument)
                for key, item in pairs(isActive3()) do
                    if type(item) == "table" then
                        if item.Role then
                            if tostring(item.Role):lower():find(argument) then
                                if item.Dead ~= true then
                                    return key
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function callback2(transform)
                local value = isActive2()
                if value and transform then
                    pcall(function()
                        value.CFrame = transform
                    end)
                    return true
                end
                return false
            end
            local function callback3(character)
                if not character then
                    return false
                end
                local localPlayer2 = players:FindFirstChild(character)
                if localPlayer2 then
                    if localPlayer2 == localPlayer then
                        return false
                    end
                else
                    return false
                end
                character = localPlayer2.Character
                localPlayer2 = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                if not localPlayer2 then
                    return false
                end
                return callback2(localPlayer2.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 5))
            end
            local function isActive()
                local instance, calculatedValue = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
                    or workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
                if instance then
                    local spawns = instance:FindFirstChild("Spawns")
                    calculatedValue = (if spawns then (spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) else calculatedValue)
                        or (instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true))
                else
                end
                calculatedValue = calculatedValue or workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
                if calculatedValue then
                    return callback2(calculatedValue.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
                end
                return false
            end
            local function isActive2()
                for unused, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                    if instance:IsA("Model") then
                        if not (string.find(instance.Name, "Lobby", 1, true)) then
                            if instance:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") then
                                return instance
                            elseif instance:FindFirstChild("Spawns") then
                                return instance
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function isActive3()
                local instance = isActive2()
                if not instance then
                    pcall(function()
                        local mainWindow, entries = uiWindow.W, {}
                        entries.Title, entries.Kind, entries.Duration = localization.tr("No map loaded"), "warning", 2.5
                        mainWindow:Notify(entries)
                    end)
                    return false
                end
                local entries, spawns = {}, instance:FindFirstChild("Spawns")
                if spawns then
                    for unused, instance2 in ipairs(spawns:GetChildren()) do
                        if instance2:IsA("BasePart") then
                            entries[#entries + 1] = instance2
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #entries > 0 then
                    return callback2(entries[math.random(1, #entries)].CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
                end
                spawns = instance:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
                entries = spawns and (spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
                if entries then
                    return callback2(CFrame.new(entries.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
                end
                return callback2(instance:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
            end
            local tabResult = uiWindow:Tab("Teleport", "location-pin-map")
            tabResult:Columns()
            tabResult:Group({ Title = "TP Role", Side = "Left" })
            tabResult:Button({
                Text = "Tp Lobby",
                Callback = function()
                    isActive()
                end,
            })
            tabResult:Button({
                Text = "Tp Map",
                Callback = function()
                    isActive3()
                end,
            })
            tabResult:Button({
                Text = "Tp Murderer",
                Callback = function()
                    callback3(callback("murder"))
                end,
            })
            tabResult:Button({
                Text = "Tp Sheriff",
                Callback = function()
                    callback3(callback("sheriff") or callback("hero"))
                end,
            })
            tabResult:Group({ Title = "TP Player", Side = "Right" })
            tabResult:PlayerList({
                ExcludeLocal = true,
                Momentary = true,
                ActionIcon = "map-pin",
                OnSelect = function(argument)
                    if argument then
                        callback3(argument.Name)
                    end
                end,
            })
        end
    end

                if entries2 == nil then

                if

                end

                        + math.abs(argument2.G - argument3.G)
                        + math.abs(argument2.B - argument3.B)
                    < 0.004
                then

                end
                return argument2
            end

            pulseESP2.make = function(argument2, argument3, parent)
                local instance = Instance.new(argument2)
                for key, item in pairs(argument3 or {}) do
                    instance[key] = item
                end
                instance.Parent = parent
                return instance
            end
            pulseESP2.holder = function()
                if argument then
                    if argument.Parent then
                        return argument
                    end
                end
                return localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            end
            pulseESP2.root = function()
                if i.gui then
                    if i.gui.Parent then
                        return i.gui
                    end
                end
                i.gui = pulseESP2.make(
                    "ScreenGui",
                    {
                        Name = "PulseESP2",
                        ResetOnSpawn = false,
                        IgnoreGuiInset = true,
                        DisplayOrder = 9,
                        ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
                    },
                    pulseESP2.holder()
                )
                return i.gui
            end
            pulseESP2.frame = function(argument2, name, argument)
                return pulseESP2.make(
                    "Frame",
                    { Name = name, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, Visible = false, ZIndex = argument
                        or 2 },
                    argument2
                )
            end
            pulseESP2.stroke = function(argument2, argument)
                return pulseESP2.make(
                    "UIStroke",
                    {
                        Thickness = argument or 1,
                        Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
                        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
                        Transparency = 1,
                    },
                    argument2
                )
            end
            pulseESP2.line = function(argument2, argument)
                local frame = pulseESP2.frame(argument2, argument, 4)
                frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                return { frame = frame, stroke = pulseESP2.stroke(frame, 1) }
            end
            pulseESP2.drawLineXY = function(
                argument2,
                argument,
                argument3,
                argument4,
                stroke,
                argument5,
                argument6,
                argument7,
                argument8
            )
                local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2, frame = argument4 - argument, stroke - argument3, argument2.frame
                local sqrtResult = math.sqrt(calculatedValue * calculatedValue + calculatedValue2 * calculatedValue2)
                local calculatedValue3 = sqrtResult < 60 and 1 or 4
                callback4(
                    frame,
                    "Position",
                    math.floor((argument + argument4) * 0.5 + 0.5),
                    math.floor((argument3 + stroke) * 0.5 + 0.5)
                )
                callback4(
                    frame,
                    "Size",
                    math.max(math.floor(sqrtResult + 0.5), 1),
                    math.max(1, math.floor(argument6 + 0.5))
                )
                put(
                    frame,
                    "Rotation",
                    math.floor(math.deg(math.atan2(calculatedValue2, calculatedValue)) * calculatedValue3 + 0.5)
                        / calculatedValue3
                )
                put(frame, "BackgroundColor3", argument5)
                put(frame, "BackgroundTransparency", callback5(1 - argument7))
                stroke = argument2.stroke
                if argument8 then
                    put(stroke, "Enabled", true)
                    put(stroke, "Color", pulseESP2.outlineCol or color2)
                    put(
                        stroke,
                        "Transparency",
                        callback5(
                            1 - math.min(argument7 * 1.15 * math.clamp((pulseESP2.outlineAlpha or 65) / 65, 0, 1.5), 1)
                        )
                    )
                else
                    put(stroke, "Enabled", false)
                    put(stroke, "Transparency", 1)
                end
                put(frame, "Visible", true)
            end
            pulseESP2.drawLine = function(argument2, argument, argument3, argument4, argument5, argument6, argument7)
                pulseESP2.drawLineXY(
                    argument2,
                    argument.X,
                    argument.Y,
                    argument3.X,
                    argument3.Y,
                    argument4,
                    argument5,
                    argument6,
                    argument7
                )
            end
            pulseESP2.makeBar = function(argument2, argument)
                local back = pulseESP2.frame(argument2, argument, 5)
                back.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(11, 15, 22)
                local fill = pulseESP2.frame(back, "Fill", 6)
                local gradient, separators, number = pulseESP2.make("UIGradient", {}, fill), pulseESP2.make, {}
                number.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
                separators("UICorner", number, back)
                separators, number = pulseESP2.make, {}
                number.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
                separators("UICorner", number, fill)
                number, separators =
                    pulseESP2.make(
                        "TextLabel",
                        {
                            Name = argument .. "Value",
                            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                            BorderSizePixel = 0,
                            RichText = false,
                            Text = "",
                            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                            TextSize = 11,
                            TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                            TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 8, 13),
                            Visible = false,
                            ZIndex = 8,
                        },
                        argument2
                    ),
                    {}
                for index = 1, 9, 1 do
                    separators[index] = pulseESP2.frame(back, "Segment" .. index, 7)
                end
                return {
                    back = back,
                    fill = fill,
                    gradient = gradient,
                    number = number,
                    stroke = pulseESP2.stroke(back, 1),
                    separators = separators,
                }
            end

            pulseESP2.makeSet = function(localPlayer2)
                local layer = pulseESP2.frame(pulseESP2.root(), "Player_" .. tostring(localPlayer2.UserId), 2)
                layer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                localPlayer2 = pulseESP2.frame(layer, "Box", 3)
                local fillGradient, edge =
                    pulseESP2.make("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90 }, localPlayer2), pulseESP2.stroke(localPlayer2, 1.5)
                local edgeGradient, round, glow =
                    pulseESP2.make("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90 }, edge),
                    pulseESP2.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0) }, localPlayer2),
                    pulseESP2.frame(layer, "Glow", 2)
                local glowStroke, glowRound, outer =
                    pulseESP2.stroke(glow, 6), pulseESP2.make("UICorner", {}, glow), pulseESP2.frame(layer, "BoxOutline", 2)
                local entries = {
                    layer = layer,
                    box = localPlayer2,
                    edge = edge,
                    round = round,
                    glow = glow,
                    glowStroke = glowStroke,
                    glowRound = glowRound,
                    fillGradient = fillGradient,
                    outer = outer,
                    outerStroke = pulseESP2.stroke(outer, 3.5),
                    outerRound = pulseESP2.make("UICorner", {}, outer),
                    edgeGradient = edgeGradient,
                    corners = {},
                    cornerGlow = {},
                    cornerEdge = {},
                    bones = {},
                    hp = pulseESP2.makeBar(layer, "Health"),
                    look = pulseESP2.line(layer, "Look"),
                    tracer = pulseESP2.line(layer, "Tracer"),
                }
                for index = 1, 8, 1 do
                    entries.corners[index] = pulseESP2.line(layer, "Corner" .. index)
                    entries.cornerGlow[index] = pulseESP2.line(layer, "CornerGlow" .. index)
                    entries.cornerGlow[index].frame.ZIndex = 2
                    entries.cornerEdge[index] = pulseESP2.frame(layer, "CornerEdge" .. index, 3)
                end
                for index = 1, #pulseESP2.BONES.R15, 1 do
                    edgeGradient, outer, edge = pulseESP2.line(layer, "Bone" .. index), pulseESP2.make, {}
                    edge.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                    outer("UICorner", edge, edgeGradient.frame)
                    entries.bones[index] = edgeGradient
                end
                entries.head = pulseESP2.frame(layer, "Head", 4)
                entries.head.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                edgeGradient, round = pulseESP2.make, {}
                round.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                edgeGradient("UICorner", round, entries.head)
                entries.headStroke = pulseESP2.stroke(entries.head, 1.5)
                return entries
            end

                    argument2.hpRatio = nil
                end
            end

            pulseESP2.modelRoot = function()
                local camera2 = workspace2.CurrentCamera
                if not camera2 then
                    return nil
                end
                if i.modelFolder then
                    if i.modelFolder.Parent == camera2 then
                        return i.modelFolder
                    end
                end
                if i.modelFolder then
                    pcall(function()
                        i.modelFolder:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                for unused, item in ipairs(camera2:GetChildren()) do
                    if item.Name == "PulseESPModels" then
                        pcall(function()
                            item:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                end
                i.modelFolder = pulseESP2.make("Folder", { Name = "PulseESPModels" }, camera2)
                return i.modelFolder
            end
            pulseESP2.poolFor = function(entries, argument)
                local pool, pool2 = i.pool
                if pool then
                    pool2 = pool
                else
                    local callback7, entries2 = setmetatable, { __mode = "k" }
                    pool2 = callback7({}, entries2)
                end
                i.pool = pool2
                pool = i.pool[entries]
                if pool then
                else
                    pool = {}
                    i.pool[entries] = pool
                end
                entries = pool[argument]
                if entries then
                else
                    entries = { at = os.clock(), items = {} }
                    pool[argument] = entries
                end
                return entries
            end
            pulseESP2.poolKey = function(argument2)
                local specialMesh = argument2.Size
                local calculatedValue = argument2.Name
                    .. "|"
                    .. argument2.ClassName
                    .. "|"
                    .. string.format("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f", specialMesh.X, specialMesh.Y, specialMesh.Z)
                if argument2.ClassName == "MeshPart" then
                    calculatedValue ..= "|" .. tostring(argument2.MeshId)
                else
                    specialMesh = argument2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
                    if specialMesh then
                        local scale = specialMesh.Scale
                        calculatedValue ..= "|" .. tostring(specialMesh.MeshId) .. "|" .. specialMesh.MeshType.Name .. "|" .. string.format(
                            "%.3f,%.3f,%.3f",
                            scale.X,
                            scale.Y,
                            scale.Z
                        )
                    else
                    end
                end
                return calculatedValue
            end
            pulseESP2.poolPurge = function(argument2)
                if not i.pool then
                    return
                end
                for unused, item in pairs(i.pool) do
                    for key, item2 in pairs(item) do
                        if argument2 == nil or key == argument2 then
                            for unused, item3 in pairs(item2.items) do
                                for unused, item2 in ipairs(item3) do
                                    pcall(function()
                                        item2:Destroy()
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                            item[key] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.poolSweep = function()
                if not i.pool then
                    return
                end
                local now = os.clock()
                for unused, item in pairs(i.pool) do
                    for key, item2 in pairs(item) do
                        if type(key) ~= "table" and key.Parent == nil or now - item2.at > 45 then
                            for unused, item3 in pairs(item2.items) do
                                for unused, item2 in ipairs(item3) do
                                    pcall(function()
                                        item2:Destroy()
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                            item[key] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.modelDropIn = function(argument2, argument)
                local entry = argument2[argument]
                if entry then
                    for unused, item in ipairs(entry.conns or {}) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end
                    local calculatedValue = entry.kind ~= "Wireframe"
                            and entry.keys
                            and pulseESP2.poolFor(argument2, argument)
                        or nil
                    for key, item in ipairs(entry.clones) do
                        local calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue and entry.keys[key]
                        if calculatedValue2 and item.Parent ~= nil then
                            pcall(function()
                                item.Transparency = 1
                            end)
                            key = calculatedValue.items[calculatedValue2]
                            if key then
                            else
                                key = {}
                                calculatedValue.items[calculatedValue2] = key
                            end
                            key[#key + 1] = item
                        else
                            pcall(function()
                                item:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    if calculatedValue then
                        calculatedValue.at = os.clock()
                    end
                end
                argument2[argument] = nil
            end
            pulseESP2.modelDrop = function(argument2)
                pulseESP2.modelDropIn(i.models, argument2)
                pulseESP2.modelDropIn(i.halos, argument2)
            end
            pulseESP2.cloneable = function(instance)
                local partKinds, className = i.partKinds, instance.ClassName
                local isAResult = partKinds[className]
                if isAResult == nil then
                    isAResult = instance:IsA("BasePart")
                    partKinds[className] = isAResult
                else
                end
                if isAResult then
                    if instance.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        return false
                    end
                else
                    return false
                end
                if instance.Transparency >= 0.95 then
                    return false
                elseif instance.LocalTransparencyModifier >= 0.95 then
                    return false
                end
                if instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer") then
                    return false
                end
                className = instance:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory")
                if className then
                    if className:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer", true) then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            pulseESP2.modelBroken = function(argument2)
                return argument2.char.Parent == nil
            end
            pulseESP2.modelBuild = function(char, material, spec, parent, argument)
                local kind = tostring(material):match("^[^@]+")
                local entries = { material = material, kind = kind, spec = spec, char = char }
                entries.root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                    or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                entries.sources = {}
                entries.clones = {}
                entries.sizes = {}
                entries.meshes = {}
                entries.scales = {}
                entries.cfs = {}
                entries.boxes = {}
                entries.keys = {}
                entries.shown = nil
                entries.scale = 1
                entries.conns = {}
                argument = if kind == "Wireframe" then nil else argument
                for key, item in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if pulseESP2.cloneable(item) then
                        material = argument and pulseESP2.poolKey(item) or nil
                        key = material and argument.items[material]
                        local m = key and table.remove(key)
                        while m and m.Parent ~= parent do
                            pcall(function()
                                m:Destroy()
                            end)
                            m = table.remove(key)
                        end
                        local specialMesh, calculatedValue
                        if m then
                            specialMesh = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
                            if specialMesh then
                                local specialMesh2 = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
                                calculatedValue = specialMesh2 and specialMesh2.Scale or specialMesh.Scale
                            else
                            end
                        else
                            local archivable = item.Archivable
                            item.Archivable = true
                            local success, result = pcall(function()
                                return item:Clone()
                            end)
                            item.Archivable = archivable
                            if success and result then
                                m = result
                                if m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh") then
                                    for unused, instance in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
                                        if instance:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                                            instance.TextureId = ""
                                            specialMesh = instance
                                        else
                                            instance:Destroy()
                                        end
                                    end
                                else
                                    m:ClearAllChildren()
                                end
                                calculatedValue = if specialMesh then specialMesh.Scale else calculatedValue
                                if m:IsA("MeshPart") then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        m.TextureID = ""
                                    end)
                                end
                                m.Name = "M"
                            else
                            end
                        end
                        if m then
                            local calculatedValue2 = #entries.clones + 1
                            if specialMesh and specialMesh.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then
                                entries.meshes[calculatedValue2], entries.scales[calculatedValue2] =
                                    specialMesh, calculatedValue * spec[2]
                                specialMesh.Scale = entries.scales[calculatedValue2]
                            else
                                entries.sizes[calculatedValue2] = item.Size * spec[2]
                                m.Size = entries.sizes[calculatedValue2]
                            end
                            m.Anchored = true
                            m.CanCollide = false
                            m.CanQuery = false
                            m.CanTouch = false
                            m.CastShadow = false
                            m.Material, m.Reflectance = spec[1], spec[4]
                            m.Transparency = 1
                            if kind == "Wireframe" then
                                if item.Parent == char then
                                    if item.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                                        entries.boxes[calculatedValue2] = pulseESP2.make(
                                            "SelectionBox",
                                            { Adornee = m, LineThickness = 0.02, SurfaceTransparency = 1, Transparency = 1 },
                                            m
                                        )
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if m.Parent ~= parent then
                                m.Parent = parent
                            end
                            entries.sources[calculatedValue2], entries.clones[calculatedValue2], entries.keys[calculatedValue2] =
                                item, m, material
                        end
                    end
                end
                local function handleAction(instance)
                    if
                        instance:IsA("BasePart")
                        or instance:IsA("Accessory")
                        or instance:IsA("WrapLayer")
                        or instance:IsA("SpecialMesh")
                    then
                        if not entries.dirty then
                            entries.dirty = os.clock()
                        end
                    end
                end
                entries.conns[1] = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(handleAction)
                entries.conns[2] = char.DescendantRemoving:Connect(handleAction)
                return entries
            end
            pulseESP2.modelResize = function(argument2, scale)
                argument2.scale = scale
                for key, item in ipairs(argument2.clones) do
                    local entry = argument2.meshes[key]
                    if entry then
                        entry.Scale = argument2.scales[key] * scale
                    else
                        item.Size = argument2.sizes[key] * scale
                    end
                end
                for unused, item in pairs(argument2.boxes) do
                    item.LineThickness = 0.02 * scale
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.modelPaint = function(entry, argument, transparency, argument2)
                local clones, sources, calculatedValue, calculatedValue2, color3 =
                    entry.clones, entry.sources, entry.kind or entry.material, pulseESP2.chamsSpeed or 1, entry.root
                local calculatedValue3, chamToneResult, chamToneResult2 = color3 and color3.Parent and color3.Position.Y
                    or 0
                if calculatedValue == "Gradient" then
                    chamToneResult, chamToneResult2 =
                        pulseESP2.chamTone(pulseESP2.tone(pulseESP2.chamsGradA)),
                        pulseESP2.chamTone(pulseESP2.tone(pulseESP2.chamsGradB))
                else
                end
                for index = 1, #clones, 1 do
                    entry, color3 = clones[index]
                    if calculatedValue == "Iridescent" then
                        color3 = Color3.fromHSV((argument2 * 0.12 * calculatedValue2 + index * 0.012) % 1, 0.38, 1)
                    else
                        if calculatedValue == "Gradient" then
                            local entry2 = sources[index]
                            local value = if entry2
                                then if entry2.Parent
                                    then math.clamp((entry2.Position.Y - (calculatedValue3 - 3)) / 5.6, 0, 1)
                                    else 0.5
                                else 0.5
                            value = if pulseESP2.chamsGradScroll
                                then math.abs((value + argument2 * 0.2 * calculatedValue2) % 1 * 2 - 1)
                                else value
                            color3 = (chamToneResult2:Lerp(chamToneResult, value))
                        else
                            color3 = argument
                        end
                    end
                    entry.Color = color3
                    entry.Transparency = transparency
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.modelShow = function(argument2, argument, color3, argument3)
                if not argument then
                    if argument2.shown ~= false then
                        for unused, item in ipairs(argument2.clones) do
                            item.Transparency = 1
                        end
                        for unused, item in pairs(argument2.boxes) do
                            item.Transparency = 1
                        end
                        argument2.shown = false
                    end
                    return
                end
                local now, clones = os.clock(), argument2.shown == true
                if clones then
                    if now - (argument2.propsAt or 0) < 0.03333333333333333 then
                        return
                    end
                end
                local lastTr, calculatedValue =
                    1 - math.clamp(argument2.spec[3] * argument3, 0, 1), argument2.kind or argument2.material
                argument2.propsAt = now
                if calculatedValue == "Wireframe" then
                    argument2.shown = true
                    if
                        (if clones then argument2.lastTint ~= color3 else not clones)
                        or math.abs((argument2.lastTr or -1) - lastTr) >= 0.01
                    then
                        argument2.lastTint = color3
                        argument2.lastTr = lastTr
                        for unused, item in pairs(argument2.boxes) do
                            item.Color3 = color3
                            item.Transparency = lastTr
                        end
                    end
                    return
                end
                if calculatedValue == "Iridescent" or calculatedValue == "Gradient" then
                    argument2.shown = true
                    argument2.lastTint = nil
                    argument2.lastTr = nil
                    pulseESP2.modelPaint(argument2, color3, lastTr, now)
                    return
                end
                argument = not clones
                calculatedValue, argument3 =
                    if clones then argument2.lastTint ~= color3 else argument,
                    if clones then math.abs((argument2.lastTr or -1) - lastTr) >= 0.01 else argument
                if calculatedValue then
                elseif argument3 then
                else
                    return
                end
                argument2.shown = true
                clones = argument2.clones
                if calculatedValue then
                    argument2.lastTint = color3
                    for index = 1, #clones, 1 do
                        clones[index].Color = color3
                    end
                end
                if argument3 then
                    argument2.lastTr = lastTr
                    for index = 1, #clones, 1 do
                        clones[index].Transparency = lastTr
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.modelPlaceStore = function(argument2, argument, argument3, argument4)
                for root, item in pairs(argument2) do
                    root = item.root
                    local calculatedValue = not (root and root.Parent)
                    if item.shown then
                        if argument3 then
                            if root then
                                if root.Parent then
                                    if item.view ~= nil then
                                        calculatedValue = item.view == false
                                    else
                                        local position = root.Position
                                        if (position - argument).Magnitude > 12 then
                                            local worldToViewportPointResult, calculatedValue2, calculatedValue3 =
                                                argument3:WorldToViewportPoint(position),
                                                argument4.X * 0.35,
                                                argument4.Y * 0.35
                                            calculatedValue = worldToViewportPointResult.Z < -6
                                                or worldToViewportPointResult.X < -calculatedValue2
                                                or worldToViewportPointResult.X > argument4.X + calculatedValue2
                                                or worldToViewportPointResult.Y < -calculatedValue3
                                                or worldToViewportPointResult.Y > argument4.Y + calculatedValue3
                                        else
                                        end
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if item.shown and calculatedValue then
                        if not item.parked then
                            item.parked = true
                            local transform, entries = CFrame.new(0, 30000, 0), {}
                            for index = 1, #item.clones, 1 do
                                entries[index] = transform
                            end
                            pcall(function()
                                workspace2:BulkMoveTo(item.clones, entries, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    if item.shown and not calculatedValue then
                        item.parked = nil
                        if pulseESP2.chamsThrough and root and root.Parent then
                            local maximumValue = math.max((root.Position - argument).Magnitude, 0.01)
                            local minimumValue, scale = math.min(1, i.modelDepth / maximumValue), item.scale
                            if minimumValue >= 1 then
                                if scale < 1 then
                                    pulseESP2.modelResize(item, 1)
                                end
                            elseif scale >= 1 then
                                pulseESP2.modelResize(item, minimumValue)
                            else
                                local calculatedValue = maximumValue * scale
                                if calculatedValue < i.modelDepth * 0.76 then
                                    pulseESP2.modelResize(item, minimumValue)
                                elseif calculatedValue > i.modelDepth * 1.3 then
                                    pulseESP2.modelResize(item, minimumValue)
                                end
                            end
                        elseif item.scale ~= 1 then
                            pulseESP2.modelResize(item, 1)
                        end
                        local scale, cfs, sources = item.scale, item.cfs, item.sources
                        if scale < 1 then
                            local calculatedValue = argument * (1 - scale)
                            for index = 1, #sources, 1 do
                                local transform = sources[index].CFrame
                                cfs[index] = transform.Rotation + (transform.Position * scale + calculatedValue)
                            end
                        else
                            for index = 1, #sources, 1 do
                                cfs[index] = sources[index].CFrame
                            end
                        end
                        pcall(workspace2.BulkMoveTo, workspace2, item.clones, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.modelPlace = function()
                local camera2 = workspace2.CurrentCamera
                if not camera2 then
                    return
                end
                local position, viewportSize = camera2.CFrame.Position, camera2.ViewportSize
                pulseESP2.modelPlaceStore(i.models, position, camera2, viewportSize)
                pulseESP2.modelPlaceStore(i.halos, position, camera2, viewportSize)
            end
            pulseESP2.placeBind = function()
                if i.placeBound then
                    return
                end
                i.placeBound = "PulseESP2ModelPlace"
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(i.placeBound)
                end)
                local placeBound, enum = i.placeBound, Enum
                local last, handleAction =
                    enum.RenderPriority.Last, function()
                        pcall(pulseESP2.modelPlace)
                    end
                runService:BindToRenderStep(placeBound, last.Value, handleAction)
            end
            pulseESP2.placeUnbind = function()
                if not i.placeBound then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(i.placeBound)
                end)
                i.placeBound = nil
            end
            pulseESP2.modelStep = function(
                argument2,
                argument,
                argument3,
                argument4,
                argument5,
                argument6,
                argument7,
                argument8,
                view
            )
                local now, modelBuildResult = os.clock(), argument2[argument]
                if
                    modelBuildResult == nil
                    or modelBuildResult.char ~= argument3
                    or modelBuildResult.material ~= argument7
                    or pulseESP2.modelBroken(modelBuildResult)
                    or modelBuildResult.dirty ~= nil and now - modelBuildResult.dirty > 0.35
                then
                    if not argument4 then
                        if modelBuildResult then
                            pulseESP2.modelDropIn(argument2, argument)
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if (i.budget or 0) <= 0 then
                        if modelBuildResult then
                            if modelBuildResult.char == argument3 then
                                modelBuildResult.view = view
                                pulseESP2.modelShow(modelBuildResult, argument4, argument5, argument6)
                            end
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    i.budget = i.budget - 1
                    pulseESP2.modelDropIn(argument2, argument)
                    local modelRootResult = pulseESP2.modelRoot()
                    if modelRootResult then
                        if argument7 then
                            if not argument8 then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                    modelBuildResult = pulseESP2.modelBuild(
                        argument3,
                        argument7,
                        argument8,
                        modelRootResult,
                        pulseESP2.poolFor(argument2, argument)
                    )
                    argument2[argument] = modelBuildResult
                    pulseESP2.placeBind()
                else
                end
                modelBuildResult.view = view
                pulseESP2.modelShow(modelBuildResult, argument4, argument5, argument6)
            end
            pulseESP2.dropCham = function(argument2)
                local entry = i.highlights[argument2]
                if entry then
                    pcall(function()
                        entry:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                i.highlights[argument2] = nil
                i.chamState[argument2] = nil
                if i.models[argument2] then
                    pulseESP2.modelDrop(argument2)
                elseif i.halos[argument2] then
                    pulseESP2.modelDrop(argument2)
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.clearChams = function()
                for key in pairs(i.highlights) do
                    pulseESP2.dropCham(key)
                end
                for key in pairs(i.models) do
                    pulseESP2.modelDrop(key)
                end
                for key in pairs(i.halos) do
                    pulseESP2.modelDrop(key)
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.fxDrop = function(argument2)
                local entry = i.fx[argument2]
                if not entry then
                    return
                end
                for unused, item in pairs(entry.objs) do
                    pcall(function()
                        item:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                i.fx[argument2] = nil
            end
            pulseESP2.fxClear = function()
                for key in pairs(i.fx) do
                    pulseESP2.fxDrop(key)
                end
                if i.fxFolder then
                    pcall(function()
                        i.fxFolder:Destroy()
                    end)
                    i.fxFolder = nil
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.fxFolder = function()
                local camera2 = workspace2.CurrentCamera
                if not camera2 then
                    return nil
                end
                if i.fxFolder then
                    if i.fxFolder.Parent == camera2 then
                        return i.fxFolder
                    end
                end
                for unused, item in ipairs(camera2:GetChildren()) do
                    if item.Name == "PulseESPFX" then
                        pcall(function()
                            item:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                end
                i.fxFolder = pulseESP2.make("Folder", { Name = "PulseESPFX" }, camera2)
                return i.fxFolder
            end
            pulseESP2.fxWanted = function(argument2)
                if pulseESP2.fxTargets == "Murderer" then
                    return argument2 == "Murderer"
                end
                if pulseESP2.fxTargets == "Armed" then
                    return argument2 == "Murderer" or argument2 == "Sheriff" or argument2 == "Hero"
                end
                return true
            end

            pulseESP2.fxStep = function(localPlayer2, char, argument, entries, colour, calculatedValue)
                local calculatedValue2 = pulseESP2.murderBeam and entries == "Murderer"
                if pulseESP2.sparkles or pulseESP2.skyBeam or calculatedValue2 or pulseESP2.trail then
                    if not (pulseESP2.fxWanted(entries)) then
                        pulseESP2.fxDrop(localPlayer2)
                        return
                    end
                else
                    pulseESP2.fxDrop(localPlayer2)
                    return
                end
                entries = i.fx[localPlayer2]
                if entries then
                    if entries.char ~= char then
                        pulseESP2.fxDrop(localPlayer2)
                        entries = nil
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                local now = os.clock()
                if entries then
                    if entries.still then
                        if entries.colour == colour then
                            if now - entries.at < 0.2 then
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if entries then
                else
                    entries = { char = char, objs = {} }
                    i.fx[localPlayer2] = entries
                end
                local objs = entries.objs
                char = localPlayer2.UserId % 97 * 0.13
                local function callback7(...)
                    local entries2 = { ... }
                    for unused, item in ipairs(entries2) do
                        if objs[item] then
                            pcall(function()
                                objs[item]:Destroy()
                            end)
                            objs[item] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
                if pulseESP2.sparkles then
                    local calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4 =
                        pulseESP2.SPARKS[pulseESP2.sparkleStyle] or pulseESP2.SPARKS.Sparkles,
                        objs.att and objs.att.Parent == argument and objs.pe and objs.pe.Parent == objs.att
                    if if calculatedValue4 then objs.peStyle ~= pulseESP2.sparkleStyle else not calculatedValue4 then
                        callback7("att", "pe")
                        objs.att = pulseESP2.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPSparkAtt" }, argument)
                        objs.pe = pulseESP2.make(
                            "ParticleEmitter",
                            {
                                Name = "PulseESPSparks",
                                Texture = calculatedValue3.tex,
                                LightEmission = 1,
                                LightInfluence = 0,
                                Size = NumberSequence.new({
                                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, calculatedValue3.size),
                                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
                                }),
                                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
                                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                                }),
                                Lifetime = calculatedValue3.life,
                                Speed = calculatedValue3.speed,
                                SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(calculatedValue3.spread, calculatedValue3.spread),
                                Acceleration = calculatedValue3.acc,
                                Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
                                ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume,
                            },

                        )
                        objs.peStyle = pulseESP2.sparkleStyle
                        objs.peColour = nil
                    end
                    if objs.peColour ~= colour then
                        objs.pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(colour:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4), colour)
                        objs.peColour = colour
                    end
                    if objs.pe.Rate ~= pulseESP2.sparkleRate then
                        objs.pe.Rate = pulseESP2.sparkleRate
                    end
                else
                    callback7("att", "pe")
                end
                if pulseESP2.skyBeam then
                    if
                        not (
                            objs.sky
                            and objs.sky.Parent
                            and objs.sa0
                            and objs.sa0.Parent == argument
                            and objs.sa1
                            and objs.sa1.Parent == argument
                        )
                    then
                        callback7("sky", "sa0", "sa1")
                        objs.sa0 = pulseESP2.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPSky0" }, argument)
                        objs.sa1 = pulseESP2.make(
                            "Attachment",
                            { Name = "PulseESPSky1", Position = Vector3.new(0, 70, 0) },
                            argument
                        )
                        objs.sky = pulseESP2.make(
                            "Beam",
                            {
                                Name = "PulseESPSkyBeam",
                                Attachment0 = objs.sa0,
                                Attachment1 = objs.sa1,
                                FaceCamera = true,
                                LightEmission = 1,
                                LightInfluence = 0,
                                Segments = 1,
                                Width0 = 1.1,
                                Width1 = 0.25,
                            },
                            argument
                        )
                    end
                    objs.sky.Color = ColorSequence.new(colour)
                    localPlayer2 = 1 - 0.55 * calculatedValue * (0.8 + 0.2 * math.sin(now * 2 + char))
                    objs.sky.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, localPlayer2),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                    })
                else
                    callback7("sky", "sa0", "sa1")
                end
                if calculatedValue2 then
                    localPlayer2 = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if localPlayer2 then
                        if
                            not (
                                objs.mb
                                and objs.mb.Parent
                                and objs.ma0
                                and objs.ma0.Parent == localPlayer2
                                and objs.ma1
                                and objs.ma1.Parent == argument
                            )
                        then
                            callback7("mb", "ma0", "ma1")
                            objs.ma0 = pulseESP2.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPBeamFrom" }, localPlayer2)
                            objs.ma1 = pulseESP2.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPBeamTo" }, argument)
                            objs.mb = pulseESP2.make(
                                "Beam",
                                {
                                    Name = "PulseESPMurderBeam",
                                    Attachment0 = objs.ma0,
                                    Attachment1 = objs.ma1,
                                    FaceCamera = true,
                                    LightEmission = 1,
                                    LightInfluence = 0,
                                    Segments = 1,
                                    Width0 = 0.08,
                                    Width1 = 0.18,
                                },
                                argument
                            )
                        end
                        objs.mb.Color = ColorSequence.new(colour:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.3), colour)
                        char = 1 - 0.8 * calculatedValue * (0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(now * 5))
                        objs.mb.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15, char),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, char * 0.7),

                    else
                        callback7("mb", "ma0", "ma1")
                    end
                else
                    callback7("mb", "ma0", "ma1")

                        )

                                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.5),
                                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                                        })
                                    or NumberSequence.new({
                                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, calculatedValue3 and 0.05 or 0.25),
                                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                                    }),
                            },
                            argument
                        )
                        objs.trlStyle = pulseESP2.trailStyle
                        objs.trlW = localPlayer2
                        objs.trlColour = nil
                    end
                    if objs.trl.Lifetime ~= pulseESP2.trailLife then
