                    end
                    if objs.trlColour ~= colour then
                        objs.trl.Color = pulseESP2.trailStyle == "Neon"
                                and ColorSequence.new(colour:Lerp(color, 0.45), colour)
                            or ColorSequence.new(colour)
                        objs.trlColour = colour
                    end
                else
                    callback7("trl", "ta0", "ta1")
                end
                entries.at, entries.colour, entries.still = now, colour, not (pulseESP2.skyBeam or calculatedValue2)
            end
            pulseESP2.labelsHide = function(argument2)
                local entry = i.labels[argument2]
                if entry then
                    entry.sig = nil
                    put(entry.top, "Visible", false)
                    put(entry.bottom, "Visible", false)
                    if entry.side then
                        put(entry.side, "Visible", false)
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.labelsDrop = function(argument2)
                local entry = i.labels[argument2]
                if not entry then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    entry.top:Destroy()
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    entry.bottom:Destroy()
                end)
                if entry.side then
                    pcall(function()
                        entry.side:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                i.labels[argument2] = nil
            end
            pulseESP2.labelsClear = function()
                if i.labelGui then
                    pcall(function()
                        i.labelGui:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                i.labelGui = nil
                i.labels = {}
            end
            pulseESP2.release = function(argument2)
                local entry = i.objects[argument2]
                if entry then
                    pcall(function()
                        entry.layer:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                i.objects[argument2] = nil
                i.retryAt[argument2] = nil
                pulseESP2.dropCham(argument2)
                pulseESP2.poolPurge(argument2)
                pulseESP2.fxDrop(argument2)
                pulseESP2.radarDrop(argument2)
                pulseESP2.labelsDrop(argument2)
            end
            pulseESP2.clear = function()
                for key in pairs(i.objects) do
                    pulseESP2.release(key)
                end
                pulseESP2.clearChams()
                pulseESP2.poolPurge()
                pulseESP2.fxClear()
                if i.modelFolder then
                    pcall(function()
                        i.modelFolder:Destroy()
                    end)
                    i.modelFolder = nil
                end
                pulseESP2.placeUnbind()
                pulseESP2.radarClear()
                pulseESP2.labelsClear()
                if i.gui then
                    pcall(function()
                        i.gui:Destroy()
                    end)
                    i.gui = nil
                end
                table.clear(i.retryAt)
            end
            pulseESP2.hideAll = function()
                pulseESP2.clearChams()
                for key in pairs(i.fx) do
                    pulseESP2.fxDrop(key)
                end
                for key, item in pairs(i.objects) do
                    pulseESP2.hideSet(item, true)
                    pulseESP2.radarHide(key)
                    pulseESP2.labelsHide(key)
                end
                i.hidden = true
            end
            pulseESP2.prune = function()
                local entries, callback7 = {}, ipairs
                for unused, item in callback7(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
                    entries[item] = true
                end
                for key in pairs(i.objects) do
                    if not entries[key] then
                        pulseESP2.release(key)
                    end
                end
                for key in pairs(i.highlights) do
                    if not entries[key] then
                        pulseESP2.dropCham(key)
                    end
                end
                for key in pairs(i.radar) do
                    if not entries[key] then
                        pulseESP2.radarDrop(key)
                    end
                end
                for key in pairs(i.labels) do
                    if not entries[key] then
                        pulseESP2.labelsDrop(key)
                    end
                end
                for key in pairs(i.fx) do
                    if not entries[key] then
                        pulseESP2.fxDrop(key)
                    end
                end
            end

            pulseESP2.ck = function(argument2)
                return math.floor(argument2.R * 255 + 0.5) * 65536
                    + math.floor(argument2.G * 255 + 0.5) * 256
                    + math.floor(argument2.B * 255 + 0.5)
            end
            pulseESP2.tone = function(fromHSVResult)
                local toneB, toneS = (pulseESP2.brightness or 100) / 100, (pulseESP2.saturation or 100) / 100
                if toneB == 1 then
                    if toneS == 1 then
                        return fromHSVResult
                    end
                end
                local toneCache = i.toneCache
                if (if toneCache then i.toneB ~= toneB else not toneCache) or i.toneS ~= toneS then
                    toneCache = {}
                    i.toneCache = toneCache
                    i.toneB = toneB
                    i.toneS = toneS
                    i.toneN = 0
                else
                end
                local value = pulseESP2.ck(fromHSVResult)
                local entry = toneCache[value]
                if entry then
                    return entry
                end
                local toHSVResult, toHSVResult2, toHSVResult3 = fromHSVResult:ToHSV()
                entry = toHSVResult3 * toneB
                fromHSVResult = Color3.fromHSV(toHSVResult, math.clamp(toHSVResult2 * toneS, 0, 1), math.clamp(entry, 0, 1))
                fromHSVResult = if entry > 1
                    then fromHSVResult:Lerp(color, math.clamp((entry - 1) * 0.6, 0, 0.6))
                    else fromHSVResult
                i.toneN = (i.toneN or 0) + 1
                if i.toneN > 4096 then
                    i.toneCache = nil
                end
                toneCache[value] = fromHSVResult
                return fromHSVResult
            end
            pulseESP2.ink = function(argument2, argument, argument3)
                if argument2 == "Custom" then
                    return pulseESP2.tone(argument or color)
                end
                if argument2 == "White" then
                    return pulseESP2.tone(color)
                end
                if argument2 == "Light" then
                    return argument3:Lerp(color, 0.45)
                end
                if argument2 == "Dark" then
                    return argument3:Lerp(color2, 0.5)
                end
                return argument3
            end

            pulseESP2.upper = function(argument2)
                local upperCache = i.upperCache
                if if upperCache then (i.upperN or 0) > 3000 else not upperCache then
                    upperCache = {}
                    i.upperCache = upperCache
                    i.upperN = 0
                else
                end
                local upperRawResult = upperCache[argument2]
                if upperRawResult then
                    return upperRawResult
                end
                upperRawResult = pulseESP2.upperRaw(argument2)
                upperCache[argument2] = upperRawResult
                i.upperN = (i.upperN or 0) + 1
                return upperRawResult
            end
            pulseESP2.upperRaw = function(entries)
                local upperResult = string.upper(entries)
                if not (string.find(upperResult, "[\208\209]")) then
                    return upperResult
                end
                entries = {}
                for unused, item in utf8.codes(upperResult) do
                    item = if item >= 1072
                        then if item <= 1103 then item - 32 else if item == 1105 then 1025 else item
                        else if item == 1105 then 1025 else item
                    entries[#entries + 1] = utf8.char(item)
                end
                return table.concat(entries)
            end

            end

            pulseESP2.distText = function(roundedValue)

                    roundedValue = calculatedValue < 10 and -(math.floor(calculatedValue * 10 + 0.5) + 1)
                        or math.floor(calculatedValue + 0.5) + 1000000

                end

                if if distCache then (i.distN or 0) > 4000 else not distCache then
                    distCache = {}

                distCache[roundedValue] = distTextRawResult

                    end
                    return tostring(math.floor(calculatedValue + 0.5)) .. " m"
                end
                return tostring(math.floor(math.max(argument2, 0) + 0.5)) .. " st"
            end
            pulseESP2.chamTone = function(argument2)
                local calculatedValue = (pulseESP2.chamsBright or 100) / 100
                if calculatedValue > 1 then
                    local packedValues = packValues(math.clamp((calculatedValue - 1) * 0.6, 0, 0.6))
                    return argument2:Lerp(color, unpackTuple(packedValues))
                end
                if calculatedValue < 1 then
                    local packedValues = packValues(math.clamp(1 - calculatedValue, 0, 0.85))
                    return argument2:Lerp(color2, unpackTuple(packedValues))
                end
                return argument2
            end

                roleBaseResult, colorMode = pulseESP2.roleBase(argument2), pulseESP2.colorMode
                roleBaseResult = if colorMode == "Rainbow"

                        os.clock() * 0.09 * (pulseESP2.rainbowSpeed or 1) % 1,

                        else roleBaseResult
                    else roleBaseResult

            pulseESP2.alpha = function(argument2, calculatedValue)
                local calculatedValue2 = pulseESP2.visCheck
                        and pulseESP2.dimHidden
                        and not calculatedValue
                        and pulseESP2.hiddenStyle ~= "Grey"
                        and 0.72
                    or 1
                if pulseESP2.fade then
                    calculatedValue = pulseESP2.maxDist * math.clamp(pulseESP2.fadeFrom, 10, 95) / 100
                    calculatedValue2 = if argument2 > calculatedValue
                        then calculatedValue2 * math.clamp(
                            1 - (argument2 - calculatedValue) / math.max(pulseESP2.maxDist - calculatedValue, 1),
                            0.45,
                            1
                        )
                        else calculatedValue2
                else
                end
                return calculatedValue2 * math.clamp((pulseESP2.opacity or 100) / 100, 0.05, 1)
            end
            pulseESP2.boundsOf = function(argument2, argument)
                local entries, now = i.bounds[argument2], os.clock()
                if if entries then now - entries.at > 0.15 else not entries then
                    local y, partKinds, partKinds2 = i.partKinds
                    for className, instance in ipairs(argument2:GetChildren()) do
                        className = instance.ClassName
                        local isAResult = y[className]
                        if isAResult == nil then
                            isAResult = instance:IsA("BasePart")
                            y[className] = isAResult
                        else
                        end
                        if isAResult then
                            local calculatedValue, y2 = instance.Size.Y * 0.5, instance.Position.Y
                            local calculatedValue2, calculatedValue3 = y2 + calculatedValue, y2 - calculatedValue
                            partKinds, partKinds2 =
                                if partKinds == nil
                                    then calculatedValue2
                                    else if calculatedValue2 > partKinds then calculatedValue2 else partKinds,
                                if partKinds2 == nil
                                    then calculatedValue3
                                    else if calculatedValue3 < partKinds2 then calculatedValue3 else partKinds2
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    y = argument.Position.Y
                    entries = { at = now, top = (partKinds or y + 3) - y, bottom = (partKinds2 or y - 3) - y }
                    i.bounds[argument2] = entries
                else
                end
                return entries.top, entries.bottom
            end
            pulseESP2.project = function(w, viewportSize)
                local boundsOfResult, h2 = pulseESP2.boundsOf(w, viewportSize)
                w = viewportSize.Position
                local vptResult, vptResult2 =
                    pulseESP2.vpt(Vector3.new(w.X, w.Y + boundsOfResult + 0.12, w.Z)),
                    pulseESP2.vpt(Vector3.new(w.X, w.Y + h2 - 0.08, w.Z))
                if vptResult.Z <= 0.08 then
                    return nil
                elseif vptResult2.Z <= 0.08 then
                    return nil
                end
                viewportSize, h2 = camera.ViewportSize, math.abs(vptResult2.Y - vptResult.Y)
                if h2 < 2 then
                    return nil
                elseif h2 > viewportSize.Y * 4 then
                    return nil
                end
                w = h2 * math.clamp((pulseESP2.boxWidth or 50) / 100, 0.2, 1)
                local x, y = (vptResult.X + vptResult2.X) * 0.5 - w * 0.5, math.min(vptResult.Y, vptResult2.Y)
                if x + w < 0 then
                    return nil
                elseif x > viewportSize.X then
                    return nil
                elseif y + h2 < 0 then
                    return nil
                elseif y > viewportSize.Y then
                    return nil
                end
                if w < 12 then
                    w, x = 12, x - (12 - w) * 0.5
                else
                end
                if h2 < 22 then
                    h2, y = 22, y - (22 - h2) * 0.5
                else
                end
                return { x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h2 }
            end
            pulseESP2.smoothRect = function(argument2, calculatedValue, rel, calculatedValue2)
                local calculatedValue3 = math.clamp(pulseESP2.smooth, 0, 95) / 100
                local rect = calculatedValue3 > 0
                        and 1 - calculatedValue3 ^ (math.clamp(rel or 0.016666666666666666, 0.001, 0.1) * 60)
                    or 1
                calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue2
                    or Vector2.new(calculatedValue.x + calculatedValue.w * 0.5, calculatedValue.y + calculatedValue.h * 0.5)
                rel, calculatedValue3 =
                    {
                        x = calculatedValue.x - calculatedValue2.X,
                        y = calculatedValue.y - calculatedValue2.Y,
                        w = calculatedValue.w,
                        h = calculatedValue.h,
                    },
                    argument2.rect and argument2.rel
                if calculatedValue3 then
                    calculatedValue = math.abs(rel.x - calculatedValue3.x)
                        + math.abs(rel.y - calculatedValue3.y)
                        + math.abs(rel.w - calculatedValue3.w)
                        + math.abs(rel.h - calculatedValue3.h)
                    if calculatedValue < math.max(camera.ViewportSize.X, camera.ViewportSize.Y) * 0.35 then
                        rel.x = calculatedValue3.x + (rel.x - calculatedValue3.x) * rect
                        rel.y = calculatedValue3.y + (rel.y - calculatedValue3.y) * rect
                        rel.w = calculatedValue3.w + (rel.w - calculatedValue3.w) * rect
                        rel.h = calculatedValue3.h + (rel.h - calculatedValue3.h) * rect
                    end
                end
                argument2.rel = rel
                rect = { x = calculatedValue2.X + rel.x, y = calculatedValue2.Y + rel.y, w = rel.w, h = rel.h }
                argument2.rect = rect
                return {
                    x = math.floor(rect.x + 0.5),
                    y = math.floor(rect.y + 0.5),
                    w = math.max(1, math.floor(rect.w + 0.5)),
                    h = math.max(1, math.floor(rect.h + 0.5)),
                }
            end

            pulseESP2.drawBox = function(argument2, argument, calculatedValue, calculatedValue2, y, w)
                local calculatedValue3 = pulseESP2.boxStyle or "Corners"
                calculatedValue3 = if argument2.role == "Murderer"
                    then if pulseESP2.murdBox
                        then if pulseESP2.murdBox ~= "Same" then pulseESP2.murdBox else calculatedValue3
                        else calculatedValue3
                    else calculatedValue3
                local roundedValue, calculatedValue4 =
                    pulseESP2.box == true and not argument2.boxOff,
                    calculatedValue3 == "Corners" or calculatedValue3 == "Brackets"
                local calculatedValue5, minimumValue =
                    roundedValue and not calculatedValue4, pulseESP2.boxGlow == true or w == true
                local maximumValue = calculatedValue5
                    and calculatedValue3 ~= "Double"
                    and pulseESP2.outline == true
                    and pulseESP2.outlineInner == true
                if roundedValue then
                    if not calculatedValue4 then
                        pulseESP2.segHide(argument2, 1)
                    end
                else
                    pulseESP2.segHide(argument2, 1)
                end
                if argument2.inner then
                    if not (calculatedValue5 and (calculatedValue3 == "Double" or maximumValue)) then
                        put(argument2.inner, "Visible", false)
                    end
                end
                put(argument2.box, "Visible", roundedValue)
                put(argument2.glow, "Visible", calculatedValue5 and minimumValue)
                put(argument2.outer, "Visible", calculatedValue5 and pulseESP2.outline)
                if not roundedValue then
                    return
                end
                local maximumValue2, x = pulseESP2.boxAnimK(y)
                if x > 0 then
                    roundedValue = math.floor(x * 2 + 0.5)
                    argument = if roundedValue > 0
                        then {
                            x = argument.x - roundedValue,
                            y = argument.y - roundedValue,
                            w = argument.w + roundedValue * 2,
                            h = argument.h + roundedValue * 2,
                        }
                        else argument
                else
                end
                roundedValue = math.floor(tonumber(pulseESP2.boxPad) or 0)
                argument = if roundedValue ~= 0
                    then {
                        x = argument.x - roundedValue,
                        y = argument.y - roundedValue,
                        w = math.max(4, argument.w + roundedValue * 2),
                        h = math.max(4, argument.h + roundedValue * 2),
                    }
                    else argument

                    maximumValue + (pulseESP2.ringText and 19 or 0) + 4

                    math.max(0, math.min(viewportSize.X * 0.5 - calculatedValue2, viewportSize.Y * 0.5 - calculatedValue3))
                clampedValue = math.clamp(pulseESP2.ringRadius, math.min(60, maximumValue), maximumValue)
                if pulseESP2.markerPos == "Screen Edge" then
                    local maximumValue2, maximumValue =
                        math.max(20, viewportSize.X * 0.5 - calculatedValue2 - 26),
                        math.max(20, viewportSize.Y * 0.5 - calculatedValue3 - 26)
                    return calculatedValue + point * math.min(
                        maximumValue2 / math.max(math.abs(point.X), 1.0E-4),
                        maximumValue / math.max(math.abs(point.Y), 1.0E-4)
                    ),
                        math.deg(math.atan2(point.Y, point.X)) + 90
                end
                return calculatedValue + point * clampedValue, math.deg(math.atan2(point.Y, point.X)) + 90
            end
            pulseESP2.ARROW = {
                fill = "",
                rim = "",
                shade = "",
            }
            pulseESP2.arrowTexture = function(argument2)
                i.arrowTex = i.arrowTex or {}
                local entry = i.arrowTex[argument2]
                if entry ~= nil then
                    return entry or nil
                end
                i.arrowTex[argument2] = false
                local entry2 = pulseESP2.ARROW[argument2]
                if entry2 and type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
                    if not (type(writefile) == "function") then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end
                local success, result = pcall(function()
                    local value = callback(entry2)
                    if type(value) ~= "string" then
                        return nil
                    elseif #value < 60 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    if type(makefolder) == "function" then
                        if type(isfolder) == "function" then
                            if not (isfolder("PulseHub")) then
                                pcall(makefolder, "PulseHub")
                            end
                        else
                            pcall(makefolder, "PulseHub")
                        end
                    end
                    local calculatedValue = "PulseHub/esp-arrow-" .. argument2 .. "-" .. tostring(#value) .. ".png"
                    if type(isfile) == "function" then
                        if not (isfile(calculatedValue)) then
                            writefile(calculatedValue, value)
                        end
                    else
                        writefile(calculatedValue, value)
                    end
                    return getcustomasset(calculatedValue)
                end)
                if success then
                    if type(result) == "string" then
                        if result ~= "" then
                            i.arrowTex[argument2] = result
                            return result
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            pulseESP2.arrowLayers = function(argument2)
                local arrowTextureResult, arrowTextureResult2, arrowTextureResult3 =
                    pulseESP2.arrowTexture("shade"), pulseESP2.arrowTexture("rim"), pulseESP2.arrowTexture("fill")
                if arrowTextureResult then
                    if arrowTextureResult2 then
                        if not arrowTextureResult3 then
                            return nil
                        end
                    else
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end

                    return pulseESP2.make(
                        "ImageLabel",
                        {
                            Name = name,
                            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                            Image = image,
                            ImageColor3 = imageColor3,

                            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
                            ZIndex = zIndex,
                            Visible = false,
                        },
                        argument2
                    )
                end
                local shade = callback("ArrowShade", arrowTextureResult, 11, Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
                shade.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1)
                local rim, fill, make, entries =
                    callback("ArrowRim", arrowTextureResult2, 12, Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
                    callback("ArrowFill", arrowTextureResult3, 13, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
                    pulseESP2.make,
                    { Rotation = 90 }
                entries.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(184, 184, 184))
                make("UIGradient", entries, fill)
                return { shade = shade, rim = rim, fill = fill }
            end

            pulseESP2.radarShow = function(localPlayer2, argument, argument2, color3, argument3, alpha)
                local entries = i.radar[localPlayer2]

                                ZIndex = 11,

                        dotStroke = dotStroke,
                    }
                    i.radar[localPlayer2] = entries
                else
                end
                local style = pulseESP2.radarStyle or "Arrow"
                local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 = style == "Avatar", style == "Dot"
                local value, maximumValue =
                    if calculatedValue then not calculatedValue else not calculatedValue2,
                    math.clamp(pulseESP2.arrowSize, 5, 26) * (calculatedValue and 3 or 2)
                maximumValue = if calculatedValue2 then maximumValue * 0.5 else maximumValue
                maximumValue = if pulseESP2.arrowPulse
                    then maximumValue * (1 + 0.12 * math.sin(os.clock() * 4 + localPlayer2.UserId % 89 * 0.4))
                    else maximumValue
                maximumValue = math.max(4, math.floor(maximumValue + 0.5))
                local calculatedValue3, value2 = math.floor(argument2 * 2 + 0.5) / 2, callback5(1 - alpha)
                callback4(entries.frame, "Position", math.floor(argument.X + 0.5), math.floor(argument.Y + 0.5))
                callback4(entries.frame, "Size", maximumValue, maximumValue)
                local layers, showText, sig = entries.layers, pulseESP2.ringText or pulseESP2.arrowName, entries.sig
                if
                    (if sig then sig.ver ~= (i.labelVer or 0) else not sig)
                    or sig.style ~= style
                    or sig.color ~= color3
                    or sig.alpha ~= alpha
                    or sig.showText ~= showText
                then
                    if sig then
                    else
                        sig = {}
                        entries.sig = sig
                    end
                    sig.ver = i.labelVer or 0
                    sig.style = style
                    sig.color = color3
                    sig.alpha = alpha
                    sig.showText = showText
                    put(entries.image, "Visible", calculatedValue)
                    put(entries.arrow, "Visible", value and not layers)

                    put(entries.image, "ImageTransparency", value2)
                    if calculatedValue2 then

                        put(entries.frame, "BackgroundTransparency", value2)
                        put(entries.dotStroke, "Color", pulseESP2.outlineCol or color2)
                        put(entries.dotStroke, "Transparency", callback5(1 - alpha * 0.5))
                    else
                        put(entries.frame, "BackgroundColor3", Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 38))
                        put(entries.frame, "BackgroundTransparency", calculatedValue and callback5(1 - alpha * 0.92) or 1)
                        put(entries.dotStroke, "Transparency", 1)
                    end
                    put(entries.edge, "Color", color3)
                    put(entries.edge, "Transparency", value2)
                    if value then
                        if not layers then
                            put(entries.arrow, "TextColor3", color3)
                            put(entries.arrow, "TextTransparency", value2)
                        end
                    end
                    put(entries.text, "Visible", showText)
                    if showText then
                        put(entries.text, "TextColor3", color3)
                        put(entries.text, "TextTransparency", value2)
                    end
                end
                if value then
                    if layers then
                        put(layers.shade, "Rotation", calculatedValue3)
                        put(layers.rim, "Rotation", calculatedValue3)
                        put(layers.fill, "Rotation", calculatedValue3)
                    else
                        put(entries.arrow, "Rotation", calculatedValue3)
                    end
                end
                if showText then
                    argument = if pulseESP2.arrowName then pulseESP2.formatName(localPlayer2) else ""
                    argument = if pulseESP2.ringText
                        then argument ~= "" and argument .. "  " .. pulseESP2.distText(argument3) or pulseESP2.distText(
                            argument3
                        )
                        else argument
                    put(entries.text, "Text", argument)
                end
                put(entries.frame, "Visible", true)
            end
