            pulseESP2.skelRefs = function(instance, argument)
                local entries = {}
                for key, item in ipairs(argument.pts) do
                    local enabled, part = false, instance:FindFirstChild(item[1])
                    if part then
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local x, y = item[2], item[3]
                            if type(x) == "number" then
                                enabled = { part = part, x = x, y = y }
                            else
                                if type(x) == "string" then
                                    local att, instance = part:FindFirstChild(x), y and (part:FindFirstChild(y))
                                    enabled = if att
                                        then if att:IsA("Attachment")
                                            then { att = att, att2 = instance and instance:IsA("Attachment") and instance
                                                or nil }
                                            else { part = part }
                                        else { part = part }
                                else
                                    enabled = { part = part }
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    entries[key] = enabled
                end
                return entries
            end
            pulseESP2.skelPos = function(argument2)
                local att = argument2.att
                if att then
                    if argument2.att2 then
                        return (att.WorldPosition + argument2.att2.WorldPosition) * 0.5
                    end
                    return att.WorldPosition
                end
                att = argument2.part
                if argument2.x then
                    local size, transform = att.Size, att.CFrame
                    local packedValues = packValues(Vector3.new(size.X * argument2.x, size.Y * argument2.y, 0))
                    return transform:PointToWorldSpace(unpackTuple(packedValues))
                end
                return att.Position
            end
            pulseESP2.headSize = function(argument2)
                local roundedValue, headStyle =
                    math.floor(math.clamp(argument2.w * 0.28 * (pulseESP2.headScale or 100) / 100, 3, 120) + 0.5),
                    pulseESP2.headStyle
                return if headStyle
                    then if headStyle == "Dot" then math.max(4, math.floor(roundedValue * 0.35 + 0.5)) else roundedValue
                    else roundedValue
            end
            pulseESP2.drawBoneXY = function(
                localization2,
                tr,
                argument,
                rot,
                argument2,
                col,
                argument3,
                argument4,
                argument5
            )
                local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2, frame = rot - tr, argument2 - argument, localization2.frame
                local sqrtResult = math.sqrt(calculatedValue * calculatedValue + calculatedValue2 * calculatedValue2)
                local calculatedValue3, px, py, w, h2 =
                    sqrtResult < 60 and 1 or 4,
                    math.floor((tr + rot) * 0.5 + 0.5),
                    math.floor((argument + argument2) * 0.5 + 0.5),
                    math.max(math.floor(sqrtResult + 0.5), 1),
                    math.max(1, math.floor(argument3 + 0.5))
                rot, tr =
                    math.floor(math.deg(math.atan2(calculatedValue2, calculatedValue)) * calculatedValue3 + 0.5)
                        / calculatedValue3,
                    callback5(1 - argument4)
                if localization2.px ~= px or localization2.py ~= py then
                    localization2.px = px
                    localization2.py = py
                    frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py)
                end
                if localization2.w ~= w or localization2.h ~= h2 then
                    localization2.w = w
                    localization2.h = h2
                    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h2)
                end
                if localization2.rot ~= rot then
                    localization2.rot = rot
                    frame.Rotation = rot
                end
                if localization2.col ~= col then
                    localization2.col = col
                    frame.BackgroundColor3 = col
                end
                if localization2.tr ~= tr then
                    localization2.tr = tr
                    frame.BackgroundTransparency = tr
                end
                h2 = localization2.stroke
                if argument5 then
                    col, w =
                        pulseESP2.outlineCol or color2,
                        callback5(
                            1 - math.min(argument4 * 1.15 * math.clamp((pulseESP2.outlineAlpha or 65) / 65, 0, 1.5), 1)
                        )
                    if localization2.sOn ~= true then
                        localization2.sOn = true
                        h2.Enabled = true
                    end
                    if localization2.sCol ~= col then
                        localization2.sCol = col
                        h2.Color = col
                    end
                    if localization2.sTr ~= w then
                        localization2.sTr = w
                        h2.Transparency = w
                    end
                elseif localization2.sOn ~= false then
                    localization2.sOn = false
                    localization2.sTr = 1
                    h2.Enabled = false
                    h2.Transparency = 1
                end
                put(frame, "Visible", true)
            end
            pulseESP2.drawSkeleton = function(argument2, char, argument, argument3, bones, calculatedValue)
                calculatedValue = pulseESP2.skeleton == true and not argument2.skelOff
                if not calculatedValue then
                    if argument2.bonesOff then
                        return
                    end
                end
                argument2.bonesOff = not calculatedValue
                local counter, counter2, counter3 = 0, 0, 0
                if calculatedValue then
                    local rig, now, sk =
                        char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") and pulseESP2.SKEL.R15 or pulseESP2.SKEL.R6,
                        os.clock(),
                        argument2.sk
                    if (if sk then sk.char ~= char else not sk) or sk.rig ~= rig or now - sk.at > 2 then
                        sk = { char = char, rig = rig, at = now, refs = pulseESP2.skelRefs(char, rig) }
                        argument2.sk = sk
                    else
                    end
                    now = i.skelXY
                    if now then
                    else
                        now = { x = {}, y = {}, ok = {} }
                        i.skelXY = now
                    end
                    local x, y, ok, refs, vxy, skelPos = now.x, now.y, now.ok, sk.refs, pulseESP2.vxy, pulseESP2.skelPos
                    for index = 1, #refs, 1 do
                        local entry, enabled = refs[index], false
                        if entry then
                            local value, value2, value3 = vxy(skelPos(entry))
                            if value3 > 0.08 then
                                x[index] = value
                                y[index] = value2
                                enabled = true
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        ok[index] = enabled
                    end
                    vxy, now, skelPos, refs =
                        pulseESP2.boneBase(argument2, argument3),
                        math.max(1, math.floor(pulseESP2.lw(pulseESP2.boneThick) + 0.5)),
                        bones * math.clamp((pulseESP2.boneAlpha or 100) / 100, 0, 1),
                        pulseESP2.boneStyle == "Soft Glow" and not pulseESP2.perfOn()
                    local roundedValue = math.floor(now * 2.6 + 1.5)
                    local calculatedValue, interpolatedValue, skelTCa, skelTCb, skelTC = roundedValue * 0.5, skelPos * 0.16
                    if pulseESP2.boneGrad then
                        skelTCa, skelTCb, skelTC =
                            pulseESP2.tone(pulseESP2.boneTop), pulseESP2.tone(pulseESP2.boneBottom), i.skelTC
                        if (if skelTC then i.skelTCa ~= skelTCa else not skelTC) or i.skelTCb ~= skelTCb then
                            skelTC = {}
                            i.skelTC = skelTC
                            i.skelTCa = skelTCa
                            i.skelTCb = skelTCb
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    local y2, maximumValue, calculatedValue2 = argument.y, math.max(argument.h, 1), 0
                    if pulseESP2.headDot then
                        local calculatedValue3 = pulseESP2.headStyle or "Ring"
                        calculatedValue2 = pulseESP2.headSize(argument) * 0.5
                            + (calculatedValue3 == "Dot" and 0.5 or pulseESP2.lw(1.5) * 0.5)
                    else
                    end
                    local bones2, calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, bones3, pts, value =
                        rig.bones,
                        pulseESP2.outline and not refs and now >= 2,
                        now * 0.5,
                        argument2.bones,
                        pulseESP2.drawBoneXY,
                        calculatedValue2
                    for index = 1, #bones2, 1 do
                        local entry = bones2[index]
                        local entry2, entry3 = entry[1], entry[2]
                        if ok[entry2] then
                            if ok[entry3] then
                                local entry4, entry5, entry6, entry7 = x[entry2], y[entry2], x[entry3], y[entry3]
                                index, entry = entry6 - entry4, entry7 - entry5
                                local sqrtResult, calculatedValue2 =
                                    math.sqrt(index * index + entry * entry), entry2 == 1 and value or 0
                                if sqrtResult > calculatedValue2 + 0.75 then
                                    local calculatedValue5, calculatedValue6, calculatedValue7, calculatedValue8 =
                                        index / sqrtResult, entry / sqrtResult
                                    if calculatedValue2 > 0 then
                                        calculatedValue7, calculatedValue8 =
                                            entry4 + calculatedValue5 * calculatedValue2,
                                            entry5 + calculatedValue6 * calculatedValue2
                                    else
                                        calculatedValue7, calculatedValue8 =
                                            entry4 - calculatedValue5 * calculatedValue4,
                                            entry5 - calculatedValue6 * calculatedValue4
                                    end
                                    local interpolatedValue2
                                    if skelTCa then
                                        local roundedValue2 = math.floor(
                                            math.clamp(((entry5 + entry7) * 0.5 - y2) / maximumValue, 0, 1) * 40 + 0.5
                                        )
                                        interpolatedValue2 = skelTC[roundedValue2]
                                        if interpolatedValue2 then
                                        else
                                            interpolatedValue2 = skelTCa:Lerp(skelTCb, roundedValue2 / 40)
                                            skelTC[roundedValue2] = interpolatedValue2
                                        end
                                    else
                                        interpolatedValue2 = vxy
                                    end
                                    local calculatedValue9 = counter + 1
                                    pts(
                                        bones3[calculatedValue9],
                                        calculatedValue7,
                                        calculatedValue8,
                                        entry6 + calculatedValue5 * calculatedValue4,
                                        entry7 + calculatedValue6 * calculatedValue4,
                                        interpolatedValue2,
                                        now,
                                        skelPos,
                                        calculatedValue3
                                    )
                                    if refs then
                                        local calculatedValue10, calculatedValue11, calculatedValue3 = counter3 + 1
                                        if calculatedValue2 <= 0 then
                                            calculatedValue11, calculatedValue3 =
                                                entry4 - calculatedValue5 * calculatedValue,
                                                entry5 - calculatedValue6 * calculatedValue
                                        else
                                            calculatedValue11, calculatedValue3 = calculatedValue7, calculatedValue8
                                        end
                                        pts(
                                            pulseESP2.boneGlow(argument2, calculatedValue10),
                                            calculatedValue11,
                                            calculatedValue3,
                                            entry6 + calculatedValue5 * calculatedValue,
                                            entry7 + calculatedValue6 * calculatedValue,
                                            interpolatedValue2,
                                            roundedValue,
                                            interpolatedValue,
                                            false
                                        )
                                        counter3 = calculatedValue10
                                    else
                                    end
                                    counter = calculatedValue9
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if pulseESP2.joints then
                        pts = rig.pts
                        for index = 1, #pts, 1 do
                            if ok[index] then
                                if pts[index].j then
                                    calculatedValue, interpolatedValue = counter2 + 1
                                    if skelTCa then
                                        now = math.floor(math.clamp((y[index] - y2) / maximumValue, 0, 1) * 40 + 0.5)
                                        interpolatedValue = skelTC[now]
                                        if interpolatedValue then
                                        else
                                            interpolatedValue = skelTCa:Lerp(skelTCb, now / 40)
                                            skelTC[now] = interpolatedValue
                                        end
                                    else
                                        interpolatedValue = vxy
                                    end
                                    pulseESP2.jointDrawXY(
                                        argument2,
                                        calculatedValue,
                                        x[index],
                                        y[index],
                                        interpolatedValue,
                                        skelPos
                                    )
                                    counter2 = calculatedValue
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                bones = argument2.bones
                for index = counter + 1, #bones, 1 do
                    put(bones[index].frame, "Visible", false)
                end
                if argument2.boneGlows then
                    for index = counter3 + 1, #argument2.boneGlows, 1 do
                        put(argument2.boneGlows[index].frame, "Visible", false)
                    end
                end
                if argument2.joints then
                    for index = counter2 + 1, #argument2.joints, 1 do
                        put(argument2.joints[index].frame, "Visible", false)
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.drawHead = function(argument2, argument, argument3, argument4, argument5, enabled)
                enabled = false
                if pulseESP2.headDot then
                    local vptResult = pulseESP2.vpt(argument.Position)
                    if vptResult.Z > 0.08 then
                        local calculatedValue, headStroke, calculatedValue2 =
                            pulseESP2.headStyle or "Ring",
                            pulseESP2.headSize(argument3),
                            pulseESP2.skeleton and pulseESP2.boneBase(argument2, argument4) or argument4
                        local headStroke2 = pulseESP2.ink(pulseESP2.headColMode, pulseESP2.headCol, calculatedValue2)
                        callback4(argument2.head, "Position", math.floor(vptResult.X + 0.5), math.floor(vptResult.Y + 0.5))
                        callback4(argument2.head, "Size", headStroke, headStroke)
                        put(argument2.head, "BackgroundColor3", headStroke2)
                        headStroke = if calculatedValue == "Filled"
                            then math.clamp((pulseESP2.headFill or 25) / 100, 0, 1)
                            else if calculatedValue == "Dot" then 1 else 0
                        put(
                            argument2.head,
                            "BackgroundTransparency",
                            headStroke > 0 and callback5(1 - argument5 * headStroke) or 1
                        )
                        headStroke, calculatedValue2 =
                            argument2.headStroke, calculatedValue == "Dot" and (pulseESP2.outlineCol or color2)
                        put(headStroke, "Color", calculatedValue2 or headStroke2)
                        put(argument2.headStroke, "Thickness", calculatedValue == "Dot" and 1 or pulseESP2.lw(1.5))
                        headStroke2, calculatedValue2 =
                            argument2.headStroke,
                            calculatedValue == "Dot" and (pulseESP2.outline and callback5(1 - argument5 * 0.5) or 1)
                        put(headStroke2, "Transparency", calculatedValue2 or callback5(1 - argument5))
                        enabled = true
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                put(argument2.head, "Visible", enabled)
            end
            pulseESP2.tracerOrigin = function()
                local viewportSize = camera.ViewportSize
                if pulseESP2.tracerFrom == "Top" then
                    return Vector2.new(viewportSize.X * 0.5, 2)
                end
                if pulseESP2.tracerFrom == "Middle" then
                    return viewportSize * 0.5
                end
                if pulseESP2.tracerFrom == "Mouse" then
                    return userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                end
                if pulseESP2.tracerFrom == "Character" then
                    local calculatedValue = localPlayer.Character
                        and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if calculatedValue then
                        local value = camera
                        local worldToViewportPointResult =
                            value:WorldToViewportPoint(calculatedValue.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0))
                        if worldToViewportPointResult.Z > 0.08 then
                            return Vector2.new(worldToViewportPointResult.X, worldToViewportPointResult.Y)
                        end
                    end
                end
                return Vector2.new(viewportSize.X * 0.5, viewportSize.Y - 2)
            end
            pulseESP2.tracerHide = function(argument2)
                put(argument2.tracer.frame, "Visible", false)
            end
            pulseESP2.tracerDraw = function(
                argument2,
                argument,
                argument3,
                argument4,
                argument5,
                calculatedValue,
                calculatedValue2
            )
                if pulseESP2.tracerMurderer then
                    if calculatedValue2 ~= "Murderer" then
                        pulseESP2.tracerHide(argument2)
                        return
                    end
                end
                calculatedValue2, calculatedValue =
                    pulseESP2.tracerRole and argument4 or pulseESP2.tone(pulseESP2.tracerColour),
                    pulseESP2.tracerStyle == "Fade"
                pulseESP2.drawLine(
                    argument2.tracer,
                    argument,
                    argument3,
                    calculatedValue2,
                    pulseESP2.lw(pulseESP2.tracerThickness),
                    argument5 * pulseESP2.tracerAlpha / 100,
                    pulseESP2.outline and not calculatedValue
                )
                if calculatedValue or argument2.tracerGrad then
                    if not argument2.tracerGrad then
                        argument2.tracerGrad = pulseESP2.make(
                            "UIGradient",
                            {
                                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.95),
                                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.4),
                                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
                                }),
                            },
                            argument2.tracer.frame
                        )
                    end
                    put(argument2.tracerGrad, "Enabled", calculatedValue)
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.visible = function(argument2, argument, calculatedValue)
                local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                local filterDescendantsInstances = { calculatedValue, workspace2.CurrentCamera }
                if localPlayer.Character then
                    filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = localPlayer.Character
                end
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
                raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
                calculatedValue = argument.Position - argument2
                if calculatedValue.Magnitude < 0.05 then
                    return true
                end
                for index = 1, 6, 1 do
                    index = workspace2:Raycast(argument2, calculatedValue, raycastParams)
                    if index == nil then
                        return true
                    end
                    if index.Instance.Transparency < 0.3 then
                        return false
                    end
                    filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = index.Instance
                    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
                end
                return false
            end
            pulseESP2.roleOf = function(localPlayer2, calculatedValue)
                if type(localPlayer2) == "table" then
                    return localPlayer2.FakeRole
                end
                local calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue and calculatedValue[localPlayer2.Name]
                calculatedValue = calculatedValue2 and calculatedValue2.Role or nil
                calculatedValue = if calculatedValue2 and (
                            calculatedValue2.Dead == true or calculatedValue2.Killed == true
                        )
                    then if calculatedValue ~= "Zombie"
                        then if calculatedValue ~= "Vampire"
                            then if calculatedValue ~= "Freezer" then nil else calculatedValue
                            else calculatedValue
                        else calculatedValue
                    else calculatedValue
                calculatedValue = if calculatedValue == "Zombie"
                    then "Murderer"
                    else if calculatedValue == "Vampire"
                        then "Murderer"
                        else if calculatedValue == "Freezer"
                            then "Murderer"
                            else if calculatedValue == "Survivor"
                                then "Innocent"
                                else if calculatedValue == "Hunter"
                                    then "Innocent"
                                    else if calculatedValue == "Villager"
                                        then "Innocent"
                                        else if calculatedValue == "Runner" then "Innocent" else calculatedValue
                if calculatedValue == "Innocent" then
                    local now, entries = os.clock(), i.heroAt[localPlayer2]
                    if entries == nil then
                        entries = { at = -1, hero = false }
                        i.heroAt[localPlayer2] = entries
                    else
                    end
                    if now - entries.at > 0.12 then
                        entries.at = now
                        local character, backpack = localPlayer2.Character, localPlayer2:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                        entries.hero = (
                            character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")
                        )
                                and true
                            or false
                    end
                    calculatedValue = if entries.hero then "Hero" else calculatedValue
                else
                end
                return if calculatedValue ~= "Murderer"
                    then if calculatedValue ~= "Sheriff"
                        then if calculatedValue ~= "Hero"
                            then if calculatedValue ~= "Innocent" then nil else calculatedValue
                            else calculatedValue
                        else calculatedValue
                    else calculatedValue
            end
            pulseESP2.roleShown = function(argument2)
                if argument2 == "Murderer" then
                    return pulseESP2.murderer
                end
                if argument2 == "Sheriff" then
                    return pulseESP2.sheriff
                end
                if argument2 == "Hero" then
                    return pulseESP2.hero
                end
                if argument2 == "Innocent" then
                    return pulseESP2.innocent
                end
                return pulseESP2.noRole
            end
            pulseESP2.weaponScan = function(localPlayer2, argument)
                local character, backpack = localPlayer2.Character, localPlayer2:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                if character then
                    if character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
                        return "Knife", true
                    end
                    if character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
                        return "Gun", true
                    end
                end
                if backpack then
                    if backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
                        return "Knife", false
                    end
                    if backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
                        return "Gun", false
                    end
                end
                if argument == "Murderer" then
                    return "Knife", false
                end
                if argument == "Sheriff" then
                    return "Gun", false
                elseif argument == "Hero" then
                    return "Gun", false
                end
                return nil, false
            end
            pulseESP2.weaponOf = function(localPlayer2, role)
                local now, entries, char = os.clock(), i.weaponAt[localPlayer2], localPlayer2.Character
                if entries then
                    if now - entries.at < 0.15 then
                        if entries.role == role then
                            if entries.char == char then
                                return entries.name, entries.equipped
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local name, equipped = pulseESP2.weaponScan(localPlayer2, role)
                if entries then
                else
                    entries = {}
                    i.weaponAt[localPlayer2] = entries
                end
                entries.at = now
                entries.role = role
                entries.char = char
                entries.name = name
                entries.equipped = equipped
                return name, equipped
            end
            pulseESP2.partsOf = function(instance)
                local now, entries = os.clock(), i.parts[instance]
                if entries then
                    if entries.root then
                        if entries.hum then
                            if now - entries.at < 1 then
                                if entries.root.Parent == instance then
                                    if entries.hum.Parent == instance then
                                        return entries
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        elseif now - entries.at < 0.25 then
                            return entries
                        end
                    elseif now - entries.at < 0.25 then
                        return entries
                    end
                else
                    entries = {}
                    i.parts[instance] = entries
                end
                entries.at = now
                entries.hum = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                entries.root = instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    or instance:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                    or instance:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                entries.head = instance:FindFirstChild("Head") or entries.root
                return entries
            end
            pulseESP2.updatePlayer = function(localPlayer2, enabled, dx)
                local makeSetResult, char, role =
                    i.objects[localPlayer2], localPlayer2.Character, pulseESP2.roleOf(localPlayer2, dx)
                dx = char and pulseESP2.partsOf(char)
                local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 = dx and dx.hum, dx and dx.root
                local vptResult, camPos =
                    char and calculatedValue2 and calculatedValue and calculatedValue.Health > 0 and pulseESP2.roleShown(
                        role
                    ),
                    i.camPos
                local distance = vptResult and (calculatedValue2.Position - camPos).Magnitude or 0
                if if vptResult then distance > pulseESP2.maxDist else not vptResult then
                    if makeSetResult then
                        makeSetResult.dx = nil
                    end
                    pulseESP2.hideSet(makeSetResult, true)
                    pulseESP2.dropCham(localPlayer2)
                    pulseESP2.fxDrop(localPlayer2)
                    pulseESP2.radarHide(localPlayer2)
                    pulseESP2.labelsHide(localPlayer2)
                    return
                end
                if if makeSetResult then not makeSetResult.layer.Parent else not makeSetResult then
                    makeSetResult = pulseESP2.makeSet(localPlayer2)
                    i.objects[localPlayer2] = makeSetResult
                else
                end
                if makeSetResult.character ~= char then
                    makeSetResult.rect = nil
                    makeSetResult.rel = nil
                    makeSetResult.hpRatio = nil
                    makeSetResult.character = char
                end
                local weapon, now, inViewResult, equipped =
                    dx.head or calculatedValue2, os.clock(), pulseESP2.inView(calculatedValue2.Position, camPos, i.vp)
                if
                    (pulseESP2.visCheck or (pulseESP2.chams or pulseESP2.skeleton) and inViewResult)
                    and (makeSetResult.seenAt == nil or now - makeSetResult.seenAt > 0.12)
                then
                    makeSetResult.seen = pulseESP2.visible(camPos, weapon, char)
                    makeSetResult.seenAt = now
                end
                camPos = pulseESP2.visCheck
                dx = if camPos then makeSetResult.seen ~= false else not camPos
                local color3, alpha, focus, calculatedValue =
                    pulseESP2.color(role, dx, 1, localPlayer2, distance),
                    pulseESP2.alpha(distance, dx),
                    pulseESP2.murdererFocus == true and role == "Murderer",
                    pulseESP2.limits == true
                local function projectResult(argument)
                    return calculatedValue and (tonumber(argument) or 0) > 0 and distance > argument
                end
                i.lwk = pulseESP2.distScale and math.clamp(90 / math.max(distance, 1), 0.55, 1.6) or 1
                makeSetResult.role = role
                makeSetResult.boxOff = projectResult(pulseESP2.boxMaxDist)
                makeSetResult.skelOff = projectResult(pulseESP2.skelMaxDist)
                now, camPos =
                    projectResult(pulseESP2.nameMaxDist), type(localPlayer2) == "table" and localPlayer2.Ghost == true
                if camPos then
                    pulseESP2.dropCham(localPlayer2)
                elseif projectResult(pulseESP2.chamsMaxDist) then
                    pulseESP2.dropCham(localPlayer2)
                else
                    pulseESP2.cham(localPlayer2, char, role, makeSetResult.seen ~= false, alpha, inViewResult, distance)
                end
                if camPos then
                    pulseESP2.fxDrop(localPlayer2)
                else
                    pulseESP2.fxStep(localPlayer2, char, calculatedValue2, role, color3, alpha)
                end
                projectResult = pulseESP2.project(char, calculatedValue2)
                if not projectResult then
                    makeSetResult.dx = nil
                    pulseESP2.labelsHide(localPlayer2)
                    inViewResult, vptResult = pulseESP2.ringPoint(calculatedValue2.Position)
                    if pulseESP2.offscreen then
                        pulseESP2.radarShow(localPlayer2, inViewResult, vptResult, color3, distance, alpha)
                    else
                        pulseESP2.radarHide(localPlayer2)
                    end
                    if pulseESP2.tracer then
                        pulseESP2.hideInner(makeSetResult)
                        makeSetResult.rect = nil
                        makeSetResult.rel = nil
                        pulseESP2.tracerDraw(
                            makeSetResult,
                            pulseESP2.tracerOrigin(),
                            inViewResult,
                            color3,
                            alpha,
                            localPlayer2,
                            role
                        )
                        put(makeSetResult.layer, "Visible", true)
                    else
                        pulseESP2.hideSet(makeSetResult, true)
                    end
                    return
                end
                put(makeSetResult.layer, "Visible", true)
                vptResult, dx = equipped or pulseESP2.vpt(calculatedValue2.Position), makeSetResult.dx
                if dx then
                    if pulseESP2.skipFrames ~= false then
                        if dx.n < 1 then
                            if dx.char == char then
                                if projectResult.h < 160 then
                                    if dx.color == color3 then
                                        if dx.alpha == alpha then
                                            if dx.focus == focus then
                                                if math.abs(vptResult.X - dx.x) < 1 then
                                                    if math.abs(vptResult.Y - dx.y) < 1 then
                                                        if math.abs(projectResult.h - dx.h) < 1 then
                                                            if math.abs(projectResult.w - dx.w) < 1 then
                                                                dx.n = dx.n + 1
                                                                dx.dt = dx.dt + enabled
                                                                return
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                calculatedValue2 = enabled + (dx and dx.dt or 0)
                if dx then
                else
                    dx = {}
                    makeSetResult.dx = dx
                end
                dx.n, dx.dt, dx.char, dx.x, dx.y, dx.h, dx.w =
                    0, 0, char, vptResult.X, vptResult.Y, projectResult.h, projectResult.w
                dx.color = color3
                dx.alpha = alpha
                dx.focus = focus
                projectResult = pulseESP2.smoothRect(
                    makeSetResult,
                    projectResult,
                    calculatedValue2,
                    vptResult.Z > 0.08 and Vector2.new(vptResult.X, vptResult.Y) or nil
                )
                if projectResult.h < (pulseESP2.perfOn() and 48 or 26) then
                    makeSetResult.skelOff = true
                end
                pulseESP2.drawBox(makeSetResult, projectResult, color3, alpha, localPlayer2, focus)
                pulseESP2.radarHide(localPlayer2)
                pulseESP2.drawSkeleton(makeSetResult, char, projectResult, color3, alpha, localPlayer2)
                pulseESP2.drawHead(makeSetResult, weapon, projectResult, color3, alpha, localPlayer2)
                enabled = false
                if pulseESP2.lookLine then
                    vptResult, char =
                        pulseESP2.vpt(weapon.Position),
                        pulseESP2.vpt(weapon.Position + weapon.CFrame.LookVector * pulseESP2.lookLength)
                    if vptResult.Z > 0.08 then
                        if char.Z > 0.08 then
                            pulseESP2.drawLine(
                                makeSetResult.look,
                                Vector2.new(vptResult.X, vptResult.Y),
                                Vector2.new(char.X, char.Y),
                                pulseESP2.ink(pulseESP2.lookColMode, pulseESP2.lookCol, color3, localPlayer2),
                                pulseESP2.lw(pulseESP2.lookThick or 1.5),
                                alpha,
                                pulseESP2.outline
                            )
                            enabled = true
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                if not enabled then
                    put(makeSetResult.look.frame, "Visible", false)
                end
                weapon, equipped = pulseESP2.weaponOf(localPlayer2, role)
                if now then
                    pulseESP2.labelsHide(localPlayer2)
                else
                    pulseESP2.labelsUpdate(
                        localPlayer2,
                        projectResult,
                        {
                            alpha = alpha,
                            colour = color3,
                            role = role,
                            roleColour = pulseESP2.roleColour(role),
                            weapon = weapon,
                            equipped = equipped,
                            distance = distance,
                            infoY = projectResult.y + projectResult.h + 5,
                            focus = focus,
                            ghostTag = camPos and localPlayer2.GhostTag or nil,
                        }
                    )
                end
                if pulseESP2.tracer then
                    weapon = projectResult.y + projectResult.h
                    weapon = if pulseESP2.tracerTo == "Center"
                        then projectResult.y + projectResult.h * 0.5
                        else if pulseESP2.tracerTo == "Head" then projectResult.y else weapon
                    pulseESP2.tracerDraw(
                        makeSetResult,
                        pulseESP2.tracerOrigin(),
                        Vector2.new(projectResult.x + projectResult.w * 0.5, weapon),
                        color3,
                        alpha,
                        localPlayer2,
                        role
                    )
                else
                    pulseESP2.tracerHide(makeSetResult)
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.perfOn = function()
                if pulseESP2.perfMode == false then
                    return false
                end
                if pulseESP2.perfMode == true then
                    return true
                end
                local touchPerf, touchPerf2 = i.touchPerf
                if touchPerf == nil then
                    touchPerf2 = false
                    pcall(function()
                        local userInputService2 = game:GetService("UserInputService")
                        touchPerf2 = userInputService2.TouchEnabled and not userInputService2.KeyboardEnabled
                            or getgenv().NOVA_FORCE_TOUCH == true
                    end)
                    i.touchPerf = touchPerf2
                else
                    touchPerf2 = touchPerf
                end
                return touchPerf2
            end
            pulseESP2.step = function(argument2)
                if not pulseESP2.on then
                    if not i.hidden then
                        pulseESP2.hideAll()
                    end
                    local pruneAt = i.pruneAt
                    if if pruneAt then os.clock() >= i.pruneAt else not pruneAt then
                        i.pruneAt = os.clock() + 1
                        pulseESP2.prune()
                    end
                    return
                end
                camera = workspace2.CurrentCamera or camera
                if camera == nil then
                    pulseESP2.hideAll()
                    return
                end
                local poolSweepAt = i.poolSweepAt
                if if poolSweepAt then os.clock() >= i.poolSweepAt else not poolSweepAt then
                    i.poolSweepAt = os.clock() + 5
                    pcall(pulseESP2.poolSweep)
                end
                i.hidden = false
                i.budget = 1
                i.camCF = camera.CFrame
                i.camPos = i.camCF.Position
                i.vp = camera.ViewportSize
                i.pcf, i.pcx, i.pcy = i.camCF, i.vp.X * 0.5, i.vp.Y * 0.5
                i.pf = i.pcy / math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView) * 0.5)
                i.pok = false
                poolSweepAt = i.camPos + i.camCF.LookVector * 20 + i.camCF.RightVector * 3 + i.camCF.UpVector * 2
                local success, pointToObjectSpaceResult =
                    camera:WorldToViewportPoint(poolSweepAt), i.pcf:PointToObjectSpace(poolSweepAt)
                poolSweepAt = -pointToObjectSpaceResult.Z
                if poolSweepAt > 0.08 then
                    local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 =
                        i.pcx + pointToObjectSpaceResult.X / poolSweepAt * i.pf,
                        i.pcy - pointToObjectSpaceResult.Y / poolSweepAt * i.pf
                    i.pok = math.abs(calculatedValue - success.X) < 0.5
                        and math.abs(calculatedValue2 - success.Y) < 0.5
                        and math.abs(poolSweepAt - success.Z) < 0.05
                end
                pointToObjectSpaceResult, poolSweepAt = isActive and isActive() or {}, {}
                i.frameN = (i.frameN or 0) + 1
                local success2, skipDt = i.skipDt
                if success2 then
                    skipDt = success2
                else
                    local callback, entries = setmetatable, { __mode = "k" }
                    skipDt = callback({}, entries)
                end
                i.skipDt = skipDt
                local perfOnResult, callback, packedValues, counter =
                    pulseESP2.perfOn(), ipairs, packValues(PulsePlayers()), 0
                for key, item in callback(unpackTuple(packedValues)) do
                    if item ~= localPlayer then
                        poolSweepAt[item] = true
                        counter += 1
                        if perfOnResult and (counter + i.frameN) % 2 == 1 and i.objects[item] ~= nil then
                            i.skipDt[item] = (i.skipDt[item] or 0) + argument2
                        else
                            skipDt = i.retryAt[item]
                            if if skipDt then os.clock() >= i.retryAt[item] else not skipDt then
                                key = argument2 + (i.skipDt[item] or 0)
                                i.skipDt[item] = nil
                                success2, success = pcall(pulseESP2.updatePlayer, item, key, pointToObjectSpaceResult)
                                if success2 then
                                    i.retryAt[item] = nil
                                else
                                    i.lastError = tostring(success)
                                    i.retryAt[item] = os.clock() + 0.5
                                    pulseESP2.hideSet(i.objects[item], true)
                                    pulseESP2.dropCham(item)
                                    pulseESP2.fxDrop(item)
                                    pulseESP2.radarHide(item)
                                    pulseESP2.labelsHide(item)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                skipDt = pulseESP2.extraPlayers
                if type(skipDt) == "table" then
                    for success3, item in ipairs(skipDt) do
                        poolSweepAt[item] = true
                        success, success3 = pcall(pulseESP2.updatePlayer, item, argument2, pointToObjectSpaceResult)
                        if not success then
                            i.lastError = tostring(success3)
                        end
                    end
                end
                i.pok = false
                for key in pairs(i.objects) do
                    if not poolSweepAt[key] then
                        pulseESP2.release(key)
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.clean = function(argument2)
                if type(argument2) ~= "string" then
                    return ""
                end
                return (argument2:gsub("[%z\001-\031\127]", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
            end
            pulseESP2.formatNameBuild = function(argument2)
                local cleanResult, cleanResult2 = pulseESP2.clean(argument2.Name), pulseESP2.clean(argument2.DisplayName)
                cleanResult = if cleanResult == "" then cleanResult2 else cleanResult
                cleanResult = if cleanResult == "" then "Player" else cleanResult
                cleanResult2 = if cleanResult2 == "" then cleanResult else cleanResult2
                if pulseESP2.nameMode == "Display name" then
                    return cleanResult2, ""
                end
                if pulseESP2.nameMode == "Both" then
                    return cleanResult2, cleanResult2 ~= cleanResult and "@" .. cleanResult or ""
                end
                return cleanResult, ""
            end
            pulseESP2.formatName = function(argument2)
                local name, display, mode, entries =
                    argument2.Name, argument2.DisplayName, pulseESP2.nameMode, i.names[argument2]
                if entries then
                    if entries.name == name then
                        if entries.display == display then
                            if entries.mode == mode then
                                return entries.main, entries.second
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local main, second = pulseESP2.formatNameBuild(argument2)
                if entries then
                else
                    entries = {}
                    i.names[argument2] = entries
                end
                entries.name = name
                entries.display = display
                entries.mode = mode
                entries.main = main
                entries.second = second
                return main, second
            end

            pulseESP2.fontFace = function(argument2)
                local entries = i.faceFast[pulseESP2.textFont]
                local fontFaceBuildResult = entries and entries[argument2]
                if fontFaceBuildResult then
                    return fontFaceBuildResult
                end
                fontFaceBuildResult = pulseESP2.fontFaceBuild(argument2)
                if entries then
                else
                    entries = {}
                    i.faceFast[pulseESP2.textFont] = entries
                end
                entries[argument2] = fontFaceBuildResult
                return fontFaceBuildResult
            end
            pulseESP2.fontFaceBuild = function(argument2)
                i.faces = i.faces or {}
                local calculatedValue = tostring(pulseESP2.textFont) .. tostring(argument2)
                if i.faces[calculatedValue] then
                    return i.faces[calculatedValue]
                end
                local text = "rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json"
                if pulseESP2.textFont == "Gotham" then
                    text = "rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json"
                else
                    if pulseESP2.textFont == "Code" then
                        text = "rbxasset://fonts/families/RobotoMono.json"
                    else
                        if pulseESP2.textFont == "Source Sans" then
                            text = "rbxasset://fonts/families/SourceSansPro.json"
                        else
                            if pulseESP2.textFont == "Montserrat" then
                                text = "rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json"
                            else
                                if pulseESP2.FONT_ENUM[pulseESP2.textFont] then
                                    local success, result = pcall(function()
                                        return Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font[pulseESP2.FONT_ENUM[pulseESP2.textFont]])
                                    end)
                                    if success then
                                        if result then
                                            if argument2 then
                                                local success2, result2 = pcall(Font.new, result.Family, argument2)
                                                result = if success2 then result2 or result else result
                                            else
                                            end
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                    local faces
                                    faces, result = i.faces, success and result
                                    faces[calculatedValue] = result or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
                                    return i.faces[calculatedValue]
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local success, result = pcall(Font.new, text, argument2 or Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
                i.faces[calculatedValue] = success and result or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
                return i.faces[calculatedValue]
            end

            pulseESP2.gradStops = function(argument2)
                if pulseESP2.textGradStyle == "Custom" then
                    return { pulseESP2.textGradA, pulseESP2.textGradB }
                end
                if pulseESP2.textGradStyle == "ESP Color" then
                    return { color, argument2 or color }
                elseif pulseESP2.textGradStyle == "Role" then
                    return { color, argument2 or color }
                elseif not pulseESP2.GRAD_STYLES[pulseESP2.textGradStyle] then
                    return { color, argument2 or color }
                end
                return pulseESP2.GRAD_STYLES[pulseESP2.textGradStyle]
            end
            pulseESP2.gradSeq = function(colorSequence)
                local textGradStyle = pulseESP2.textGradStyle
                local value = if pulseESP2.GRAD_STYLES[textGradStyle]
                    then textGradStyle
                    else if textGradStyle == "Custom"
                        then "custom" .. tostring(pulseESP2.textGradA) .. tostring(pulseESP2.textGradB)
                        else math.floor(colorSequence.R * 255 + 0.5) * 65536
                            + math.floor(colorSequence.G * 255 + 0.5) * 256
                            + math.floor(colorSequence.B * 255 + 0.5)
                i.gradCache = i.gradCache or {}
                i.gradFrameCache = i.gradFrameCache or {}
                textGradStyle = if pulseESP2.textGradAnim then i.gradFrameCache[value] else i.gradCache[value]
                if textGradStyle then
                    return textGradStyle
                end
                textGradStyle = pulseESP2.gradStops(colorSequence)
                colorSequence = #textGradStyle
                if colorSequence < 2 then
                    textGradStyle, colorSequence = { textGradStyle[1] or color, textGradStyle[1] or color }, 2
                else
                end
                if not pulseESP2.textGradAnim then
                    local entries = {}
                    for key, item in ipairs(textGradStyle) do
                        entries[#entries + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new((key - 1) / (colorSequence - 1), item)
                    end
                    local colorSequence2 = ColorSequence.new(entries)
                    i.gradCache[value] = colorSequence2
                    return colorSequence2
                end
                local entries = {}
                for index = 1, colorSequence, 1 do
                    entries[index] = textGradStyle[index]
                end
                if colorSequence == 2 then
                    entries[3] = textGradStyle[1]
                    colorSequence = 3
                else
                end
                local calculatedValue, entries2 = i.gradPhase or 0, {}
                for index = 0, 8, 1 do
                    textGradStyle = index / 8
                    index = (textGradStyle + calculatedValue) % 1 * colorSequence
                    local calculatedValue2 = math.floor(index) % colorSequence + 1
                    local calculatedValue = calculatedValue2 % colorSequence + 1
                    entries2[#entries2 + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
                        textGradStyle,
                        entries[calculatedValue2]:Lerp(entries[calculatedValue], index - math.floor(index))
                    )
                end
                colorSequence = ColorSequence.new(entries2)
                i.gradFrameCache[value] = colorSequence
                return colorSequence
            end
            pulseESP2.gradTick = function(calculatedValue)
                calculatedValue = calculatedValue or 0
                i.gradPhase = ((i.gradPhase or 0) + calculatedValue * 0.25 * (tonumber(pulseESP2.textGradSpeed) or 1)) % 1
                i.gradAcc = (i.gradAcc or 0) + calculatedValue
                if i.gradAcc >= 0.03333333333333333 then
                    i.gradAcc = 0
                    i.gradFrameCache = {}
                elseif i.gradFrameCache == nil then
                    i.gradAcc = 0
                    i.gradFrameCache = {}
                end
            end

            pulseESP2.labelMeasure = function(argument2, argument, text, size, font, limit)
                local entry = argument2.measures[argument]
                if entry then
                    if entry.text == text then
                        if entry.size == size then
                            if entry.font == font then
                                if entry.limit == limit then
                                    return entry.width, entry.height
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                i.textService = i.textService or game:GetService("TextService")
                local success, result = pcall(function()
                    local textService, packedValues = i.textService, packValues(Vector2.new(100000, 100000))
                    return textService:GetTextSize(text, size, font, unpackTuple(packedValues))
                end)
                local width, height =
                    success and math.ceil(result.X) or math.min(limit, #text * size * 0.55),
                    success and math.ceil(result.Y) or size + 3
                width, height = math.min(math.max(width + 2, 1), limit), math.max(height + 2, size + 3)
                argument2.measures[argument] =
                    { text = text, size = size, font = font, limit = limit, width = width, height = height }
                return width, height
            end

            pulseESP2.flagsUpdate = function(
                makeResult,
                entries,
                argument,
                argument2,
                clampedValue,
                argument3,
                calculatedValue,
                callback,
                argument4,
                argument5
            )
                local side = makeResult.side
                if #argument == 0 then
                    if side then
                        put(side, "Visible", false)
                    end
                    return
                end
                if if side then side.Parent == nil else not side then
                    local labelRootResult = pulseESP2.labelRoot()
                    if not labelRootResult then
                        return
                    end
                    side = pulseESP2.make(
                        "Frame",
                        { Name = "Flags", BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = false, Visible = false },
                        labelRootResult
                    )
                    makeResult.side = side
                    makeResult.flagSlots = {}
                else
                end
                local flagSlots, calculatedValue2, counter = makeResult.flagSlots, argument2 + 2, 0
                for unused, item in ipairs(argument) do
                    item.w =
                        pulseESP2.labelMeasure(makeResult, item.slot, item.text, argument2, clampedValue, calculatedValue)
                    counter = if item.w > counter then item.w else counter
                end
                calculatedValue = math.floor(pulseESP2.lw(pulseESP2.boxThickness) + 0.5)
                    + (pulseESP2.box and pulseESP2.outline and math.floor((pulseESP2.outlineSize or 2) + 0.5) or 0)
                    + 3
                makeResult = entries.x + entries.w + calculatedValue
                makeResult = if makeResult + counter > argument4.X - argument5
                    then entries.x - calculatedValue - counter
                    else makeResult
                clampedValue = math.clamp(
                    entries.y - 2,
                    argument5,
                    math.max(argument5, argument4.Y - argument5 - calculatedValue2 * #argument)
                )
                callback4(side, "Position", math.floor(makeResult + 0.5), math.floor(clampedValue + 0.5))
                callback4(side, "Size", counter, calculatedValue2 * #argument)
                put(side, "Visible", true)
                entries = {}
                for key, item in ipairs(argument) do
                    makeResult = flagSlots[item.slot]
                    if makeResult then
                    else
                        makeResult = pulseESP2.make(
                            "TextLabel",
                            {
                                Name = item.slot,
                                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                                Active = false,
                                RichText = false,
                                TextScaled = false,
                                TextWrapped = false,
                                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
                                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                                TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 8, 13),
                                Text = "",
                                ZIndex = 3,
                            },
                            side
                        )
                        flagSlots[item.slot] = makeResult
                    end

                i.labelVer = (i.labelVer or 0) + 1
                local value
                for unused, item in ipairs(pulseESP2.styles) do
                    if item.name == featureState then
                        value = item
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not value then
                    return
                end
                featureState = {
                    on = true,
                    maxDist = true,
                    murderer = true,
                    sheriff = true,
                    hero = true,
                    innocent = true,
                    noRole = true,
                    murdererColour = true,
                    sheriffColour = true,
                    heroColour = true,
                    innocentColour = true,
                    noRoleColour = true,
                    nameMode = true,
                }
                for key, item in pairs(pulseESP2.defaults) do
                    if not featureState[key] then
                        pulseESP2[key] = item
                    end
                end
                for key, item in pairs(value.values) do
                    pulseESP2[key] = item
                end
                pulseESP2.style = value.name
                pulseESP2.on = true
                if not pulseESP2.chams then
                    pulseESP2.clearChams()
                end
                if not pulseESP2.offscreen then
                    pulseESP2.radarClear()
                end
                for key in pairs(i.fx) do
                    pulseESP2.fxDrop(key)
                end
                for unused, item in pairs(i.labels) do
                    item.measures = {}
                end
                pulseESP2.syncUI()
            end
            pulseESP2.syncUI = function()
                i.labelVer = (i.labelVer or 0) + 1

                    pcall(function()
                        local entry = pulseESP2[key]
                        if item.kind == "t" then
                            item.h.SetSilent(entry == true)
                        elseif item.kind == "s" then
                            item.h.Set(entry)
                        elseif item.kind == "d" then
                            item.h.Set(entry)
                        elseif item.kind == "c" then
                            item.h.Set(entry)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            pulseESP2.onChange = function(argument2)
                i.labelVer = (i.labelVer or 0) + 1
                if argument2 == "on" then
                    if not pulseESP2.on then
                        pulseESP2.hideAll()
                    end
                end
                if argument2 == "chams" and not pulseESP2.chams then
                    pulseESP2.clearChams()
                elseif argument2 == "chamsMaterial" then
                    pulseESP2.clearChams()
                elseif argument2 == "chamsStyle" then
                    pulseESP2.clearChams()
                end
                if argument2 == "offscreen" then
                    if not pulseESP2.offscreen then
                        pulseESP2.radarClear()
                    end
                end
                if argument2 == "radarStyle" then
                    pulseESP2.radarClear()
                end
                if argument2 == "fxTargets" or argument2 == "sparkleStyle" then
                    for key in pairs(i.fx) do
                        pulseESP2.fxDrop(key)
                    end
                end
                if argument2 == "textGradStyle" then
                    i.gradCache = {}
                elseif argument2 == "textGradAnim" then
                    i.gradCache = {}
                end
                if
                    argument2 == "textFont"
                    or argument2 == "textSize"
                    or argument2 == "infoSize"
                    or argument2 == "nameMode"
                then
                    i.faces = {}
                    for unused, item in pairs(i.labels) do
                        item.measures = {}
                    end
                end
                if argument2 == "brightness" or argument2 == "saturation" or argument2 == "boxGradStyle" then
                    i.boxSeqCache = nil
                    i.boxStops = nil
                    i.toneCache = nil
                    for unused, item in pairs(i.objects) do
                        item.edgeKey = nil
                        item.fillKey = nil
                    end
                end
                if argument2 == "chamsShell" then
                    pulseESP2.clearChams()
                end
                if argument2 == "boxStyle" or argument2 == "box" then
                    for unused, item in pairs(i.objects) do
                        pcall(pulseESP2.hideInner, item)
                    end
                end
                if argument2 == "radarStyle" then
                    pulseESP2.radarClear()
                elseif argument2 == "arrowGlow" then
                    pulseESP2.radarClear()
                end
                if argument2 == "trail" or argument2 == "trailStyle" or argument2 == "trailWidth" then
                    for key in pairs(i.fx) do
                        pulseESP2.fxDrop(key)
                    end
                end
                if
                    argument2 == "textScale"
                    or argument2 == "nameCase"
                    or argument2 == "nameWeight"
                    or argument2 == "distUnit"
                    or argument2 == "roleStyle"
                    or argument2 == "plateStyle"
                then
                    for unused, item in pairs(i.labels) do
                        item.measures = {}
                    end
                end
            end

            pcall(function()
                local pulseDesyncGhost = { by = {}, last = {}, leak = {}, far = 1000000, keep = 20 }
                getgenv().__pulseDesyncGhost = pulseDesyncGhost
                local function callback7(argument)
                    return argument.X ~= argument.X
                        or argument.Y ~= argument.Y
                        or argument.Z ~= argument.Z
                        or argument.Magnitude > pulseDesyncGhost.far
                end
                local function isActive2()
                    local pulseGhost = Instance.new("Model")
                    pulseGhost.Name = "PulseGhost"
                    local function humanoid(name, size, argument)
                        local part = Instance.new("Part")
                        part.Name = name
                        part.Size = size
                        part.Anchored = true
                        part.CanCollide = false
                        part.CanQuery = false
                        part.CanTouch = false
                        part.Transparency = 1
                        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, argument, 0)
                        part.Parent = pulseGhost
                        return part
                    end
                    local primaryPart = humanoid("HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), 0)
                    humanoid("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), 2.25)
                    humanoid("Feet", Vector3.new(2, 1, 1), -2.5)
                    humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
                    humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                    humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
                    humanoid.Parent = pulseGhost
                    pulseGhost.PrimaryPart = primaryPart
                    return pulseGhost
                end
                local function callback(localPlayer2)
                    local entries = pulseDesyncGhost.by[localPlayer2]
                    if entries then
                    else
                        local model = isActive2()
                        entries = {
                            model = model,
                            fake = {
                                Name = localPlayer2.Name,
                                DisplayName = localPlayer2.DisplayName,
                                UserId = localPlayer2.UserId,
                                Character = model,
                                Ghost = true,
                                FindFirstChild = function(unused, argument)
                                    return localPlayer2:FindFirstChild(argument)
                                end,
                            },
                        }
                        pulseDesyncGhost.by[localPlayer2] = entries
                    end
                    return entries
                end
                local function callback8(argument)
                    local entry = pulseDesyncGhost.by[argument]
                    if entry then
                        pcall(function()
                            entry.model:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    pulseDesyncGhost.by[argument] = nil
                end
                local function callback9(argument)
                    local parent = argument
                    for index = 1, 6, 1 do
                        if not parent then
                            return nil
                        end
                        index = playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(parent)
                        if index then
                            return index, parent
                        end
                        parent = parent.Parent
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                task.spawn(function()
                    local clientServices = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ClientServices", 30)
                    clientServices = clientServices and (clientServices:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 30))
                    clientServices = clientServices and (clientServices:WaitForChild("GunFired", 30))
                    if not clientServices then
