                    connectSignal(clientServices.OnClientEvent, function(rootPart, argument, argument2)
                        if typeof(rootPart) ~= "Instance" then
                            return
                        end
                        argument, argument2 =
                            if typeof(argument) == "CFrame" then argument.Position else argument,
                            if typeof(argument2) == "CFrame" then argument2.Position else argument2
                        if typeof(argument) ~= "Vector3" then
                            return
                        elseif callback7(argument) then
                            return
                        end
                        local value, ch = callback9(rootPart)
                        if value then
                            if value == localPlayer then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                        rootPart = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if rootPart then
                            if not (callback7(rootPart.Position)) then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                        rootPart = argument - Vector3.new(0, 1.25, 0)
                        if typeof(argument2) == "Vector3" then
                            local position = Vector3.new(argument2.X - argument.X, 0, argument2.Z - argument.Z)
                            if position.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                                position = position.Unit
                                rootPart = rootPart - position * 3.45 - position:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) * 1.4
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        local leak, entries = pulseDesyncGhost.leak, { p = rootPart }
                        entries.t, entries.ch, leak[value] = os.clock(), ch, entries
                    end)
                end)
                connectSignal(runService.Heartbeat, function()
                    if not pulseESP2.on then
                        if pulseESP2.extraPlayers then
                            pulseESP2.extraPlayers = nil
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    local now, callback9, packedValues = os.clock(), ipairs, packValues(PulsePlayers())
                    local value, extraPlayers, value2
                    for ch, localPlayer2 in callback9(unpackTuple(packedValues)) do
                        if localPlayer2 ~= localPlayer then
                            ch = localPlayer2.Character
                            local calculatedValue = ch and PulseFC(ch, "HumanoidRootPart")
                            local calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue and PulseFCC(ch, "Humanoid")
                            if calculatedValue then
                                if calculatedValue2 then
                                    if calculatedValue2.Health > 0 then
                                        local p, entries = calculatedValue.Position, pulseDesyncGhost.last[localPlayer2]
                                        if callback7(p) then
                                            local at, t
                                            if entries and entries.ch == ch then
                                                at = entries.p
                                                t = entries.t
                                            else
                                            end
                                            local roundedValue = pulseDesyncGhost.leak[localPlayer2]
                                            if
                                                roundedValue
                                                and roundedValue.ch == ch
                                                and (if t then roundedValue.t > t else not t)
                                            then
                                                at = roundedValue.p
                                                t = roundedValue.t
                                            else
                                            end
                                            if at and now - t < pulseDesyncGhost.keep then
                                                local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2, calculatedValue3, value3 =
                                                    value or (isActive and isActive() or {}),
                                                    extraPlayers or {},
                                                    value2 or {},
                                                    callback(localPlayer2)
                                                roundedValue = math.floor(now - t)
                                                value3.fake.Name = localPlayer2.Name
                                                value3.fake.DisplayName = localPlayer2.DisplayName
                                                value3.fake.GhostTag = roundedValue >= 1 and "DESYNC " .. roundedValue .. "s"
                                                    or "DESYNC"
                                                value3.fake.FakeRole = pulseESP2.roleOf(localPlayer2, calculatedValue)
                                                if value3.at ~= at then
                                                    value3.at = at
                                                    pcall(function()
                                                        value3.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(at))
                                                    end)
                                                end
                                                calculatedValue3[localPlayer2] = true
                                                calculatedValue2[#calculatedValue2 + 1] = value3.fake
                                                value, extraPlayers, value2 =
                                                    calculatedValue, calculatedValue2, calculatedValue3
                                            else
                                            end
                                        else
                                            if entries then
                                            else
                                                entries = {}
                                                pulseDesyncGhost.last[localPlayer2] = entries
                                            end
                                            entries.p = p
                                            entries.t = now
                                            entries.ch = ch
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if next(pulseDesyncGhost.by) then
                        for key in pairs(pulseDesyncGhost.by) do
                            if value2 then
                                if not value2[key] then
                                    callback8(key)
                                end
                            else
                                callback8(key)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if now - (pulseDesyncGhost.gcAt or 0) > 1 then
                        pulseDesyncGhost.gcAt = now
                        for key in pairs(pulseDesyncGhost.last) do
                            if not key.Parent then
                                pulseDesyncGhost.last[key] = nil
                                pulseDesyncGhost.leak[key] = nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseESP2.extraPlayers = extraPlayers
                end)
                callback2(function()
                    pulseESP2.extraPlayers = nil
                    for key in pairs(pulseDesyncGhost.by) do
                        callback8(key)
                    end
                end)
            end)

                local ru = localization.data.ru

            entries.wrap = function(argument, argument2)
                local curSub = uiPage._curSub
                if entries.LEG[argument] then
                    uiPage._curSub = entries.LEG[argument]
                end
                local success, result = pcall(argument2)
                uiPage._curSub = curSub
                if success then
                    return result
                end
                warn("[QwernESP] " .. tostring(result))
                return nil
            end
            entries.rowOf = function(argument)
                if argument then
                    if not argument.Row then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end
                local lastSectionResult = uiPage:LastSection()
                if lastSectionResult and lastSectionResult.Rows then
                    for unused, item in ipairs(lastSectionResult.Rows) do
                        if item.Frame == argument.Row then
                            return item
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            entries.setVisible = function(argument, argument2, visible)
                if argument then
                    if argument.SetVisible then
                        if argument.selfHidden ~= not visible then
                            argument.SetVisible(visible)
                        end
                    elseif argument2 then
                        if argument2.Row then
                            argument2.Row.Visible = visible
                        end
                    end
                elseif argument2 then
                    if argument2.Row then
                        argument2.Row.Visible = visible
                    end
                end
            end

            entries.grid = function(argument, argument2, argument3)
                local value = createInstance(
                    "Frame",
                    { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1 },
                    uiPage:Container()
                )
                local value2 = createInstance(
                    "UIGridLayout",
                    {
                        CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / argument, -math.ceil(6 * (argument - 1) / argument), 0, argument2 or 30),
                        CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
                        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                    },
                    value
                )
                if argument3 then
                    local function handleAction()
                        local mainWindow = sharedState.W
                        local clampedValue = mainWindow and mainWindow.Scale and mainWindow.Scale.Scale or 1
                        mainWindow = value.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(clampedValue, 0.1)
                        if mainWindow < 40 then
                            return
                        end
                        clampedValue = math.clamp(math.floor((mainWindow + 6) / (argument3 + 6)), 1, argument)
                        value2.CellSize = UDim2.new(
                            1 / clampedValue,
                            -math.ceil(6 * (clampedValue - 1) / clampedValue),
                            0,
                            argument2 or 30
                        )
                    end
                    connectSignal(value:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), handleAction)
                    task.defer(handleAction)
                end
                return value
            end
            entries.fitState = {}
            entries.fitText = function(argument)
                local entries3, entry = entries.fitState[argument]
                if entries3 then
                    entry = entries3
                else
                    entries3 = {}
                    entries.fitState[argument] = entries3
                    entry = entries3
                end
                if entry.busy then
                    entry.again = true
                    return
                end
                entry.busy = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    repeat
                        entry.again = false
                        local counter = 12
                        for unused, item in ipairs(argument) do
                            if item.l then
                                if not item.base then
                                    item.base = item.l.TextSize
                                end
                            end
                            counter = if item.base then if item.base > counter then item.base else counter else counter
                        end
                        for textSize = math.floor(counter), 8, -1 do
                            for unused, item in ipairs(argument) do
                                if item.l then
                                    item.l.TextSize = textSize
                                end
                            end
                            task.wait()
                            textSize = true
                            for unused, item in ipairs(argument) do
                                if item.l and item.l.AbsoluteSize.X > 1 and not item.l.TextFits then
                                    textSize = false
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                            if textSize then
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    until not entry.again
                    entry.busy = false
                end)
            end
            entries.paintChip = function(argument)
                if argument.paint then
                    return argument.paint(argument)
                end
                local nv, calculatedValue = entries.NV, argument.on == true
                nv.paint(argument.b, "BackgroundColor3", calculatedValue and "Accent" or "Surface2", "Quick")
                local tweenInstance, b, chk = nv.Motion.tween, argument.b, {}
                chk.BackgroundTransparency = calculatedValue and 0.82 or 0
                tweenInstance(b, "Quick", chk)
                nv.paint(argument.st, "Color", (calculatedValue or argument.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
                nv.Motion.tween(
                    argument.st,
                    "Quick",
                    {
                        Transparency = calculatedValue and 0.1 or (argument.hover and 0.45 or 0.86),
                        Thickness = calculatedValue and 1.5 or 1,
                    }
                )
                nv.paint(argument.l, "TextColor3", (calculatedValue or argument.hover) and "Text" or "Muted", "Quick")
                if argument.chk then
                    tweenInstance, chk, b = nv.Motion.tween, argument.chk, {}
                    b.ImageTransparency = calculatedValue and 0 or 1
                    tweenInstance(chk, "Quick", b)
                end
                if argument.sw then
                    if argument.dotOf then
                        argument.sw.BackgroundColor3 = argument.dotOf()
                    end
                    argument.sw.BackgroundTransparency = argument.dim and not calculatedValue and 0.65 or 0
                end
            end
            entries.chip = function(calculatedValue, st, argument, color3, argument2)
                local nv = entries.NV
                local b = createInstance(
                    "TextButton",
                    { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = st },

    constructors.createDesyncController = function(
        settings,
        connectSignal,
        argument,
        isActive,
        localPlayer,
        playersService,
        argument2,
        callback,
        callback2
    )
        return function()
            local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
            if type(settings.fakepos) ~= "table" then
                settings.fakepos = {}
            end
            local cfg = settings.fakepos
            if cfg.on == nil then
                cfg.on = false
            end
            if tonumber(cfg.power) == nil then
                cfg.power = 5
            end
            if cfg.vel == nil then
                cfg.vel = true
            end
            if cfg.md == nil then
                cfg.md = true
            end
            if cfg.side == nil then
                cfg.side = true
            end
            local off = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            local pulseFakePos = { active = false, off = off }
            getgenv().__pulseFakePos = pulseFakePos
            local pulseAntiAim = { cfg = cfg, frames = 0, restores = 0, threat = nil, side = 1 }
            getgenv().__pulseAntiAim = pulseAntiAim
            pcall(function()
                local numberValue = tonumber(getfflag("WorldStepMax"))
                if numberValue then
                    if numberValue < 0 then
                        setfflag("WorldStepMax", "30")
                    end
                end
            end)
            local humanoidStateType, entries = Enum.HumanoidStateType, {}
            entries[humanoidStateType.Dead] = true
            entries[humanoidStateType.Seated] = true
            entries[humanoidStateType.Climbing] = true
            entries[humanoidStateType.Physics] = true
            entries[humanoidStateType.PlatformStanding] = true
            entries[humanoidStateType.Ragdoll] = true
            entries[humanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true
            entries[humanoidStateType.Swimming] = true
            entries[humanoidStateType.GettingUp] = true
            local value, calculatedValue, calculatedValue2
            local enabled, assemblyLinearVelocity, assemblyLinearVelocity2, moveDirection, md, transform, fakeCF = false
            local side, calculatedValue3, threat = 1, 0
            local calculatedValue4, enabled2, calculatedValue5, entries2 = 0, false, 0, {}
            local function callback3(instance)
                value, enabled = instance, false
                local value2 = entries2
                for unused, item in ipairs(value2) do
                    pcall(function()
                        item:Disconnect()
                    end)
                end
                entries2 = {}
                if instance then
                    local function handleAction(instance2)
                        if instance2:IsA("Tool") then
                            pulseAntiAim.toolAt = os.clock()
                        end
                    end
                    value2 = entries2
                    value2[1] = connectSignal(instance.ChildAdded, handleAction)
                    local value3 = entries2
                    value3[2] = connectSignal(instance.ChildRemoved, handleAction)
                end
                assemblyLinearVelocity, assemblyLinearVelocity2, moveDirection, md, transform, fakeCF =
                    nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
                calculatedValue = instance and instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
                calculatedValue2 = instance and instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
            end
            local function handleAction()
                enabled = false
                local value2, value3 = calculatedValue, calculatedValue2
                if fakeCF then
                    if transform then
                        if value2 then
                            if value2.Parent then
                                local transform2 = value2.CFrame
                                if (transform2.Position - fakeCF.Position).Magnitude < 0.01 then
                                    if transform2.LookVector:Dot(fakeCF.LookVector) > 0.9999 then
                                        value2.CFrame = transform
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if assemblyLinearVelocity2 then
                    if assemblyLinearVelocity then
                        if value2 then
                            if value2.Parent then
                                local assemblyLinearVelocity3 = value2.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                                local magnitude, magnitude2 =
                                    (assemblyLinearVelocity3 - assemblyLinearVelocity2).Magnitude,
                                    (assemblyLinearVelocity3 - assemblyLinearVelocity).Magnitude
                                if magnitude < 0.05 then
                                    value2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = assemblyLinearVelocity
                                elseif magnitude < magnitude2 then
                                    value2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                                        assemblyLinearVelocity.X,
                                        math.min(assemblyLinearVelocity3.Y, assemblyLinearVelocity.Y),
                                        assemblyLinearVelocity.Z
                                    )
                                    pulseAntiAim.leakFix = (pulseAntiAim.leakFix or 0) + 1
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if md then
                    if moveDirection then
                        if value3 then
                            if value3.Parent then
                                if (value3.MoveDirection - md).Magnitude < 0.05 then
                                    value3:Move(moveDirection, false)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                assemblyLinearVelocity, assemblyLinearVelocity2, moveDirection, md, transform, fakeCF =
                    nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
                pulseAntiAim.restores = pulseAntiAim.restores + 1
            end
            local function isActive2()
                if enabled then
                    if not (pcall(handleAction)) then
                        enabled, assemblyLinearVelocity, assemblyLinearVelocity2, moveDirection, md, transform, fakeCF =
                            false, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
                    end
                end
            end
            local function isActive3()
                local value2 = calculatedValue
                if value2 then
                    if not value2.Parent then
                        return false
                    end
                else
                    return false
                end
                for name, item in ipairs(value2:GetChildren()) do
                    name = item.Name
                    if name == "PulseFarmBV" then
                        return true
                    elseif name == "PulseFarmBG" then
                        return true
                    end
                    if item:GetAttribute("PulseMine") then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local function isActive4()
                if os.clock() < (tonumber(getgenv().__pulseShotHold) or 0) then
                    return true
                end
                if os.clock() - (pulseAntiAim.toolAt or 0) < 0.35 then
                    return true
                end
                if getgenv().__pulseFlyActive then
                    return true
                end
                if getgenv().__pulseManualFling then
                    return true
                end
                if getgenv().__pulseTouchFlinging then
                    return true
                end
                if getgenv().__pulseFlingTargetChar then
                    return true
                end
                if settings.autoFlingSheriff then
                    return true
                end
                local pulseInvis = getgenv().__pulseInvis
                if pulseInvis then
                    if pulseInvis.active then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                if (tonumber(getgenv().__pulseBombJumpUntil) or 0) > os.clock() then
                    return true
                end
                if argument[6][argument[5]] then
                    if argument[6][argument[5]].getEnabled then
                        if argument[6][argument[5]].getEnabled() then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
                pulseInvis = enabled2
                return pulseInvis
            end
            local function handleAction(argument3)
                local value2 = isActive()
                if type(value2) ~= "table" then
                    return nil
                end
                local localPlayer2 = value2[localPlayer.Name]
                local calculatedValue6, players =
                    localPlayer2 ~= nil and tostring(localPlayer2.Role) == "Murderer", playersService:GetPlayers()
                local count, count2, count3 = #players
                for index = 1, count, 1 do
                    localPlayer2 = players[index]
                    if localPlayer2 ~= localPlayer then
                        index = value2[localPlayer2.Name]
                        if index then
                            if index.Dead ~= true then
                                if index.Killed ~= true then
                                    local text = tostring(index.Role)
                                    if
                                        if calculatedValue6 then text == "Sheriff" or text == "Hero" else text == "Murderer"
                                    then
                                        local character = localPlayer2.Character
                                        local calculatedValue7 = character
                                            and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                                        if calculatedValue7 then
                                            character = (calculatedValue7.Position - argument3).Magnitude
                                            if count2 then
                                                if character < count2 then
                                                    count2, count3 = character, calculatedValue7
                                                else
                                                end
                                            else
                                                count2, count3 = character, calculatedValue7
                                            end
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                return count3
            end
            local entries2 =
                { a = 0, d = nil, dUntil = 0, flip = 1, md = nil, mdUntil = 0, pauseAt = 0, pauseV = false, coinAt = -10, coinCont = nil }
            local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            local function isActive5()
                return math.random() * 2 - 1
            end
            local function callback4(argument)
                return Vector3.new(
                    math.clamp(argument.X, -32767, 32767),
                    math.clamp(argument.Y, -32767, 32767),
                    math.clamp(argument.Z, -32767, 32767)
                )
            end
            local function callback5(argument, argument3)
                local calculatedValue6 = cfg.dir or "Random"
                if calculatedValue6 == "Underground" then
                    return Vector3.new(isActive5() * argument3 * 0.15, -argument3, isActive5() * argument3 * 0.15)
                elseif calculatedValue6 == "Sky" then
                    return Vector3.new(isActive5() * argument3 * 0.15, argument3, isActive5() * argument3 * 0.15)
                elseif calculatedValue6 == "Spin" then
                    entries2.a = (entries2.a + 0.9 + math.random() * 0.6) % 6.283185307179586
                    return Vector3.new(
                        math.cos(entries2.a) * argument3,
                        isActive5() * argument3 * 0.35,
                        math.sin(entries2.a) * argument3
                    )
                elseif calculatedValue6 == "Jitter" then
                    local d = entries2.d
                    if if d then argument >= entries2.dUntil else not d then
                        local position = Vector3.new(isActive5(), isActive5() * 0.4, isActive5())
                        entries2.d = position.Magnitude > 0.1 and position.Unit or Vector3.xAxis
                        entries2.dUntil = argument + 0.25 + math.random() * 0.25
                    end
                    entries2.flip = -entries2.flip
                    return entries2.d * (argument3 * 1.6 * entries2.flip)
                end
                return Vector3.new(
                    (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * argument3,
                    isActive5() * argument3,
                    (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * argument3
                )
            end
            local function handleAction2(argument, coinAt)
                if coinAt - entries2.coinAt > 1 or not (entries2.coinCont and entries2.coinCont.Parent) then
                    entries2.coinAt = coinAt
                    entries2.coinCont = nil
                    for coinContainer, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                        coinContainer = instance:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
                        if coinContainer then
                            entries2.coinCont = coinContainer
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if entries2.coinCont then
                        overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { entries2.coinCont }
                    end
                end
                if not entries2.coinCont then
                    return false
                end
                return #workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(argument, pulseAntiAim.coinR or 14, overlapParams) > 0

                    entries4.drive = function(k)
                        local rootCF, pulseFCResult, pulseFCResult2 =
                            entries4.links, PulseFC(k, "HumanoidRootPart"), PulseFC(entries4.model, "HumanoidRootPart")
                        if rootCF then

                            local entry = rootCF[relG]
                            local relC, g, g2 = entry.g
                            if relC.motor then
                                g, g2 = relC.j.C0, relC.j.C1
                            else
                                g, g2 = relC.a0.CFrame, relC.a1.CFrame

                            relG = g * relC.j.Transform * g2:Inverse()

                                then CFrame.new(entry.restC.Position + (relG.Position - entry.restG.Position) * k)
                                    * relG.Rotation
                                else entry.pivot0 * relG.Rotation * entry.pivot1

                            entry.relC = relC
                            entry.c.j.Transform = entry.c0inv * relC * entry.c1
                        end
                        k = entries4.lift
                        if #entries4.feet > 0 then
                            local huge, huge2 = math.huge, math.huge
                            for unused, item in ipairs(entries4.feet) do
                                local identity, identity2 = CFrame.identity, CFrame.identity
                                for unused, item2 in ipairs(item.list) do
                                    identity, identity2 = identity * rootCF[item2].relG, identity2 * rootCF[item2].relC
                                end
                                huge, huge2 = (math.min(huge, identity.Y - item.gh)), math.min(huge2, identity2.Y - item.ch)
                            end
                            k = if huge < math.huge then if huge2 < math.huge then huge - huge2 else k else k
                        else
                        end
                        rootCF = pulseFCResult.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, k, 0)
                        pulseFCResult2.CFrame = rootCF
                        entries4.rootCF, entries4.hrpCF = rootCF, pulseFCResult.CFrame

                    entries4.pose = function(calculatedValue2, callback9, argument, argument2)

                            end

                    entries4.corpseStep = function()
                        for key, item in pairs(entries4.corpses) do
                            local parent = key.Parent
                            if if parent then not item.model.Parent else not parent then
                                entries4.corpseFree(item)
                                entries4.corpses[key] = nil
                            else
                                local now = os.clock()
                                if item.dirty ~= false or now - (item.scanAt or 0) > 1 then
                                    item.dirty = false
                                    item.scanAt = now
                                    if not item.watch then
                                        item.watch = key.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
                                            item.dirty = true
                                        end)
                                    end
                                    for unused, item2 in ipairs(key:GetDescendants()) do
                                        if entries4.isA(item2, "BasePart") or entries4.isA(item2, "Decal") then
                                            if item2.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
                                                item2.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1

                                            if not item.seen[item2] then
                                                item.seen[item2] = true
                                                item.hidden[#item.hidden + 1] = item2
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                now = item.map.LowerTorso
                                if not item.done then
                                    entries4.pose(item.links, function(argument)
                                        return item.map[argument.Name]
                                    end, item.joints, item.root)
                                    if now then
                                        if now.Anchored then
                                            if os.clock() - item.t0 > 5 then
                                                item.done = true
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                now = entries4.fadeOf(item.hidden)
                                if now ~= item.fade then
                                    item.fade = now
                                    for unused, item2 in ipairs(item.parts) do
                                        if item2.Parent then
                                            item2.LocalTransparencyModifier = now
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                                        item.m:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or item.m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),

                                        calculatedValue2
                                        and (calculatedValue2.Position - death.pos).Magnitude < 12
                                        and (death.sig == "||" or result and value2 == death.sig)
                                    then
                                        death.done = true
                                        death.corpse = item.m
                                        entries4.adopt(item.m)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        entries4.raggies = raggies
                    end

                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                entries4.grips[key] = nil
                            end

                                return

                        end

                                else not pulseFCResult

                    local deserialResult = entries4.deserial(skin.desc)
                    if deserialResult then
                        if entries4.dress(deserialResult) then
                            if skin.kind == "bundle" then
                                entries4.pub = tonumber(skin.id) and { b = tonumber(skin.id) } or nil
                            else
                                local u = tonumber(skin.uid) or tonumber(skin.id)
                                entries4.pub = u and { u = u } or nil
                            end
                            config.skin = skin
                            save()
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                    if skin.kind == "user" then
                        return entries4.applyUser(skin.id)
                    end
                    if skin.id then
                        return entries4.applyBundle(skin.id)
                    end
                    return false
                end
                entries4.reset = function()
                    entries4.stop()
                    config.skin = nil
                    save()
                    return true, "Skin removed"
                end
                local pulseRemoteSkin = { list = {}, raggies = {}, descs = {}, bound = false }
                getgenv().__pulseRemoteSkin = pulseRemoteSkin
                do
                    local players = game:GetService("Players")
                    local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
                    pulseRemoteSkin.prep = function(pulseRemoteSkin2)
                        for unused, instance in ipairs(pulseRemoteSkin2:GetDescendants()) do
                            if instance:IsA("BaseScript") then
                                instance:Destroy()
                            elseif instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                entries4.ghost(instance)
                            elseif instance:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
                                instance.IsKinematic = true
                            elseif instance:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
                                instance.Enabled = false
                            end
                        end
                        local humanoid = pulseRemoteSkin2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if humanoid then
                            pcall(function()
                                humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                                humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
                                humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
                                humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
                            end)
                        end
                        local rootPart = pulseRemoteSkin2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if rootPart then
                            rootPart.Anchored = true
                            rootPart.Transparency = 1
                        end
                        pulseRemoteSkin2.Name = "PulseRemoteSkin"
                        local function jointsResult(instance)
                            if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                entries4.ghost(instance)
                            end
                        end
                        pulseRemoteSkin2.DescendantAdded:Connect(jointsResult)
                        jointsResult = entries4.joints(pulseRemoteSkin2)
                        local groundResult, entries = entries4.ground(pulseRemoteSkin2, jointsResult), {}
                        for unused, instance in ipairs(pulseRemoteSkin2:GetDescendants()) do
                            if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                if instance.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                                    entries[#entries + 1] = instance
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        return jointsResult, groundResult, entries
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.solid = function(argument)
                        if not argument.model then
                            return
                        end
                        for unused, instance in ipairs(argument.model:GetDescendants()) do
                            if
                                instance:IsA("BasePart") and (instance.CanCollide or instance.CanTouch or instance.CanQuery)
                            then
                                instance.CanCollide = false
                                instance.CanTouch = false
                                instance.CanQuery = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.attach = function(argument, char)
                        argument.char = char
                        argument.links = nil
                        local p0 = entries4.joints(char)
                        local rightHand = entries4.ground(char, p0)
                        if rightHand == nil then
                            return
                        elseif argument.cg == nil then
                            return
                        elseif rightHand <= 0 then
                            return
                        end
                        local links, instance = {}, {}
                        for key, g in pairs(p0) do
                            local c = argument.cj[key]
                            if c then
                                local framesResult, framesResult2 = entries4.frames(g)
                                local framesResult3, c1 = entries4.frames(c)
                                links[#links + 1] = {
                                    g = g,
                                    c = c,
                                    root = g.p0.Name == "HumanoidRootPart",
                                    restG = framesResult * framesResult2:Inverse(),
                                    restC = framesResult3 * c1:Inverse(),
                                    c0inv = framesResult3:Inverse(),
                                    c1 = c1,
                                    pivot0 = CFrame.new(framesResult3.Position),
                                    pivot1 = CFrame.new(c1.Position):Inverse(),
                                }
                                instance[c.p1.Name] = #links
                            end
                        end
                        if #links == 0 then
                            return
                        end
                        argument.k = argument.cg / rightHand
                        argument.lift = argument.cg - rightHand
                        argument.chain = {}
                        for key in pairs(instance) do
                            local entries, calculatedValue2, counter = {}, key, 0
                            while calculatedValue2 and instance[calculatedValue2] and counter < 32 do
                                counter += 1
                                rightHand = instance[calculatedValue2]
                                table.insert(entries, 1, rightHand)
                                p0 = links[rightHand].c.p0
                                calculatedValue2 = p0.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and p0.Name or nil
                                if calculatedValue2 == nil then
                                    argument.chain[key] = entries
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        argument.feet = {}
                        instance = { "LeftFoot", "RightFoot" }
                        for instance2, item in ipairs(instance) do
                            instance2, rightHand = char:FindFirstChild(item), argument.model:FindFirstChild(item)
                            if argument.chain[item] then
                                if instance2 then
                                    if rightHand then
                                        if instance2:IsA("BasePart") then
                                            if rightHand:IsA("BasePart") then
                                                argument.feet[#argument.feet + 1] = {
                                                    list = argument.chain[item],
                                                    gh = instance2.Size.Y / 2,
                                                    ch = rightHand.Size.Y / 2,
                                                }
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        rightHand = argument.model:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
                        instance = rightHand and (rightHand:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment"))
                        argument.modelGrip = instance and instance:IsA("Attachment") and instance.CFrame
                            or (rightHand and CFrame.new(0, -rightHand.Size.Y / 2, 0) or CFrame.identity)
                        argument.links = links
                        if argument.plr then
                            entries4.notify(argument.plr)
                        end
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.drive = function(argument, rootCF)
                        local links, pulseFCResult, pulseFCResult2 =
                            argument.links, PulseFC(rootCF, "HumanoidRootPart"), PulseFC(argument.model, "HumanoidRootPart")
                        if links then
                            if pulseFCResult then
                                if not pulseFCResult2 then
                                    return false
                                end
                            else
                                return false
                            end
                        else
                            return false
                        end
                        local k, now = argument.k, os.clock()
                        rootCF = now - (argument.framesAt or 0) > 1
                        if rootCF then
                            argument.framesAt = now
                        end
                        for relC = 1, #links, 1 do
                            now = links[relC]
                            relC = now.g
                            if rootCF or not now.g0 then
                                local g0, c1
                                if relC.motor then
                                    g0, c1 = relC.j.C0, relC.j.C1
                                else
                                    g0, c1 = relC.a0.CFrame, relC.a1.CFrame
                                end
                                now.g0, now.g1inv = g0, c1:Inverse()
                            end
                            local relG = now.g0 * relC.j.Transform * now.g1inv
                            relC = if now.root
                                then CFrame.new(now.restC.Position + (relG.Position - now.restG.Position) * k) * relG.Rotation
                                else now.pivot0 * relG.Rotation * now.pivot1
                            now.relG = relG
                            now.relC = relC
                            now.c.j.Transform = now.c0inv * relC * now.c1
                        end
                        k = argument.lift
                        if #argument.feet > 0 then
                            local huge, huge2 = math.huge, math.huge
                            for identity, item in ipairs(argument.feet) do
                                identity, rootCF = CFrame.identity, CFrame.identity
                                for unused, item2 in ipairs(item.list) do
                                    identity, rootCF = identity * links[item2].relG, rootCF * links[item2].relC
                                end
                                huge, huge2 = (math.min(huge, identity.Y - item.gh)), math.min(huge2, rootCF.Y - item.ch)
                            end
                            k = if huge < math.huge then if huge2 < math.huge then huge - huge2 else k else k
                        else
                        end
                        rootCF = pulseFCResult.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, k, 0)
                        pulseFCResult2.CFrame = rootCF
                        argument.rootCF, argument.hrpCF = rootCF, pulseFCResult.CFrame
                        return true
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.world = function(argument, argument2, calculatedValue2)
                        local calculatedValue3 = argument.chain and argument.chain[calculatedValue2]
                        if not calculatedValue3 then
                            return nil
                        end
                        calculatedValue2 = argument2 == "model" and argument.rootCF or argument.hrpCF
                        if not calculatedValue2 then
                            return nil
                        end
                        for unused, item in ipairs(calculatedValue3) do
                            calculatedValue2 *= argument2 == "model" and argument.links[item].relC or argument.links[item].relG
                        end
                        return calculatedValue2
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.gripFollow = function(argument, instance)
                        local pulseFCResult = PulseFC(instance, "RightHand")
                        instance = pulseFCResult and PulseFC(pulseFCResult, "RightGrip")
                        for key, item in pairs(argument.grips) do
                            if key ~= instance then
                                if key.Parent then
                                    if item.applied then
                                        local c0, applied = key.C0, item.applied
                                        if c0:FuzzyEq(applied, 0.001) then
                                            pcall(function()
                                                key.C0 = item.c0
                                            end)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                argument.grips[key] = nil
                            end
                        end
                        if instance then
                            if not (instance:IsA("JointInstance")) then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                        pulseFCResult = argument.grips[instance]
                        if
                            if pulseFCResult
                                then not (pulseFCResult.applied and instance.C0:FuzzyEq(pulseFCResult.applied, 0.001))
                                else not pulseFCResult
                        then
                            pulseFCResult = { c0 = instance.C0 }
                            argument.grips[instance] = pulseFCResult
                        else
                        end
                        local worldResult, worldResult2 =
                            pulseRemoteSkin.world(argument, "real", "RightHand"),
                            pulseRemoteSkin.world(argument, "model", "RightHand")
                        if worldResult then
                            if not worldResult2 then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                        local c0 = worldResult:Inverse() * worldResult2 * argument.modelGrip
                        pulseFCResult.applied = c0
                        instance.C0 = c0
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.restoreGrips = function(argument)
                        for key, item in pairs(argument.grips) do
                            if key.Parent then
                                if item.applied then
                                    local c0, applied = key.C0, item.applied
                                    if c0:FuzzyEq(applied, 0.001) then
                                        pcall(function()
                                            key.C0 = item.c0
                                        end)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        argument.grips = {}
                        entries4.restoreMountsOf(argument)
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.collectBody = function(argument, bodyChar)
                        local body = {}
                        for isAResult, item in ipairs(bodyChar:GetChildren()) do
                            isAResult = entries4.isA(item, "Tool")
                            if if isAResult then not isAResult else not item:GetAttribute("PulseVFX") then
                                if entries4.isA(item, "BasePart") then
                                    body[#body + 1] = item
                                elseif entries4.isA(item, "Decal") then
                                    body[#body + 1] = item
                                end
                                for unused, item2 in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if entries4.isA(item2, "BasePart") or entries4.isA(item2, "Decal") then
                                        if not (item2:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")) then
                                            body[#body + 1] = item2
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        argument.body, argument.bodyAt = body, os.clock()
                        argument.bodyDirty = false
                        if argument.bodyChar ~= bodyChar then
                            if argument.bodyConn then
                                pcall(function()
                                    argument.bodyConn:Disconnect()
                                end)
                            end
                            argument.bodyChar = bodyChar
                            argument.bodyConn = bodyChar.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
                                argument.bodyDirty = true
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.hideBody = function(argument, argument2)
                        local now = os.clock()
                        local calculatedValue2 = now - (argument.bodyAt or 0)
                        if
                            argument.char ~= argument2
                            or argument.bodyChar ~= argument2
                            or not argument.body
                            or argument.bodyDirty and calculatedValue2 > 0.2
                        then
                            pulseRemoteSkin.collectBody(argument, argument2)
                        elseif calculatedValue2 > 3 then
                            pulseRemoteSkin.collectBody(argument, argument2)
                        elseif now - (argument.hideAt or 0) < 0.25 then
                            return
                        end
                        argument.hideAt = now
                        for unused, item in ipairs(argument.body) do
                            if item.Parent then
                                if item.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
                                    item.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                                    argument.hidden[item] = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.showBody = function(argument)
                        for key in pairs(argument.hidden) do
                            if key.Parent then
                                pcall(function()
                                    key.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                        argument.hidden = {}
                        argument.body = nil
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.corpseFree = function(argument)
                        if argument.watch then
                            pcall(function()
                                argument.watch:Disconnect()
                            end)
                            argument.watch = nil
                        end
                        if argument.model then
                            pcall(function()
                                argument.model:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                        for unused, item in ipairs(argument.hidden or {}) do
                            if item.Parent then
                                pcall(function()
                                    item.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.adopt = function(argument, argument2)
                        if argument.corpses[argument2] then
                            return
                        elseif argument.model then
                            if not argument.links then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                        local pulseRemoteSkinCorpse = argument.model:Clone()
                        pulseRemoteSkinCorpse.Name = "PulseRemoteSkinCorpse"
                        local entries = {
                            model = pulseRemoteSkinCorpse,
                            map = {},
                            hidden = {},
                            seen = {},
                            fade = -1,
                            links = argument.links,
                            t0 = os.clock(),
                        }
                        for unused, instance in ipairs(argument2:GetChildren()) do
                            if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                entries.map[instance.Name] = instance
                            end
                        end
                        entries.joints = entries4.joints(pulseRemoteSkinCorpse)
                        entries.parts = {}
                        for unused, instance in ipairs(pulseRemoteSkinCorpse:GetDescendants()) do
                            if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                entries4.ghost(instance)
                                if instance.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                                    entries.parts[#entries.parts + 1] = instance
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        entries.root = pulseRemoteSkinCorpse:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        pulseRemoteSkinCorpse.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
                        for unused, instance in ipairs(pulseRemoteSkinCorpse:GetDescendants()) do
                            if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                instance.CanCollide = false
                                instance.CanTouch = false
                                instance.CanQuery = false
                            end
                        end
                        argument.corpses[argument2] = entries
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.corpseStep = function(argument)
                        for key, item in pairs(argument.corpses) do
                            local parent = key.Parent
                            if if parent then not item.model.Parent else not parent then
                                pulseRemoteSkin.corpseFree(item)
                                argument.corpses[key] = nil
                            else
                                local now = os.clock()
                                if item.dirty ~= false or now - (item.scanAt or 0) > 1 then
                                    item.dirty = false
                                    item.scanAt = now
                                    if not item.watch then
                                        item.watch = key.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
                                            item.dirty = true
                                        end)
                                    end
                                    for unused, item2 in ipairs(key:GetDescendants()) do
                                        if entries4.isA(item2, "BasePart") or entries4.isA(item2, "Decal") then
                                            if item2.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
                                                item2.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                                            end
                                            if not item.seen[item2] then
                                                item.seen[item2] = true
                                                item.hidden[#item.hidden + 1] = item2
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                now = item.map.LowerTorso
                                if not item.done then
                                    entries4.pose(item.links, function(argument)
                                        return item.map[argument.Name]
                                    end, item.joints, item.root)
                                    if now then
                                        if now.Anchored then
                                            if os.clock() - item.t0 > 5 then
                                                item.done = true
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                now = entries4.fadeOf(item.hidden)
                                if now ~= item.fade then
                                    item.fade = now
                                    for unused, item2 in ipairs(item.parts) do
                                        if item2.Parent then
                                            item2.LocalTransparencyModifier = now
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.matchDeath = function(argument)
                        local death = argument.death
                        if death then
                            if death.done then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                        if os.clock() - death.t > 4 then
                            death.done = true
                            return
                        end
                        for unused, item in ipairs(pulseRemoteSkin.raggies) do
                            if os.clock() - item.t < 6 then
                                if item.m.Parent then
                                    if not item.taken then
                                        local calculatedValue2, result, value2 =
                                            item.m:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or item.m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
                                            pcall(entries4.sig, item.m)
                                        if
                                            calculatedValue2
                                            and (calculatedValue2.Position - death.pos).Magnitude < 12
                                            and (death.sig == "||" or result and value2 == death.sig)
                                        then
                                            death.done = true
                                            death.corpse = item.m
                                            item.taken = true
                                            pulseRemoteSkin.adopt(argument, item.m)
                                            return
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.watchRaggy = function(m)
                        if m.Name == "Raggy" and m:IsA("Model") then
                            local now, raggies = os.clock(), {}
                            for unused, item in ipairs(pulseRemoteSkin.raggies) do
                                if now - item.t < 6 then
                                    raggies[#raggies + 1] = item
                                end
                            end
                            raggies[#raggies + 1] = { m = m, t = now }
                            pulseRemoteSkin.raggies = raggies
                        end
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.stepOne = function(argument)
                        local localPlayer2 = argument.plr
                        pcall(pulseRemoteSkin.corpseStep, argument)
                        local model = argument.model
                        if not model then
                            return
                        end
                        local ch = localPlayer2.Character
                        local magnitude, parent = ch and PulseFCC(ch, "Humanoid"), workspace.CurrentCamera
                        pcall(pulseRemoteSkin.matchDeath, argument)
                        if
                            ch ~= nil
                            and magnitude ~= nil
                            and ch.Parent ~= nil
                            and magnitude.Health <= 0
                            and argument.char == ch
                            and argument.links ~= nil
                        then
                            localPlayer2 = argument.death
                            if if localPlayer2 then argument.death.ch ~= ch else not localPlayer2 then
                                local calculatedValue2, result, value2 =
                                    ch:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
                                    pcall(entries4.sig, ch)
                                argument.death = {
                                    ch = ch,
                                    t = os.clock(),
                                    pos = calculatedValue2 and calculatedValue2.Position or Vector3.zero,
                                    sig = result and value2 or "||",
                                }
                                pcall(pulseRemoteSkin.matchDeath, argument)
                            end
                            pulseRemoteSkin.restoreGrips(argument)
                            if argument.death.corpse ~= nil and argument.corpses[argument.death.corpse] ~= nil then
                                if model.Parent then
                                    model.Parent = nil
                                end
                            elseif
                                entries4.pose(argument.links, function(argument2)
                                    return argument2
                                end, nil, model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                            then
                                if model.Parent ~= parent then
                                    model.Parent = parent
                                    pulseRemoteSkin.solid(argument)
                                end
                            elseif model.Parent then
                                model.Parent = nil
                            end
                            pulseRemoteSkin.hideBody(argument, ch)
                            local deadFade = entries4.fadeOf(argument.body or {})
                            if deadFade ~= argument.deadFade then
                                argument.deadFade = deadFade
                                for unused, item in ipairs(argument.parts or {}) do
                                    if item.Parent then
                                        item.LocalTransparencyModifier = deadFade
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            return
                        end
                        if not (ch and magnitude and magnitude.Health > 0 and PulseFC(ch, "HumanoidRootPart")) then
                            if model.Parent then
                                model.Parent = nil
                            end
                            pulseRemoteSkin.showBody(argument)
                            pulseRemoteSkin.restoreGrips(argument)
                            argument.char = nil
                            argument.links = nil
                            return
                        end
                        if argument.deadFade then
                            argument.deadFade = nil
                            for unused, item in ipairs(argument.parts or {}) do
                                if item.Parent then
                                    item.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if argument.char ~= ch or argument.links == nil and os.clock() - (argument.attachAt or 0) > 0.5 then
                            argument.attachAt = os.clock()
                            argument.driven = nil
                            pulseRemoteSkin.showBody(argument)
                            pulseRemoteSkin.restoreGrips(argument)
                            pcall(pulseRemoteSkin.attach, argument, ch)
                        end
                        if not argument.links then
                            return
                        end
                        if model.Parent ~= parent then
                            model.Parent = parent
                            argument.driven = nil
                            pulseRemoteSkin.solid(argument)
                        end
                        localPlayer2 = pulseRemoteSkin.view
                        if argument.driven then
                            if localPlayer2.cam then
                                parent = PulseFC(ch, "HumanoidRootPart").Position
                                magnitude = (parent - localPlayer2.eye).Magnitude
                                if magnitude > 12 then
                                    local worldToViewportPointResult = localPlayer2.cam:WorldToViewportPoint(parent)
                                    if worldToViewportPointResult.Z < -6 then
                                        return
                                    elseif worldToViewportPointResult.X < -localPlayer2.mx then
                                        return
                                    elseif worldToViewportPointResult.X > localPlayer2.w + localPlayer2.mx then
                                        return
                                    elseif worldToViewportPointResult.Y < -localPlayer2.my then
                                        return
                                    elseif worldToViewportPointResult.Y > localPlayer2.h + localPlayer2.my then
                                        return
                                    end
                                    if magnitude > 100 then
                                        argument.tick = (argument.tick or 0) + 1
                                        if argument.tick % (magnitude > 250 and 3 or 2) ~= 0 then
                                            return
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if not (pulseRemoteSkin.drive(argument, ch)) then
                            return
                        end
                        argument.driven = true
                        pulseRemoteSkin.hideBody(argument, ch)
                        pcall(pulseRemoteSkin.gripFollow, argument, ch)
                        argument.worldFn = argument.worldFn
                            or function(argument2, argument3)
                                return pulseRemoteSkin.world(argument, argument2, argument3)
                            end
                        pcall(entries4.mountFollowOf, argument, ch, model, argument.worldFn)
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.view = {}
                    pulseRemoteSkin.step = function()
                        local view, cam = pulseRemoteSkin.view, workspace.CurrentCamera
                        view.cam = cam
                        if cam then
                            local viewportSize = cam.ViewportSize
                            view.eye, view.w, view.h, view.mx, view.my =
                                cam.CFrame.Position,
                                viewportSize.X,
                                viewportSize.Y,
                                viewportSize.X * 0.35,
                                viewportSize.Y * 0.35
                        end
                        for unused, item in pairs(pulseRemoteSkin.list) do
                            if not (pcall(pulseRemoteSkin.stepOne, item)) then
                                item.links = nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pulseRemoteSkin.bind = function()
                        local calculatedValue2 = next(pulseRemoteSkin.list) ~= nil
                        if calculatedValue2 and not pulseRemoteSkin.bound then
                            pulseRemoteSkin.bound = true
                            local value2, handleAction =
                                Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value, function()
                                    pcall(pulseRemoteSkin.step)
                                end
                            runService:BindToRenderStep("PulseRSkinStep", value2 + 3, handleAction)
                            pulseRemoteSkin.addConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(pulseRemoteSkin.watchRaggy)
                        elseif calculatedValue2 then
                        elseif pulseRemoteSkin.bound then
                            pulseRemoteSkin.bound = false
                            pcall(function()
                                runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseRSkinStep")

            local function callback5(argument3, argument4)
                local count, entry = #argument3, argument3[1]
                if argument4 <= 0 then
                    return entry.p
                elseif count < 2 then
                    return entry.p
                end

                if argument4 >= entry2.tau then
                    return entry2.p
                end
                local entry3 = argument3[2].tau - entry.tau
                if entry3 > 1.0E-6 then
                    local entry4, entry5 =
                        argument3[math.floor(argument4 / entry3) + 1], argument3[math.floor(argument4 / entry3) + 2]
                    if entry4 then

                            if entry4.tau <= argument4 then
                                if entry5.tau >= argument4 then

                                        entry4.p,

                                    return p:Lerp(p2, calculatedValue)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                for index = 2, count, 1 do
                    if argument3[index].tau >= argument4 then
                        entry, entry3 = argument3[index - 1], argument3[index]
                        local p, p2, calculatedValue =
                            entry.p, entry3.p, (argument4 - entry.tau) / math.max(1.0E-6, entry3.tau - entry.tau)
                        return p:Lerp(p2, calculatedValue)
                    end
                end
                return entry2.p
            end

            local function pick(argument3, argument4)
                local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local calculatedValue, entries = c and c.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), {}
                for hrp, localPlayer2 in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if callback2(localPlayer2, argument4) then
                        c = localPlayer2.Character
                        hrp = c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                        if hrp then
                            local calculatedValue2 = hrp.Position - argument3

                            if dist <= pulseKnifeAim.maxDist then
                                if dist > 0.5 then
