                                        math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(calculatedValue:Dot(calculatedValue2.Unit), -1, 1)))
                                    if pulseKnifeAim.fov >= 360 or degResult <= pulseKnifeAim.fov * 0.5 then
                                        local entry = argument4[localPlayer2.Name]

                                        entry = score:find("sheriff") ~= nil or score:find("hero") ~= nil
                                        score = if pulseKnifeAim.mode == "Crosshair"
                                            then -degResult
                                            else if pulseKnifeAim.mode == "Nearest"
                                                then -dist
                                                else if pulseKnifeAim.mode == "Sheriff"
                                                    then (entry and 1000 or 0) - degResult - dist * 0.05
                                                    else -degResult - dist * 0.12 + (entry and 14 or 0)
                                        score = if pulseKnifeAim.sticky

                                                else score

                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                table.sort(entries, function(argument5, argument6)
                    return argument5.score > argument6.score
                end)
                return entries
            end
            local function callback7(argument3)

            local function callback8(argument3, argument4, argument5, horizon, argument6)
                local now, entries = os.clock(), pulseKnifeAim.hcache[argument4]
                if entries then
                    if not argument6 then
                        if now - entries.at < 0.22 then
                            if entries.horizon >= horizon - 0.05 then
                                return entries
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local k, shift = argument3.k, argument3.shift
                argument3.k = argument3.speedFactor(argument5)
                argument3.shift = argument3.lagOf(argument4)
                local tNow = argument5[#argument5].t
                local success, result = pcall(argument3.hypotheses, argument5, tNow, horizon, argument3.moveParams())
                if success then
                    if type(result) == "table" then
                        if #result > 0 then
                            pcall(function()
                                local lastTrust = argument3.mdTrust and argument3.mdTrust(argument5, tNow) or 1
                                if lastTrust < 0.98 then
                                    local value = result
                                    for unused, item in ipairs(value) do
                                        if
                                            item.kind == "md"
                                            or item.kind == "mdE"
                                            or item.kind == "mdL"
                                            or item.kind == "mdNJ"
                                            or item.kind == "mdv"
                                            or item.kind == "mdJe"
                                            or item.kind == "mdJl"
                                        then
                                            item.w = item.w * math.max(lastTrust, 0.03)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                local calculatedValue = argument3.arc3
                                    and horizon < 1
                                    and (
                                        argument3.mode(argument5) == "nr"
                                        or (argument3.kinVel(argument5, tNow, 0.08) or Vector3.zero).Magnitude > 28
                                    )
                                if calculatedValue then
                                    local traj = argument3.arc3(argument5, tNow, horizon)
                                    if traj then
                                        local value, counter2 = result, 0
                                        for unused, item in ipairs(value) do
                                            counter2 = if item.w > counter2 then item.w else counter2
                                        end
                                        value = result
                                        local calculatedValue2, entries2 = #value + 1, { kind = "arc3" }
                                        entries2.w, entries2.traj, value[calculatedValue2] =
                                            math.max(counter2 * 0.8, 0.15), traj, entries2
                                    end
                                end
                                calculatedValue = argument3.anomaly and argument3.anomaly(argument5, tNow)
                                if calculatedValue then
                                    if argument3.resolverHyps then
                                        local lastTrust2 = argument3.lastTrust
                                        argument3.lastTrust = lastTrust
                                        result = argument3.resolverHyps(argument5, tNow, horizon, result, calculatedValue)
                                        argument3.lastTrust = lastTrust2
                                    end
                                end
                                calculatedValue, lastTrust = result, 0
                                for unused, item in ipairs(calculatedValue) do
                                    lastTrust += item.w
                                end
                                if lastTrust > 0 then
                                    calculatedValue = result
                                    for unused, item in ipairs(calculatedValue) do
                                        item.w = item.w / lastTrust
                                    end
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
                argument3.k = k
                argument3.shift = shift
                if success then
                    if type(result) ~= "table" then
                        return nil
                    elseif #result == 0 then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end
                table.sort(result, function(argument6, argument5)
                    return argument6.w > argument5.w
                end)
                success = argument3.bodyModel(argument4, true)
                entries = { at = now, tNow = tNow, hyps = result, horizon = horizon, body = success and callback7(success)
                    or nil }
                pulseKnifeAim.hcache[argument4] = entries
                return entries
            end
            local function solve(p, argument3, argument4)
                local rootPart = p:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not rootPart then
                    return nil
                end
                local speed = pulseKnifeAim.speed
                local value = isActive9()
                local entry, clampedValue, position =
                    pulseKnifeAim.hist[p], math.clamp(pulseKnifeAim.lead / 100, 0, 3), rootPart.Position
                local function p2(argument5, argument6)
                    if pulseKnifeAim.wall then
                        if callback6(argument3, argument5) then
                            return nil
                        end
                    end
                    return argument5, argument6, (argument5 - argument3).Magnitude / speed
                end
                if not pulseKnifeAim.predict then
                    return p2(position, 0.6)
                end
                if not (value and entry and #entry >= 8) then
                    rootPart = entry and entry[#entry] or callback3(p, nil)
                    if not rootPart then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2, p3 =
                        Vector3.new(rootPart.md.X, 0, rootPart.md.Z) * rootPart.ws,
                        (value and (value.L or 0.15) or isActive10() + 0.1) * clampedValue,
                        rootPart.p
                    for unused = 1, 5, 1 do
                        p3 = rootPart.p + calculatedValue * (calculatedValue2 + (p3 - argument3).Magnitude / speed)
                    end
                    return p2(p3, 0.35)
                end
                rootPart = callback8(
                    value,
                    p,
                    entry,
                    math.clamp((position - argument3).Magnitude / speed + 0.6, 0.7, 2.2),
                    argument4 >= 1
                )
                if not rootPart then
                    return p2(position, 0.3)
                end
                local hyps, body = rootPart.hyps, rootPart.body
                local unit, tausResult =
                    math.clamp(os.clock() - rootPart.tNow, 0, 0.5), value.taus(value.mode(entry), nil, 1)
                p, rootPart =
                    if argument4 >= 1
                        then tausResult
                        else if #tausResult < 5
                            then tausResult
                            else { tausResult[2], tausResult[math.ceil(#tausResult / 2)], tausResult[#tausResult - 1] },
                    0
                for unused, item in ipairs(p) do
                    rootPart += item.w
                end
                if rootPart <= 0 then
                    return p2(position, 0.3)
                end
                local p3, entries = argument4 >= 1 and 8 or 4, {}
                for key, item in ipairs(hyps) do
                    if key > p3 then
                        break
                    end
                    for unused, item2 in ipairs(p) do
                        entries[#entries + 1] = { w = item.w * item2.w / rootPart, traj = item.traj, Ls = item2.tau + unit }
                    end
                end
                local counter2 = 0
                for unused, item in ipairs(entries) do
                    counter2 += item.w
                end
                if counter2 <= 0 then
                    return p2(position, 0.3)
                end
                local entries2 = {}
                local function s(p4, w)
                    for unused, item in ipairs(entries2) do
                        if (item.p - p4).Magnitude < 0.7 then
                            item.w = item.w + w
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    entries2[#entries2 + 1] = { p = p4, w = w }
                end
                tausResult, entry, hyps = 0, 0, 0
                for unused, item in ipairs(entries) do
                    p = callback5(item.traj, item.Ls)
                    for unused = 1, 4, 1 do
                        p = callback5(item.traj, item.Ls + (p - argument3).Magnitude / speed)
                    end
                    item.p = p
                    s(p, item.w)
                    tausResult, entry, hyps = tausResult + p.X * item.w, entry + p.Y * item.w, hyps + p.Z * item.w
                end
                table.sort(entries2, function(argument5, argument6)
                    return argument5.w > argument6.w
                end)
                p2 = argument4 >= 1 and 6 or 3
                while #entries2 > p2 do
                    table.remove(entries2)
                end
                s(Vector3.new(tausResult / counter2, entry / counter2, hyps / counter2), 0.001)
                local function callback2(magnitude)
                    local calculatedValue = magnitude - argument3
                    magnitude = calculatedValue.Magnitude
                    if magnitude < 0.5 then
                        return 0
                    end
                    calculatedValue /= magnitude
                    local counter3 = 0
                    for maximumValue, item in ipairs(entries) do
                        maximumValue = magnitude / speed
                        local value2 = callback5(item.traj, item.Ls + maximumValue)
                        for unused = 1, 2, 1 do
                            maximumValue = math.max(0, (value2 - argument3):Dot(calculatedValue) / speed)
                            value2 = callback5(item.traj, item.Ls + maximumValue)
                        end
                        maximumValue = nil
                        if body then
                            maximumValue = value.hitsBody(
                                body,
                                value2,
                                argument3,
                                calculatedValue,
                                (value2 - argument3).Magnitude + 3
                            ) ~= nil
                        else
                            local calculatedValue2 = value2 - argument3
                            maximumValue = (calculatedValue2 - calculatedValue * math.max(
                                0,
                                calculatedValue2:Dot(calculatedValue)
                            )).Magnitude < 1.9
                        end
                        counter3 = if maximumValue then counter3 + item.w else counter3
                    end
                    return counter3 / counter2
                end
                for unused, item in ipairs(entries2) do
                    item.s = callback2(item.p)
                end
                table.sort(entries2, function(argument5, argument6)
                    if math.abs(argument5.s - argument6.s) > 0.02 then
                        return argument5.s > argument6.s
                    end
                    return argument5.w > argument6.w
                end)
                rootPart = nil
                for unused, item in ipairs(entries2) do
                    if pulseKnifeAim.wall then
                        if not (callback6(argument3, item.p)) then
                            rootPart = item
                            break
                        end
                    else
                        rootPart = item
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not rootPart then
                    return nil
                end
                if argument4 >= 1 then
                    if rootPart.s < 0.9 then
                        unit = rootPart.p - argument3
                        if unit.Magnitude > 1 then
                            unit = unit.Unit
                            tausResult = unit:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
                            tausResult = tausResult.Magnitude > 0.001 and tausResult.Unit or Vector3.xAxis
                            p3, p = tausResult:Cross(unit), ipairs
                            hyps, entry = { tausResult * 0.7, -tausResult * 0.7, p3 * 0.7, -p3 * 0.7 }, rootPart
                            for key, item in p(hyps) do
                                p2 = entry.p + item
                                s = callback2(p2)
                                key, item = s > entry.s + 0.03
                                if key then
                                    local wall = pulseKnifeAim.wall
                                    item = if wall then not callback6(argument3, p2) else not wall
                                else
                                    item = key
                                end
                                entry = if item then { p = p2, s = s, w = entry.w } else entry
                            end
                            rootPart = entry
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                p3 = rootPart.p
                p3 = if clampedValue ~= 1 then position + (p3 - position) * clampedValue else p3
                return p3, rootPart.s, (p3 - argument3).Magnitude / speed
            end
            local function aim()
                if pulseKnifeAim.on then
                    if isActive7() then
                        if not (isActive5()) then
                            return nil
                        end
                    else
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end
                local now = os.clock()
                if pulseKnifeAim.cache then
                    if now - (pulseKnifeAim.cacheT or 0) < 0.035 then
                        return pulseKnifeAim.cache
                    end
                end
                local o = origin()
                if not o then
                    return nil
                end
                local value, now2 = pick(o, isActive6()), os.clock()
                for index = 1, math.min(#value, 4), 1 do
                    local entry = value[index]
                    local cache, curScore = solve(entry.c, o, 1)
                    if cache then
                        pulseKnifeAim.cur = entry.c
                        pulseKnifeAim.curScore = curScore
                        pulseKnifeAim.curPoint = cache
                        pulseKnifeAim.cache = cache
                        pulseKnifeAim.cacheT = now
                        pulseKnifeAim.lastAim = { t = now, O = o, P = cache, c = entry.c, sc = curScore }
                        pulseKnifeAim.lastMs = (os.clock() - now2) * 1000
                        return cache
                    end
                end
                pulseKnifeAim.cur = nil
                return nil
            end
            pulseKnifeAim.aim = aim
            pulseKnifeAim.solve = solve
            pulseKnifeAim.pick = pick
            pulseKnifeAim.origin = origin
            local instance
            local function callback6(l, text)
                local l2 = pulseKnifeAim.show and l and l:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not l2 then
                    if instance then
                        instance.Enabled = false
                    end
                    return
                end
                if not (instance and instance.Parent) then
                    local pulseKnifeTarget = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                    pulseKnifeTarget.Name = "PulseKnifeTarget"
                    pulseKnifeTarget.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 26)
                    pulseKnifeTarget.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0)

            local function pulseDiscordInvite(success)
                local calculatedValue2 = syn and syn.request or http and http.request or http_request or request
                if type(calculatedValue2) ~= "function" then
                    return false
                end
                local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
                local body = httpService:JSONEncode({
                    cmd = "INVITE_BROWSER",
                    args = { code = success },
                    nonce = httpService:GenerateGUID(false),
                })
                for index = 6463, 6472, 1 do
                    httpService, success = pcall(
                        calculatedValue2,
                        {
                            Url = ("http://127.0.0.1:%d/rpc?v=1"):format(index),
                            Method = "POST",
                            Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", Origin = "https://discord.com" },
                            Body = body,
                        }
                    )
                    if httpService then
                        if type(success) == "table" then
                            if tonumber(success.StatusCode) == 200 then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end

                        - 1

                    #gsubResult, gsubResult:sub(-2) == "==" and 2 or (gsubResult:sub(-1) == "=" and 1 or 0)
                local calculatedValue2 = count // 4 * 3 - calculatedValue
                local createResult, counter = buffer.create(math.max(calculatedValue2, 0)), 0
                for index = 1, count - 3, 4 do
                    local byteResult, byteResult2, byteResult3, byteResult4 = string.byte(gsubResult, index, index + 3)
                    calculatedValue = (entries[byteResult] or 0) * 262144
                        + (entries[byteResult2] or 0) * 4096
                        + (entries[byteResult3] or 0) * 64
                        + (entries[byteResult4] or 0)
                    if counter < calculatedValue2 then
                        buffer.writeu8(createResult, counter, calculatedValue // 65536 % 256)
                    end
                    if counter + 1 < calculatedValue2 then
                        buffer.writeu8(createResult, counter + 1, calculatedValue // 256 % 256)
                    end
                    if counter + 2 < calculatedValue2 then
                        buffer.writeu8(createResult, counter + 2, calculatedValue % 256)
                    end
                    counter += 3
                end
                return buffer.tostring(createResult)
            end)

    constructors.createTranslator = function(localization)

                end
            end
            return argument
        end
    end
    
    constructors.createBigIntegerCrypto = function(cryptoLibrary)
        return function()
            local band = bit32.band
            local rshift = bit32.rshift
            local floor = math.floor
            local function callback(argument)
                while #argument > 1 and argument[#argument] == 0 do
                    argument[#argument] = nil
                end
                return argument
            end
            local function fromHex(gsubResult)
                gsubResult = gsubResult:gsub("%s", "")
                gsubResult = if #gsubResult % 4 ~= 0 then string.rep("0", 4 - #gsubResult % 4) .. gsubResult else gsubResult
                local entries = {}
                for index = #gsubResult, 1, -4 do
                    entries[#entries + 1] = tonumber(gsubResult:sub(index - 3, index), 16)
                end
                return callback(entries)
            end
            local function toHex(gsubResult)
                local entries = {}
                for index = #gsubResult, 1, -1 do
                    entries[#entries + 1] = string.format("%04x", gsubResult[index])
                end
                gsubResult = table.concat(entries):gsub("^0+", "")
                return gsubResult == "" and "0" or gsubResult
            end
            local function callback2(argument, argument2)
                if #argument ~= #argument2 then
                    return #argument > #argument2 and 1 or -1
                end
                for index = #argument, 1, -1 do
                    if argument[index] ~= argument2[index] then
                        return argument[index] > argument2[index] and 1 or -1
                    end
                end
                return 0
            end
            local function callback3(argument, argument2)
                local entries = {}
                for index = 1, #argument + #argument2, 1 do
                    entries[index] = 0
                end
                for index = 1, #argument, 1 do
                    local counter, entry = 0, argument[index]
                    if entry ~= 0 then
                        for index2 = 1, #argument2, 1 do
                            local calculatedValue = entries[index + index2 - 1] + entry * argument2[index2] + counter
                            entries[index + index2 - 1] = band(calculatedValue, 65535)
                            counter = floor(calculatedValue / 65536)
                        end
                        local calculatedValue
                        calculatedValue = index + #argument2
                        while counter > 0 do
                            local calculatedValue2 = entries[calculatedValue] + counter
                            entries[calculatedValue] = band(calculatedValue2, 65535)
                            counter, calculatedValue = (floor(calculatedValue2 / 65536)), calculatedValue + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
                return callback(entries)
            end
            local function callback4(argument)
                local entries, counter = {}, 0
                for index = 1, #argument, 1 do
                    local calculatedValue = argument[index] * 2 + counter
                    entries[index] = band(calculatedValue, 65535)
                    counter = (rshift(calculatedValue, 16))
                end
                if counter > 0 then
                    entries[#entries + 1] = counter
                end
                return entries
            end
            local function callback5(argument, argument2)
                local entries, counter = {}, 0
                for index = 1, #argument, 1 do
                    local calculatedValue = argument[index] - counter - (argument2[index] or 0)
                    if calculatedValue < 0 then
                        counter, calculatedValue = 1, calculatedValue + 65536
                    else
                        counter = 0
                    end
                    entries[index] = calculatedValue
                end
                return callback(entries)
            end
            local function callback6(argument, argument2)
                if callback2(argument, argument2) < 0 then
                    local entries = {}
                    for index = 1, #argument, 1 do
                        entries[index] = argument[index]
                    end
                    return entries
                end
                local entries, counter = { 0 }, 0
                for index = #argument * 16 - 1, 0, -1 do
                    entries = callback4(entries)
                    if band(rshift(argument[floor(index / 16) + 1] or 0, index % 16), 1) == 1 then
                        entries[1] = entries[1] + 1
                    end
                    callback(entries)
                    entries = if callback2(entries, argument2) >= 0 then callback5(entries, argument2) else entries
                    counter += 1
                    if counter >= 200 then
                        if coroutine.isyieldable() then
                            task.wait()
                        end
                        counter = 0
                    else
                    end
                end
                return entries
            end
            local function slowModexp(argument, argument2, argument3)
                local value = -1
                for index = 0, #argument2 * 16 - 1, 1 do
                    value = if band(rshift(argument2[floor(index / 16) + 1] or 0, index % 16), 1) == 1 then index else value
                end
                local entries = { 1 }
                if value < 0 then
                    return entries
                end
                local value2 = (callback6(argument, argument3))
                for index = 0, value, 1 do
                    entries, value2 =
                        if band(rshift(argument2[floor(index / 16) + 1] or 0, index % 16), 1) == 1
                            then callback6(callback3(entries, value2), argument3)
                            else entries,
                        if index < value then callback6(callback3(value2, value2), argument3) else value2
                end
                return entries
            end
            local function callback7(argument, argument2, argument3, argument4, argument5)
                local entries = {}
                for index = 1, argument4 + 2, 1 do
                    entries[index] = 0
                end
                for index = 1, argument4, 1 do
                    local calculatedValue, counter = argument[index] or 0, 0
                    for index2 = 1, argument4, 1 do
                        index = entries[index2] + calculatedValue * (argument2[index2] or 0) + counter
                        counter = floor(index / 65536)
                        entries[index2] = index - counter * 65536
                    end
                    calculatedValue = entries[argument4 + 1] + counter
                    counter = floor(calculatedValue / 65536)
                    entries[argument4 + 1] = calculatedValue - counter * 65536
                    entries[argument4 + 2] = entries[argument4 + 2] + counter
                    index = entries[1] * argument5 % 65536
                    counter = floor((entries[1] + index * argument3[1]) / 65536)
                    for index2 = 2, argument4, 1 do
                        calculatedValue = entries[index2] + index * argument3[index2] + counter
                        counter = floor(calculatedValue / 65536)
                        entries[index2 - 1] = calculatedValue - counter * 65536
                    end
                    calculatedValue = entries[argument4 + 1] + counter
                    counter = floor(calculatedValue / 65536)
                    entries[argument4] = calculatedValue - counter * 65536
                    entries[argument4 + 1] = entries[argument4 + 2] + counter
                    entries[argument4 + 2] = 0
                end
                entries[argument4 + 2] = nil
                callback(entries)
                return if callback2(entries, argument3) >= 0 then callback5(entries, argument3) else entries
            end
            local function modexp(argument, argument2, argument3)
                if #argument3 < 2 then
                    return slowModexp(argument, argument2, argument3)
                elseif argument3[1] % 2 == 0 then
                    return slowModexp(argument, argument2, argument3)
                end
                local value = -1
                for index = 0, #argument2 * 16 - 1, 1 do
                    value = if band(rshift(argument2[floor(index / 16) + 1] or 0, index % 16), 1) == 1 then index else value
                end
                if value < 0 then
                    return { 1 }
                end
                local count, calculatedValue = #argument3, 1
                for unused = 1, 5, 1 do
                    calculatedValue = calculatedValue * (2 - argument3[1] * calculatedValue % 65536) % 65536
                end
                local calculatedValue2, entries, counter = (65536 - calculatedValue) % 65536, { 1 }, 0
                for unused = 1, 32 * count, 1 do
                    entries = callback4(entries)
                    entries = if callback2(entries, argument3) >= 0 then callback5(entries, argument3) else entries
                    counter += 1
                    if counter >= 1024 then
                        if coroutine.isyieldable() then
                            task.wait()
                        end
                        counter = 0
                    else
                    end
                end
                local value2, value3 =
                    callback7(
                        callback2(argument, argument3) >= 0 and callback6(argument, argument3) or argument,
                        entries,
                        argument3,
                        count,
                        calculatedValue2
                    ),
                    callback7({ 1 }, entries, argument3, count, calculatedValue2)
                for index = value, 0, -1 do
                    value3 = callback7(value3, value3, argument3, count, calculatedValue2)
                    value3 = if band(rshift(argument2[floor(index / 16) + 1] or 0, index % 16), 1) == 1
                        then callback7(value3, value2, argument3, count, calculatedValue2)
                        else value3
                end
                return callback7(value3, { 1 }, argument3, count, calculatedValue2)
            end
            local function callback(argument, entries)
                local calculatedValue = entries - #argument - 3
                if calculatedValue < 8 then
                    return nil
                end
                entries = {}
                for index = 1, calculatedValue, 1 do
                    local randomResult = math.random(1, 255)
                    entries[index] = string.char(randomResult)
                end
                return "\000\002" .. table.concat(entries) .. "\000" .. argument
            end
            cryptoLibrary.encrypt = function(argument, argument2, argument3)
                local value, value2, value3 = fromHex(argument2), fromHex(argument3), floor(#argument2 / 2)
                argument3 = callback(argument, value3)
                if not argument3 then
                    return nil, ""
                end
                argument = toHex((modexp(
                    fromHex((argument3:gsub(".", function(argument4)
                        return string.format("%02x", argument4:byte())
                    end))),
                    value2,
                    value
                )))
                argument = if #argument % 2 == 1 then "0" .. argument else argument
                local function handleAction(argument4)
                    return string.char(tonumber(argument4, 16))
                end
                return ((string.rep("0", value3 * 2 - #argument) .. argument):gsub("%x%x", handleAction))
            end
            cryptoLibrary._fromHex = fromHex
            cryptoLibrary._toHex = toHex
            cryptoLibrary._modexp = modexp
            cryptoLibrary._slowModexp = slowModexp
        end
    end

            local function placeKnob(argument4)
                local size = entries4[pulseChat.chan]
                if not size then
                    return
                end
                local position = isActive3()
                local calculatedValue2 = size.b.AbsoluteSize.X / position
                if calculatedValue2 < 4 then
                    return
                end
                local calculatedValue3 = (size.b.AbsolutePosition.X - value7.AbsolutePosition.X) / position
                position, size =
                    UDim2.new(0, math.floor(calculatedValue3 + 0.5), 0.5, 0),
                    UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(calculatedValue2 + 0.5), 26)
                if argument4 then
                    tweenInstance(
                        value6,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        { Position = position, Size = size }
                    )
                else
                    value6.Position = position
                    value6.Size = size
                end
            end

                        calculatedValue3 = (calculatedValue3 * 33 + string.byte(url, index)) % 4294967296
                    end

                        end

                            break
                        end

                                pulseChat.unread = 0
                                pulseChat.badge()
                            end
                        end
                        task.wait(0.1)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

    constructors.createDuelTracker = function(argument, argument2, connectSignal, isActive, isActive2, playersService, callback)
        return function()
            local duelState = { on = false, mates = {}, foes = {}, at = 0, cur = nil }
            getgenv().__pulseDuel = duelState
            local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
            local function apply(argument3)
                if type(argument3) ~= "table" then
                    return
                end
                local callback2, entries, mine = ipairs, { "Team1", "Team2" }
                for unused, item in callback2(entries) do
                    mine = if type(argument3[item]) == "table"
                        then if argument3[item][argument.Name] ~= nil then item else mine
                        else mine
                end
                local mates, foes, callback3, entries = {}, {}, ipairs, { "Team1", "Team2" }
                for callback4, item in callback3(entries) do
                    if type(argument3[item]) == "table" then
                        callback4, callback2 = pairs, argument3[item]
                        for key in callback4(callback2) do
                            if key ~= argument.Name then
                                if mine then
                                    if item == mine then
                                        mates[key] = true
                                    else
                                        foes[key] = true
                                    end
                                else
                                    foes[key] = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                duelState.mates, duelState.foes, duelState.mine, duelState.at = mates, foes, mine, os.clock()
                duelState.cur = nil
                duelState.on = next(foes) ~= nil
            end
            local function stop()

            duelState.pick = function(callback3)
                if not duelState.on then
                    return nil
                end
                local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not camera then
                    return nil
                end
                local position, lookVector = camera.CFrame.Position, camera.CFrame.LookVector
                if userInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
                    local success, result = pcall(function()
                        local getMouseLocationResult = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                        return camera:ViewportPointToRay(getMouseLocationResult.X, getMouseLocationResult.Y)
                    end)
                    if success then
                        if result then
                            local origin, unit = result.Origin, result.Direction.Unit
                            position, lookVector = origin, unit
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                local callback2, ipairs2, ipairs3, cur, ipairs4 = ipairs
                for aliveResult, item in callback2(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
                    if duelState.isFoe(item) then
                        aliveResult = duelState.alive(item)
                        if aliveResult and (if callback3 then callback3(aliveResult) else not callback3) then
                            local calculatedValue = aliveResult.HumanoidRootPart.Position - position
                            local magnitude = calculatedValue.Magnitude
                            if magnitude > 0.01 then
                                local calculatedValue2 = math.acos(
                                    math.clamp(lookVector:Dot(calculatedValue / magnitude), -1, 1)
                                ) + magnitude * 5.0E-4
                                ipairs2 = if item == duelState.cur then calculatedValue2 else ipairs2
                                if ipairs3 then
                                    if calculatedValue2 < ipairs3 then
                                        ipairs3, cur, ipairs4 = calculatedValue2, item, aliveResult
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                    ipairs3, cur, ipairs4 = calculatedValue2, item, aliveResult
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if duelState.cur then
                    if ipairs2 then
                        if cur ~= duelState.cur then
                            if ipairs3 > ipairs2 - (duelState.stick or 0.06) then
                                return duelState.cur, duelState.cur.Character
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not callback3 then
                    duelState.cur = cur
                end
                return cur, ipairs4
            end
        end
    end

                local function find(argument, argument3)
                    if not (callback4(argument, argument3)) then
                        return { argument, argument3 }, "direct"
                    end
                    local calculatedValue = argument3 - argument
                    local unit = calculatedValue.Unit
                    local crossResult = unit:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
                    crossResult = crossResult.Magnitude < 0.1 and Vector3.xAxis or crossResult.Unit
                    local unit2 = crossResult:Cross(unit).Unit

                        { unit2, crossResult, -crossResult, (unit2 + crossResult).Unit, (unit2 - crossResult).Unit, -unit2 }
                    for key, item in ipairs(entries3) do
                        for key2, item2 in ipairs(entries4) do
                            key2 = argument + calculatedValue * item2
                            for key3, item3 in ipairs(entries5) do
                                key = key2 + item3 * item
                                key3 = (key - argument).Magnitude + (argument3 - key).Magnitude
                                if if entries6 then key3 < entries6 else not entries6 then
                                    if callback4(argument, key) then
                                    else
                                        if callback4(key, argument3) then
                                        else
                                            entries6, entries7 = key3, key
                                        end
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if entries7 then
                            return { argument, entries7, argument3 }, "one"
                        end
                    end
                    unit2, calculatedValue = callback4(argument, argument3), callback4(argument3, argument)
                    if unit2 and calculatedValue then
                        local entries8, entries4 = {}, {}
                        for unused, item in ipairs(entries3) do
                            for key, item2 in ipairs(entries5) do
                                key = unit2.Position - unit * 1.5 + item2 * item
                                if not (callback4(argument, key)) then
                                    entries8[#entries8 + 1] = key
                                end
                                key = calculatedValue.Position + unit * 1.5 + item2 * item
                                if not (callback4(key, argument3)) then
                                    entries4[#entries4 + 1] = key
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        local counter, entries3 = 0
                        for key, item in ipairs(entries8) do
                            for unused, item2 in ipairs(entries4) do
                                key = (item - argument).Magnitude + (item2 - item).Magnitude + (argument3 - item2).Magnitude
                                if if entries6 then key < entries6 else not entries6 then
                                    counter += 1
                                    if counter > 500 then
                                        break
                                    end
                                    if callback4(item, item2) then
                                    else
                                        entries6, entries3 = key, { item, item2 }
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            end
                            if counter > 500 then
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if entries3 then

                end

                local function handleAction3()
                    local now = os.clock()
                    for index = #knife.live, 1, -1 do
                        local entry = knife.live[index]
                        local success = pcall(function()
                            local kBlade = entry.kBlade
                            if kBlade then
                                if kBlade.Parent then
                                    local kLast = (kBlade.Position - entry.kOrigin):Dot(entry.kDir)
                                    if kLast > entry.kLast then
                                        entry.kLast = kLast
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 =
                                entry.kObj.Parent ~= nil and (kBlade == nil or kBlade.Parent ~= nil), now - entry.t0
                            if calculatedValue then
                                if calculatedValue2 > 8 then

                                elseif entry.landed then
                                    if entry.L < 599 then
                                        if calculatedValue2 > entry.L / entry.speed + 0.4 then
                                            entry.pts[#entry.pts] = entry.kOrigin + entry.kDir * 600
                                            entry.cum[#entry.cum] = 600
                                            entry.L = 600
                                            entry.landed = false
                                            entry.impact = false
                                            if entry.trail then
                                                entry.trail.Rate = 70
                                            end
                                            callback8("EXTEND")
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                callback12(entry, math.max(entry.kLast + 0.6, 0.5))
                            end
                        end)
                        if if success then entry.kDone else not success then
                            table.remove(knife.live, index)
                        end
                    end
                end

            pulseCfgHub.paintPill = function(argument, argument2, calculatedValue3, argument4)
                calculatedValue3 = tonumber(argument4.v) or 0
                if calculatedValue3 > 0 then
                    argument.Text = string.format("%.1f", tonumber(argument4.r) or 0)
                    argument2.Text = callback7(calculatedValue3)
                    argument2.Visible = true
                else
                    argument.Text = callback3("No votes")
                    argument2.Visible = false
                end
            end
            pulseCfgHub.paintCard = function(argument)
                local item = argument.item
                if not item then
                    return
                end
                argument.title.Text = tostring(item.t or "")
                if argument.uid ~= item.u then
                    argument.uid = item.u
                    argument.av.Image = callback8(item.u)
                end
                pulseCfgHub.paintPill(argument.pVal, argument.pCnt, argument.pill, item)
                local text, text2 = tostring(item.n or ""), tostring(item.dn or "")
                argument.author.Text = text2 ~= "" and text2 or "@" .. text
                argument.age.Text = callback6(item.c)
                argument.dls.Text = callback7(item.dl)
                if item.st == 3 then
                    argument.state.set("Hidden")
                    paint(argument.state.c, "BackgroundColor3", "Danger", tweenInfo)
                    paint(argument.state.l, "TextColor3", "Danger", tweenInfo)
                elseif item.p == 1 then
                    argument.state.set("Pinned")
                    paint(argument.state.c, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent", tweenInfo)
                    paint(argument.state.l, "TextColor3", "Accent", tweenInfo)
                else
                    argument.state.set(nil)
                end
                text2 = type(item.g) == "table" and item.g or {}
                for key, item2 in ipairs(argument.tags) do
                    item2.set(text2[key] and tostring(text2[key]) or nil)
                end
                text2 = pulseCfgHub.favs[item.id] == true
                paint(argument.favI, "ImageColor3", text2 and "Warning" or "Muted", "Quick")
                paint(argument.fav, "BackgroundColor3", text2 and "Elevated" or "Surface", "Quick")
                argument.get.Visible = not item.own
                argument.getL.Text = callback3(item.got and "Got" or "Get")
                pcall(novaUI.Icons.apply, argument.getI, item.got and "check" or "download")
            end
            pulseCfgHub.toggleFav = function(argument)
                if pulseCfgHub.favs[argument.id] then
                    pulseCfgHub.favs[argument.id] = nil
                else
                    pulseCfgHub.favs[argument.id] = true
                end
                pulseCfgHub.saveFavs()
                if pulseCfgHub.view == "saved" then
                    if not pulseCfgHub.favs[argument.id] then
                        task.defer(pulseCfgHub.render)
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseCfgHub.render = function()
                local items = pulseCfgHub.items
                for layoutOrder, item in ipairs(items) do
                    local makeCardResult = pulseCfgHub.cards[layoutOrder]
                    if makeCardResult then
                    else
                        makeCardResult = pulseCfgHub.makeCard()
                        pulseCfgHub.cards[layoutOrder] = makeCardResult
                    end
                    makeCardResult.item = item
                    makeCardResult.card.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
                    makeCardResult.card.Visible = not (pulseCfgHub.view == "saved" and not pulseCfgHub.favs[item.id])
                    pulseCfgHub.paintCard(makeCardResult)
                end
                for index = #items + 1, #pulseCfgHub.cards, 1 do
                    pulseCfgHub.cards[index].card.Visible = false
                    pulseCfgHub.cards[index].item = nil
                end
                entries4.moreB.Visible = pulseCfgHub.more and pulseCfgHub.view == "all"
                local counter4 = 0
                for index = 1, #items, 1 do
                    counter4 = if pulseCfgHub.cards[index].card.Visible then counter4 + 1 else counter4
                end
                entries4.search.PlaceholderText = (pulseCfgHub.all or 0) > 0
                        and string.format(callback3("Search configs  ·  %d"), pulseCfgHub.all)
                    or callback3("Search configs or players")
                entries4.mineL.Text =
                    string.format(callback3("Published %d/%d"), pulseCfgHub.mineCount, pulseCfgHub.maxLive)
                for key, item in ipairs(entries4.mineDots) do
                    paint(item, "BackgroundColor3", key <= pulseCfgHub.mineCount and "Accent" or "Elevated", "Quick")
                end
                local empty, loading = entries4.empty, pulseCfgHub.loading
                empty.Visible = if loading then not loading else counter4 == 0
                if entries4.empty.Visible then
                    empty = pulseCfgHub.err and "No connection"
                        or pulseCfgHub.view == "saved" and "No saved configs"
                        or pulseCfgHub.view == "mine" and "No published configs"
                        or pulseCfgHub.q ~= "" and "Nothing found"
                        or "No configs yet"
                    entries4.eText.Text = callback3(empty)
                    local ePub, err = entries4.ePub, pulseCfgHub.err
                    ePub.Visible = if err then not err else pulseCfgHub.view == "mine"
                    local callback, apply, eIcon, calculatedValue3 =
                        pcall,
                        novaUI.Icons.apply,
                        entries4.eIcon,
                        pulseCfgHub.view == "saved" and "star"
                            or (pulseCfgHub.view == "mine" and "upload" or (pulseCfgHub.q ~= "" and "search" or "library"))
                    callback(apply, eIcon, calculatedValue3)
                end
                if pulseCfgHub.loading then
                    if #items == 0 then
                        entries4.empty.Visible = true
                        entries4.ePub.Visible = false
                        entries4.eText.Text = callback3("Loading")
                        pcall(novaUI.Icons.apply, entries4.eIcon, "refresh-cw")
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseCfgHub.load = function(argument)
                pulseCfgHub.gen = pulseCfgHub.gen + 1
                local gen = pulseCfgHub.gen
                if argument then
                    pulseCfgHub.page = 0
                    pulseCfgHub.items = {}
                end
                pulseCfgHub.loading = true
                pulseCfgHub.err = nil
                pulseCfgHub.loadedAt = os.clock()
                pcall(pulseCfgHub.render)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local apiResult, apiResult2
                    if pulseCfgHub.view == "mine" then
                        apiResult, apiResult2 = pulseCfgHub.api("mine", {})
                    else
                        if pulseCfgHub.view == "saved" then
                            local ids = {}
                            for key in pairs(pulseCfgHub.favs) do
                                ids[#ids + 1] = key
                            end
                            apiResult, apiResult2 = pulseCfgHub.api("list", { ids = ids, sort = pulseCfgHub.sort })
                        else
                            apiResult, apiResult2 = pulseCfgHub.api(
                                "list",
                                { q = pulseCfgHub.q, sort = pulseCfgHub.sort, page = pulseCfgHub.page }
                            )
                        end
                    end
                    if gen ~= pulseCfgHub.gen then
                        return
                    end
                    pulseCfgHub.loading = false
                    if not apiResult then
                        pulseCfgHub.err = apiResult2 or "net"
                        pcall(pulseCfgHub.render)
                        if pulseCfgHub.page > 0 then
                            callback5(callback4(apiResult2), nil, "danger")
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    pulseCfgHub.mod = apiResult.mod == true or pulseCfgHub.mod
                    pulseCfgHub.owner = apiResult.owner == true or pulseCfgHub.owner
                    apiResult2 = type(apiResult.items) == "table" and apiResult.items or {}
                    if pulseCfgHub.view == "mine" then
                        pulseCfgHub.maxLive = tonumber(apiResult.max) or pulseCfgHub.maxLive
                        local mineCount = 0
                        for unused, item in ipairs(apiResult2) do
                            mineCount = if item.st == 0
                                then mineCount + 1
                                else if item.st == 3 then mineCount + 1 else mineCount
                        end
                        pulseCfgHub.mineCount = mineCount
                    end
                    if pulseCfgHub.view == "saved" then
                        local entries5 = {}
                        for unused, item in ipairs(apiResult2) do
                            entries5[item.id] = true
                        end
                        local enabled = false
                        for key in pairs(pulseCfgHub.favs) do
                            if entries5[key] then
                            else
                                pulseCfgHub.favs[key] = nil
                                enabled = true
                            end
                        end
                        if enabled then
                            pulseCfgHub.saveFavs()
                        end
                    end
                    for unused, item in ipairs(apiResult2) do
                        table.insert(pulseCfgHub.items, item)
                    end
                    pulseCfgHub.more = apiResult.more == true
                    pulseCfgHub.total = tonumber(apiResult.total) or #pulseCfgHub.items
                    if apiResult.all ~= nil then
                        pulseCfgHub.all = tonumber(apiResult.all) or pulseCfgHub.all
                    end
                    pcall(pulseCfgHub.render)
                end)
            end
            pulseCfgHub.setView = function(view, argument)
                pulseCfgHub.view = view
                for key, item in pairs(entries4.segBtns) do
                    local calculatedValue3, b2, entries5 = key == view, item.b, {}
                    entries5.BackgroundTransparency = calculatedValue3 and 0 or 1
                    tweenInstance(b2, "Quick", entries5)
                    paint(item.lb, "TextColor3", calculatedValue3 and "Text" or "Muted", "Quick")

            entries6.paintDetail = function()
                local detail = pulseCfgHub.detail
                if not detail then
                    return
                end
                entries6.dTitle.Text = tostring(detail.t or "")
                local own, aRep = tostring(detail.dn or ""), tostring(detail.n or "")
                entries6.dAuthor.Text = own ~= "" and own ~= aRep and own .. "  ·  @" .. aRep or "@" .. aRep
                if entries6.dAvUid ~= detail.u then
                    entries6.dAvUid = detail.u
                    entries6.dAv.Image = callback8(detail.u)
                end
                own = tonumber(detail.v) or 0
                entries6.tRate.v.Text = own > 0 and string.format("%.1f", tonumber(detail.r) or 0) or "—"
                entries6.tRate.l.Text = callback7(own) .. " " .. callback3("votes")
                entries6.tDl.v.Text = callback7(detail.dl)
                entries6.tDl.l.Text = callback3("downloads")
                entries6.tAge.v.Text = callback6(detail.c)
                entries6.tAge.l.Text = callback3("published")
                entries6.dDesc.Text = tostring(detail.d or "")
                entries6.dDescBox.Visible = entries6.dDesc.Text ~= ""
                aRep = type(detail.g) == "table" and detail.g or {}
                for key, item in ipairs(entries6.dTags) do
                    item.set(aRep[key] and tostring(aRep[key]) or nil)
                end
                entries6.dTagsRow.Visible = #aRep > 0
                if detail.own then
                    entries6.rateState.Text = callback3("Your config")
                elseif detail.od then
                    entries6.rateState.Text = callback3("Published from this device")
                elseif detail.got then
                    aRep = tonumber(detail.my)
                    if aRep then
                        if aRep > 0 then
                            entries6.rateState.Text = string.format(callback3("Your rating: %d"), tonumber(detail.my))
                        else
                            entries6.rateState.Text = ""
                        end
                    else
                        entries6.rateState.Text = ""
                    end
                else
                    entries6.rateState.Text = callback3("Download to rate")
                end
                entries6.paintRate(nil)
                entries6.aGet.Visible = not detail.own
                entries6.aApply.Size = detail.own and UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0)
                entries6.aGetL.Text = callback3(detail.got and "Downloaded" or "Download")
                pcall(novaUI.Icons.apply, entries6.aGetI, detail.got and "check" or "download")
                aRep, own = entries6.aRep, detail.own
                aRep.Visible = if own then not own else not detail.od
                entries6.aDel.Visible = detail.own or pulseCfgHub.mod
                entries6.aBan.Visible = pulseCfgHub.mod and not detail.own
                entries6.aPin.Visible = pulseCfgHub.owner == true and detail.st == 0
                entries6.aPinL.Text = callback3(detail.p == 1 and "Unpin" or "Pin")
                pcall(novaUI.Icons.apply, entries6.aPinI, detail.p == 1 and "pin-off" or "pin")

                entries6.aFavL.Text = callback3(own and "In saved" or "Add to saved")
                paint(entries6.dFavI, "ImageColor3", own and "Warning" or "Muted", "Quick")
            end

            pulseCfgHub.findCard = function(argument)
                for unused, item in ipairs(pulseCfgHub.cards) do
                    if item.item then
                        if item.item.id == argument then
                            return item
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseCfgHub.merge = function(argument, findCardResult)
                if type(findCardResult) ~= "table" then
                    return
                end
                for key, item in pairs(findCardResult) do
                    argument[key] = item
                end
                findCardResult = pulseCfgHub.findCard(argument.id)
                if findCardResult then
                    pulseCfgHub.paintCard(findCardResult)
                end
                if pulseCfgHub.detail == argument then
                    entries6.paintDetail()
                end
            end
            pulseCfgHub.download = function(applyDataResult, argument)
                local apiResult, data = pulseCfgHub.api("get", { id = applyDataResult.id })
                if not apiResult then
                    callback5(callback4(data), nil, "danger")
                    return
                end
                pulseCfgHub.merge(applyDataResult, apiResult.item)
                data = apiResult.data
                if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.s) ~= "table" then
                    callback5(callback4("data"), nil, "danger")
                    return
                end
                local localApi = argument3.localApi
                local calculatedValue3 = localApi
                        and localApi.add(
                            tostring(applyDataResult.t or "Config"),
                            data,
                            apiResult.key ~= "" and apiResult.key or nil
                        )
                    or tostring(applyDataResult.t)
                if argument then

                    music.hidden[song] = nil
                    music.song = song

                    value11.Text = ""
                    isActive3()
                    isActive10()
                    return
                end
                local gsubResult = callback11(song)
                if gsubResult then
                    music.song = song
                    value10.Text = ""
                    value11.Text = ""
                    isActive7()
                    isActive10()
                    callback7("Already in the list", callback10(gsubResult), "warning")
                    return
                end
                gsubResult = tostring(value11.Text):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                if gsubResult == "" then
                    local matchResult = text:match("/%d%d%d%d%d+/([^/%?#]+)")
                    gsubResult = if matchResult then (matchResult:gsub("[%-_]+", " ")) else gsubResult
                else
                end

                local calculatedValue, entries4 = #custom2 + 1, { id = song }

                value10.Text = ""

    constructors.createBase64Decoder = function(base64Lookup)
        return function(gsubResult)
            gsubResult = gsubResult:gsub("[^%w%+%/%=]", "")
            local byte, char, floor, concat, entries, entries2, count, counter, counter2, counter3, calculatedValue, counter4 =
                string.byte, string.char, math.floor, table.concat, {}, {}, #gsubResult, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0
            while counter <= count do
                local enabled = false
                if counter2 == 0 then
                    if counter + 3 <= count then
                        local calculatedValue2, calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, enabled2 =
                            byte(gsubResult, counter, counter + 3)
                        local entry, entry2, entry3, entry4 =
                            base64Lookup[calculatedValue2],
                            base64Lookup[calculatedValue3],
                            base64Lookup[calculatedValue4],
                            base64Lookup[enabled2]
                        if entry then
                            if entry2 then
                                if entry3 then
                                    if entry4 then
                                        calculatedValue2, calculatedValue4 =
                                            ((entry * 64 + entry2) * 64 + entry3) * 64 + entry4, counter3 + 1
                                        entries2[calculatedValue4] = char(
                                            floor(calculatedValue2 / 65536),
                                            floor(calculatedValue2 / 256) % 256,
                                            calculatedValue2 % 256
                                        )
                                        calculatedValue3, enabled2 = counter + 4, true
                                        enabled, counter, counter3 = enabled2, calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                if enabled then
                else
                    local entry = base64Lookup[byte(gsubResult, counter)]
                    counter += 1
                    if entry then
                        calculatedValue = calculatedValue * 64 + entry
                        counter2 += 6
                        if counter2 >= 8 then
                            counter2 -= 8
                            local calculatedValue2 = counter2 == 4 and 16 or (counter2 == 2 and 4 or 1)
                            counter3 += 1
                            entries2[counter3] = char(floor(calculatedValue / calculatedValue2))
                            calculatedValue = calculatedValue % calculatedValue2
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if counter3 >= 512 then
                    counter4 += 1
                    entries[counter4] = concat(entries2, "", 1, counter3)
                    counter3 = 0
                else
                end
            end
            if counter3 > 0 then
                entries[counter4 + 1] = concat(entries2, "", 1, counter3)
            end
            return concat(entries)
        end
    end
    
    constructors.createFadeWatchdog = function(isActive, localPlayer)
        return function()
            local pulseFadeWatch = { dark = {}, aliveAt = nil, fixes = 0, log = {} }
            getgenv().__pulseFadeWatch = pulseFadeWatch
            local tweenService, entries =
                game:GetService("TweenService"), { SpawnFade = true, CameraFade = true, DeathFade = true }
            task.spawn(function()
                while isActive() do
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    pcall(function()
                        local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                        if not playerGui then
                            return
                        end
                        local character = localPlayer.Character
                        local cameraSubject = character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                        local calculatedValue = cameraSubject ~= nil
                            and cameraSubject.Health > 0
                            and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") ~= nil
                        if calculatedValue then
                            pulseFadeWatch.aliveAt = pulseFadeWatch.aliveAt or os.clock()
                        else
                            pulseFadeWatch.aliveAt = nil
                        end
                        local now, entries2 = os.clock(), {}
                        for unused, instance in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
                            if entries[instance.Name] and instance:IsA("ScreenGui") and instance.Enabled then
                                local fade = instance:FindFirstChild("Fade")
                                if
                                    fade
                                    and fade:IsA("GuiObject")
                                    and fade.Visible
                                    and fade.BackgroundTransparency < 0.05
                                then
                                    entries2[fade] = true
                                    pulseFadeWatch.dark[fade] = pulseFadeWatch.dark[fade] or now
                                    if
                                        calculatedValue
                                        and now - pulseFadeWatch.aliveAt > 2
                                        and now - pulseFadeWatch.dark[fade] > 5
                                    then
                                        pulseFadeWatch.fixes = pulseFadeWatch.fixes + 1
                                        if #pulseFadeWatch.log < 30 then
                                            pulseFadeWatch.log[#pulseFadeWatch.log + 1] = os.date("%H:%M:%S")
                                                .. " "
                                                .. instance.Name
                                        end
                                        if instance.Name == "DeathFade" then
                                            pcall(function()
                                                instance:Destroy()
                                            end)
                                        else
                                            pcall(function()
                                                tweenService
                                                    :Create(fade, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
                                                    :Play()
                                            end)
                                        end
                                        pulseFadeWatch.dark[fade] = nil
                                        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                                        if camera and camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
                                            pcall(function()
                                                camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                                                camera.CameraSubject = cameraSubject
                                            end)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        for key in pairs(pulseFadeWatch.dark) do
                            if not entries2[key] then
                                pulseFadeWatch.dark[key] = nil
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    
    constructors.createXRayControls = function(playersService, argument, callback, connectSignal, argument2, uiPage, argument3)
        return function()
            local runService, pulseXrayOrig = game:GetService("RunService"), {}
            pcall(function()
                local pulseXrayOrig2 = getgenv().__pulseXrayOrig
                if type(pulseXrayOrig2) == "table" then
                    for key, transparency in pairs(pulseXrayOrig2) do
                        pcall(function()
                            if key.Parent then
                                key.Transparency = transparency
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
            getgenv().__pulseXrayOrig = pulseXrayOrig
            local instances, counter = {}, 1
            local function callback2(instance)
                if not (instance:IsA("BasePart")) then
                    return false
                end
                if instance:IsA("Terrain") then
                    return false
                end
                if instance.Transparency >= 1 then
                    return false
                end
                local findFirstAncestorWhichIsAResult = (instance:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model"))
                while findFirstAncestorWhichIsAResult do
                    if playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(findFirstAncestorWhichIsAResult) then
                        return false
                    end
                    findFirstAncestorWhichIsAResult = findFirstAncestorWhichIsAResult.Parent
                            and findFirstAncestorWhichIsAResult.Parent:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
                        or nil
                end
                return true
            end
            local function callback3(argument4, argument5)
                return argument4 + (1 - argument4) * argument5
            end
            local function isActive()
                local strength = argument.xray.strength
                for key, item in pairs(pulseXrayOrig) do
                    if key.Parent then
                        key.Transparency = callback3(item, strength)
                    else
                        pulseXrayOrig[key] = nil
                    end
                end
            end
            local function isActive2()
                for key, transparency in pairs(pulseXrayOrig) do
                    if key.Parent then
                        key.Transparency = transparency
                    end
                    pulseXrayOrig[key] = nil
                end
                instances, counter = {}, 1
            end
            callback(isActive2)
            connectSignal(runService.Heartbeat, function()
                local value = counter
                if value > #instances then
                    return
                end
                if not argument.xray.on then
                    instances, counter = {}, 1
                    return
                end
                local strength, counter2 = argument.xray.strength, 0
                while true do
                    value = counter
                    local entry = value <= #instances
                    if not (entry and counter2 < 180) then
                        break
                    end
                    entry = instances[counter]
                    counter += 1
                    counter2 += 1
                    if entry then
                        if entry.Parent then
                            if pulseXrayOrig[entry] == nil then
                                if callback2(entry) then
                                    local transparency = entry.Transparency
                                    pulseXrayOrig[entry] = transparency
                                    entry.Transparency = callback3(transparency, strength)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                strength = counter
                if strength > #instances then
                    instances, counter = {}, 1
                end
            end)
            connectSignal(argument2.DescendantAdded, function(instance)
                if argument.xray.on then
                    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local value = instances
                        value[#value + 1] = instance
                    end
                end
            end)
            uiPage:Toggle({
                Text = "X-Ray",
                Default = argument3.xray.on,
                Callback = function(on)
                    argument.xray.on = on
                    if on then
                        instances, counter = argument2:GetDescendants(), 1
                    else
                        isActive2()
                    end
                end,
                Settings = function()
                    uiPage:Slider({
                        Text = "X-Ray Strength",
                        Min = 10,
                        Max = 100,
                        Default = math.floor(argument.xray.strength * 100 + 0.5),
                        Decimals = 0,
                        Suffix = "%",
                        Callback = function(argument4)
                            argument.xray.strength = argument4 / 100
                            if argument.xray.on then
                                isActive()
                            end
                        end,
                    })
                end,
            })
        end
    end
    
    constructors.createInstanceBuilder = function()
        return function(argument, argument2, parent)
            local instance = Instance.new(argument)
            for key, item in pairs(argument2 or {}) do
                instance[key] = item
            end
            if parent then
                instance.Parent = parent
            end
            return instance
        end
    end

                local function isActive9()

                                    else value
                                else value
                            else value
