                pulseAimV3.note = function(o, argument2, char, argument3)
                    local calculatedValue = argument2 - o
                    if calculatedValue.Magnitude < 0.5 then
                        entries.pend = nil
                        return
                    end
                    entries.pend = {
                        t = os.clock(),
                        o = o,
                        u = calculatedValue.Unit,
                        char = char,
                        v = argument3 or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
                        rh = entries.rawHist,
                        base = isActive8() + entries.interp,
                    }
                end
                pulseAimV3.onFired = function(startP, endP, argument2)
                    local pend = entries.pend
                    if not pend then
                        return
                    end
                    if typeof(startP) == "Vector3" then
                        pend.startP = startP
                    end
                    if
                        typeof(endP) == "Vector3"
                        and typeof(argument2) == "Instance"
                        and pend.char
                        and argument2:IsDescendantOf(pend.char)
                    then
                        pend.endP = endP
                        local calculatedValue = 0.5
                        pcall(function()
                            local transform, size = argument2.CFrame, argument2.Size
                            calculatedValue = 0.5
                                * (
                                    math.abs(transform.RightVector:Dot(pend.u)) * size.X
                                    + math.abs(transform.UpVector:Dot(pend.u)) * size.Y
                                    + math.abs(transform.LookVector:Dot(pend.u)) * size.Z
                                )
                        end)
                        pend.hw = math.clamp(calculatedValue, 0.2, 1.2)
                    end
                    startP = os.clock() - pend.t
                    if startP > 0.005 then
                        if startP < 1.2 then
                            if entries.wire > 0 then
                                entries.jit = callback(entries.jit, math.abs(startP - entries.wire), 0.2)
                            end
                            entries.wire = entries.wire > 0 and callback(entries.wire, startP, 0.25) or startP
                        end
                    end
                end
                local function callback2(calculatedValue, argument2, calculatedValue2, argument3)
                    local calculatedValue3, entry
                    for index = argument2, 1, -1 do
                        calculatedValue3 = calculatedValue3
                            or (
                                if calculatedValue[argument2].t - calculatedValue[index].t >= calculatedValue2
                                    then calculatedValue[index]
                                    else calculatedValue3
                            )
                        if calculatedValue3 and calculatedValue3.t - calculatedValue[index].t >= argument3 then
                            entry = calculatedValue[index]
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if entry then
                        if not calculatedValue3 then
                            return nil
                        end
                    else
                        return nil
                    end
                    calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue3.t - entry.t
                    if calculatedValue2 < 0.03 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    calculatedValue = (calculatedValue3.p - entry.p) / calculatedValue2
                    return Vector3.new(calculatedValue.X, 0, calculatedValue.Z), (calculatedValue3.t + entry.t) * 0.5
                end
                pulseAimV3.turnRate = function()
                    local unit = entries.tHist
                    local unit2 = #unit
                    if unit2 < 5 then
                        return 0
                    end
                    local calculatedValue, value = callback2(unit, unit2, 0, 0.12)
                    local position, value2 = callback2(unit, unit2, 0.12, 0.12)
                    if calculatedValue then
                        if position then
                            if value then
                                if not value2 then
                                    return 0
                                end
                            else
                                return 0
                            end
                        else
                            return 0
                        end
                    else
                        return 0
                    end
                    if calculatedValue.Magnitude < 4 then
                        return 0
                    elseif position.Magnitude < 4 then
                        return 0
                    end
                    unit, unit2 = position.Unit, calculatedValue.Unit
                    position = Vector3.new(-unit.Z, 0, unit.X)
                    local atan2Result, calculatedValue2 = math.atan2(position:Dot(unit2), unit:Dot(unit2)), value - value2
                    if calculatedValue2 < 0.03 then
                        return 0
                    end
                    calculatedValue = atan2Result / calculatedValue2
                    if calculatedValue ~= calculatedValue then
                        return 0
                    end
                    return math.clamp(calculatedValue, -6, 6)
                end
                pulseAimV3.arcLead = function(argument2, argument3)
                    local magnitude = argument2.Magnitude
                    if magnitude < 0.001 or argument3 <= 0 then
                        return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), argument2
                    end
                    local unit, turnRateResult = argument2.Unit, pulseAimV3.turnRate()
                    if math.abs(turnRateResult) < 0.35 then
                        return argument2 * argument3, argument2
                    end
                    local position, calculatedValue, clampedValue =
                        Vector3.new(-unit.Z, 0, unit.X),
                        magnitude / turnRateResult,
                        math.clamp(turnRateResult * argument3, -1, 1)
                    return unit * (calculatedValue * math.sin(clampedValue)) + position * (calculatedValue * (1 - math.cos(
                        clampedValue
                    ))),
                        (unit * math.cos(clampedValue) + position * math.sin(clampedValue)) * magnitude
                end
                local entries2 =
                    { HumanoidRootPart = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true, Torso = true, Head = true }
                pulseAimV3.bestPart = function(argument2, transform)
                    if argument2 then
                        if typeof(transform) ~= "Vector3" then
                            return nil, 0
                        elseif transform.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                            return nil, 0
                        end
                    else
                        return nil, 0
                    end
                    local unit = transform.Unit
                    transform = math.abs(unit.Y) > 0.9 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
                    local unit2 = unit:Cross(transform)
                    if unit2.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                        return nil, 0
                    end
                    unit2 = unit2.Unit
                    local unit3, unit4, unit5 = unit:Cross(unit2).Unit
                    for unused, instance in ipairs(argument2:GetChildren()) do
                        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                            if entries2[instance.Name] then
                                if instance.Transparency < 1 then
                                    transform, unit = instance.CFrame, instance.Size
                                    local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2, calculatedValue3, rightVector, upVector, lookVector =
                                        unit.X * 0.5,
                                        unit.Y * 0.5,
                                        unit.Z * 0.5,
                                        transform.RightVector,
                                        transform.UpVector,
                                        transform.LookVector
                                    local calculatedValue4, calculatedValue5 =
                                        calculatedValue * math.abs(rightVector:Dot(unit2)) + calculatedValue2 * math.abs(
                                            upVector:Dot(unit2)
                                        ) + calculatedValue3 * math.abs(
                                            lookVector:Dot(unit2)
                                        ),
                                        calculatedValue * math.abs(rightVector:Dot(unit3)) + calculatedValue2 * math.abs(
                                            upVector:Dot(unit3)
                                        ) + calculatedValue3 * math.abs(
                                            lookVector:Dot(unit3)
                                        )
                                    upVector = math.min(calculatedValue4, calculatedValue5)
                                    if unit4 then
                                        if upVector > unit4 then
                                            unit4, unit5 = upVector, instance
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                        unit4, unit5 = upVector, instance
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    return unit5, unit4 or 0
                end
                pulseAimV3.bestAxis = function(instance, unit)
                    local calculatedValue = instance
                        and (instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or instance:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                    if not calculatedValue then

                local function callback2(argument2, calculatedValue, argument3)
                    local entries2, entries3, entries4 = {}, {}, {}

                pulseAimV3.jumpCycle = function()
                    local rawHist = entries.rawHist
                    local count = #rawHist
                    if count < 8 then
                        return false, 0
                    end
                    local t, calculatedValue = rawHist[count].t, 1
                    for index = count, 1, -1 do
                        if t - rawHist[index].t > 0.6 then
                            calculatedValue = index + 1
                            break
                        end
                    end

                        return false, 0

                            index = calculatedValue2 > 0 and 1 or -1
                            counter, counter2 =
                                index,
                                if counter ~= 0 then if index ~= counter then counter2 + 1 else counter2 else counter2
                        else
                        end
                    end

                end
                pulseAimV3.resolve = function()
                    local rawHist = entries.rawHist
                    local count = #rawHist
                    if count < 6 then
                        return nil, "none"
                    end
                    local t, calculatedValue = rawHist[count].t, 1
                    for index = count, 1, -1 do

                            calculatedValue = index + 1
                            break

                    if calculatedValue4 > 3 then
                        if magnitude < calculatedValue4 * 1.5 then

                        end
                    end

                end
                getgenv().__pulseAimV3 = pulseAimV3

                                            entries.tHist = tHist2
                                            tHist = tHist2

                                        end

                                    end

                                                    else
                                                    end
                                                else
                                                    value, value2 = magnitude, key

                                            else
                                            end

                                        end
                                    end

                                        for index = value2, 1, -1 do

                pulseAimX.median = function(argument2)
                    local count = #argument2
                    if count == 0 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local cloneResult = table.clone(argument2)
                    table.sort(cloneResult)
                    if count % 2 == 1 then
                        return cloneResult[(count + 1) / 2]
                    end
                    return (cloneResult[count / 2] + cloneResult[count / 2 + 1]) * 0.5
                end
                pulseAimX.watchLag = PULSE_NV(function(localPlayer3, c, calculatedValue, ev, tmin)
                    local entries3 = pulseAimX.lagDB[localPlayer3.UserId]
                    if entries3 then
                    else
                        entries3 = { js = {} }
                        pulseAimX.lagDB[localPlayer3.UserId] = entries3
                    end
                    if entries3.c ~= c then
                        entries3.c = c
                        entries3.py = nil
                        entries3.ev = nil
                    end

                    if entries3.py then
                        ev = entries3.ev
                        if ev then
                            if localPlayer3 <= ev.ymin + 0.05 then
                                if localPlayer3 < ev.ymin then
                                    ev.ymin = localPlayer3
                                end
                                ev.tmin = tmin
                            end

                                calculatedValue = ev.tmin - ev.t0 + 0.008
                                if calculatedValue > 0.04 then
                                    if calculatedValue < 0.5 then
                                        local js, lagPool = entries3.js, pulseAimX.lagPool
                                        js[#js + 1] = calculatedValue
                                        if #js > 7 then
                                            table.remove(js, 1)
                                        end
                                        lagPool[#lagPool + 1] = calculatedValue
                                        if #lagPool > 40 then
                                            table.remove(lagPool, 1)
                                        end

                                        pulseAimX.lagCount = (pulseAimX.lagCount or 0) + 1
                                        if pulseAimX.lagCount % 8 == 0 then
                                            if #lagPool >= 8 then
                                                pulseAimX.lagPrior = pulseAimX.median(lagPool)
                                                pulseAimX.saveState()
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                entries3.ev = nil
                            elseif tmin - ev.t0 > 0.6 then
                                entries3.ev = nil
                            end
                        elseif c == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                            if entries3.pst ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                                entries3.ev = { t0 = tmin, ymin = localPlayer3, tmin = tmin }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    entries3.py = localPlayer3
                    entries3.pst = c
                end)
                pulseAimX.lagOf = function(lagCC)
                    local localPlayer3
                    if lagCC then
                        local localPlayer4 = pulseAimX.lagCP
                        if
                            localPlayer4
                            and pulseAimX.lagCC == lagCC
                            and localPlayer4.Character == lagCC
                            and localPlayer4.Parent
                        then
                            localPlayer3 = localPlayer4
                        else
                            localPlayer3 = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(lagCC)
                            pulseAimX.lagCC = lagCC
                            pulseAimX.lagCP = localPlayer3
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    local calculatedValue, medVer, med =
                        localPlayer3 and pulseAimX.lagDB[localPlayer3.UserId], pulseAimX.lagVer or 0
                    if calculatedValue then
                        if #calculatedValue.js > 0 then
                            if calculatedValue.medVer ~= medVer or calculatedValue.medN ~= #calculatedValue.js then
                                calculatedValue.medVer, calculatedValue.medN, calculatedValue.med =
                                    medVer, #calculatedValue.js, pulseAimX.median(calculatedValue.js)
                            end
                            med = calculatedValue.med
                        else
                            med = if calculatedValue then false else med
                        end
                    else
                        med = if calculatedValue then false else med
                    end
                    lagCC = nil
                    if #pulseAimX.lagPool >= 4 then
                        if
                            pulseAimX.poolMedVer ~= medVer
                            or pulseAimX.poolMedN ~= #pulseAimX.lagPool
                            or pulseAimX.poolMedT ~= pulseAimX.lagPool
                        then
                            pulseAimX.poolMedVer, pulseAimX.poolMedN, pulseAimX.poolMedT, pulseAimX.poolMed =
                                medVer, #pulseAimX.lagPool, pulseAimX.lagPool, pulseAimX.median(pulseAimX.lagPool)
                        end
                        lagCC = pulseAimX.poolMed
                    else
                    end
                    lagCC = lagCC or pulseAimX.lagPrior
                    medVer = nil
                    if med and lagCC then
                        local count = #calculatedValue.js
                        medVer = (med * count + lagCC * 3) / (count + 3)
                    else
                        medVer = lagCC or med and #calculatedValue.js >= 2 and med or nil
                    end
                    if not medVer then
                        return 0
                    end
                    return math.clamp(medVer - pulseAimX.lagRef, -0.07, 0.25)
                end

                                                    string.format(
                                                        "DESYNC back %s after %.2fs",
                                                        target.Name,
                                                        now.t - (pulseAimX.ds.since or pulseAimX.ds.farAt)
                                                    )
                                                )
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            local entry = hist[#hist]
                            if if entry then now.t - entry.t >= 0.004166666666666667 else not entry then
                                if entry then
                                    if (now.p - entry.p).Magnitude > 8 then
                                        pulseAimX.jumps = (pulseAimX.jumps or 0) + 1
                                    end

                                            table.clear(hist)
                                            pulseAimX.hcut = os.clock()
                                        end
                                    end

                                            if now.v.Magnitude >= (pulseAimX.spoofMin or 400) then
                                                local success, result = pcall(pulseAimX.kinVel, hist, now.t, 0.1)
                                                result = success and typeof(result) == "Vector3" and result
                                                    or (now.p - entry.p) / math.max(now.t - entry.t, 0.004166666666666667)
                                                if result.Magnitude < now.v.Magnitude * (pulseAimX.spoofK or 0.25) then

                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end

                pulseAimX.at = PULSE_NV(function(argument2, argument3)
                    local count = #argument2
                    if count == 0 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    if argument3 >= argument2[count].t then
                        return argument2[count], count
                    end
                    if argument3 <= argument2[1].t then
                        return argument2[1], 1
                    end
                    local counter, calculatedValue = 1, count
                    while counter < calculatedValue do
                        count = math.floor((counter + calculatedValue + 1) / 2)
                        if argument2[count].t <= argument3 then
                            counter = count
                        else
                            calculatedValue = count - 1
                        end
                    end
                    return argument2[counter], counter
                end)
                pulseAimX.posAt = PULSE_NV(function(argument2, argument3)
                    local value, value2 = pulseAimX.at(argument2, argument3)
                    if not value then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local entry = argument2[value2 + 1]
                    if entry then
                        if argument3 <= value.t then
                            return value.p
                        end
                    else
                        return value.p
                    end
                    local p, p2, packedValues =
                        value.p,
                        entry.p,
                        packValues(math.clamp((argument3 - value.t) / math.max(1.0E-4, entry.t - value.t), 0, 1))
                    return p:Lerp(p2, unpackTuple(packedValues))
                end)
                pulseAimX.kinVel = PULSE_NV(function(argument2, calculatedValue, calculatedValue2)
                    calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue2 or 0.1
                    if #argument2 < 2 then
                        return nil
                    elseif calculatedValue - calculatedValue2 < argument2[1].t then
                        return nil
                    end

                        pulseAimX.posAt(argument2, calculatedValue),
                        pulseAimX.posAt(argument2, calculatedValue - calculatedValue2)

                        if not posAtResult then
                            return nil

                        return nil
                    end

                        (posAtResult - posAtResult2) / calculatedValue2,
                        pulseAimX.posAt(argument2, calculatedValue - calculatedValue2 * 0.5)
                    posAtResult2 = posAtResult4 and (posAtResult - posAtResult4) / (calculatedValue2 * 0.5) or posAtResult3

                        (posAtResult3 - posAtResult2).Magnitude
                        < 0.35 * math.max(posAtResult3.Magnitude, posAtResult2.Magnitude) + 3

                    end
                    posAtResult3 = pulseAimX.posAt(argument2, calculatedValue - 0.025)
                    calculatedValue = posAtResult3 and (posAtResult - posAtResult3) / 0.025 or Vector3.zero
                    if calculatedValue.Magnitude > 300 then

                pulseAimX.speedFactor = PULSE_NV(function(argument2)
                    local count = #argument2
                    if count < 10 then
                        return 1
                    end
                    local t, velMdFitResult, calculatedValue = argument2[count].t, {}, count
                    while calculatedValue > 1 and t - argument2[calculatedValue].t < 1.5 do
                        count = argument2[calculatedValue]

                            count.t - 0.2 >= argument2[1].t and pulseAimX.posAt(argument2, count.t - 0.2) or nil,
                            pulseAimX.at(argument2, count.t - pulseAimX.D),

                                                        Vector3.new(calculatedValue3.X, 0, calculatedValue3.Z).Magnitude,
                                                        value.ws * value.md.Magnitude

                                                        if magnitude > 2 then
                                                            velMdFitResult[#velMdFitResult + 1] = magnitude
                                                                / calculatedValue2
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        calculatedValue -= 3
                    end
                    calculatedValue = #velMdFitResult >= 5 and math.clamp(pulseAimX.median(velMdFitResult), 0.4, 8) or 1
                    if pulseAimX.kFit == true then
                        velMdFitResult, count = pulseAimX.velMdFit(argument2, t)
                        calculatedValue = if velMdFitResult
                            then if count
                                then if velMdFitResult < (pulseAimX.velFitDeg or 25)
                                    then if count > math.max(pulseAimX.kFitMin or 1.6, calculatedValue * 1.4)
                                        then math.clamp(count, 0.4, 8)
                                        else calculatedValue
                                    else calculatedValue
                                else calculatedValue
                            else calculatedValue
                    else
                    end
                    return calculatedValue
                end)
                pulseAimX.kNow = PULSE_NV(function(sqrtResult, calculatedValue, argument2)
                    local calculatedValue2 = pulseAimX.kLocW or 0
                    if calculatedValue2 <= 0 then
                        return argument2
                    end
                    local calculatedValue3, posAtResult =
                        pulseAimX.kLocWin or 0.25, pulseAimX.posAt(sqrtResult, calculatedValue)
                    local posAtResult2 = pulseAimX.posAt(sqrtResult, calculatedValue - calculatedValue3)
                    if posAtResult then
                        if not posAtResult2 then
                            return argument2
                        end
                    else
                        return argument2
                    end
                    local calculatedValue4, calculatedValue5 = 0, 0
                    for index = 0, 4, 1 do
                        local value = pulseAimX.at(
                            sqrtResult,
                            calculatedValue - calculatedValue3 + (index + 0.5) * calculatedValue3 / 5 - pulseAimX.D
                        )
                        if value then
                            if value.air then
                                return argument2
                            end
                        else
                            return argument2
                        end
                        calculatedValue4, calculatedValue5 =
                            calculatedValue4 + value.md.X * value.ws * calculatedValue3 / 5,
                            calculatedValue5 + value.md.Z * value.ws * calculatedValue3 / 5
                    end
                    sqrtResult = math.sqrt(calculatedValue4 * calculatedValue4 + calculatedValue5 * calculatedValue5)
                    if sqrtResult < (pulseAimX.kLocMin or 1.5) then
                        return argument2
                    end
                    calculatedValue = posAtResult - posAtResult2
                    calculatedValue3 = math.sqrt(
                        calculatedValue.X * calculatedValue.X + calculatedValue.Z * calculatedValue.Z
                    ) / sqrtResult
                    if calculatedValue3 >= argument2 * (pulseAimX.kLocThr or 0.6) then
                        return argument2
                    end
                    return argument2 + (math.max(calculatedValue3, 0.15) - argument2) * calculatedValue2
                end)
                pulseAimX.jumpTau = PULSE_NV(function(argument2, argument3)
                    local count, jumping, calculatedValue =
                        #argument2, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, pulseAimX.jFlagLead or 0
                    local calculatedValue2, t = count
                    while calculatedValue2 > 1 and argument3 - argument2[calculatedValue2].t < 0.4 + pulseAimX.shiftJ() do
                        local entry, entry2 = argument2[calculatedValue2], argument2[calculatedValue2 - 1]
                        if t then
                            if t - entry.t > (pulseAimX.jFlagWin or 0.15) then
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if entry.t <= argument3 then
                            if entry.jump then
                                if entry2.jump then
                                else
                                    if t then
                                    else
                                        if calculatedValue <= 0 then
                                            return entry.t + pulseAimX.J + pulseAimX.shiftJ() - argument3
                                        end
                                        t = entry.t
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                            end
                            if entry.st == jumping then
                                if entry2.st ~= jumping then
                                    if not entry2.air then
                                        return entry.t + pulseAimX.J + pulseAimX.shiftJ() - argument3
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if entry.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
                                if entry.jump then
                                    if not entry2.air then
                                        if entry2.st ~= jumping then
                                            if entry2.st ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
                                                return entry.t + pulseAimX.J + pulseAimX.shiftJ() - argument3
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if
                                pulseAimX.ffJump == true
                                and entry.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
                                and not entry.air
                                and not entry2.air

                pulseAimX.clusters = PULSE_NV(function(p, p2)
                    local entries3 = {}
                    for index = #p, 1, -1 do
                        local entry = p[index]
                        if p2 - entry.t > 0.6 then
                            break
                        end
                        entries3[#entries3 + 1] = entry.p
                    end
                    if #entries3 < 8 then
                        return nil
                    end

                        if calculatedValue.Magnitude > 8 then
                            p2, p, counter =
                                p2 + 1,

                                if p
                                    then if calculatedValue:Dot(p) < -0.3 * calculatedValue.Magnitude * p.Magnitude
                                        then counter + 1
                                        else counter
                                    else counter
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if p2 < 3 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    if pulseAimX.clusterRev then
                        if counter < pulseAimX.clusterRev then
                            return nil
                        end
                    end
                    p, p2 = entries3[1], entries3[1]
                    for unused, item in ipairs(entries3) do
                        p2 = if (item - p).Magnitude > (p2 - p).Magnitude then item else p2
                    end
                    for unused = 1, 6, 1 do
                        local zero, calculatedValue, zero2, calculatedValue2 = Vector3.zero, 0, Vector3.zero, 0
                        for unused, item in ipairs(entries3) do
                            if (item - p).Magnitude <= (item - p2).Magnitude then
                                zero, calculatedValue = zero + item, calculatedValue + 1
                            else
                                zero2, calculatedValue2 = zero2 + item, calculatedValue2 + 1
                            end
                        end
                        p, p2 =
                            if calculatedValue > 0 then zero / calculatedValue else p,
                            if calculatedValue2 > 0 then zero2 / calculatedValue2 else p2
                        pulseAimX.clusterW = { calculatedValue / #entries3, calculatedValue2 / #entries3 }
                    end

                                vectorToObjectSpaceResult, pointToObjectSpaceResult

                        end

                            if pointToObjectSpaceResult > value then pointToObjectSpaceResult else value,
                            if vectorToObjectSpaceResult < value2 then vectorToObjectSpaceResult else value2

                            return nil
                        end

                        if math.abs(z) > z3 then
                            return nil
                        end

                        y2, calculatedValue = (-z3 - z) / z2, (z3 - z) / z2
                        if y2 > calculatedValue then
                            y2, calculatedValue = calculatedValue, y2
                        else
                        end
                        value = if y2 > value then y2 else value
                        if value > (if calculatedValue < value2 then calculatedValue else value2) then
                            return nil
                        end
                    end
                    if value <= 0 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    return value
                end)

                pulseAimX.hitsBody = PULSE_NV(function(slabResult, calculatedValue, rot, cd, argument2)
                    local parts = slabResult.parts
                    if #parts == 0 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local cld, position, bhalf, half =
                        slabResult.rad, rot.X - calculatedValue.X, rot.Y - calculatedValue.Y, rot.Z - calculatedValue.Z
                    if cld then
                        calculatedValue = -(position * cd.X + bhalf * cd.Y + half * cd.Z)
                        if calculatedValue < -cld then
                            return nil
                        elseif calculatedValue > argument2 + cld then
                            return nil
                        end
                        if
                            position * position + bhalf * bhalf + half * half - calculatedValue * calculatedValue
                            > cld * cld
                        then
                            return nil
                        end
                    end
                    rot = slabResult.rot
                    if slabResult.cd ~= cd then
                        slabResult.cd = cd
                        cld = rot:VectorToObjectSpace(cd)
                        slabResult.cld = cld
                        for unused, item in ipairs(parts) do
                            item.ld = item.rel:VectorToObjectSpace(cld)
                        end
                    end
                    cd, cld = rot:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(position, bhalf, half)), slabResult.cld
                    if slabResult.bcf then
                        position, bhalf = slabResult.bcf.Position, slabResult.bhalf
                        if
                            not (
                                pulseAimX.slab(
                                    cd.X - position.X,
                                    cd.Y - position.Y,
                                    cd.Z - position.Z,
                                    cld.X,
                                    cld.Y,
                                    cld.Z,
                                    bhalf.X + 0.01,
                                    bhalf.Y + 0.01,
                                    bhalf.Z + 0.01,
                                    argument2
                                )
                            )
                        then
                            calculatedValue, half, rot = cd.X - position.X, cd.Y - position.Y, cd.Z - position.Z
                            if math.abs(calculatedValue) <= bhalf.X then
                                if math.abs(half) <= bhalf.Y then
                                    if not (math.abs(rot) <= bhalf.Z) then
                                        return nil
                                    end
                                else
                                    return nil
                                end
                            else
                                return nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    position, bhalf, calculatedValue = slabResult.nCore or 0
                    for pointToObjectSpaceResult, item in ipairs(parts) do
                        if pointToObjectSpaceResult == position + 1 then
                            if bhalf then
                                return bhalf, bhalf
                            end
                        end

                        slabResult = pulseAimX.slab(
                            pointToObjectSpaceResult.X,
                            pointToObjectSpaceResult.Y,
                            pointToObjectSpaceResult.Z,

                            cld.Y,
                            cld.Z,
                            half.X,
                            half.Y,
                            half.Z,
                            argument2
                        )

                                then if slabResult < calculatedValue then slabResult else calculatedValue
                                else slabResult

                                then if bhalf then if slabResult < bhalf then slabResult else bhalf else slabResult
                                else bhalf
                        else

                    end

                end)

                            then if tau <= -0.15 then -0.149 + (index + calculatedValue2) * 0.001 else tau
                            else tau

                            entries3[#entries3 + 1] = { tau = tau, w = w }
                            if index == 0 then
                                entries3.mid = #entries3
                            end
                            counter += w
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    for unused, item in ipairs(entries3) do
                        item.w = item.w / counter

                pulseAimX.shotTraj = function(argument2)
                    local entries3 = {}
                    for unused, item in ipairs(argument2.pre or {}) do

                pulseAimX.tauGridMin = -0.05
                pulseAimX.tauGridStep = 0.01
                pulseAimX.tauGridN = 51
                pulseAimX.tauInit = function()
                    if type(pulseAimX.tauLog) == "table" then
                        if #pulseAimX.tauLog == pulseAimX.tauGridN then
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    pulseAimX.tauLog = {}
                    local l, maximumValue = pulseAimX.L, math.max(pulseAimX.Lsd * 1.5, 0.05)
                    for index = 1, pulseAimX.tauGridN, 1 do
                        local calculatedValue = pulseAimX.tauGridMin + (index - 1) * pulseAimX.tauGridStep
                        pulseAimX.tauLog[index] = -0.5 * ((calculatedValue - l) / maximumValue) ^ 2
                    end
                end
                pulseAimX.tauApply = function()
                    local calculatedValue, entries3, value = 0.12 + (pulseAimX.pingCal or 0.05), {}, -math.huge
                    for key, item in ipairs(pulseAimX.tauLog) do
                        entries3[key] = item
                            - 0.5 * ((pulseAimX.tauGridMin + (key - 1) * pulseAimX.tauGridStep - calculatedValue) / 0.05) ^ 2
                        value = if entries3[key] > value then entries3[key] else value
                    end

                    for key, item in ipairs(entries3) do
                        entries4[key] = math.exp(item - value)
                        counter += entries4[key]
                    end

                    for index = 1, pulseAimX.tauGridN, 1 do
                        calculatedValue = pulseAimX.tauGridMin + (index - 1) * pulseAimX.tauGridStep
                        counter2 += calculatedValue * entries4[index] / counter
                        counter3 += entries4[index] / counter
                        calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue2
                            or (if counter3 >= 0.5 then calculatedValue else calculatedValue2)
                    end
                    entries3 = 0
                    for index = 1, pulseAimX.tauGridN, 1 do
                        entries3 += (pulseAimX.tauGridMin + (index - 1) * pulseAimX.tauGridStep - counter2) ^ 2 * entries4[index] / counter
                    end
                    pulseAimX.L = math.clamp(calculatedValue2 or counter2, -0.05, 0.45)
                    pulseAimX.Lsd = math.clamp(math.sqrt(entries3), 0.035, 0.09)
                end

    constructors.createChaChaRounds = function(quarterRoundScheduleCell)
        return function(argument, argument2)
            local unused = argument[13]
            for index = 1, argument2, 2 do
                for index2 = 1, 32, 4 do
                    index = index2 - 1
                    local readCapturedOffsetResult, xorBitsResult =
                        readCapturedOffset(quarterRoundScheduleCell, index), index2 + 1 - 1
                    local readCapturedOffsetResult2, calculatedValue =
                        readCapturedOffset(quarterRoundScheduleCell, xorBitsResult), index2 + 2 - 1
                    local readCapturedOffsetResult3, calculatedValue2 =
                        readCapturedOffset(quarterRoundScheduleCell, calculatedValue), index2 + 3 - 1
                    local readCapturedOffsetResult4, andBitsResult, entry, entry2 =
                        readCapturedOffset(quarterRoundScheduleCell, calculatedValue2),
                        argument[readCapturedOffsetResult],
                        argument[readCapturedOffsetResult2],
                        argument[readCapturedOffsetResult3]
                    index2 = argument[readCapturedOffsetResult4]
                    andBitsResult = (andBitsResult + entry) % 4294967296
                    xorBitsResult = xorBits(index2, andBitsResult)
                    index2 = orBits(shiftLeft(xorBitsResult, 16), (shiftRight(xorBitsResult, 16))) % 4294967296
                    entry2 = (entry2 + index2) % 4294967296
                    xorBitsResult = xorBits(entry, entry2)
                    entry = orBits(shiftLeft(xorBitsResult, 12), (shiftRight(xorBitsResult, 20))) % 4294967296
                    andBitsResult = andBits(andBitsResult + entry, 4294967295)
                    xorBitsResult = xorBits(index2, andBitsResult)
                    index2 = orBits(shiftLeft(xorBitsResult, 8), (shiftRight(xorBitsResult, 24))) % 4294967296
                    entry2 = (entry2 + index2) % 4294967296
                    xorBitsResult = xorBits(entry, entry2)
                    entry = orBits(shiftLeft(xorBitsResult, 7), (shiftRight(xorBitsResult, 25))) % 4294967296
                    argument[readCapturedOffsetResult] = andBitsResult
                    argument[readCapturedOffsetResult2] = entry
                    argument[readCapturedOffsetResult3] = entry2
                    argument[readCapturedOffsetResult4] = index2
                end
            end
        end
    end

                    return nil, "download"
                end
                local calculatedValue = "PulseHub/sc" .. "/" .. tostring(argument.id) .. ".mp3"

                            end
                        end
                    end

                    type(success) ~= "table"
                    or success.ok ~= true
                    or type(success.f) ~= "string"
                    or not success.f:match("^%x+%.mp3$")
                then
                    return nil, type(success) == "table" and success.err or "net"

                            end
                            getcustomassetResult = getcustomasset(calculatedValue2)
                        end)

            musicState.volume = function()

            musicState.place = function()
                local snd = musicState.snd
                if snd then
                    if not snd.Parent then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                if fx.d8 then
                    local pulseSC8D = musicState.emit
                    if pulseSC8D and pulseSC8D.Parent then
                    else
                        pulseSC8D = Instance.new("Attachment")
                        pulseSC8D.Name = "PulseSC8D"
                        pulseSC8D.Parent = workspace.Terrain
                        musicState.emit = pulseSC8D
                    end
                    snd.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
                    snd.RollOffMinDistance = 16
                    snd.RollOffMaxDistance = 10000
                    if snd.Parent ~= pulseSC8D then
                        snd.Parent = pulseSC8D
                    end
                    if not musicState.orbit then
                        musicState.ang = musicState.ang or 0
                        musicState.orbit = connectSignal(runService.RenderStepped, function(argument)
                            local camera, emit = workspace.CurrentCamera, musicState.emit
                            if camera then
                                if emit then
                                    if not emit.Parent then
                                        return
                                    end
                                else
                                    return
                                end
                            else
                                return
                            end
                            musicState.ang = (musicState.ang + argument * (0.35 + fx.d8s / 100 * 2.4)) % 6.283185307179586
                            emit.WorldPosition = (
                                camera.CFrame
                                * CFrame.Angles(0, musicState.ang, 0)
                                * CFrame.new(0, 0, -6)
                            ).Position
                        end)
                    end
                else
                    if musicState.orbit then
                        musicState.orbit:Disconnect()
                        musicState.orbit = nil
                    end
                    if snd.Parent ~= soundService then
                        snd.Parent = soundService
                    end
                    if musicState.emit then
                        pcall(function()
                            musicState.emit:Destroy()
                        end)
                        musicState.emit = nil
                    end
                end
            end
            musicState.applyFx = function()
                local snd, fxi = musicState.snd, musicState.fxi
                if snd then
                    if snd.Parent then
                        if fxi then
                            local playbackSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(fx.speed) or 1, 0.5, 2)
                            snd.PlaybackSpeed = playbackSpeed
                            local octave = 2 ^ ((tonumber(fx.pitch) or 0) / 12)
                            octave = if fx.keep then octave / playbackSpeed else octave
                            octave = math.clamp(octave, 0.5, 2)
                            fxi.pitch.Octave = octave
                            fxi.pitch.Enabled = math.abs(octave - 1) > 0.001
                            fxi.eq.LowGain = math.clamp(fx.bass, 0, 10)
                            fxi.eq.MidGain = 0
                            fxi.eq.HighGain = math.clamp(fx.treble, -20, 10)
                            fxi.eq.Enabled = fx.bass ~= 0 or fx.treble ~= 0
                            playbackSpeed = math.clamp(fx.reverb / 100, 0, 1)
                            fxi.rev.DecayTime = 0.8 + 3.2 * playbackSpeed
                            fxi.rev.Density = 1
                            fxi.rev.Diffusion = 1
                            fxi.rev.DryLevel = -3 * playbackSpeed
                            fxi.rev.WetLevel = -22 + 20 * playbackSpeed
                            fxi.rev.Enabled = playbackSpeed > 0
                            playbackSpeed = math.clamp(fx.echo / 100, 0, 1)
                            fxi.echo.Delay = 0.3
                            fxi.echo.Feedback = 0.15 + 0.4 * playbackSpeed
                            fxi.echo.DryLevel = 0
                            fxi.echo.WetLevel = -20 + 14 * playbackSpeed
                            fxi.echo.Enabled = playbackSpeed > 0
                            playbackSpeed = math.clamp(fx.dist / 100, 0, 1)
                            fxi.dist.Level = 0.75 * playbackSpeed
                            fxi.dist.Enabled = playbackSpeed > 0
                            musicState.place()
                        end
                    end
                end
                if musicState.paintFx then
                    musicState.paintFx()
                end
            end
            musicState.setFx = function(argument, argument3)
                if fx[argument] == argument3 then
                    return
                end
                fx[argument] = argument3
                musicState.applyFx()
            end
            musicState.fxActive = function()
                for key, item in pairs(fxdef) do
                    if key ~= "d8s" then
                        if key ~= "keep" then
                            if fx[key] ~= item then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            musicState.presetOf = function()
                for key, item in ipairs(musicState.PRESETS) do
                    local enabled = true
                    for key2, item2 in pairs(fxdef) do
                        if key2 ~= "d8s" then
                            local entry = item[2][key2]
                            entry = if entry == nil then item2 else entry
                            if type(entry) == "number" then
                                if math.abs((tonumber(fx[key2]) or 0) - entry) > 0.001 then
                                    enabled = false
                                    break
                                end
                            elseif fx[key2] ~= entry then
                                enabled = false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if enabled then
                        return key
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            musicState.setPreset = function(entry)
                local entry2 = musicState.PRESETS[entry]
                if not entry2 then
                    return
                end
                for key, item in pairs(fxdef) do
                    if key ~= "d8s" then
                        entry = entry2[2][key]
                        fx[key] = if entry == nil then item else entry
                    end
                end
                musicState.applyFx()
            end
            musicState.sound = function()
                if musicState.snd then
                    if musicState.snd.Parent then
                        return musicState.snd
                    end
                end
                if musicState.snd then
                    pcall(function()
                        musicState.snd:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                local pulseSoundCloud = Instance.new("Sound")
                pulseSoundCloud.Name = "PulseSoundCloud"
                pulseSoundCloud.Volume = musicState.volume()
                pulseSoundCloud.Parent = soundService
                musicState.snd = pulseSoundCloud
                musicState.fxi = {
                    eq = createInstance("EqualizerSoundEffect", { Priority = 5, Enabled = false }, pulseSoundCloud),
                    pitch = createInstance("PitchShiftSoundEffect", { Priority = 4, Enabled = false }, pulseSoundCloud),
                    dist = createInstance("DistortionSoundEffect", { Priority = 3, Enabled = false }, pulseSoundCloud),
                    echo = createInstance("EchoSoundEffect", { Priority = 2, Enabled = false }, pulseSoundCloud),
                    rev = createInstance("ReverbSoundEffect", { Priority = 1, Enabled = false }, pulseSoundCloud),
                }
                connectSignal(pulseSoundCloud.Ended, function()
                    if musicState.snd ~= pulseSoundCloud then
                        return
                    elseif sc.rep == "one" then
                        return
                    end
                    local pickResult = musicState.pick(1, true)
                    if pickResult then
                        musicState.play(musicState.queue, pickResult, "step")
                    else
                        musicState.ended = true
                        if musicState.refresh then
                            musicState.refresh()
                        end
                    end
                end)
                musicState.applyFx()
                return pulseSoundCloud
            end
            musicState.playing = function()
                return musicState.snd ~= nil and musicState.snd.Parent ~= nil and musicState.snd.IsPlaying
            end
            musicState.pick = function(argument, argument3)
                local queue = musicState.queue
                local count = #queue
                if count == 0 then
                    return nil
                end
                if argument > 0 and sc.shuf then
                    if musicState.nxt then
                        if musicState.nxt ~= musicState.qi then
                            if queue[musicState.nxt] then
                                if queue[musicState.nxt].ok then
                                    if not musicState.played[musicState.nxt] then
                                        return musicState.nxt
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local entries3 = {}
                    for key, item in ipairs(queue) do
                        if item.ok then
                            if key ~= musicState.qi then
                                if not musicState.played[key] then
                                    entries3[#entries3 + 1] = key
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if #entries3 == 0 then
                        if argument3 then
                            if sc.rep == "off" then
                                return nil
                            end
                        end
                        table.clear(musicState.played)
                        for key, item in ipairs(queue) do
                            if item.ok then
                                if key ~= musicState.qi then
                                    entries3[#entries3 + 1] = key
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if #entries3 == 0 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    return entries3[math.random(#entries3)]
                end
                local qi = musicState.qi
                for unused = 1, count, 1 do
                    qi += argument
                    if qi > count then
                        if argument3 then
                            if sc.rep == "off" then
                                return nil
                            end
                        end
                        qi = 1
                    else
                        qi = if qi < 1 then count else qi
                    end
                    if queue[qi] then
                        if queue[qi].ok then
                            return qi
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            musicState.play = function(queue, qi, argument)
                local cur = queue[qi]
                if not cur then
                    return
                end
                if not cur.ok then
                    musicState.toast("Track unavailable", "warning")
                    return
                end
                if argument == nil then
                    musicState.queue = table.clone(queue)
                    queue = musicState.queue
                    musicState.hist = {}
                    musicState.played = {}
                elseif argument == "step" then
                    if musicState.qi > 0 then
                        table.insert(musicState.hist, musicState.qi)
                        if #musicState.hist > 100 then
                            table.remove(musicState.hist, 1)
                        end
                    end
                end
                musicState.qi = qi
                musicState.played[qi] = true
                musicState.nxt = nil
                musicState.ended = false
                musicState.gen = musicState.gen + 1
                local gen = musicState.gen
                musicState.cur, musicState.loading = cur, cur.id
                if musicState.snd then
                    pcall(function()
                        musicState.snd:Stop()
                    end)
                end
                if musicState.refresh then
                    musicState.refresh()
                end
                task.spawn(function()
                    local soundId, soundResult = musicState.trackFile(cur)
                    if gen ~= musicState.gen then
                        return
                    end
                    musicState.loading = nil
                    if not soundId then
                        musicState.toast(entries2[soundResult] or "Could not load the track", "error")
                        if musicState.refresh then
                            musicState.refresh()
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    soundResult = musicState.sound()
                    soundResult.SoundId = soundId
                    soundResult.Looped = sc.rep == "one"
                    soundResult.Volume = musicState.volume()
                    soundResult.TimePosition = 0
                    musicState.applyFx()
                    soundResult:Play()
                    musicState.pushRecent(cur)
                    musicState.nxt = musicState.pick(1, false)
                    if musicState.refresh then
                        musicState.refresh()
                    end
                    local calculatedValue = musicState.nxt and musicState.queue[musicState.nxt]
                    if calculatedValue and calculatedValue.ok then
                        if not (isfile and isfile("PulseHub/sc" .. "/" .. tostring(calculatedValue.id) .. ".mp3")) then
                            task.delay(4, function()
                                if gen == musicState.gen then
                                    pcall(musicState.api, "/pulse/sc/get", { id = calculatedValue.id })
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            musicState.step = function(argument)
                if argument < 0 then
                    local snd = musicState.snd
                    if snd then
                        if snd.Parent then
                            if snd.IsPlaying then
                                if snd.TimePosition > 4 then
                                    snd.TimePosition = 0
                                    return
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if sc.shuf then
                        if #musicState.hist > 0 then
                            snd = table.remove(musicState.hist)
                            if musicState.queue[snd] then
                                return musicState.play(musicState.queue, snd, "back")
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local pickResult = musicState.pick(argument, false)
                if pickResult then
                    musicState.play(musicState.queue, pickResult, argument > 0 and "step" or "back")
                end
            end
            musicState.toggle = function()
                if musicState.loading then
                    return
                end
                local snd = musicState.snd
                if not (snd and snd.Parent and snd.SoundId ~= "") then
                    local listOfResult, entries3 = musicState.listOf(musicState.view), {}
                    for key, item in ipairs(listOfResult) do
                        if item.ok then
                            entries3[#entries3 + 1] = key
                        end
                    end
                    if #entries3 > 0 then
                        musicState.play(listOfResult, sc.shuf and entries3[math.random(#entries3)] or entries3[1])
                    end
                    return
                end
                if snd.IsPlaying then
                    snd:Pause()
                elseif musicState.ended then
                    musicState.ended = false
                    snd.TimePosition = 0
                    snd:Play()
                else
                    snd:Resume()
                end
                if musicState.refresh then
                    musicState.refresh()
                end
            end
            musicState.setRepeat = function(rep)
                sc.rep = rep
                if musicState.snd then
                    musicState.snd.Looped = rep == "one"
                end
                musicState.nxt = musicState.pick(1, false)
            end
            musicState.toggleShuffle = function()
                sc.shuf = not sc.shuf
                musicState.played = {}
                if musicState.qi > 0 then
                    musicState.played[musicState.qi] = true
                end
                musicState.nxt = musicState.pick(1, false)
                if musicState.renderCard then
                    musicState.renderCard()
                end
            end
            musicState.cycleRepeat = function()
                local setRepeat, calculatedValue =
                    musicState.setRepeat, sc.rep == "all" and "one" or (sc.rep == "one" and "off" or "all")
                setRepeat(calculatedValue)
                if musicState.renderCard then
                    musicState.renderCard()
                end
            end
            musicState.toggleMute = function()
                if sc.mute or sc.vol == 0 then
                    sc.mute = false
                    if sc.vol == 0 then
                        sc.vol = 50
                    end
                else
                    sc.mute = true
                end
                if musicState.snd then
                    musicState.snd.Volume = musicState.volume()
                end
                if musicState.paintVol then
                    musicState.paintVol()
                end
            end
            musicState.favCurrent = function()
                local cur = musicState.cur
                if not cur then
                    return
                end
                musicState.setFav(cur, not musicState.isFav(cur.id))
                if musicState.view == "favs" and musicState.render then
                    musicState.render()
                elseif musicState.refresh then
                    musicState.refresh()
                end
            end
            musicState.search = function(argument)
                local query = tostring(argument or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                if query == "" then
                    if musicState.query then
                        musicState.clearSearch()
                    end
                    return
                end
                if musicState.searching then
                    return
                end
                musicState.searching = true
                musicState.view = "results"
                musicState.query = query
                musicState.results = {}
                musicState.more = false
                musicState.page = 0
                musicState.moreLoading = false
                if musicState.render then
                    musicState.render()
                end
                task.spawn(function()
                    local apiResult = musicState.api("/pulse/sc/search", { q = query, p = 0 })
                    if musicState.query ~= query then
                        return
                    end
                    musicState.searching = false
                    local results = {}
                    if type(apiResult) == "table" and apiResult.ok == true and type(apiResult.items) == "table" then
                        for cleanResult2, item in ipairs(apiResult.items) do
                            cleanResult2 = musicState.clean(item)
                            if cleanResult2 then
                                results[#results + 1] = cleanResult2
                            end
                        end
                        musicState.more = apiResult.more == true
                    elseif type(apiResult) == "table" then
                        if entries2[apiResult.err] then
                            musicState.toast(entries2[apiResult.err], "warning")
                        end
                    end
                    musicState.results = results
                    if #results == 0 then
                        musicState.toast("Nothing found", "info")
                    end
                    if musicState.render then
                        musicState.render()
                    end
                end)
            end
            musicState.searchMore = function()
                if musicState.query then
                    if musicState.more then
                        if musicState.moreLoading then
                            return
                        elseif musicState.searching then
                            return
                        elseif #musicState.results >= 600 then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                musicState.moreLoading = true
                local q = musicState.query
                local page = musicState.page + 1
                if musicState.paintMore then
                    musicState.paintMore()
                end
                task.spawn(function()
                    local apiResult = musicState.api("/pulse/sc/search", { q = q, p = page })
                    if musicState.query ~= q then
                        return
                    end
                    musicState.moreLoading = false
                    local entries3 = {}
                    if type(apiResult) == "table" and apiResult.ok == true and type(apiResult.items) == "table" then
                        local entries4 = {}
                        for unused, item in ipairs(musicState.results) do
                            entries4[item.id] = true
                        end
                        for cleanResult2, item in ipairs(apiResult.items) do
                            cleanResult2 = musicState.clean(item)
                            if cleanResult2 then
                                if not entries4[cleanResult2.id] then
                                    entries4[cleanResult2.id] = true
                                    musicState.results[#musicState.results + 1] = cleanResult2
                                    entries3[#entries3 + 1] = #musicState.results
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        musicState.page = page
                        musicState.more = apiResult.more == true and #musicState.results < 600
                    else
                        musicState.moreFail = os.clock()
                        if type(apiResult) == "table" then
                            if entries2[apiResult.err] then
                                musicState.toast(entries2[apiResult.err], "warning")
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if musicState.appendRows then
                        musicState.appendRows(entries3)
                    end
                end)
            end
            musicState.clearSearch = function()
                musicState.query = nil
                musicState.searching = false
                musicState.results = {}
                musicState.more = false
                musicState.page = 0
                musicState.moreLoading = false
                musicState.view = "results"
                musicState.loadTop(musicState.genre())
                if musicState.render then
                    musicState.render()
                end
            end
            musicState.loadTop = function(argument)
                local topLoading = argument or musicState.genre()
                if musicState.topLoading == topLoading then
                    return
                end
                if musicState.tops[topLoading] then
                    if os.clock() - (musicState.topAt[topLoading] or 0) < 900 then
                        return
                    end
                end
                musicState.topLoading = topLoading
                task.spawn(function()
                    local apiResult = musicState.api("/pulse/sc/top", { g = topLoading })
                    if musicState.topLoading == topLoading then
                        musicState.topLoading = nil
                    end
                    if type(apiResult) == "table" and apiResult.ok == true and type(apiResult.items) == "table" then
                        local entries3 = {}
                        for cleanResult2, item in ipairs(apiResult.items) do
                            cleanResult2 = musicState.clean(item)
                            if cleanResult2 then
                                entries3[#entries3 + 1] = cleanResult2
                            end
                        end
                        musicState.tops[topLoading], musicState.topAt[topLoading] = entries3, os.clock()
                    elseif type(apiResult) == "table" then
                        if entries2[apiResult.err] then
                            musicState.toast(entries2[apiResult.err], "warning")
                        end
                    end
                    if musicState.render then
                        if musicState.view == "results" then
                            if not musicState.query then
                                if musicState.genre() == topLoading then
                                    musicState.render()
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            callback(function()
                musicState.gen = musicState.gen + 1
                if musicState.orbit then
                    pcall(function()
                        musicState.orbit:Disconnect()
                    end)
                    musicState.orbit = nil
                end
                if musicState.snd then
                    pcall(function()
                        musicState.snd:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                if musicState.emit then
                    pcall(function()
                        musicState.emit:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                musicState.render = nil
                musicState.refresh = nil
                musicState.paintFx = nil
            end)
            getgenv().__pulseSCUI = function(uiPage)
                local novaUI = sharedState.Nova

                local tex = novaUI.Tex
                local font = novaUI.Font
                local userInputService, color = game:GetService("UserInputService"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 0)
                local color2, dimension, entries, entries2, entries3, entries4 =
                    Color3.new(1, 1, 1), UDim.new(1, 0), {}, {}, { cards = {}, chips = {} }, {}
                local function callback3(argument, argument2)
                    return u.corner(argument, argument2)
                end
                local function callback4(argument, argument2)
                    pcall(function()
                        novaUI.Sound.play(argument, argument2)
                    end)
                end
                local function isActive()
                    return math.max(mainWindow.Scale and mainWindow.Scale.Scale or 1, 0.1)
                end
                local function callback5(argument, argument2)
                    connectSignal(argument.MouseEnter, function()
                        pcall(function()

                        end)
                    end)
                    novaUI.U.leave(argument, function()

                            mainWindow:HideTip()
                        end)

                local function callback6(argument, argument2)
                    local value = createInstance(
                        "UIStroke",
                        { Thickness = 1, Transparency = argument2 or 0.9, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border },
                        argument
                    )
                    bindTheme(value, "Color", "Glass")
                    return value
                end
                local function callback7(argument, argument2, argument3)
                    local entries5 = {
                        FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                        HorizontalAlignment = argument3 or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
                        VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                        Padding = UDim.new(0, argument2 or 6),
                        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                    }
                    return createInstance("UIListLayout", entries5, argument)
                end
                local entries5 = {}
                local function connectSignal2(argument, move, done)
                    local entries6 = { move = move, done = done }
                    entries5[#entries5 + 1] = entries6
                    connectSignal(argument.InputBegan, function(input)
                        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                            entries6.arm = { input = input, x = input.Position.X, y = input.Position.Y }
                        elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

                        end
