                        pcall(handleAction3)
                        pcall(function()
                            argument.W:Notify({
                                Title = localization.tr("Anti Coin"),
                                Text = localization.tr("Coin leaked, strict mode on"),
                                Kind = "error",
                                Duration = 3,
                            })
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                while isActive() do
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    if pulseAntiCoin then
                        pcall(handleAction2)
                        if pulseAntiCoinInfo.strict then
                            pcall(handleAction3)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            local function set(argument2)
                pulseAntiCoin = argument2 and true or false
                getgenv().__pulseAntiCoin = pulseAntiCoin
                if pulseAntiCoin then
                    pcall(handleAction2)
                else
                    isActive2()
                end
            end
            pulseAntiCoinInfo.set = set
            uiPage:Toggle({ Text = "Anti Coin", Default = false, Callback = set })
        end
    end
    
    constructors.createGuardSequenceB = function(argument, argument2, argument3)
        return function()
            local counter = 0
            while true do
                if counter <= 0 then
                    argument[6][argument[5]] = true
                    argument2[6][argument2[5]] = argument2[6][argument2[5]] - argument2[6][argument2[5]] % 2 + 1
                    argument3[6][argument3[5]], counter = (796337 * argument3[6][argument3[5]] + 236121203) % 268435456, 1
                else
                    return
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    constructors.createSHA256 = function(bitAnd, rightShift, leftShift, bitXor, rotateRight, bitNot, roundConstants)
        return function(argument)
            local count = #argument
            local calculatedValue = count * 8
            local roundedValue, entries = math.floor(calculatedValue / 4294967296), calculatedValue % 4294967296
            argument ..= "\128" .. string.rep("\000", (56 - (count + 1) % 64) % 64) .. string.char(
                bitAnd(rightShift(roundedValue, 24), 255),
                bitAnd(rightShift(roundedValue, 16), 255),
                bitAnd(rightShift(roundedValue, 8), 255),
                bitAnd(roundedValue, 255),
                bitAnd(rightShift(entries, 24), 255),
                bitAnd(rightShift(entries, 16), 255),
                bitAnd(rightShift(entries, 8), 255),
                bitAnd(entries, 255)
            )
            local count2, counter, counter2, counter3, counter4, counter5, counter6, counter7, counter8 =
                #argument, 1779033703, 3144134277, 1013904242, 2773480762, 1359893119, 2600822924, 528734635, 1541459225
            for index = 1, count2, 64 do
                roundedValue = {}
                for index2 = 0, 15, 1 do
                    local byteResult, byteResult2, byteResult3, byteResult4 =
                        argument:byte(index + index2 * 4, index + index2 * 4 + 3)
                    roundedValue[index2] = bit32.bor(
                        leftShift(byteResult, 24),
                        leftShift(byteResult2, 16),
                        leftShift(byteResult3, 8),
                        byteResult4
                    )
                end
                for index2 = 16, 63, 1 do
                    index, entries = roundedValue[index2 - 15], roundedValue[index2 - 2]
                    count, calculatedValue =
                        bitXor(rotateRight(index, 7), rotateRight(index, 18), rightShift(index, 3)),
                        bitXor(rotateRight(entries, 17), rotateRight(entries, 19), rightShift(entries, 10))
                    roundedValue[index2] =
                        bitAnd(roundedValue[index2 - 16] + count + roundedValue[index2 - 7] + calculatedValue, 4294967295)
                end
                local value, value2, value3, value4, value5, value6, value7, value8 =
                    counter5, counter6, counter7, counter8, counter, counter2, counter3, counter4
                for index = 0, 63, 1 do
                    local value9, value10 =
                        bitXor(rotateRight(value, 6), rotateRight(value, 11), rotateRight(value, 25)),
                        bitXor(bitAnd(value, value2), bitAnd(bitNot(value), value3))
                    local value11, value12, value13 =
                        bitAnd(value4 + value9 + value10 + roundConstants[index + 1] + roundedValue[index], 4294967295),
                        bitXor(rotateRight(value5, 2), rotateRight(value5, 13), rotateRight(value5, 22)),
                        bitXor(bitAnd(value5, value6), bitAnd(value5, value7), bitAnd(value6, value7))
                    index = bitAnd(value12 + value13, 4294967295)
                    value, value4, value5, value8, value2, value3, value6, value7 =
                        bitAnd(value8 + value11, 4294967295),
                        value3,
                        bitAnd(value11 + index, 4294967295),
                        value7,
                        value,
                        value2,
                        value5,
                        value6
                end
                counter, counter2, counter3, counter4, counter5, counter6, counter7 =
                    bitAnd(counter + value5, 4294967295),
                    bitAnd(counter2 + value6, 4294967295),
                    bitAnd(counter3 + value7, 4294967295),
                    bitAnd(counter4 + value8, 4294967295),
                    bitAnd(counter5 + value, 4294967295),
                    bitAnd(counter6 + value2, 4294967295),
                    bitAnd(counter7 + value3, 4294967295)
                counter8 = bitAnd(counter8 + value4, 4294967295)
            end
            roundedValue, count2, entries =
                {}, ipairs, { counter, counter2, counter3, counter4, counter5, counter6, counter7, counter8 }
            for unused, item in count2(entries) do
                roundedValue[#roundedValue + 1] = string.char(
                    bitAnd(rightShift(item, 24), 255),
                    bitAnd(rightShift(item, 16), 255),
                    bitAnd(rightShift(item, 8), 255),
                    bitAnd(item, 255)
                )
            end
            return table.concat(roundedValue)
        end
    end
    
    constructors.createRoleActions = function(argument, localPlayer, connectSignal, isActive, callback, localization)
        return function()
            local pulseRoleFarm, callback2, entries =
                {
                    on = { inno = false, sheriff = false, murder = false, exp = false },
                    state = "Off",
                    role = nil,
                    log = {},
                    drops = {},
                    hooked = false,
                    holding = false,
                    acted = false,
                    wins = 0,
                    kills = 0,
                    seen = {},
                },
                setmetatable,
                { __mode = "k" }
            pulseRoleFarm.flung = callback2({}, entries)
            pulseRoleFarm.flingWait = 0
            pulseRoleFarm.lastTp = 0
            pulseRoleFarm.conns = {}
            getgenv().__pulseRoleFarm = pulseRoleFarm
            pulseRoleFarm.Players = game:GetService("Players")
            pulseRoleFarm.Run = game:GetService("RunService")
            pulseRoleFarm.KPARTS = { "HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "LowerTorso", "Head" }
            pulseRoleFarm.say = function(argument2)
                pulseRoleFarm.log[#pulseRoleFarm.log + 1] = string.format("%s %s", os.date("%H:%M:%S"), tostring(argument2))
                if #pulseRoleFarm.log > 40 then
                    table.remove(pulseRoleFarm.log, 1)
                end
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.mine = function()
                local success, result = pcall(argument)
                if success then
                    if type(result) ~= "table" then
                        return nil, {}
                    end
                else
                    return nil, {}
                end
                success = result[localPlayer.Name]
                if type(success) ~= "table" then
                    return nil, result
                elseif success.Role then
                    if success.Dead == true then
                        return nil, result
                    elseif success.Killed == true then
                        return nil, result
                    end
                else
                    return nil, result
                end
                return tostring(success.Role), result
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.hrp = function()
                local character = localPlayer.Character
                return character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.hum = function()
                local character = localPlayer.Character
                return character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.alive = function()
                local humResult = pulseRoleFarm.hum()
                return humResult ~= nil and humResult.Health > 0
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.lobbyCF = function()
                local instance, calculatedValue = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
                    or workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
                if instance then
                    local spawns = instance:FindFirstChild("Spawns")
                    calculatedValue = (if spawns then (spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) else calculatedValue)
                        or (instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true))
                else
                end
                return calculatedValue and calculatedValue.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) or nil
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.inLobby = function()
                local hrpResult, lobbyCFResult = pulseRoleFarm.hrp(), pulseRoleFarm.lobbyCF()
                return hrpResult ~= nil
                    and lobbyCFResult ~= nil
                    and (hrpResult.Position - lobbyCFResult.Position).Magnitude < 300
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.toLobby = function()
                if pulseRoleFarm.inLobby() then
                    return true
                end
                local hrpResult = pulseRoleFarm.hrp()
                local transform = pulseRoleFarm.lobbyCF()
                if not (hrpResult and transform) then
                    return false
                end
                pcall(function()
                    hrpResult.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    hrpResult.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    hrpResult.CFrame = transform
                end)
                pulseRoleFarm.lastTp = os.clock()
                pulseRoleFarm.say("TP lobby")
                return true
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.who = function(argument2, argument)
                local callback2 = pairs
                for key, item in callback2(argument2) do
                    if type(item) == "table" then
                        if item.Role then
                            if item.Dead ~= true then
                                if item.Killed ~= true then
                                    if tostring(item.Role):lower():find(argument) then
                                        local localPlayer2 = pulseRoleFarm.Players:FindFirstChild(key)
                                        local calculatedValue = localPlayer2
                                            and localPlayer2 ~= localPlayer
                                            and localPlayer2.Character
                                        local calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue
                                            and (calculatedValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                                        if calculatedValue2 then
                                            if calculatedValue2.Health > 0 then
                                                return localPlayer2, calculatedValue
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil, nil
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.gun = function()
                local backpack = localPlayer.Character
                local calculatedValue = backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun"))
                if calculatedValue then
                    return calculatedValue, true
                end
                backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                return backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")), false
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.shoot = function(rawgetResult)
                local unused, whoResult = pulseRoleFarm.who(rawgetResult, "murder")
                if not whoResult then
                    return false
                end
                local gunResult, gunResult2 = pulseRoleFarm.gun()
                if not gunResult then
                    return false
                end
                if not gunResult2 then
                    local humResult = pulseRoleFarm.hum()
                    if humResult then
                        pcall(function()
                            humResult:EquipTool(gunResult)
                        end)
                    end
                    return true
                end
                pulseRoleFarm.target = whoResult.Name
                gunResult2 = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseAimX")
                if type(gunResult2) == "table" then
                    if gunResult2.alive then
                        if type(gunResult2.fireFor) == "function" then
                            local success, result = pcall(gunResult2.fireFor, whoResult, false, false)
                            if success then
                                if result then
                                    pulseRoleFarm.say("SHOT " .. whoResult.Name)
                                end
                            end
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
                rawgetResult = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseShotMurder")
                if type(rawgetResult) == "function" then
                    pcall(rawgetResult)
                end
                return true
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.knife = function()
                local character = localPlayer.Character
                local calculatedValue = character and (character:FindFirstChild("Knife"))
                if calculatedValue then
                    return calculatedValue
                end
                local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                local instance = backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife"))
                local humResult = pulseRoleFarm.hum()
                if instance and (instance:IsA("Tool")) then
                    if humResult then
                        pcall(function()
                            humResult:EquipTool(instance)
                        end)
                    end
                end
                return character and (character:FindFirstChild("Knife"))
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.stabAll = function(argument2)
                local instance = pulseRoleFarm.knife()
                if not (instance and firetouchinterest) then
                    return 0
                end
                local calculatedValue = instance:FindFirstChild("Handle") or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if not calculatedValue then
                    return 0
                end
                local callback2, packedValues, counter = ipairs, packValues(pulseRoleFarm.Players:GetPlayers()), 0
                for key, localPlayer2 in callback2(unpackTuple(packedValues)) do
                    key = localPlayer2 ~= localPlayer and argument2[localPlayer2.Name]
                    if type(key) == "table" then
                        if key.Dead ~= true then
                            if key.Killed ~= true then
                                local character = localPlayer2.Character
                                local calculatedValue2 = character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                                if calculatedValue2 then
                                    if calculatedValue2.Health > 0 then
                                        local calculatedValue3 = counter + 1
                                        for unused, item in ipairs(pulseRoleFarm.KPARTS) do
                                            local findFirstChildResult = character:FindFirstChild(item)
                                            if findFirstChildResult then
                                                pcall(function()
                                                    firetouchinterest(calculatedValue, findFirstChildResult, 0)
                                                    firetouchinterest(calculatedValue, findFirstChildResult, 1)
                                                    firetouchinterest(findFirstChildResult, calculatedValue, 0)
                                                    firetouchinterest(findFirstChildResult, calculatedValue, 1)
                                                end)
                                            end
                                        end
                                        counter = calculatedValue3
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if counter > 0 then
                    pcall(function()
                        instance:Activate()
                    end)
                end
                return counter
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.hook = function()
                if pulseRoleFarm.hooked then
                    return
                end
                pulseRoleFarm.hooked = true
                connectSignal(workspace.DescendantAdded, function(instance)
                    if instance.Name == "GunDrop" then
                        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                            table.insert(pulseRoleFarm.drops, instance)
                        end
                    end
                end)
                for unused, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if instance.Name == "GunDrop" then
                        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                            table.insert(pulseRoleFarm.drops, instance)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.drop = function()
                for index = #pulseRoleFarm.drops, 1, -1 do
                    local entry = pulseRoleFarm.drops[index]
                    if entry.Parent then
                        local workspace2 = workspace
                        if entry:IsDescendantOf(workspace2) then
                            return entry
                        end
                    end
                    table.remove(pulseRoleFarm.drops, index)
                end
                return nil
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.touch = function(argument2)
                local character = localPlayer.Character
                if character then
                    if argument2 then
                        if not firetouchinterest then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                for unused, instance in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                        pcall(function()
                            firetouchinterest(instance, argument2, 0)
                            firetouchinterest(instance, argument2, 1)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.grab = function()
                local dropResult = pulseRoleFarm.drop()
                if not dropResult then
                    return false
                end
                local now = os.clock()
                while os.clock() - now < 0.6 and dropResult.Parent and not pulseRoleFarm.gun() and pulseRoleFarm.alive() do
                    pulseRoleFarm.touch(dropResult)
                    pulseRoleFarm.Run.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                if pulseRoleFarm.gun() then
                    pulseRoleFarm.say("GUN remote")
                    return true
                end
                if not dropResult.Parent then
                    return false
                end
                local hrpResult = pulseRoleFarm.hrp()
                if not hrpResult then
                    return false
                end
                now = os.clock()
                while os.clock() - now < 1.2 and dropResult.Parent and not pulseRoleFarm.gun() and pulseRoleFarm.alive() do
                    pcall(function()
                        hrpResult.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        hrpResult.CFrame = CFrame.new(dropResult.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    end)
                    pulseRoleFarm.touch(dropResult)
                    pulseRoleFarm.Run.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                local calculatedValue = pulseRoleFarm.gun() ~= nil
                pulseRoleFarm.say(calculatedValue and "GUN near" or "GUN miss")
                pulseRoleFarm.toLobby()
                return calculatedValue
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.fling = function(argument2)
                local rawgetResult = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseFlingDown")
                if type(rawgetResult) ~= "function" then
                    return false
                end
                local success, result, result2 = pcall(rawgetResult, argument2, 0.8, { home = pulseRoleFarm.lobbyCF() })
                pulseRoleFarm.say("FLING " .. tostring(argument2.Name) .. " " .. tostring(success and result2 or result))
                return success and result == true
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.hold = function(holding)
                holding = holding and true or false
                if holding then
                    pulseRoleFarm.acted = true
                end
                if pulseRoleFarm.holding ~= holding then
                    pulseRoleFarm.holding = holding
                    getgenv().__pulseRoleFarmHold = holding or nil
                end
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.count = function(argument2)
                local callback3 = pairs
                for key, item in callback3(argument2) do
                    if key ~= localPlayer.Name then
                        if type(item) == "table" then
                            if item.Dead == true or item.Killed == true then
                                if pulseRoleFarm.seen[key] then
                                    pulseRoleFarm.seen[key] = nil
                                    if pulseRoleFarm.state == "Killing" then
                                        pulseRoleFarm.kills = pulseRoleFarm.kills + 1
                                    elseif pulseRoleFarm.state == "Shooting" then
                                        if pulseRoleFarm.target == key then
                                            pulseRoleFarm.kills = pulseRoleFarm.kills + 1
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                pulseRoleFarm.seen[key] = true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.expInnocent = function(now)
                if pulseRoleFarm.gun() then
                    pulseRoleFarm.toLobby()
                    pulseRoleFarm.state = "Shooting"
                    pulseRoleFarm.shoot(now)
                    return
                end
                local unused, whoResult = pulseRoleFarm.who(now, "sheriff")
                if whoResult then
                else
                    whoResult, whoResult = pulseRoleFarm.who(now, "hero")
                end
                now = os.clock()
                if whoResult then
                    if now >= pulseRoleFarm.flingWait then
                        if (pulseRoleFarm.flung[whoResult] or 0) < 4 then
                            pulseRoleFarm.flung[whoResult] = (pulseRoleFarm.flung[whoResult] or 0) + 1
                            pulseRoleFarm.state = "Flinging"
                            local flingResult = pulseRoleFarm.fling(whoResult)
                            pulseRoleFarm.flingWait = os.clock() + (flingResult and 2.5 or 0.5)
                            pulseRoleFarm.toLobby()
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
                if pulseRoleFarm.drop() then
                    pulseRoleFarm.state = "Picking Gun"
                    pulseRoleFarm.grab()
                    return
                end
                pulseRoleFarm.toLobby()
                pulseRoleFarm.state = "Surviving"
            end
            pulseRoleFarm.step = function()
                local settings = pulseRoleFarm.on
                if not settings.inno then
                    if not settings.sheriff then
                        if not settings.murder then
                            if not settings.exp then
                                pulseRoleFarm.state = "Off"
                                pulseRoleFarm.role = nil
                                pulseRoleFarm.hold(false)
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                pulseRoleFarm.hook()
                local role, mineResult = pulseRoleFarm.mine()
                pulseRoleFarm.role = role
                if if role then not pulseRoleFarm.alive() else not role then
                    pulseRoleFarm.state = "Waiting"
                    pulseRoleFarm.hold(false)
                    if not role then
                        table.clear(pulseRoleFarm.seen)
                    end
                    return
                end
                pulseRoleFarm.count(mineResult)
                local lowerResult = role:lower()
                if lowerResult:find("murder") then
                    if settings.murder or settings.exp then
                        pulseRoleFarm.hold(true)
                        pulseRoleFarm.state = "Killing"
                        pulseRoleFarm.stabAll(mineResult)
                        return
                    end
                elseif lowerResult == "sheriff" then
                    if settings.sheriff or settings.exp then
                        pulseRoleFarm.hold(true)
                        pulseRoleFarm.toLobby()
                        pulseRoleFarm.state = "Shooting"
                        pulseRoleFarm.shoot(mineResult)
                        return
                    end
                elseif lowerResult == "hero" then
                    if settings.exp then
                        pulseRoleFarm.hold(true)
                        pulseRoleFarm.toLobby()
                        pulseRoleFarm.state = "Shooting"
                        pulseRoleFarm.shoot(mineResult)
                        return
                    elseif settings.inno then
                        pulseRoleFarm.hold(true)
                        pulseRoleFarm.toLobby()
                        pulseRoleFarm.state = "Surviving"
                        return
                    end
                elseif settings.exp then
                    pulseRoleFarm.hold(true)
                    pulseRoleFarm.expInnocent(mineResult)
                    return
                elseif settings.inno then
                    pulseRoleFarm.hold(true)
                    pulseRoleFarm.toLobby()
                    pulseRoleFarm.state = "Surviving"
                    return
                end
                pulseRoleFarm.hold(false)
                pulseRoleFarm.state = "Waiting"
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                while isActive() do
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    local success, result = pcall(pulseRoleFarm.step)
                    if not success then
                        pulseRoleFarm.say("ERR " .. tostring(result))
                        task.wait(1)
                    end
                end
                pulseRoleFarm.hold(false)
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes", 30)
                remotes = remotes and (remotes:WaitForChild("Gameplay", 30))
                local calculatedValue = remotes and (remotes:WaitForChild("VictoryScreen", 30))
                if calculatedValue then
                    if not (isActive()) then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                pulseRoleFarm.conns[#pulseRoleFarm.conns + 1] = calculatedValue.OnClientEvent:Connect(
                    function(rawgetResult, argument, argument2)
                        rawgetResult = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseGameSounds")
                        local calculatedValue = type(rawgetResult) == "table"
                            and rawgetResult.WIN
                            and rawgetResult.WIN[tostring(argument)]
                        if pulseRoleFarm.acted then
                            if calculatedValue then
                                if calculatedValue[tostring(argument2)] == true then
                                    pulseRoleFarm.wins = pulseRoleFarm.wins + 1
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        pulseRoleFarm.say("END " .. tostring(argument) .. " " .. tostring(argument2))
                        pulseRoleFarm.acted = false
                    end
                )
            end)
            callback(function()
                pulseRoleFarm.on.inno, pulseRoleFarm.on.sheriff, pulseRoleFarm.on.murder, pulseRoleFarm.on.exp =
                    false, false, false, false
                pulseRoleFarm.hold(false)
                for unused, item in ipairs(pulseRoleFarm.conns) do
                    pcall(function()
                        item:Disconnect()
                    end)
                end
                getgenv().__pulseRoleFarmUI = nil
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local entries2, callback3 =
                    {
                        Coin = { ru = "Coins", uk = "Coins" },
                        Role = { ru = "Role", uk = "Role" },
                        ["Role Farm"] = { ru = "Role Farm", uk = "Role Farm" },
                        ["Innocent Win Farm"] = {
                            ru = "Innocent Win Farm",
                            uk = "Innocent Win Farm",
                        },
                        ["Sheriff Win Farm"] = {
                            ru = "Sheriff Win Farm",
                            uk = "Sheriff Win Farm",
                        },
                        ["Murderer Kill Farm"] = {
                            ru = "Murderer Kill Farm",
                            uk = "Murderer Kill Farm",
                        },
                        ["EXP Farm"] = { ru = "EXP Farm", uk = "EXP Farm" },
                        Wins = { ru = "Wins", uk = "Wins" },
                        Kills = { ru = "Kills", uk = "Kills" },
                        Off = { ru = "Off", uk = "Off" },
                        Waiting = { ru = "Waiting", uk = "Waiting" },
                        Surviving = { ru = "Surviving", uk = "Surviving" },
                        Shooting = { ru = "Shooting", uk = "Shooting" },
                        Killing = { ru = "Killing", uk = "Killing" },
                        Flinging = { ru = "Fling", uk = "Fling" },
                        ["Picking Gun"] = { ru = "Picking Gun", uk = "Picking Gun" },
                        Innocent = { ru = "Innocent", uk = "Innocent" },
                        Sheriff = { ru = "Sheriff", uk = "Sheriff" },
                        Hero = { ru = "Hero", uk = "Hero" },
                        Murderer = { ru = "Murderer", uk = "Murderer" },
                    },
                    pairs
                for key, item in callback3(entries2) do
                    if localization.data.ru then
                        if localization.data.ru[key] == nil then
                            localization.data.ru[key] = item.ru
                        end
                    end
                    if localization.data.uk then
                        if localization.data.uk[key] == nil then
                            localization.data.uk[key] = item.uk
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            getgenv().__pulseRoleFarmUI = function(uiPage)
                uiPage:Sub("Role")
                uiPage:Header("Stats")
                local gridResult, entries2, entries3 =
                    uiPage:Grid({ Columns = 2, Height = 66, MinWidth = 150 }),

    constructors.createCameraNoclip = function(argument, instance, callback, argument2, argument3)
        return function()
            if type(argument.noclipCam) ~= "table" then
                argument.noclipCam = { on = false, key = "" }
            end
            local getgenvResult = getgenv()
            local pulseNoclipCam = rawget(getgenvResult, "__pulseNoclipCam")
            local value
            if type(pulseNoclipCam) ~= "table" then
                pulseNoclipCam = { on = false, hooked = false, mode = nil }
                getgenvResult.__pulseNoclipCam = pulseNoclipCam
                value = pulseNoclipCam
            else
                value = pulseNoclipCam
            end
            local function isActive()
                local playerScripts = instance:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
                local instance2 = playerScripts and (playerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule"))
                playerScripts = instance2 and (instance2:FindFirstChild("CameraModule"))
                instance2 = playerScripts and (playerScripts:FindFirstChild("ZoomController"))
                return instance2 and (instance2:FindFirstChild("Popper"))
            end
            local function isActive2()
                local value2 = isActive()
                if not value2 then
                    return nil
                end
                if type(getgc) == "function" then
                    local getFullNameResult = value2:GetFullName()
                    local value3
                    for infoResult, item in ipairs(getgc(false)) do
                        if type(item) == "function" and (type(islclosure) ~= "function" or islclosure(item)) then
                            local success, result, result2 = pcall(debug.info, item, "sa")
                            if
                                success
                                and type(result) == "string"
                                and (result == getFullNameResult or result:sub(-#value2.Name - 1) == "." .. value2.Name)
                            then
                                if result2 == 3 then
                                    infoResult = debug.info(item, "n")
                                    if infoResult == nil then
                                        value3 = item
                                        break
                                    elseif infoResult == "" then
                                        value3 = item
                                        break
                                    elseif string.lower(infoResult) == "popper" then
                                        value3 = item
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if value3 then
                        return value3
                    end
                end
                local success, result = pcall(require, value2)
                if success then
                    if type(result) == "function" then
                        return result
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function isActive3()
                if value.hooked then
                    return true
                end
                if type(hookfunction) ~= "function" then
                    return false
                end
                local value2 = isActive2()
                if not value2 then
                    return false
                end
                local hookfunctionResult
                local success = pcall(function()
                    hookfunctionResult = hookfunction(value2, function(argument4, argument5, argument6)
                        local rawgetResult = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseNoclipCam")
                        if rawgetResult then
                            if rawgetResult.on then
                                if rawgetResult.mode == "hook" then
                                    if type(argument5) == "number" then
                                        return argument5
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        rawgetResult = hookfunctionResult
                        return rawgetResult(argument4, argument5, argument6)
                    end)
                end)
                if success then
                    if hookfunctionResult then
                        value.hooked = true
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local devCameraOcclusionMode
            local function callback2(argument4)
                value.on = argument4 and true or false
                if value.on then
                    if isActive3() then
                        value.mode = "hook"
                    else
                        value.mode = "invisicam"
                        pcall(function()
                            if devCameraOcclusionMode == nil then
                                devCameraOcclusionMode = instance.DevCameraOcclusionMode
                            end
                            instance.DevCameraOcclusionMode = Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam
                        end)
                    end
                else
                    if value.mode == "invisicam" then
                        if devCameraOcclusionMode ~= nil then
                            pcall(function()
                                instance.DevCameraOcclusionMode = devCameraOcclusionMode
                            end)
                            devCameraOcclusionMode = nil
                        end
                    end
                    value.mode = nil
                end
            end
            callback(function()
                callback2(false)
            end)
            argument2:ToggleKey({
                Text = "No Clip Camera",
                Default = argument3.noclipCam and argument3.noclipCam.on,
                Bind = getgenv().__pulseBindFromName(argument.noclipCam.key or ""),
                Callback = function(argument4)
                    argument.noclipCam.on = argument4 and true or false
                    callback2(argument.noclipCam.on)
                end,
                OnBind = function(argument4)
                    argument.noclipCam.key = argument4 and argument4.Name or ""
                end,
            })
        end
    end

            local function callback2(argument)
                local entries2 = {}
                for key in (argument .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
                    entries2[#entries2 + 1] = key
                end
                while #entries2 > 0 and entries2[#entries2] == "" do
                    table.remove(entries2)
                end
                while #entries2 > 0 and entries2[1] == "" do
                    table.remove(entries2, 1)
                end
                return entries2
            end
            local function callback3(subResult)
                local value, value2, entries2 = callback2(subResult.art), callback2(subResult.map), {}
                for key, item in ipairs(value) do
                    local calculatedValue, entries3, count, calculatedValue2 = value2[key] or "", {}, #item, 1
                    while calculatedValue2 <= count do
                        subResult, key = calculatedValue:sub(calculatedValue2, calculatedValue2), calculatedValue2
                        while key < count and calculatedValue:sub(key + 1, key + 1) == subResult do
                            key += 1
                        end
                        local gsubResult, entry = item:sub(calculatedValue2, key):gsub("%*", "•"), entries.COL[subResult]
                        entries3[#entries3 + 1] = entry and '<font color="' .. entry .. '">' .. gsubResult .. "</font>"
                            or gsubResult
                        calculatedValue2 = key + 1
                    end
                    entries2[#entries2 + 1] = table.concat(entries3)
                end
                return table.concat(entries2, "\n"), #value
            end
            local function isActive2()
                if entries.lbl then
                    if entries.lbl.Parent then
                        return entries.lbl
                    end
                end
                local regularLobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
                local calculatedValue = regularLobby
                    and regularLobby:FindFirstChild("MainLobby")
                    and regularLobby.MainLobby:FindFirstChild("Parts")
                if calculatedValue then
                    for surfaceGui, instance in ipairs(calculatedValue:GetChildren()) do
                        surfaceGui = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceGui")
                        instance = surfaceGui and (surfaceGui:FindFirstChild("Title"))
                        if instance then
                            if instance:IsA("TextLabel") then
                                if instance.Text == entries.orig then
                                    return instance
                                elseif instance.Text == entries.text then
                                    return instance
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if regularLobby and os.clock() - entries.lastScan > 30 then
                    entries.lastScan = os.clock()
                    for unused, instance in ipairs(regularLobby:GetDescendants()) do
                        if instance:IsA("TextLabel") then
                            if instance.Text == entries.orig then
                                return instance
                            elseif instance.Text == entries.text then
                                return instance
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function isActive3()
                local entries2, callback4 = {}, ipairs
                for unused, localPlayer2 in callback4(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
                    if localPlayer2.Character then
                        entries2[#entries2 + 1] = localPlayer2.Character
                    end
                end
                for unused, item in pairs(entries.parts) do
                    if item then
                        entries2[#entries2 + 1] = item
                    end
                end
                return entries2
            end
            local function callback4(argument, argument3, argument4)
                local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                local filterDescendantsInstances = isActive3()
                for index = 1, 10, 1 do
                    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
                    index = workspace:Raycast(argument, -argument3 * 40, raycastParams)
                    if not index then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local dotResult = (index.Position - argument):Dot(-argument3)
                    if index.Instance.Transparency < 0.9 then
                        if index.Normal:Dot(argument3) > 0.7 then
                            if dotResult >= (argument4 or 0) then
                                return dotResult
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = index.Instance
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function callback5(position)
                position = Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z)
                return position.Magnitude > 0.1 and position.Unit or nil
            end

            entries.newLobby = function()
                if workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby") then
                    return nil
                end
                local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
                local sp = lobby and (lobby:FindFirstChild("Spawns"))
                if not (sp and (lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePads"))) then
                    return nil
                end
                local nl = entries.nl
                if nl then
                    if nl.L == lobby then
                        if nl.sp == sp then
                            if nl.L.Parent then
                                return nl
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local success, invisibleWalls = pcall(function()
                    return sp:GetBoundingBox()
                end)
                if not success then
                    return nil
                end
                local plaza, raycastParams = invisibleWalls.Position, RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                success, invisibleWalls = isActive3(), lobby:FindFirstChild("InvisibleWalls")
                if invisibleWalls then
                    success[#success + 1] = invisibleWalls
                end
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = success
                invisibleWalls = workspace:Raycast(plaza + Vector3.new(0, 18, 0), Vector3.new(-120, 0, 0), raycastParams)
                if invisibleWalls then
                    if math.abs(invisibleWalls.Normal.Y) > 0.2 then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end
                success = callback5(invisibleWalls.Normal)
                if not success then
                    return nil
                end
                local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(
                    Vector3.new(invisibleWalls.Position.X, plaza.Y + 4, invisibleWalls.Position.Z) + success * 4,
                    Vector3.new(0, -20, 0),
                    raycastParams
                )
                raycastParams = raycastResult and raycastResult.Position.Y or plaza.Y
                nl = {
                    L = lobby,
                    sp = sp,
                    plaza = plaza,
                    n = success,
                    t = Vector3.yAxis:Cross(success),
                    base = Vector3.new(invisibleWalls.Position.X, raycastParams, invisibleWalls.Position.Z),
                    floor = raycastParams,
                }
                entries.nl = nl
                return nl
            end
            entries.wallSpot = function(argument, argument3, argument4, argument5, argument6)
                local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 = argument.base
                    + argument.t * argument3
                    + Vector3.new(0, argument4, 0)
                for index = -4, 4, 1 do
                    for index2 = -2, 2, 1 do
                        argument4 = callback4(
                            calculatedValue
                                + argument.t * (index * (argument5 / 2 - 0.3) / 4)
                                + Vector3.new(0, index2 * (argument6 / 2 - 0.3) / 2, 0)
                                + argument.n * 3,
                            argument.n,
                            0
                        )
                        calculatedValue2 = if argument4
                            then if calculatedValue2
                                then if argument4 < calculatedValue2 then argument4 else calculatedValue2
                                else argument4
                            else calculatedValue2
                    end
                end
                if not calculatedValue2 then
                    return nil
                end
                return calculatedValue + argument.n * 3 - argument.n * (calculatedValue2 - 0.03), argument.n
            end
            entries.PIECES[1].spot = function(instance, calculatedValue)
                local newLobbyResult = entries.newLobby()
                if newLobbyResult then
                    local face = entries.NEW.face
                    return entries.wallSpot(newLobbyResult, face.u, face.h, instance, calculatedValue)
                end
                instance = isActive2()
                calculatedValue = instance and (instance:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui"))
                instance = calculatedValue and calculatedValue.Parent
                if instance then
                    if not (instance:IsA("BasePart")) then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end
                calculatedValue = callback5(instance.CFrame.RightVector)
                if not calculatedValue then
                    return nil
                end
                newLobbyResult = instance.Position + Vector3.new(0, 11.3, 0)
                instance = callback4(newLobbyResult + calculatedValue * 0.5, calculatedValue) or 9.92
                return newLobbyResult + calculatedValue * 0.5 - calculatedValue * (instance - 0.03), calculatedValue
            end

                    isActive3(), newLobbyResult.L:FindFirstChild("InvisibleWalls")

                    filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = invisibleWalls
                end
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
                invisibleWalls = workspace:Raycast(
                    newLobbyResult.plaza + Vector3.new(0, entries.NEW.hvh.h, 0),
                    Vector3.new(120, 0, 0),

                    if math.abs(invisibleWalls.Normal.Y) > 0.2 then
                        return nil

                    return nil
                end

                if not raycastParams then
                    return nil
                end

                    n = raycastParams,

            entries.b64 = function(argument)
                local concatResult, entries2 =
                    ipairs, { crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode }
                for unused, item in concatResult(entries2) do
                    if type(item) == "function" then
                        local success, result = pcall(item, argument)
                        if success then
                            if type(result) == "string" then
                                if #result > 0 then
                                    return result
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                entries2, concatResult = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", {}
                for index = 1, 64, 1 do
                    concatResult[entries2:byte(index)] = index - 1
                end
                entries2 = {}
                for index = 1, #argument - 3, 4 do
                    local byteResult, byteResult2, byteResult3, byteResult4 = argument:byte(index, index + 3)
                    index = (concatResult[byteResult] or 0) * 262144
                        + (concatResult[byteResult2] or 0) * 4096
                        + (concatResult[byteResult3] or 0) * 64
                        + (concatResult[byteResult4] or 0)
                    entries2[#entries2 + 1] = string.char(index // 65536, index // 256 % 256, index % 256)
                end
                concatResult = table.concat(entries2)
                return if argument:sub(-2) == "=="
                    then concatResult:sub(1, -3)
                    else if argument:sub(-1) == "=" then concatResult:sub(1, -2) else concatResult
            end
            entries.hqAsset = function(argument)
                entries.hqA = entries.hqA or {}
                if entries.hqA[argument] then
                    return entries.hqA[argument]
                end
                if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
                    return nil
                elseif type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
                    return nil
                end
                local calculatedValue = "PulseHub/troll_hq_v1_" .. argument .. ".png"
                pcall(function()
                    if type(isfolder) == "function" then
                        if type(makefolder) == "function" then
                            if not (isfolder("PulseHub")) then
                                makefolder("PulseHub")
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(calculatedValue)) then
                        local entry = entries.HQ[argument]
                        if type(entry) == "string" then
                            if #entry < 64 then
                                local rawgetResult = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseData")
                                entry = rawgetResult and rawgetResult.take(entry) or nil
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        if type(entry) ~= "string" then
                            return
                        elseif #entry < 64 then
                            return
                        end
                        writefile(calculatedValue, entries.b64(entry))
                    end
                    local getcustomassetResult = getcustomasset(calculatedValue)
                    if type(getcustomassetResult) == "string" then
                        if #getcustomassetResult > 0 then
                            entries.hqA[argument] = getcustomassetResult
                        end
                    end
                end)
                return entries.hqA[argument]
            end

            local function isActive4()
                if entries.gm ~= nil then
                    return entries.gm
                end
                entries.gm = false
                local gm, entries2, concatResult =
                    ipairs, { crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode }
                for unused, item in gm(entries2) do
                    if type(item) == "function" then
                        local success, result = pcall(item, entries.GLYPHS)
                        if success then
                            if type(result) == "string" then
                                if #result == #entries.GORDER * 360 then
                                    concatResult = result
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if concatResult then
                else
                    entries2, gm = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", {}
                    for index = 1, 64, 1 do
                        gm[entries2:byte(index)] = index - 1
                    end
                    local glyphs, entries2 = entries.GLYPHS, {}
                    for index = 1, #glyphs - 3, 4 do
                        local byteResult, byteResult2, byteResult3, byteResult4 = glyphs:byte(index, index + 3)
                        index = (gm[byteResult] or 0) * 262144
                            + (gm[byteResult2] or 0) * 4096
                            + (gm[byteResult3] or 0) * 64
                            + (gm[byteResult4] or 0)
                        entries2[#entries2 + 1] = string.char(index // 65536, index // 256 % 256, index % 256)
                    end
                    concatResult = table.concat(entries2)
                    concatResult = if glyphs:sub(-2) == "=="
                        then concatResult:sub(1, -3)
                        else if glyphs:sub(-1) == "=" then concatResult:sub(1, -2) else concatResult
                    if #concatResult ~= #entries.GORDER * 360 then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                gm = {}
                for key, item in ipairs(entries.GORDER) do
                    gm[item] = { f = (key - 1) * 360, s = (key - 1) * 360 + 180 }
                end
                entries.graw = buffer.fromstring(concatResult)
                entries.gm = gm
                return gm
            end

            local function handleAction(argument)
                if argument.building then
                    return
                end
                if argument.hq then
                    local success, result = pcall(entries.buildHQ, argument)
                    if success then
                        if result then
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
                local part, value = callback2(argument.art), callback2(argument.map)
                local count, counter = #part, 0
                for unused, item in ipairs(part) do
                    counter = if #item > counter then #item else counter
                end
                local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 = counter * 8 + 2, 16 + (count - 1) * 12 + 2
                local textBounds = argument.height * calculatedValue / calculatedValue2
                local spotResult, spotResult2 = argument.spot(textBounds, argument.height)
                if not spotResult then
                    return
                end
                argument.building = true
                local surfaceGui, result = pcall(pulseNVResult, part, value, calculatedValue, calculatedValue2)
                argument.building = false
                result = if surfaceGui then result else nil
                if entries.parts[argument.name] and entries.parts[argument.name].Parent then
                    for unused, item in ipairs(result or {}) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item.img:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    return
                end
                if result then
                    part = Instance.new("Part")
                    part.Name = argument.name
                    part.Anchored = true
                    part.CanCollide = false
                    part.CanQuery = false
                    part.CanTouch = false
                    part.CastShadow = false
                    part.Transparency = 1
                    part.Size = Vector3.new(textBounds, argument.height, 0.05)
                    part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(spotResult, spotResult + spotResult2)
                    surfaceGui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                    surfaceGui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
                    surfaceGui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
                    surfaceGui.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(calculatedValue, calculatedValue2)
                    surfaceGui.LightInfluence = 0
                    surfaceGui.Brightness = 1.25
                    surfaceGui.ZOffset = 1
                    surfaceGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
                    surfaceGui.Parent = part
                    for imageLabel, item in ipairs(result) do
                        imageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                        imageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        imageLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
                        imageLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(item.x0, 0)
                        imageLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(item.w, calculatedValue2)
                        imageLabel.ImageContent = Content.fromObject(item.img)
                        imageLabel.Parent = surfaceGui
                    end
                    part.Parent = workspace
                    entries.parts[argument.name] = part
                    entries.imgs = entries.imgs or {}
                    for unused, item in ipairs(entries.imgs[argument.name] or {}) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item.img:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    entries.imgs[argument.name] = result
                    return
                end
                local text, textSize, lineHeight, part2 = callback3(argument), 16, 0.75, Instance.new("Part")
                part2.Name = argument.name
                part2.Anchored = true
                part2.CanCollide = false
                part2.CanQuery = false
                part2.CanTouch = false
                part2.CastShadow = false
                part2.Transparency = 1
                part2.Size = Vector3.new(textBounds, argument.height, 0.05)
                part2.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(spotResult, spotResult + spotResult2)
                surfaceGui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                surfaceGui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
                surfaceGui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
                surfaceGui.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(
                    math.ceil(textBounds / argument.height * count * lineHeight * textSize),
                    math.ceil(count * lineHeight * textSize)
                )
                surfaceGui.LightInfluence = 0
                surfaceGui.Brightness = 1.25
                surfaceGui.ZOffset = 1
                surfaceGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
                surfaceGui.Parent = part2
                part = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                part.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                part.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                part.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/RobotoMono.json", Enum.FontWeight.Heavy)
                part.TextSize = textSize
                part.LineHeight = lineHeight
                part.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                part.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
                part.TextWrapped = false
                part.RichText = true
                part.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 43, 43)
                part.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 0, 0)
                part.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
                part.Text = text
                part.Parent = surfaceGui
                part2.Parent = workspace
                entries.parts[argument.name] = part2
                task.wait()
                textBounds = part.TextBounds
                if textBounds.X > 10 then
                    if textBounds.Y > 10 then
                        surfaceGui.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(math.ceil(textBounds.X) + 2, math.ceil(textBounds.Y) + 2)

                pulseNpcSounds.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
                pulseNpc.sgrp = pulseNpcSounds
                return pulseNpcSounds
            end

            pulseNpc.syllable = function()
                pulseNpc.voiceInit()
                pulseNpc.vi = pulseNpc.vi % #pulseNpc.voices + 1
                local entry = pulseNpc.voices[pulseNpc.vi]
                if not entry or entry.TimeLength <= 0.3 then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    entry:Stop()
                    entry.PlaybackSpeed = 1.08 + math.random() * 0.28
                    entry.TimePosition = math.random() * math.max(0, entry.TimeLength - 0.3)
                    entry.Volume = 0.55
                    entry:Play()
                    local calculatedValue = 0.085 + math.random() * 0.06
                    task.delay(calculatedValue, function()
                        if not entry.Parent then
                            return
                        end
                        tweenService:Create(entry, TweenInfo.new(0.05), { Volume = 0 }):Play()
                        task.delay(0.06, function()
                            if entry.Volume <= 0.01 then
                                pcall(function()
                                    entry:Stop()
                                end)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                end)
            end
            pulseNpc.loadAnims = function(argument)

                        loadAnimationResult.Looped = key == "idle"
                        loadAnimationResult.Priority = (key == "idle" or key == "look") and Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
                            or Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                        pulseNpc.anims[key] = loadAnimationResult

            pulseNpc.gesture = function(argument)
                local calculatedValue = argument and pulseNpc.anims[argument]
                if not calculatedValue then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    for key, item in pairs(pulseNpc.anims) do
                        if key ~= "idle" then
                            if key ~= argument then
                                if item.IsPlaying then
                                    item:Stop(0.25)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    calculatedValue.Looped = false
                    calculatedValue:Play(0.2)
                    task.delay(argument == "laugh" and 2.2 or 2.4, function()
                        pcall(function()
                            if calculatedValue.IsPlaying then
                                calculatedValue:Stop(0.4)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                end)
            end

            pulseNpc.safe = function()
                local safeL, safeR, safeB = 0, 0, 0
                pcall(function()
                    local parent, probe = isActive4(), pulseNpc.probe
                    if probe and probe.Parent then
                    else
                        probe = createInstance(
                            "ScreenGui",
                            {
                                Name = "PulseNpcSafe",
                                ResetOnSpawn = false,
                                IgnoreGuiInset = true,
                                ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets,
                                DisplayOrder = -10,
                            }
                        )
                        createInstance(
                            "Frame",
                            { Name = "Area", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1 },
                            probe
                        )
                        probe.Parent = parent
                        pulseNpc.probe = probe
                    end
                    local value, area = pulseNpc.vp(), probe:FindFirstChild("Area")
                    if value then
                        if area then
                            if value.X > 0 then
                                local absolutePosition, absoluteSize = area.AbsolutePosition, area.AbsoluteSize
                                safeL = math.max(0, absolutePosition.X)
                                safeR = math.max(0, value.X - (absolutePosition.X + absoluteSize.X))
                                safeB = math.max(0, value.Y - (absolutePosition.Y + absoluteSize.Y))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                pulseNpc.safeL = safeL
                pulseNpc.safeR = safeR
                pulseNpc.safeB = safeB
                local value, value2, value3 = safeL, safeR, safeB
                return value, value2, value3
            end
            pulseNpc.leftPos = function(argument)

                if pulseNpc.opts then

            pulseNpc.b64 = function(argument)
                local callback5, entries2 =
                    ipairs, { crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode }
                for unused, item in callback5(entries2) do
                    if type(item) == "function" then
                        local success, result = pcall(item, argument)
                        if success then
                            if type(result) == "string" then
                                if #result > 200 then
                                    return result
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.icons = function()
                if pulseNpc.iconAsset ~= nil then
                    return pulseNpc.iconAsset
                end
                pulseNpc.iconAsset = false
                pcall(function()
                    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
                        return
                    elseif type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
                        return
                    end
                    local success, result, value =
                        ipairs, { crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode }
                    for unused, item in success(result) do
                        if type(item) == "function" then
                            local success2, result2 = pcall(item, pulseNpc.ICONS)
                            if success2 then
                                if type(result2) == "string" then
                                    if #result2 > 200 then
                                        value = result2
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not value then
                        return
                    end
                    pcall(makefolder, "PulseHub")
                    writefile("PulseHub/npc_icons_v1.png", value)
                    success, result = pcall(getcustomasset, "PulseHub/npc_icons_v1.png")
                    if success then
                        if type(result) == "string" then
                            if result ~= "" then
                                pulseNpc.iconAsset = result
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                return pulseNpc.iconAsset
            end
            pulseNpc.hideScan = function(argument)

                                    instance:IsA("ScreenGui")
