                                then
                                    if instance.Enabled then
                                        argument.set[instance] = true
                                        argument.guis[#argument.guis + 1] = instance
                                        instance.Enabled = false
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                callback5(localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"), false)
                pcall(function()
                    callback5(isActive4(), true)
                end)
            end
            pulseNpc.hideOn = function()
                local starterGui, hid = game:GetService("StarterGui"), pulseNpc.hid
                if hid then
                    hid.off = false
                    if hid.back then
                        hid.back = false
                        for unused, item in ipairs(hid.core) do
                            pcall(starterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, starterGui, item, false)
                        end
                        for unused, item in ipairs(hid.fx) do
                            pcall(function()
                                item.Enabled = false
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    return
                end
                local hid2 =
                    { guis = {}, set = {}, core = {}, fx = {}, ltm = {}, camSeen = {}, a = 0, off = false, scanAt = 0 }
                pulseNpc.hid = hid2
                pulseNpc.hideScan(hid2)
                for unused, item in ipairs(Enum.CoreGuiType:GetEnumItems()) do
                    if item ~= Enum.CoreGuiType.All then
                        local success, result = pcall(starterGui.GetCoreGuiEnabled, starterGui, item)
                        if success then
                            if result then
                                hid2.core[#hid2.core + 1] = item
                                pcall(starterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, starterGui, item, false)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local function grab(instance)
                    if instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:IsA("Decal") then
                        if hid2.ltm[instance] == nil then
                            hid2.ltm[instance] = instance.LocalTransparencyModifier
                        end
                    elseif
                        instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                        or instance:IsA("Trail")
                        or instance:IsA("Beam")
                        or instance:IsA("Fire")
                        or instance:IsA("Smoke")
                        or instance:IsA("Sparkles")
                    then
                        if instance.Enabled then
                            hid2.fx[#hid2.fx + 1] = instance
                            instance.Enabled = false
                        end
                    end
                end
                hid2.grab = grab
                starterGui = localPlayer.Character
                if starterGui then
                    for unused, item in ipairs(starterGui:GetDescendants()) do
                        grab(item)
                    end
                end
                pulseNpc.hideCam(hid2)
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcHide")
                end)
                starterGui, grab =
                    Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value, function(argument)
                        pcall(pulseNpc.hideStep, argument)
                    end
                runService:BindToRenderStep("PulseNpcHide", starterGui + 3, grab)
            end
            pulseNpc.selfPts = function()
                local character, entries2 = localPlayer.Character, {}
                if character then
                    local entries3 = { "Head", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" }
                    for instance, item in ipairs(entries3) do
                        instance = character:FindFirstChild(item)
                        if instance then
                            if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                entries2[#entries2 + 1] = instance.Position
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return entries2
            end
            pulseNpc.liveSkin = function()
                local camera, selfPtsResult = workspace.CurrentCamera, pulseNpc.selfPts()
                local value, value2
                for huge, instance in ipairs(camera and camera:GetChildren() or {}) do
                    if instance.Name == "PulseSkin" then
                        if instance:IsA("Model") then
                            local success, result = pcall(instance.GetPivot, instance)
                            if success then
                                huge = math.huge
                                for unused, item in ipairs(selfPtsResult) do
                                    huge = math.min(huge, (result.Position - item).Magnitude)
                                end
                                if value then
                                    if huge < value then
                                        value, value2 = huge, instance
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                    value, value2 = huge, instance
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                return value2
            end
            pulseNpc.hideCam = function(argument)
                local selfPtsResult, entries2, pulseTrail = pulseNpc.selfPts(), {}, workspace.CurrentCamera
                for unused, item in ipairs(pulseTrail and pulseTrail:GetChildren() or {}) do
                    entries2[#entries2 + 1] = item
                end
                pulseTrail = workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
                for unused, item in ipairs(pulseTrail and pulseTrail:GetChildren() or {}) do
                    entries2[#entries2 + 1] = item
                end
                pulseTrail = workspace:FindFirstChild("PulseTrail")
                for unused, item in ipairs(pulseTrail and pulseTrail:GetChildren() or {}) do
                    entries2[#entries2 + 1] = item
                end
                for key, instance in ipairs(entries2) do
                    if not argument.camSeen[instance] then
                        key = instance.Name == "PulseSkin" or instance.Parent == pulseTrail
                        if key then
                        else
                            local success, result = pcall(function()
                                if instance:IsA("Model") then
                                    return instance:GetPivot()
                                end
                                if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                    return instance.CFrame
                                end
                            end)
                            if success then
                                if result then
                                    local enabled = key
                                    for unused, item in ipairs(selfPtsResult) do
                                        if (result.Position - item).Magnitude < 10 then
                                            enabled = true
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                    key = enabled
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                        if key then
                            argument.camSeen[instance] = true
                            argument.grab(instance)
                            for unused, item in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
                                argument.grab(item)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.restoreUi = function(argument)
                if argument.back then
                    return
                end
                argument.back = true
                for unused, item in ipairs(argument.guis) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if item.Parent then
                            if not item.Enabled then
                                item.Enabled = true
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                local starterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
                for unused, item in ipairs(argument.core) do
                    pcall(starterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, starterGui, item, true)
                end
                for unused, item in ipairs(argument.fx) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if item.Parent then
                            item.Enabled = true
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.hideStep = function(argument)
                local hid = pulseNpc.hid
                if not hid then
                    return
                end
                hid.a = math.clamp(hid.a + (hid.off and -argument or argument) / 0.45, 0, 1)
                argument = callback7(hid.a)
                for key, item in pairs(hid.ltm) do
                    if key.Parent then
                        key.LocalTransparencyModifier = item + (1 - item) * argument
                    end
                end
                if hid.off then
                    if os.clock() - hid.offAt > 0.3 then
                        pulseNpc.restoreUi(hid)
                    end
                    if hid.a <= 0 then
                        if hid.back then
                            pulseNpc.hideEnd()
                        end
                    end
                else
                    if os.clock() - hid.scanAt > 0.5 then
                        hid.scanAt = os.clock()
                        pulseNpc.hideScan(hid)
                        pcall(pulseNpc.hideCam, hid)
                    end
                    for unused, item in ipairs(hid.guis) do
                        if item.Enabled then
                            item.Enabled = false
                        end
                    end
                    for unused, item in ipairs(hid.fx) do
                        if item.Parent then
                            if item.Enabled then
                                item.Enabled = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.hideOff = function()
                local hid = pulseNpc.hid
                if not hid then
                    return
                end
                hid.off, hid.offAt = true, os.clock()
            end
            pulseNpc.hideEnd = function()
                local hid = pulseNpc.hid
                pulseNpc.hid = nil
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcHide")
                end)
                if not hid then
                    return
                end
                pulseNpc.restoreUi(hid)
                for key, localTransparencyModifier in pairs(hid.ltm) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if key.Parent then
                            key.LocalTransparencyModifier = localTransparencyModifier
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            pulseNpc.promptUi = function(argument)
                local prompt = pulseNpc.prompt
                if not (prompt and pulseNpc.hrp) then
                    return
                end
                pulseNpc.hud()
                local proot = pulseNpc.proot
                pcall(function()
                    local keyboardKeyCode = prompt.KeyboardKeyCode
                    pulseNpc.pkey.Text = keyboardKeyCode and keyboardKeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and keyboardKeyCode.Name
                        or "G"
                    pulseNpc.pact.Text = callback2("Talk")
                end)
                pulseNpc.pShown = argument and not pulseNpc.isOpen
                local pscale, scale = pulseNpc.pscale, pulseNpc.hs or 1
                if pulseNpc.pShown then
                    proot.Visible = true
                    pscale.Scale = 0.75 * scale
                    pulseNpc.pAnimEnd = os.clock() + 0.3
                    callback8(pscale, 0.26, { Scale = scale }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                else
                    pulseNpc.pAnimEnd = os.clock() + 0.2
                    local function handleAction2()
                        if not pulseNpc.pShown then
                            proot.Visible = false
                        end
                    end
                    callback8(pscale, 0.12, { Scale = 0.75 * scale }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In).Completed:Connect(
                        handleAction2
                    )
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.hudStep = function()
                local hrp, visible, proot = pulseNpc.hrp, pulseNpc.tagF, pulseNpc.proot
                if hrp then
                    if hrp.Parent then
                        if visible then
                            if not visible.Parent then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not camera then
                    return
                end
                local position, visible2 = camera.CFrame.Position, hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, pulseNpc.lift or 3, 0)
                local camDist = (position - visible2).Magnitude
                pulseNpc.camDist = camDist
                if camDist > 120 then
                    if not pulseNpc.dance then
                        if not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                            if not proot.Visible then
                                if visible.Visible then
                                    visible.Visible = false
                                end
                                if pulseNpc.pigTag then
                                    if pulseNpc.pigTag.Visible then
                                        pulseNpc.pigTag.Visible = false
                                    end
                                end
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                pulseNpc.hs = math.clamp(camera.ViewportSize.Y / 1000, 0.6, 1.35)
                local now = os.clock()
                if now - (pulseNpc.occAt or 0) > 0.15 then
                    pulseNpc.occAt = now
                    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = isActive3()
                    raycastParams.RespectCanCollide = false
                    local calculatedValue = visible2 - position
                    local calculatedValue2 = camDist < 90 and workspace:Raycast(position, calculatedValue, raycastParams)
                    pulseNpc.occluded = calculatedValue2
                            and calculatedValue2.Instance.Transparency < 0.9
                            and (calculatedValue2.Position - position).Magnitude < calculatedValue.Magnitude - 0.5
                        or false
                end
                local visible3, myRootResult = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(visible2)
                visible2 = myRootResult
                    and visible3.Z > 0
                    and camDist < 80
                    and not pulseNpc.occluded
                    and not pulseNpc.isOpen
                visible.Visible = visible2
                if visible2 then
                    visible.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(visible3.X + 0.5), math.floor(visible3.Y + 0.5))
                    pulseNpc.tagScale.Scale = math.clamp(16 / math.max(camDist, 1), 0.7, 1.15) * pulseNpc.hs
                    myRootResult = pulseNpc.myRoot()
                    local calculatedValue = myRootResult ~= nil and (myRootResult.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 20
                    pulseNpc.bub.Visible = calculatedValue and not pulseNpc.dance
                    local dance = pulseNpc.dance
                    if dance and dance.running and not dance.ending then
                        pulseNpc.lyrStep(dance.t or 0)
                    elseif pulseNpc.lyrL then
                        pulseNpc.lyrL.Visible = false
                    end
                    if calculatedValue and not pulseNpc.dance then
                        pulseNpc.bub.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, math.floor(-48 + math.sin(now * 2.6) * 3 + 0.5))
                        for roundedValue, item in ipairs(pulseNpc.dots) do
                            dance = (math.sin(now * 6.5 - roundedValue * 1.1) + 1) / 2
                            roundedValue = math.floor(5 + dance * 2.5 + 0.5)
                            item.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(roundedValue, roundedValue)
                            item.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 - dance * 0.45
                        end
                    end
                end
                visible = pulseNpc.sLyrF
                if visible then
                    visible2 = pulseNpc.dance
                    camDist = visible2 and visible2.tv and visible2.tv.F
                    myRootResult, visible3 = camDist and camDist.P and camDist.P.Head, false
                    if myRootResult then
                        if myRootResult.Parent then
                            if visible2.running then
                                if visible2.ending then
                                else
                                    if pulseNpc.isOpen then
                                    else
                                        local calculatedValue = myRootResult.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.7, 0)
                                        local worldToViewportPointResult, worldToViewportPointResult2 =
                                            camera:WorldToViewportPoint(calculatedValue)
                                        local magnitude = (position - calculatedValue).Magnitude
                                        if worldToViewportPointResult2 then
                                            if worldToViewportPointResult.Z > 0 then
                                                if magnitude < 80 then
                                                    visible.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
                                                        math.floor(worldToViewportPointResult.X + 0.5),
                                                        math.floor(worldToViewportPointResult.Y + 0.5)
                                                    )
                                                    pulseNpc.sLyrBase.Scale = math.clamp(
                                                        16 / math.max(magnitude, 1),
                                                        0.7,
                                                        1.15
                                                    ) * pulseNpc.hs
                                                    visible3 = pulseNpc.lyrDraw(
                                                        pulseNpc.sLyrL,
                                                        pulseNpc.sLyrScale,

            pulseNpc.join = function()
                task.spawn(function()
                    local pulseDiscordInvite = setclipboard or toclipboard
                    if pulseDiscordInvite then
                        pcall(pulseDiscordInvite, "https://discord.gg/KgUdRfg")
                    end
                    pulseDiscordInvite = getgenv().__pulseDiscordInvite
                    if pulseDiscordInvite then
                        pcall(pulseDiscordInvite, "KgUdRfg")
                    end
                end)
                pulseNpc.show("joined")
            end
            pulseNpc.show = function(argument)
                local entry = pulseNpc.TREE[argument]
                if not entry or not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                    return
                end
                pulseNpc.seq = pulseNpc.seq + 1
                local seq = pulseNpc.seq
                pulseNpc.hot = {}
                pulseNpc.clearOpts(true)
                local text = callback2(entry.text)
                pulseNpc.body.Text = text
                pulseNpc.body.MaxVisibleGraphemes = 0
                pulseNpc.skip = false
                if entry.gesture then
                    pulseNpc.gesture(entry.gesture)
                end
                task.spawn(function()
                    local entries2 = {}
                    for unused, item in utf8.codes(text) do
                        entries2[#entries2 + 1] = utf8.char(item)
                    end
                    local count, now = #entries2, os.clock()
                    pulseNpc.talking = true
                    local counter, counter2 = 0, 0
                    while counter < count and pulseNpc.isOpen and pulseNpc.seq == seq do
                        local maxVisibleGraphemes = pulseNpc.skip and count
                            or math.min(count, math.floor((os.clock() - now) * 52))
                        if pulseNpc.skip then
                        else
                            for index = counter + 1, maxVisibleGraphemes, 1 do
                                local entry2 = entries2[index]
                                if entry2 then
                                    if entry2:match("[%a\128-\255]") then
                                        if os.clock() - counter2 > 0.075 then
                                            local matchResult = (entries2[index - 1] or " "):match("[%a\128-\255]")
                                            if if matchResult then index % 3 == 0 else not matchResult then
                                                local now = os.clock()
                                                pulseNpc.syllable()
                                                counter2 = now
                                            else
                                            end
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        pulseNpc.body.MaxVisibleGraphemes = maxVisibleGraphemes
                        if maxVisibleGraphemes < count then
                            runService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                        end
                        counter = maxVisibleGraphemes
                    end
                    pulseNpc.talking = false
                    if pulseNpc.seq ~= seq then
                        return
                    elseif not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                        return
                    end
                    pulseNpc.body.MaxVisibleGraphemes = -1
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    if pulseNpc.seq ~= seq then
                        return
                    elseif not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                        return
                    end
                    for key, item in ipairs(entry.opts) do
                        local entry2 = item[2]
                        pulseNpc.button(item[1], key, function()
                            if entry2 == false then
                                pulseNpc.close()
                            elseif entry2 == "join" then
                                pulseNpc.join()
                            elseif entry2 == "verity" then
                                pulseNpc.cutPlay()
                            else
                                pulseNpc.show(entry2)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function callback5(argument)
                return CFrame.lookAt(argument.Position, argument.Position + argument.LookVector)
            end
            pulseNpc.camShot = function()
                local calculatedValue, position =
                    pulseNpc.hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, (pulseNpc.lift or 3) - 1.15, 0), pulseNpc.myRoot()
                local calculatedValue2 = position and position.Position or calculatedValue + pulseNpc.home.LookVector * 6
                calculatedValue2 = if (calculatedValue2 - calculatedValue).Magnitude > 30
                    then calculatedValue + pulseNpc.home.LookVector * 6
                    else calculatedValue2
                position = Vector3.new(calculatedValue.X - calculatedValue2.X, 0, calculatedValue.Z - calculatedValue2.Z)
                local magnitude = position.Magnitude
                position = magnitude > 0.5 and position.Unit or -pulseNpc.home.LookVector
                local unit = position:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)).Unit
                local calculatedValue2, raycastParams =
                    calculatedValue - position * math.clamp(magnitude + 3.2, 6.5, 9) + unit * 2.2 + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0),
                    RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = isActive3()
                position = workspace:Raycast(calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 - calculatedValue, raycastParams)
                calculatedValue2 = if position
                    then calculatedValue + (calculatedValue2 - calculatedValue).Unit * math.max(
                        2.5,
                        (position.Position - calculatedValue).Magnitude - 0.6
                    )
                    else calculatedValue2
                return CFrame.lookAt(calculatedValue2, calculatedValue + unit * 0.55 - Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0))
            end
            pulseNpc.camStep = function()
                local camera, cam = workspace.CurrentCamera, pulseNpc.cam
                if camera then
                    if not cam then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                if cam.mode == "cut" then
                    local cut = pulseNpc.cut
                    if cut then
                        if cut.cf then
                            camera.CFrame = cut.cf
                            camera.FieldOfView = cut.fov
                        end
                    end
                    return
                end
                local now = os.clock()
                local calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 =
                    cam.shot * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(now * 0.6) * 0.004, math.sin(now * 0.45) * 0.006, 0), cam.fov * 0.8
                if cam.mode == "in" then
                    local value = callback7((now - cam.t0) / 0.7)
                    camera.CFrame = cam.start:Lerp(calculatedValue, value)
                    camera.FieldOfView = cam.fovStart + (calculatedValue2 - cam.fovStart) * value
                else
                    local value, home, myRootResult = callback7((now - cam.t0) / 0.5), cam.home, pulseNpc.myRoot()
                    if myRootResult then
                        if cam.me0 then
                            if (myRootResult.Position - cam.me0).Magnitude > 40 then
                                pulseNpc.camEnd()
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        pulseNpc.camEnd()
                        return
                    end
                    home = if cam.me0 then home + (myRootResult.Position - cam.me0) else home
                    camera.CFrame = cam.start:Lerp(home, value)
                    camera.FieldOfView = cam.fovStart + (cam.fov - cam.fovStart) * value
                    if value >= 1 then
                        pulseNpc.camEnd()
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.camEnd = function()
                local cam = pulseNpc.cam
                pulseNpc.cam = nil
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcCam")
                end)
                local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam and camera then
                    pcall(function()
                        camera.FieldOfView = cam.fov
                        if camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
                            camera.CameraType = cam.ctype
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.camOn = function()
                local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not camera then
                    return
                end
                local cam = pulseNpc.cam
                if cam then
                else
                    if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Custom then
                        return
                    end
                    local myRootResult = pulseNpc.myRoot()
                    cam = {
                        fov = camera.FieldOfView,
                        ctype = camera.CameraType,
                        home = callback5(camera.CFrame),
                        me0 = myRootResult and myRootResult.Position,
                    }
                    pulseNpc.cam = cam
                end
                local success, result = pcall(pulseNpc.camShot)
                if not success then
                    pulseNpc.camEnd()
                    return
                end
                cam.shot, cam.start, cam.fovStart = result, callback5(camera.CFrame), camera.FieldOfView
                cam.mode, cam.t0 = "in", os.clock()
                camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcCam")
                end)
                success, camera =
                    Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value, function()
                        pcall(pulseNpc.camStep)
                    end
                runService:BindToRenderStep("PulseNpcCam", success + 2, camera)
            end
            pulseNpc.camOff = function()
                local cam, camera = pulseNpc.cam, workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam then
                    if not camera then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                cam.start, cam.fovStart = callback5(camera.CFrame), camera.FieldOfView
                cam.mode, cam.t0 = "out", os.clock()
            end

            pulseNpc.raw = function(calculatedValue)
                if type(calculatedValue) ~= "string" then
                    return nil
                end
                if #calculatedValue < 64 then
                    local pulseData = getgenv().__pulseData
                    calculatedValue = pulseData and pulseData.take(calculatedValue)
                    if type(calculatedValue) ~= "string" then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                end
                return pulseNpc.b64(calculatedValue)
            end
            pulseNpc.fileAsset = function(argument, argument2)
                local success, result = pcall(function()
                    if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
                        return nil
                    end
                    if type(isfile) == "function" then
                        if isfile(argument) then
                            local success, result = pcall(getcustomasset, argument)
                            if success then
                                if type(result) == "string" then
                                    if result ~= "" then
                                        return result
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local rawResult = pulseNpc.raw(argument2)
                    if not rawResult then
                        return nil
                    end
                    pcall(makefolder, "PulseHub")
                    writefile(argument, rawResult)
                    return getcustomasset(argument)
                end)
                if success then
                    if type(result) == "string" then
                        if result ~= "" then
                            return result
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end

            pulseNpc.makeActor = function()
                local rootPart = localPlayer.Character
                if rootPart then
                    if not (rootPart:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end
                local calculatedValue = pulseNpc.liveSkin() or rootPart
                rootPart = calculatedValue.Archivable
                calculatedValue.Archivable = true
                local head, pulseNpcActor = pcall(function()
                    return calculatedValue:Clone()
                end)
                calculatedValue.Archivable = rootPart
                if head then
                    if not pulseNpcActor then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end
                for unused, instance in ipairs(pulseNpcActor:GetDescendants()) do
                    if
                        instance:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
                        or instance:IsA("Tool")
                        or instance:IsA("BillboardGui")
                        or instance:IsA("Highlight")
                        or instance:IsA("ForceField")
                        or instance:IsA("Sound")
                        or instance:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
                        or instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                        or instance:IsA("Trail")
                        or instance:IsA("Beam")
                    then
                        pcall(function()
                            instance:Destroy()
                        end)
                    elseif instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                        instance.CanCollide = false
                        instance.CanQuery = false
                        instance.CanTouch = false
                        instance.Anchored = false
                    end
                end
                local humanoid = pulseNpcActor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                rootPart, head = pulseNpcActor:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), pulseNpcActor:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if humanoid and rootPart then
                    if not head then
                        pulseNpcActor:Destroy()
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    pulseNpcActor:Destroy()
                    return nil
                end
                rootPart.Anchored = true
                pcall(function()
                    humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                    humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
                    humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
                end)
                head = math.huge
                for unused, instance in ipairs(pulseNpcActor:GetDescendants()) do
                    head = if instance:IsA("BasePart")
                        then if instance ~= rootPart
                            then if instance:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory")
                                then head
                                else math.min(head, instance.Position.Y - instance.Size.Y / 2)
                            else head
                        else head
                end
                local calculatedValue, lookVector =
                    humanoid.HipHeight > 0.5 and humanoid.HipHeight + rootPart.Size.Y / 2 or rootPart.Position.Y - head,
                    pulseNpc.home.LookVector
                local calculatedValue2, raycastParams = pulseNpc.home.Position + lookVector * 6, RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = isActive3()
                head = workspace:Raycast(calculatedValue2 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), raycastParams)
                raycastParams = (
                    head and head.Position.Y
                    or pulseNpc.home.Position.Y - (pulseNpc.hum.HipHeight + pulseNpc.hrp.Size.Y / 2)
                ) + calculatedValue
                head = Vector3.new(calculatedValue2.X, raycastParams, calculatedValue2.Z)
                pulseNpcActor.Name = "PulseNpcActor"
                pulseNpcActor.Parent = workspace
                rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(head, head - lookVector)
                entries.parts.PulseNpcActor = pulseNpcActor
                return pulseNpcActor
            end
            local function callback9(argument)
                return 1 + 2.70158 * (argument - 1) ^ 3 + 1.70158 * (argument - 1) ^ 2
            end

            pulseNpc.cutShot = function(calculatedValue, argument, argument2)
                local lookAtResult = pulseNpc.CUT.shots[calculatedValue]
                local entry, calculatedValue2 =
                    lookAtResult[1],
                    pulseNpc.CUT.shots[calculatedValue + 1] and pulseNpc.CUT.shots[calculatedValue + 1][1]
                        or pulseNpc.CUT.len
                local clampedValue, clampedValue2, t, a, d, r, position, entry2, calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4 =
                    math.clamp((argument - entry) / math.max(0.1, calculatedValue2 - entry), 0, 1),
                    math.clamp(argument - entry, 0, 10),
                    argument2.T,
                    argument2.A,
                    argument2.d,
                    argument2.r,
                    Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
                    lookAtResult[2]
                entry, calculatedValue2 = 44, 0
                if entry2 == "wide" or entry2 == "wide2" then
                    lookAtResult = (t + a) / 2
                    calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, entry =
                        lookAtResult
                            + r * (entry2 == "wide" and 7.4 or 6)
                            + position * 0.7
                            + d * ((entry2 == "wide" and -1.2 or 0.8) + (entry2 == "wide" and 2.4 or -1.4) * clampedValue),
                        lookAtResult - position * 0.35,
                        entry2 == "wide" and 50 or 46 - 6 * clampedValue
                else
                    if entry2 == "tOTS" or entry2 == "tOTS2" then
                        calculatedValue = entry2 == "tOTS"
                        calculatedValue3 = a
                            + d * (calculatedValue and 3.2 or 2.8)
                            + r * (calculatedValue and 2.8 or 2.5)
                            + position * (calculatedValue and 0.85 or 0.6)
                        calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, entry =
                            calculatedValue3 + (t - calculatedValue3) * ((calculatedValue and 0.1 or 0.2) * clampedValue),
                            t + r * 0.35 - position * 0.2,
                            calculatedValue and 40 or 36
                    else
                        if entry2 == "tClose" then
                            calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, entry =
                                t + d * (4.4 - 0.9 * clampedValue) + r * 0.9 + position * 0.1, t - position * 0.2, 40
                        else
                            if entry2 == "tLow" then
                                local calculatedValue5 = -0.3 + 0.6 * clampedValue
                                calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, entry =
                                    t
                                        + (d * math.cos(calculatedValue5) + r * math.sin(calculatedValue5)) * 3.7
                                        - position * 1.35,
                                    t + position * 0.2,
                                    48
                            else
                                if entry2 == "mClose" then
                                    calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, entry, calculatedValue2 =
                                        a - d * 3.4 + r * 1.7 + position * 0.55,
                                        a - position * 0.2,
                                        40 - 4 * clampedValue,
                                        argument >= 9.14 and math.exp(-(argument - 9.14) * 7) * 0.02 or 0
                                else
                                    if entry2 == "mPunch" then
                                        calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, entry =
                                            a - d * 3.2 + r * 1.3 + position * 0.5,
                                            a - position * 0.1,
                                            62 - 22 * math.min(1, clampedValue2 / 0.12)
                                        calculatedValue2 = math.exp(-clampedValue2 * 6) * 0.03
                                    else
                                        if entry2 == "mOTS" then
                                            calculatedValue3 = t - d * 2.6 + r * 3 + position * 1
                                            calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, entry =
                                                calculatedValue3 + (a - calculatedValue3) * (0.14 * clampedValue),
                                                a - r * 0.35 - position * 0.3,
                                                40 - (argument >= 17.7 and 5 * math.min(1, (argument - 17.7) / 1.5) or 0)
                                        else
                                            if entry2 == "tECU" then
                                                calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, entry, calculatedValue2 =
                                                    t + d * 3 + r * 0.25, t - position * 0.1, 34, 0.012
                                            else
                                                if entry2 == "tPunch" then
                                                    calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4, entry =
                                                        t + d * 3.1 + position * 0.04,
                                                        t - position * 0.08,
                                                        52
                                                            - 18 * math.min(1, clampedValue2 / 0.09)
                                                            + (
                                                                argument >= 22.86
                                                                    and -7 * math.min(1, (argument - 22.86) / 0.08)
                                                                or 0
                                                            )
                                                    calculatedValue2 = math.exp(-clampedValue2 * 3) * 0.035
                                                        + (
                                                            argument >= 22.86 and math.exp(-(argument - 22.86) * 4) * 0.04
                                                            or 0
                                                        )
                                                else
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                lookAtResult = CFrame.lookAt(calculatedValue3, calculatedValue4)
                if argument2.rp then
                    clampedValue2 = calculatedValue3 - calculatedValue4
                    r = workspace:Raycast(calculatedValue4, clampedValue2, argument2.rp)
                    if r then
                        position = math.max(1.2, (r.Position - calculatedValue4).Magnitude - 0.4)
                        lookAtResult = CFrame.lookAt(calculatedValue4 + clampedValue2.Unit * position, calculatedValue4)
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                return if calculatedValue2 > 0
                    then lookAtResult * CFrame.Angles(
                        math.sin(argument * 37) * calculatedValue2,
                        math.sin(argument * 29 + 1) * calculatedValue2,
                        math.sin(argument * 7) * calculatedValue2 * (entry2 == "tECU" and 5 or 1.5)
                    )
                    else lookAtResult,
                    entry
            end
            pulseNpc.cutCam = function(argument)
                local g, shots, counter = pulseNpc.cut.G, pulseNpc.CUT.shots, 1
                for index = 1, #shots, 1 do
                    counter = if argument >= shots[index][1] then index else counter
                end
                local cutShotResult, cutShotResult2 = pulseNpc.cutShot(counter, argument, g)
                local beat = shots[counter][3]
                if beat then
                    if counter > 1 then
                        if argument - shots[counter][1] < beat then
                            local cutShotResult3, cutShotResult4 = pulseNpc.cutShot(counter - 1, argument, g)
                            local value = callback7((argument - shots[counter][1]) / beat)
                            local interpolatedValue, calculatedValue =
                                cutShotResult3:Lerp(cutShotResult, value),
                                cutShotResult4 + (cutShotResult2 - cutShotResult4) * value
                            cutShotResult, cutShotResult2 = interpolatedValue, calculatedValue
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                beat = pulseNpc.CUT
                shots = beat.phase + math.floor((argument - beat.phase) / beat.period) * beat.period
                beat = argument >= 0 and math.exp(-(argument - shots) * 10) or 0
                pulseNpc.cut.beat = beat
                return cutShotResult, cutShotResult2 * (1 - beat * (argument > 20 and 0.05 or 0.028))
            end
            pulseNpc.cutStep = function()
                local cut = pulseNpc.cut
                if not cut then
                    return
                end
                local calculatedValue, cut2 = cut.running and os.clock() - cut.t0 or 0, pulseNpc.CUT
                if cut.running then
                    while true do
                        local ai, tA = cut.ai, cut2.tA
                        if not (ai <= #tA and cut2.tA[cut.ai][1] <= calculatedValue) then
                            break
                        end
                        local tCur = pulseNpc.cutT and pulseNpc.cutT[cut2.tA[cut.ai][2]]
                        if tCur then
                            if cut.tCur then
                                if cut.tCur ~= tCur then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        cut.tCur:Stop(0.25)
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                            pcall(function()
                                tCur:Play(0.15)
                            end)
                            cut.tCur = tCur
                        end
                        cut.ai = cut.ai + 1
                    end
                    while true do
                        local mi, mA = cut.mi, cut2.mA
                        if not (mi <= #mA and cut2.mA[cut.mi][1] <= calculatedValue) then
                            break
                        end
                        local mCur = cut.mAn[cut2.mA[cut.mi][2]]
                        if mCur then
                            if cut.mCur then
                                if cut.mCur ~= mCur then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        cut.mCur:Stop(0.25)
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                            pcall(function()
                                mCur:Play(0.15)
                            end)
                            cut.mCur = mCur
                        end
                        cut.mi = cut.mi + 1
                    end
                    while true do
                        local fi, flash = cut.fi, cut2.flash
                        if not (fi <= #flash and cut2.flash[cut.fi][1] <= calculatedValue) then
                            break
                        end
                        pulseNpc.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - cut2.flash[cut.fi][2]
                        callback8(pulseNpc.flash, 0.4, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                        cut.fi = cut.fi + 1
                    end
                    local entry = cut2.lines[cut.li]
                    while entry and calculatedValue >= entry.w[1][1] - 0.06 do
                        pulseNpc.cutLine(cut, entry)
                        cut.li = cut.li + 1
                        entry = cut2.lines[cut.li]
                    end
                    local talking, actorTalking = false, false
                    for key, item in ipairs(cut2.lines) do
                        if calculatedValue >= item.w[1][1] then
                            if calculatedValue <= item.w[#item.w][1] + 0.5 then
                                if item.who == "t" then
                                    key = true
                                    talking = key
                                else
                                    local enabled = true
                                    actorTalking = enabled
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    pulseNpc.talking = talking
                    pulseNpc.actorTalking = actorTalking
                end
                local cf, fov = pulseNpc.cutCam(calculatedValue)
                cut.cf = cf
                cut.fov = fov
                fov, cf = cut.line, 1 + (cut.beat or 0) * 0.07
                local calculatedValue2 = fov and calculatedValue > fov.t1 and math.clamp(
                    (calculatedValue - fov.t1) / 0.2,
                    0,
                    1
                ) or 0
                for key, item in ipairs(cut.words) do
                    key = calculatedValue - item.t
                    if key < 0 then
                        item.l.TextTransparency, item.l.TextStrokeTransparency, item.st.Transparency, item.sh.TextTransparency =
                            1, 1, 1, 1
                    else
                        local minimumValue, calculatedValue3 =
                            math.min(1, key / 0.24), math.min(1, key / 0.1) * (1 - calculatedValue2)
                        item.s.Scale = (0.3 + 0.7 * callback9(minimumValue)) * cf * (1 - 0.2 * calculatedValue2)
                        item.l.TextTransparency = 1 - calculatedValue3
                        item.l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - calculatedValue3 * 0.6
                        item.st.Transparency = 1 - calculatedValue3 * 0.75
                        item.l.Rotation = item.rot * (1 - minimumValue)
                            + (fov.wob and math.sin(calculatedValue * 15 + item.i * 1.7) * 7 or 0)
                        local roundedValue = math.floor((1 - minimumValue) * 16 - calculatedValue2 * 12 + 0.5)
                        item.l.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, roundedValue)
                        item.ss.Scale = item.s.Scale
                        item.sh.Rotation = item.l.Rotation
                        item.sh.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 3, 0.5, roundedValue + 4)
                        item.sh.TextTransparency = 1 - calculatedValue3 * 0.55
                    end
                end
                cf, fov = cut.whoAt and os.clock() - cut.whoAt or 1, cut.line and 1 - calculatedValue2 or 0
                pulseNpc.who.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - fov
                pulseNpc.who.TextTransparency = 1 - fov
                pulseNpc.who.Rotation = (1 - math.min(1, cf / 0.2)) * -6
                if cut.running then
                    if calculatedValue >= cut2.len then
                        pulseNpc.cutEnd(false)
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.cutPlay = function()
                if pulseNpc.cut then
                    return
                elseif not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                    return
                end
                pcall(pulseNpc.danceStop)
                pulseNpc.seq = pulseNpc.seq + 1
                pulseNpc.hot = {}
                pulseNpc.clearOpts(true)
                pulseNpc.body.Text = ""
                pulseNpc.talking = false
                pcall(pulseNpc.cutPreload)
                pulseNpc.cutUi()
                local head, result = pcall(pulseNpc.makeActor)
                if if head then not result else not head then
                    pulseNpc.show("who")
                    return
                end
                head = result:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local calculatedValue, raycastParams =
                    head and (head:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or createInstance("Animator", {}, head)),
                    { idle = true }
                for unused, item in ipairs(pulseNpc.CUT.mA) do
                    raycastParams[item[2]] = true
                end
                local mAn = pulseNpc.loadSet(calculatedValue, raycastParams, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
                if mAn.idle then
                    pcall(function()
                        mAn.idle:Play(0.1)
                    end)
                end
                for unused, item in pairs(pulseNpc.anims) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if item.IsPlaying then
                            if item ~= pulseNpc.anims.idle then
                                item:Stop(0.2)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                head = result:FindFirstChild("Head")
                pulseNpc.actorNeck = head and head:FindFirstChild("Neck")
                pulseNpc.faceAt = result:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local t, a =
                    pulseNpc.hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, (pulseNpc.lift or 3) - 1.15, 0),
                    head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
                head = Vector3.new(a.X - t.X, 0, a.Z - t.Z)
                head = head.Magnitude > 0.1 and head.Unit or pulseNpc.home.LookVector
                raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = isActive3()
                local cut = { actor = result, mAn = mAn, words = {}, ai = 1, mi = 1, fi = 1, li = 1, running = false }
                cut.t0 = os.clock()
                cut.G = { T = t, A = a, d = head, r = head:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)).Unit, rp = raycastParams }
                pulseNpc.cut = cut
                pulseNpc.left.Visible = false
                pulseNpc.opts.Visible = false
                pulseNpc.subs.Visible = true
                pulseNpc.fit()
                callback8(pulseNpc.barT, 0.5, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.1, 0) })
                callback8(pulseNpc.barB, 0.5, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.9), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.1, 0) })
                pulseNpc.subs.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.9, -22)
                if pulseNpc.cam then
                    pulseNpc.cam.mode = "cut"
                end
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcCut")
                end)
                a, raycastParams =
                    Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value, function()
                        pcall(pulseNpc.cutStep)
                    end
                runService:BindToRenderStep("PulseNpcCut", a + 1, raycastParams)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local song, now = pulseNpc.song, os.clock()
                    while song and not song.IsLoaded and os.clock() - now < 2.5 do
                        task.wait()
                    end
                    task.wait(0.25)
                    if pulseNpc.cut ~= cut then
                        return
                    end
                    if song then
                        if song.IsLoaded then
                            song.TimePosition = 0
                            song:Play()
                        end
                    end
                    cut.t0 = os.clock()
                    cut.running = true
                end)
            end
            pulseNpc.cutEnd = function(argument)
                local cut = pulseNpc.cut
                if not cut then
                    return
                end
                pulseNpc.cut = nil
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcCut")
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if pulseNpc.song then
                        pulseNpc.song:Stop()
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if cut.tCur then
                        cut.tCur:Stop(0.3)
                    end
                end)
                for unused, item in ipairs(cut.words) do
                    pcall(function()
                        item.h:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    cut.actor:Destroy()
                end)
                entries.parts.PulseNpcActor = nil
                pulseNpc.faceAt = nil
                pulseNpc.actorNeck = nil
                pulseNpc.actorTalking = false
                pulseNpc.talking = false
                pcall(function()
                    pulseNpc.subs.Visible = false
                    pulseNpc.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    pulseNpc.left.Visible = true
                    pulseNpc.opts.Visible = true
                end)
                if argument then
                    return
                elseif not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                    return
                end
                callback8(pulseNpc.barT, 0.45, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.07), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.07, 0) })
                callback8(pulseNpc.barB, 0.45, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.93), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.07, 0) })
                local cam, camera = pulseNpc.cam, workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam then
                    if camera then
                        local success, result = pcall(pulseNpc.camShot)
                        if success then
                            cam.shot = result
                        end
                        cam.start, cam.fovStart = callback5(camera.CFrame), camera.FieldOfView
                        cam.mode, cam.t0 = "in", os.clock()
                    end
                end
                pulseNpc.show("who")
            end
            pulseNpc.open = function()
                if pulseNpc.isOpen then
                    return
                elseif pulseNpc.hrp then
                    if not pulseNpc.hrp.Parent then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                pcall(pulseNpc.danceStop)
                local barB = pulseNpc.ui()
                pulseNpc.isOpen = true
                pulseNpc.farN = 0
                pulseNpc.hot = {}
                pulseNpc.promptUi(false)
                if pulseNpc.prompt then
                    pulseNpc.prompt.Enabled = false
                end
                pulseNpc.chip.Text = isActive5()
                pulseNpc.fit()
                pulseNpc.clearOpts(false)
                pulseNpc.body.Text = ""
                barB.Enabled = true
                pulseNpc.barT.Position, pulseNpc.barT.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.07, 0)
                pulseNpc.barB.Position, pulseNpc.barB.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.07, 0)
                local barT, left = pulseNpc.barT, {}
                left.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.07)
                callback8(barT, 0.55, left)
                barB, barT = pulseNpc.barB, {}
                barT.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.93)
                callback8(barB, 0.55, barT)
                pulseNpc.shade.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                callback8(pulseNpc.shade, 0.6, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
                pulseNpc.left.Position = pulseNpc.leftPos(6)
                left, barB = pulseNpc.left, {}
                barB.Position = pulseNpc.leftPos(-18)
                callback8(left, 0.55, barB)
                pulseNpc.nameL.TextTransparency = 1
                pulseNpc.chip.TextTransparency, pulseNpc.chip.BackgroundTransparency = 1, 1
                pulseNpc.line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3)
                callback8(pulseNpc.nameL, 0.45, { TextTransparency = 0 })
                callback8(pulseNpc.chip, 0.45, { TextTransparency = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
                barB, barT = pulseNpc.line, {}
                barT.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 3)
                callback8(barB, 0.7, barT)
                callback6("rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", 0.45)
                pcall(pulseNpc.camOn)
                pcall(pulseNpc.hideOn)
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(pulseNpc.cutPreload)
                end)
                task.delay(0.25, function()
                    if pulseNpc.isOpen then
                        pulseNpc.show("start")
                    end
                end)
                if pulseNpc.watch then
                    pulseNpc.watch:Disconnect()
                end
                pulseNpc.watch = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    local myRootResult, hrp = pulseNpc.myRoot(), pulseNpc.hrp
                    local calculatedValue = myRootResult and hrp and hrp.Parent
                    if
                        if calculatedValue
                            then (myRootResult.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude > 14
                            else not calculatedValue
                    then
                        pulseNpc.farN = (pulseNpc.farN or 0) + 1
                        if pulseNpc.farN >= 6 then
                            pulseNpc.close()
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        pulseNpc.farN = 0
                    end
                    if pulseNpc.vp() ~= pulseNpc.fitVP then
                        pulseNpc.fit()
                    end
                end)
                if pulseNpc.keys then
                    pulseNpc.keys:Disconnect()
                end
                local entries2 = {}
                entries2[Enum.KeyCode.One] = 1
                entries2[Enum.KeyCode.Two] = 2
                entries2[Enum.KeyCode.Three] = 3
                entries2[Enum.KeyCode.Four] = 4
                entries2[Enum.KeyCode.Five] = 5
                entries2[Enum.KeyCode.Six] = 6
                entries2[Enum.KeyCode.Seven] = 7
                entries2[Enum.KeyCode.Eight] = 8
                entries2[Enum.KeyCode.Nine] = 9
                pulseNpc.keys = userInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(argument, entry)
                    if entry then
                        return
                    elseif not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                        return
                    end
                    entry = entries2[argument.KeyCode]
                    if entry then
                        if pulseNpc.hot[entry] then
                            pulseNpc.hot[entry]()
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            pulseNpc.close = function()
                if not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                    return
                end
                pcall(pulseNpc.cutEnd, true)
                pulseNpc.isOpen = false
                pulseNpc.talking = false
                pulseNpc.seq = pulseNpc.seq + 1
                pulseNpc.hot = {}
                if pulseNpc.watch then
                    pulseNpc.watch:Disconnect()
                    pulseNpc.watch = nil
                end
                if pulseNpc.keys then
                    pulseNpc.keys:Disconnect()
                    pulseNpc.keys = nil
                end
                local gui = pulseNpc.gui
                if gui then
                    local barT, entries2 = pulseNpc.barT, {}
                    entries2.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
                    callback8(barT, 0.38, entries2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
                    barT, entries2 = pulseNpc.barB, {}
                    entries2.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
                    callback8(barT, 0.38, entries2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
                    callback8(pulseNpc.shade, 0.35, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                    callback8(pulseNpc.nameL, 0.2, { TextTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                    callback8(
                        pulseNpc.chip,
                        0.2,
                        { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 },
                        Enum.EasingStyle.Quad
                    )
                    barT, entries2 = pulseNpc.line, {}
                    entries2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3)
                    callback8(barT, 0.2, entries2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                    pulseNpc.body.Text = ""
                    pulseNpc.clearOpts(true)
                    task.delay(0.42, function()
                        if not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                            if gui.Parent then
                                gui.Enabled = false
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                pcall(pulseNpc.camOff)
                pcall(pulseNpc.hideOff)
                pulseNpc.gesture("wave")
                task.delay(0.4, function()
                    if pulseNpc.prompt then
                        if pulseNpc.prompt.Parent then
                            if not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                                if pulseNpc.dance then
                                    if not pulseNpc.dance.noPrompt then
                                        pulseNpc.prompt.Enabled = true
                                    end
                                else
                                    pulseNpc.prompt.Enabled = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            pulseNpc.SONGS = songs
            pulseNpc.songReady = function(argument)
                if argument.data then
                    if not argument.asset then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                for unused, item in ipairs(argument.tracks or {}) do
                    if not item.asset then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            pulseNpc.prepSongs = function()
                if pulseNpc.prepBusy then
                    return
                end
                pulseNpc.prepBusy = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    for unused, item in ipairs(pulseNpc.SONGS) do
                        if item.data then
                            if not item.asset then
                                pcall(pulseNpc.trackAsset, item)
                            end
                        end
                        for unused, item2 in ipairs(item.tracks or {}) do
                            if not item2.asset then
                                item2.asset = pulseNpc.fileAsset(item2.file, item2.data)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not pulseNpc.tvNoise then
                        pulseNpc.tvNoise = pulseNpc.fileAsset("PulseHub/tv_noise_v1.png", pulseNpc.TVNOISE)
                    end
                    pulseNpc.prepBusy = false
                end)
            end
            pulseNpc.trackAsset = function(argument)
                if argument.asset then
                    return argument.asset
                end
                if not argument.data then
                    return false
                end
                argument.asset = pulseNpc.fileAsset(argument.file, argument.data)
                return argument.asset or false
            end
            pulseNpc.joints = function()
                if pulseNpc.jm then
                    if pulseNpc.jmModel == pulseNpc.model then
                        return pulseNpc.jm
                    end
                end
                local jm = {}
                for unused, instance in ipairs(pulseNpc.model and pulseNpc.model:GetDescendants() or {}) do
                    if instance:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
                        jm[instance.Name] = instance
                    elseif instance:IsA("Motor6D") then
                        jm[instance.Name] = instance
                    end
                end
                pulseNpc.jm, pulseNpc.jmModel = jm, pulseNpc.model
                return jm
            end
            local function callback5(clampedValue)
                clampedValue = math.clamp(clampedValue, 0, 1)
                return clampedValue * clampedValue * (3 - 2 * clampedValue)
            end
            local function callback6(argument, argument2, argument3, calculatedValue, calculatedValue2)
                calculatedValue, calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue or 0.12, calculatedValue2 or 0.15
                if argument <= argument2 - calculatedValue then
                    return 0
                elseif argument >= argument3 + calculatedValue2 then
                    return 0
                end
                if argument < argument2 then
                    return callback5((argument - argument2 + calculatedValue) / calculatedValue)
                end
                if argument > argument3 then
                    return 1 - callback5((argument - argument3) / calculatedValue2)
                end
                return 1
            end
            local function callback7(argument, argument2, argument3)
                return argument + (argument2 - argument) * argument3
