            pulseNpc.shake = function(argument, argument2, dur)
                local myRootResult = pulseNpc.myRoot()
                if myRootResult then
                    if pulseNpc.cut then
                        return
                    elseif pulseNpc.isOpen then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                local mag = argument2 * math.clamp(1 - (myRootResult.Position - argument).Magnitude / 75, 0, 1)
                if mag < 0.03 then
                    return
                end
                pulseNpc.shk = { t0 = os.clock(), dur = dur, mag = mag }
                if pulseNpc.shkBound then
                    return
                end
                pulseNpc.shkBound = true
                pcall(function()
                    local value, handleAction2 =
                        Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value, function()
                            local shk, camera = pulseNpc.shk, workspace.CurrentCamera
                            if shk then
                                if camera then
                                    if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Custom then
                                        return
                                    end
                                else
                                    return
                                end
                            else
                                return
                            end
                            local calculatedValue = os.clock() - shk.t0
                            if calculatedValue > shk.dur then
                                pulseNpc.shk = nil
                                return
                            end
                            local calculatedValue2 = shk.mag * (1 - calculatedValue / shk.dur) ^ 2
                            camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4 * calculatedValue2), math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4 * calculatedValue2), math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2 * calculatedValue2))
                        end
                    runService:BindToRenderStep("PulseFightShake", value + 1, handleAction2)
                end)
            end
            pulseNpc.statueFindNew = function(argument)
                if argument then
                    if not pulseNpc.hrp then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end
                local value, value2, value3
                for key, instance in ipairs(argument:GetDescendants()) do
                    if instance:IsA("Model") then
                        if instance:FindFirstChild("Torso") then
                            if instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("CharacterMesh") then
                            else
                                key = true
                                for instance2, item in ipairs(pulseNpc.R6) do
                                    instance2 = instance:FindFirstChild(item)
                                    if not (instance2 and instance2:IsA("BasePart") and instance2.Anchored) then
                                        key = false
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                                if key then
                                    local value4
                                    for size, item in
                                        ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(instance["Right Arm"].Position, 3))
                                    do
                                        if item:IsDescendantOf(instance) then
                                        else
                                            if item:IsDescendantOf(argument) then
                                                size = item.Size
                                                value4 = if math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) >= 2
                                                    then if math.min(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) <= 0.6 then item else value4
                                                    else value4
                                            else
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if value4 then
                                        local magnitude = (instance.Torso.Position - pulseNpc.hrp.Position).Magnitude
                                        if magnitude < 90 then
                                            if value then
                                                if magnitude < value then
                                                    value, value2, value3 = magnitude, instance, value4
                                                else
                                                end
                                            else
                                                value, value2, value3 = magnitude, instance, value4
                                            end
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if not value2 then
                    return nil
                end
                local entries2 = {}
                for unused, item in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(value2.Head.Position, 2.2)) do
                    if not (item:IsDescendantOf(value2)) then
                        if item ~= value3 then
                            if item:IsDescendantOf(argument) then
                                if item.Size.Magnitude < 5 then
                                    entries2[#entries2 + 1] = item
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return value2, value3, entries2
            end
            pulseNpc.statueFind = function()
                local regularLobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
                if not regularLobby then
                    local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
                    if lobby then
                        return pulseNpc.statueFindNew(lobby)
                    end
                end
                local rightArm = regularLobby and (regularLobby:FindFirstChild("MainLobby"))
                regularLobby = rightArm and (rightArm:FindFirstChild("Models"))
                if regularLobby then
                    if not pulseNpc.hrp then
                        return nil
                    end
                else
                    return nil
                end
                local value, value2
                for key, instance in ipairs(regularLobby:GetChildren()) do
                    key = instance:IsA("Model") and instance:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                    if key then
                        if instance:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                            if instance:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") then
                                if instance:FindFirstChild("Left Arm") then
                                    if instance:FindFirstChild("Right Leg") then
                                        if instance:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") then
                                            local magnitude = (key.Position - pulseNpc.hrp.Position).Magnitude
                                            if magnitude < 90 then
                                                if value then
                                                    if magnitude < value then
                                                        value, value2 = magnitude, instance
                                                    else
                                                    end
                                                else
                                                    value, value2 = magnitude, instance
                                                end
                                            else
                                            end
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if not value2 then
                    return nil
                end
                regularLobby = nil
                local parts = rightArm:FindFirstChild("Parts")
                if parts then
                    rightArm = value2["Right Arm"]
                    for unused, instance in ipairs(parts:GetChildren()) do
                        regularLobby = if instance:IsA("BasePart")
                            then if instance.Name == "Handle"
                                then if (instance.Position - rightArm.Position).Magnitude < 4
                                    then instance
                                    else regularLobby
                                else regularLobby
                            else regularLobby
                    end
                else
                end
                return value2, regularLobby
            end
            pulseNpc.R6 = { "Torso", "Head", "Right Arm", "Left Arm", "Right Leg", "Left Leg" }
            pulseNpc.fightBuild = function(argument)
                local raycastParams, knifeSrc, extrasSrc = pulseNpc.statueFind()
                if not raycastParams then
                    return false
                end
                local floor, t0, fight =
                    pulseNpc.home.Position.Y - (pulseNpc.hum.HipHeight + pulseNpc.hrp.Size.Y / 2),
                    pulseNpc.home.Position,
                    raycastParams.Torso.Position
                local position = Vector3.new(fight.X - t0.X, 0, fight.Z - t0.Z)
                if position.Magnitude < 12 then
                    return false
                end
                position = position.Unit
                fight = {
                    src = raycastParams,
                    knifeSrc = knifeSrc,
                    extrasSrc = extrasSrc,
                    hidden = {},
                    fired = {},
                    dir = position,
                    floor = floor,
                    T0 = t0,
                    sp = {},
                }
                if not (pulseNpc.statueClone(fight)) then
                    return false
                end
                raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = isActive3()
                knifeSrc = t0 + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
                floor = workspace:Raycast(knifeSrc, -position * 14, raycastParams)
                extrasSrc = floor and (floor.Position - knifeSrc).Magnitude or nil
                if extrasSrc then
                    if extrasSrc > 2.5 then
                        fight.K = t0 - position * (extrasSrc - 1.05)
                        fight.wall = floor.Position
                    else
                        fight.K = t0 - position * 6
                    end
                else
                    fight.K = t0 - position * 6
                end
                fight.L = t0 + position * 8.5
                fight.A = t0 + position * 3
                fight.S2 = fight.A + position * 1.8
                fight.B = fight.S2 - position * 2.7
                floor = position:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)).Unit
                knifeSrc, extrasSrc =
                    workspace:Raycast(fight.S2, floor * 14, raycastParams),
                    workspace:Raycast(fight.S2, -floor * 14, raycastParams)
                fight.side = floor
                    * (
                        if (extrasSrc and (extrasSrc.Position - fight.S2).Magnitude or 14)
                                > (knifeSrc and (knifeSrc.Position - fight.S2).Magnitude or 14)
                            then -1
                            else 1
                    )
                fight.torsoH = 3
                argument.fight = fight
                pulseNpc.fsnd("crack", fight.P.Torso, 1.2)
                return true
            end
            pulseNpc.statueClone = function(argument)
                local src = argument.src
                local knifeSrc, result, pulseStatue =
                    argument.knifeSrc, pcall(function()
                        return src:Clone()
                    end)
                if result then
                    if not pulseStatue then
                        return false
                    end
                else
                    return false
                end
                for unused, instance in ipairs(pulseStatue:GetDescendants()) do
                    if instance:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
                        instance:Destroy()
                    elseif instance:IsA("Configuration") then
                        instance:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                local humanoid = pulseStatue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid then
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                        humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
                    end)
                end
                for unused, instance in ipairs(pulseStatue:GetDescendants()) do
                    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                        instance.CanCollide = false
                        instance.CanQuery = false
                        instance.CanTouch = false
                    end
                end
                pulseStatue.Name = "PulseStatue"
                argument.P = {}
                for unused, item in ipairs(pulseNpc.R6) do
                    argument.P[item] = pulseStatue:FindFirstChild(item)
                    if not argument.P[item] then
                        pcall(function()
                            pulseStatue:Destroy()
                        end)
                        return false
                    end
                    argument.P[item].Anchored = true
                end
                argument.T0cf = src.Torso.CFrame
                argument.frozen = {}
                for unused, item in ipairs(pulseNpc.R6) do
                    argument.frozen[item] = src.Torso.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(src[item].CFrame)
                end
                if knifeSrc then
                    result = knifeSrc:Clone()
                    for unused, instance in ipairs(result:GetDescendants()) do
                        if instance:IsA("JointInstance") then
                            instance:Destroy()
                        elseif instance:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
                            instance:Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                    result.Anchored = true
                    result.CanCollide = false
                    result.CanQuery = false
                    result.CanTouch = false
                    result.Parent = pulseStatue
                    argument.knife = result
                    argument.knifeRel = src["Right Arm"].CFrame:ToObjectSpace(knifeSrc.CFrame)
                end
                argument.extras = {}
                for success, item in ipairs(argument.extrasSrc or {}) do
                    result, success = pcall(function()
                        return item:Clone()
                    end)
                    if result and success then
                        for unused, instance in ipairs(success:GetDescendants()) do
                            if instance:IsA("JointInstance") then
                                instance:Destroy()
                            elseif instance:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
                                instance:Destroy()
                            elseif instance:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
                                instance:Destroy()
                            end
                        end
                        success.Anchored = true
                        success.CanCollide = false
                        success.CanQuery = false
                        success.CanTouch = false
                        success.Parent = pulseStatue
                        local extras, calculatedValue, entries2, transform, transform2 =
                            argument.extras, #argument.extras + 1, {}, src.Head.CFrame, item.CFrame
                        appendValues(entries2, 0, success, transform:ToObjectSpace(transform2))
                        extras[calculatedValue] = entries2
                    end
                end
                result = argument.P.Head
                argument.eyes = {}
                local entries2 = { -1, 1 }
                for key, item in ipairs(entries2) do
                    key = createInstance("Attachment", { Position = Vector3.new(item * 0.24, 0.12, -0.52) }, result)
                    item = createInstance(
                        "ParticleEmitter",
                        {
                            Texture = pulseNpc.FXT.glow,
                            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)),
                            LightEmission = 1,
                            Brightness = 6,
                            Size = NumberSequence.new(0.38),
                            Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.1),
                            Rate = 40,
                            Speed = NumberRange.new(0),
                            LockedToPart = true,
                            Enabled = false,
                            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
                                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                            }),
                        },
                        key
                    )
                    argument.eyes[#argument.eyes + 1] = item
                end
                argument.light =
                    createInstance("PointLight", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 40), Brightness = 0, Range = 9 }, result)
                argument.trail = createInstance(
                    "Trail",
                    {
                        Attachment0 = createInstance("Attachment", { Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0) }, argument.P.Torso),
                        Attachment1 = createInstance(
                            "Attachment",
                            { Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.9, 0) },
                            argument.P.Torso
                        ),
                        Lifetime = 0.38,
                        LightEmission = 1,
                        Brightness = 1.1,
                        Enabled = false,
                        FaceCamera = true,
                        Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 200), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 60)),
                        Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.5),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                        }),
                        WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(0.8, 0.05),
                    },
                    argument.P.Torso
                )
                pulseStatue.Parent = workspace
                argument.model = pulseStatue
                entries.parts.PulseStatue = pulseStatue
                for unused, instance in ipairs(src:GetDescendants()) do
                    if instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:IsA("Decal") then
                        argument.hidden[#argument.hidden + 1] = { instance, instance.LocalTransparencyModifier }
                        instance.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                    end
                end
                if knifeSrc then
                    argument.hidden[#argument.hidden + 1] = { knifeSrc, knifeSrc.LocalTransparencyModifier }
                    knifeSrc.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                end
                for unused, item in ipairs(argument.extrasSrc or {}) do
                    for unused, instance in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                        if instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:IsA("Decal") then
                            argument.hidden[#argument.hidden + 1] = { instance, instance.LocalTransparencyModifier }
                            instance.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                        end
                    end
                    argument.hidden[#argument.hidden + 1] = { item, item.LocalTransparencyModifier }
                    item.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                end
                return true
            end
            pulseNpc.fightFree = function(entries2)
                local calculatedValue = entries2 and entries2.fight
                if not calculatedValue then
                    return
                end
                entries2.fight = nil
                for unused, item in ipairs(calculatedValue.hidden or {}) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if item[1].Parent then
                            item[1].LocalTransparencyModifier = item[2]
                        end
                    end)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    calculatedValue.model:Destroy()
                end)
                if calculatedValue.pig then
                    pcall(function()
                        calculatedValue.pig.model:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                entries2 = { "stars", "charge" }
                for unused, item in ipairs(entries2) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if calculatedValue[item] then
                            calculatedValue[item]:Destroy()
                        end
                    end)
                end
                entries.parts.PulseStatue, entries.parts.PulsePig = nil, nil
                pulseNpc.shk = nil
                pcall(function()
                    runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseFightShake")
                end)
                pulseNpc.shkBound = false
            end
            local function callback8(argument, argument2, argument3)
                local entries2 = {}
                for key, item in pairs(argument) do
                    entries2[key] = item
                end
                for key, item in pairs(argument2) do
                    entries2[key] = (argument[key] or 0) + (item - (argument[key] or 0)) * argument3
                end
                return entries2
            end
            local function callback10(argument, argument2)
                if argument <= argument2[1][1] then
                    return callback8({}, argument2[1][2], 1)
                end
                for index = 1, #argument2 - 1, 1 do
                    local entry, entry2 = argument2[index], argument2[index + 1]
                    if argument <= entry2[1] then
                        index = (argument - entry[1]) / math.max(entry2[1] - entry[1], 0.001)
                        index = entry2[3] == "lin" and index or (
                                entry2[3] == "snap" and 1 - (1 - index) ^ 3 or callback5(index)
                            )
                        return callback8(entry[2], entry2[2], index)
                    end
                end
                return callback8({}, argument2[#argument2][2], 1)
            end

            pulseNpc.fightStatue = function(argument, argument2)
                local p, dir, transform, entries2 =
                    argument2.P, argument2.dir, pulseNpc.hrp.Position, argument2.floor + argument2.torsoH
                argument2.skf = argument2.skf or isActive4()
                local value, identity, position, interpolatedValue, pos =
                    callback10(argument, argument2.skf), CFrame.identity, argument2.T0cf.Position
                if argument < 3.25 then
                    local calculatedValue = callback5((argument - 2.4) / 0.6)
                    interpolatedValue =
                        callback9(argument2.T0cf.LookVector):Lerp(callback9(transform - position), calculatedValue)
                    if argument > 0.3 then
                        if argument < 3 then
                            calculatedValue = math.clamp((argument - 0.3) / 2.2, 0, 1) * (argument < 2.85 and 1 or 0.3)
                            pos = position
                                + Vector3.new(
                                    (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.18 * calculatedValue,
                                    (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06 * calculatedValue,
                                    (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.18 * calculatedValue
                                )
                        else
                            pos = position
                        end
                    else
                        pos = position
                    end
                else
                    if argument < 4.4 then
                        local calculatedValue = (argument - 3.25) / 1.15
                        pos, interpolatedValue =
                            position:Lerp(Vector3.new(argument2.L.X, entries2, argument2.L.Z), calculatedValue)
                                + Vector3.new(0, 36 * calculatedValue * (1 - calculatedValue), 0),
                            callback9(argument2.T0 - position)
                    else
                        if argument < 4.85 then
                            pos = Vector3.new(argument2.L.X, entries2, argument2.L.Z)
                            interpolatedValue = callback9(transform - pos)
                        else
                            if argument < 6 then
                                local calculatedValue = (argument - 4.85) / 1.15
                                local interpolatedValue2 = argument2.L:Lerp(argument2.A, calculatedValue)
                                pos = Vector3.new(
                                    interpolatedValue2.X,
                                    entries2 + math.abs(math.sin(calculatedValue * 3.141592653589793 * 3)) * 0.18,
                                    interpolatedValue2.Z
                                )
                                interpolatedValue = callback9(transform - pos)
                                interpolatedValue2 = calculatedValue * 3.141592653589793 * 3
                                value.rlx = (value.rlx or 0) + math.sin(interpolatedValue2) * 0.65
                                value.llx = (value.llx or 0) - math.sin(interpolatedValue2) * 0.65
                                value.lsx = (value.lsx or 0) - math.sin(interpolatedValue2) * 0.3
                                value.tp = (value.tp or 0) - 0.08
                            else
                                if argument < 13.4 then
                                    pos = Vector3.new(argument2.A.X, entries2, argument2.A.Z)
                                        - dir * (0.9 * (value.push or 0))
                                    interpolatedValue = callback9(transform - pos)
                                    if argument > 7.4 then
                                        value.cy = 0.08 * math.abs(math.sin(argument * 13))
                                        value.nx = (value.nx or 0) + 0.12 * math.sin(argument * 13)
                                    end
                                else
                                    if argument < 16.45 then
                                        local value2 = callback5((argument - 13.4) / 3)
                                        local interpolatedValue2 = argument2.A:Lerp(argument2.S2, value2)
                                        pos = Vector3.new(
                                            interpolatedValue2.X,
                                            entries2 + math.abs(math.sin(argument * 9)) * 0.12,
                                            interpolatedValue2.Z
                                        )
                                        interpolatedValue = callback9(transform - pos)
                                        value.rsx = value.rsx + 0.7 * math.sin(argument * 13)
                                        value.lsx = value.lsx + 0.7 * math.sin(argument * 11 + 1)
                                        value.rsz = value.rsz + 0.4 * math.sin(argument * 9)
                                        value.lsz = value.lsz - 0.4 * math.sin(argument * 8 + 2)
                                        value.ny = (value.ny or 0) + 0.45 * math.sin(argument * 7)
                                        value.rlx = 0.35 * math.sin(argument * 9)
                                        value.llx = -0.35 * math.sin(argument * 9)
                                        value.tp = (value.tp or 0) + 0.1 * math.sin(argument * 6)
                                    else
                                        if argument < 17.8 then
                                            pos = Vector3.new(argument2.S2.X, entries2, argument2.S2.Z)
                                            interpolatedValue = callback9(transform - pos)
                                        else
                                            local calculatedValue, position2, calculatedValue2 =
                                                argument - 17.8,
                                                Vector3.new(argument2.S2.X, entries2, argument2.S2.Z),
                                                dir * 42 + Vector3.new(0, 52, 0)

                                                position2 + calculatedValue2 * calculatedValue + Vector3.new(
                                                    0,
                                                    -14 * calculatedValue * calculatedValue,
                                                    0
                                                ),
                                                dir,
                                                CFrame.Angles(calculatedValue * 9, calculatedValue * 4, calculatedValue * 6)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                position, dir, entries2 =
                    CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + interpolatedValue) * CFrame.new(0, value.cy or 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(
                        value.tp or 0,
                        0,
                        0
                    ) * identity,
                    math.clamp((argument - 2.3) / 0.7, 0, 1),
                    {
                        Head = CFrame.new(0, 1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(value.nx or 0, value.ny or 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0),
                        ["Right Arm"] = CFrame.new(1, 0.5, 0)
                            * CFrame.Angles(value.rsx or 0, 0, value.rsz or 0)
                            * CFrame.new(0.5, -0.5, 0),
                        ["Left Arm"] = CFrame.new(-1, 0.5, 0)
                            * CFrame.Angles(value.lsx or 0, 0, value.lsz or 0)
                            * CFrame.new(-0.5, -0.5, 0),
                        ["Right Leg"] = CFrame.new(0.5, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(value.rlx or 0, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1, 0),
                        ["Left Leg"] = CFrame.new(-0.5, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(value.llx or 0, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1, 0),
                    }
                transform = argument < 3.25 and argument2.T0cf.Rotation:Lerp(position.Rotation, dir) + position.Position
                    or position
                p.Torso.CFrame = transform
                for key, item in pairs(entries2) do
                    position = dir >= 1 and item or argument2.frozen[key]:Lerp(item, dir)
                    p[key].CFrame = transform * position
                end
                if argument2.knife then
                    argument2.knife.CFrame = p["Right Arm"].CFrame * argument2.knifeRel
                end
                for unused, item in ipairs(argument2.extras or {}) do
                    item[1].CFrame = p.Head.CFrame * item[2]
                end
                argument2.headCF = p.Head.CFrame
                argument2.pos = pos
                return value
            end

            local function statue(argument, argument2, fight)
                if pulseNpc.dance then
                    fight = pulseNpc.dance.fight
                end
                local calculatedValue = pulseNpc.hum and pulseNpc.hum.HipHeight or 2
                argument2.tkf = argument2.tkf or callback11(calculatedValue)
                calculatedValue = callback10(argument, argument2.tkf)
                if argument > 8.4 then
                    if argument < 10.6 then
                        argument2 = callback6(argument, 8.4, 10.4, 0.2, 0.3)
                        calculatedValue.ny = (calculatedValue.ny or 0) + 0.38 * math.sin(argument * 5.5) * argument2
                        calculatedValue.nz = (calculatedValue.nz or 0) + 0.22 * math.cos(argument * 5.5) * argument2
                    end
                end
                if argument > 16.3 then
                    if argument < 17.25 then
                        local value, calculatedValue2 =
                            callback6(argument, 16.4, 17.1, 0.1, 0.12), (argument - 16.3) * 2 * 3.141592653589793 * 2.6
                        calculatedValue.rhx = (calculatedValue.rhx or 0) + 0.85 * math.sin(calculatedValue2) * value
                        calculatedValue.lhx = (calculatedValue.lhx or 0) - 0.85 * math.sin(calculatedValue2) * value
                        calculatedValue.rkx = (calculatedValue.rkx or 0)

                pulseNpc.tvBuild = function(argument)
                    local upperTorso, src, knifeSrc, extrasSrc = argument.song, pulseNpc.statueFind()
                    if src then
                        if not upperTorso.tracks then
                            return false
                        end
                    else
                        return false
                    end
                    local hrp, tv = pulseNpc.hrp, pulseNpc.hum
                    pcall(function()
                        if math.abs(pulseNpc.model:GetScale() - 1) > 0.001 then
                            pulseNpc.model:ScaleTo(1)
                        end
                    end)
                    local trailB = tv.HipHeight + hrp.Size.Y / 2
                    local floor, trailA, raycastParams =
                        pulseNpc.home.Position.Y - trailB, pulseNpc.home.Position, RaycastParams.new()
                    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = isActive3()
                    tv = -callback9(pulseNpc.home.LookVector)
                    local f = workspace:Raycast(trailA + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), tv * 14, raycastParams)
                    if f then
                        if math.abs(f.Normal.Y) > 0.3 then
                            return false
                        end
                    else
                        return false
                    end
                    local n = callback9(f.Normal)
                    local l = n:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
                    local calculatedValue = trailA - n * (trailA - f.Position):Dot(n)
                    local position = Vector3.new(calculatedValue.X, floor, calculatedValue.Z)
                    local function o(argument2)
                        local callback3, entries2 =
                            ipairs, { counter7 + 0.4, counter7 + counter2 / 2, counter7 + counter2 - 0.4 }
                        for key, raycastResult in callback3(entries2) do
                            key = position + l * argument2 + Vector3.new(0, raycastResult, 0) + n * 2
                            raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(key, -n * 4, raycastParams)
                            if raycastResult then
                                if math.abs((raycastResult.Position - key):Dot(-n) - 2) > 0.15 then
                                    return false
                                end
                            else
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                        return true
                    end
                    tv, f =
                        { 0, -0.5, 0.5, -1, 1, -1.5, 1.5, -2, 2, -2.5, 2.5, -3, 3, -3.5, 3.5, -4, 4, -4.5, 4.5, -5, 5, -5.5, 5.5, -6, 6 },
                        0
                    for key, item in ipairs(tv) do
                        key = true
                        for index = -4, 4, 1 do
                            if not (o(item + index / 4 * (counter / 2 + 0.15))) then
                                key = false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if key then
                            f = item
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    o = position + l * f
                    tv, f =
                        {
                            n = n,
                            L = l,
                            O = o,
                            floor = floor,
                            hip0 = trailB,
                            fired = {},
                            curS = 1,
                            tvS = -1,
                            homeD = (trailA - o):Dot(n),
                            homeL = (trailA - o):Dot(l),
                        },
                        o + Vector3.new(0, counter7 + counter2 / 2, 0)
                    tv.cf = CFrame.lookAt(f, f + n)
                    f =
                        { src = src, knifeSrc = knifeSrc, extrasSrc = extrasSrc, hidden = {}, fired = {}, floor = floor, torsoH = 3, sp = {} }

                        return false
                    end

                    tv.song = upperTorso

            pulseNpc.danceCtx = function(calculatedValue)
                local entries2, character = {}, pulseNpc.joints().RightShoulder
                local calculatedValue2 = character and character:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and character.Attachment0
                if not calculatedValue2 then
                    return entries2
                end
                character = localPlayer.Character
                local worldCFrame = character and (character:FindFirstChild("Head"))
                character = calculatedValue or (if worldCFrame then worldCFrame.Position else calculatedValue)
                if not character then
                    return entries2
                end
                worldCFrame = calculatedValue2.WorldCFrame
                calculatedValue = character - worldCFrame.Position
                if calculatedValue.Magnitude < 1 then
                    return entries2
                elseif calculatedValue.Magnitude > 70 then
                    return entries2
                end
                character = worldCFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(calculatedValue.Unit)
                entries2.ax = math.atan2(-character.Z, -character.Y)
                entries2.az = math.asin(math.clamp(character.X, -1, 1))
                return entries2
            end
            pulseNpc.danceStep = function(transform)
                local dance = pulseNpc.dance
                if not dance then
                    return
                end
                local song, now = dance.song, os.clock()
                local t = dance.running and now - dance.t0 or -(song.pre or 0)
                dance.t = t
                if dance.running then
                    if t >= song.len then
                        if not dance.ending then
                            dance.ending = now
                        end
                    end
                end
                if dance.pending and t >= 0 then
                    local pending = dance.pending
                    dance.pending = nil
                    pcall(function()
                        pending.TimePosition = 0
                        pending:Play()
                    end)
                end
                local calculatedValue
                if dance.pig then
                    pcall(pulseNpc.pigStep, t, dance)
                    calculatedValue = dance.pig and dance.pig.headPos
                    dance.faceAt = calculatedValue and t > -1.4 and t < 26.4 and calculatedValue or nil
                else
                end
                if dance.fight then
                    pcall(pulseNpc.fightStep, t, dance)
                end
                if dance.tv then
                    pcall(pulseNpc.tvStep, t, dance)
                end
                local success, result = pcall(pulseNpc.danceCtx, calculatedValue)
                if success then
                    if result.ax then
                        dance.ax = dance.ax and callback7(dance.ax, result.ax, 0.25) or result.ax
                        dance.az = dance.az and callback7(dance.az, result.az, 0.25) or result.az
                    end
                end
                success = { ax = dance.ax, az = dance.az }
                if calculatedValue then
                    result = pulseNpc.hrp.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(calculatedValue)
                    success.lookYaw = math.atan2(-result.X, -result.Z)
                    success.lookPitch = math.atan2(result.Y - 1.6, math.sqrt(result.X * result.X + result.Z * result.Z))
                end
                local value, calculatedValue2 = pulseNpc.POSES[song.key](math.min(t, song.len), song, success)
                t = callback5((now - dance.started) / 0.35)
                t = if dance.ending then t * (1 - callback5((now - dance.ending) / 0.35)) else t
                dance.spin = (calculatedValue2 or 0) * (dance.ending and 0 or 1)
                song, calculatedValue2 = pulseNpc.joints(), 1 - math.exp(-(transform or 0.016666666666666666) * 22)
                for key, item in pairs(value) do
                    result = song[key]
                    if result then
                        transform = (dance.cur[key] or CFrame.identity):Lerp(
                            CFrame.identity:Lerp(item, t),
                            calculatedValue2
                        )
                        dance.cur[key] = transform
                        result.Transform = transform
                    end
                end
                if dance.ending then
                    if now - dance.ending >= 0.36 then
                        pulseNpc.danceEnd()
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.danceEnd = function()
                local dance = pulseNpc.dance
                if not dance then
                    return
                end
                pulseNpc.dance = nil
                pcall(pulseNpc.pigFree, dance)
                pcall(pulseNpc.fightFree, dance)
                pcall(pulseNpc.tvFree, dance)
                if dance.noPrompt then
                    pcall(function()
                        if pulseNpc.prompt then
                            if pulseNpc.prompt.Parent then
                                if not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                                    pulseNpc.prompt.Enabled = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                local jointsResult = pulseNpc.joints()
                for key in pairs(dance.cur) do
                    local entry = jointsResult[key]
                    if entry then
                        pcall(function()
                            entry.Transform = CFrame.identity
                        end)
                    end
                end
                pcall(function()
                    if dance.snd then
                        if dance.snd.IsPlaying then
                            dance.snd:Stop()
                        end
                    end
                end)
                if pulseNpc.anims.idle then
                    pcall(function()
                        pulseNpc.anims.idle:Play(0.3)
                    end)
                end
                pulseNpc.lyrSt = {}
                pulseNpc.sLyrSt = {}
                if pulseNpc.lyrL then
                    pulseNpc.lyrL.Visible = false
                end
                if pulseNpc.sLyrF then
                    pulseNpc.sLyrF.Visible = false
                end
                pulseNpc.nextDance = os.clock() + 60 + math.random() * 90
            end
            pulseNpc.danceStop = function()
                local dance = pulseNpc.dance
                if dance then
                    if dance.ending then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                dance.ending = os.clock()
                local snd = dance.snd
                if snd and snd.IsPlaying then
                    local volume = snd.Volume
                    dance = tweenService:Create(snd, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { Volume = 0 })
                    dance:Play()
                    local function handleAction2()
                        pcall(function()
                            snd:Stop()
                            snd.Volume = volume
                        end)
                    end
                    dance.Completed:Connect(handleAction2)
                end
                if pulseNpc.lyrL then
                    pulseNpc.lyrL.Visible = false
                end
                if pulseNpc.sLyrF then
                    pulseNpc.sLyrF.Visible = false
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.pickSong = function(entries2)
                local songs = pulseNpc.SONGS
                if entries2 then
                    for unused, item in ipairs(songs) do
                        if item.key == entries2 then
                            return item
                        end
                    end
                end
                entries2 = {}
                for unused, item in ipairs(songs) do
                    if item.key ~= pulseNpc.lastSong then
                        if not item.manual then
                            if pulseNpc.songReady(item) then
                                entries2[#entries2 + 1] = item
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #entries2 == 0 then
                    for unused, item in ipairs(songs) do
                        if not item.manual then
                            if pulseNpc.songReady(item) then
                                entries2[#entries2 + 1] = item
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #entries2 == 0 then
                    return nil
                end
                return entries2[math.random(1, #entries2)]
            end
            pulseNpc.danceStart = function(argument)
                if pulseNpc.dance then
                    return
                elseif pulseNpc.isOpen then
                    return
                elseif pulseNpc.cut then
                    return
                elseif pulseNpc.model then
                    if pulseNpc.model.Parent then
                        if not pulseNpc.hrp then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                local song = pulseNpc.pickSong(argument)
                if not song then
                    pulseNpc.prepSongs()
                    pulseNpc.nextDance = os.clock() + 8
                    return
                end
                if not (pulseNpc.songReady(song)) then
                    pulseNpc.prepSongs()
                    if argument and not pulseNpc.waitSong then
                        pulseNpc.waitSong = true
                        task.spawn(function()
                            local now = os.clock()
                            while true do
                                local songReadyResult = pulseNpc.songReady(song)
                                if not (if songReadyResult then not songReadyResult else os.clock() - now < 45) then
                                    break
                                end
                                task.wait(0.25)
                            end
                            pulseNpc.waitSong = nil
                            if pulseNpc.songReady(song) then
                                pulseNpc.danceStart(argument)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    return
                end
                pulseNpc.lastSong = song.key
                local success = song.asset or false
                pulseNpc.dSnd = pulseNpc.dSnd or {}
                local pending = pulseNpc.dSnd[song.key]
                if success and not (pending and pending.Parent == pulseNpc.hrp) then
                    pcall(function()
                        if pending then
                            pending:Destroy()
                        end
                    end)
                    pending = createInstance(
                        "Sound",
                        {
                            Name = "PulseNpcDance",
                            SoundId = success,
                            Volume = song.vol or 0.85,
                            RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered,
                            RollOffMinDistance = 14,
                            RollOffMaxDistance = 90,
                        },
                        pulseNpc.hrp
                    )
                    pulseNpc.dSnd[song.key] = pending
                else
                end
                if success then
                else
                    pending = nil
                end
                local success2, base, result = pulseNpc.home.Position, pulseNpc.home, pulseNpc.myRoot()
                if result then
                    success = Vector3.new(result.Position.X - success2.X, 0, result.Position.Z - success2.Z)
                    base = if success.Magnitude > 0.5
                        then if success.Magnitude < 60 then CFrame.lookAt(success2, success2 + success.Unit) else base
                        else base
                else
                end
                local dance = { song = song, snd = pending, base = base, cur = {} }
                dance.started = os.clock()
                dance.t0 = os.clock()
                dance.running = false
                dance.spin = 0
                dance.forced = argument ~= nil
                pulseNpc.dance = dance
                if song.fight then
                    success2, success = pcall(pulseNpc.fightBuild, dance)
                    if success2 then
                        if not success then
                            pulseNpc.dance = nil
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        pulseNpc.dance = nil
                        return
                    end
                end
                if song.tv then
                    success, success2 = pcall(pulseNpc.tvBuild, dance)
                    if not (success and success2) then
                        pcall(pulseNpc.tvFree, dance)
                        pulseNpc.dance = nil
                        pulseNpc.nextDance = os.clock() + 20
                        return
                    end
                end
                if song.tv or song.fight then
                    dance.noPrompt = true
                    pcall(function()
                        if pulseNpc.prompt then
                            pulseNpc.prompt.Enabled = false
                        end
                    end)
                    pcall(pulseNpc.promptUi, false)
                end
                if song.pig then
                    success2, result = pcall(pulseNpc.pigBuild)
                    if success2 then
                        if result then
                            dance.pig = result
                            if not (pcall(pulseNpc.pigPlan, dance)) then
                                pulseNpc.pigFree(dance)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                for unused, item in pairs(pulseNpc.anims) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if item.IsPlaying then
                            item:Stop(0.25)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                task.spawn(function()
                    local now = os.clock()
                    while pending and not pending.IsLoaded and os.clock() - now < 3 do
                        task.wait()
                    end
                    task.wait(0.15)
                    if pulseNpc.dance ~= dance then
                        return
                    elseif dance.ending then
                        return
                    end
                    if pending then
                        if pending.IsLoaded then
                            pending.Volume = song.vol or 0.85
                            if song.pre then
                                dance.pending = pending
                            else
                                pending.TimePosition = 0
                                pending:Play()
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    dance.t0 = os.clock() + (song.pre or 0)
                    dance.running = true
                end)
            end
            pulseNpc.danceTick = function()
                if pulseNpc.dance then
                    if not pulseNpc.cfg().dances then
                        if not pulseNpc.dance.ending then
                            if not pulseNpc.dance.forced then
                                pcall(pulseNpc.danceStop)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not pulseNpc.cfg().dances then
                    return
                end
                if pulseNpc.dance then
                    return
                elseif pulseNpc.isOpen then
                    return
                elseif pulseNpc.cut then
                    return
                elseif pulseNpc.model then
                    if pulseNpc.model.Parent then
                        if not pulseNpc.hrp then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                local now = os.clock()
                if now > (pulseNpc.prepAt or 0) then
                    pulseNpc.prepAt = now + 30
                    local value = not pulseNpc.tvNoise
                    for unused, item in ipairs(pulseNpc.SONGS) do
                        value = if pulseNpc.songReady(item) then value else true
                    end
                    if value then
                        pulseNpc.prepSongs()
                    end
                end
                if not pulseNpc.nextDance then
                    pulseNpc.nextDance = now + 20 + math.random() * 40
                    return
                end
                if now < pulseNpc.nextDance then
                    return
                end
                local myRootResult = pulseNpc.myRoot()
                if myRootResult then
                    if (myRootResult.Position - pulseNpc.hrp.Position).Magnitude > 45 then
                        pulseNpc.nextDance = now + 4
                        return
                    end
                else
                    pulseNpc.nextDance = now + 4
                    return
                end
                pulseNpc.danceStart()
            end
            pulseNpc.lyrSt = {}
            pulseNpc.sLyrSt = {}
            pulseNpc.lyrDraw = function(calculatedValue, argument, argument2, argument3, calculatedValue2)
                local key = pulseNpc.dance
                if calculatedValue then
                    if not key then
                        return false
                    end
                else
                    return false
                end
                local value, value2, value3
                for key2, item in ipairs(key.song.lyr) do
                    if item.who == calculatedValue2 then
                        if argument3 >= item.w[1][1] - 0.3 then
                            if argument3 <= item.t1 then
                                local entry = item.w[1][1]
                                local calculatedValue3 = entry <= argument3 and entry or entry - 1000
                                if value then
                                    if calculatedValue3 > value then
                                        value, value2, value3 = calculatedValue3, item, key2
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                    value, value2, value3 = calculatedValue3, item, key2
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if not value2 then
                    calculatedValue.Visible = false
                    argument2.key = nil
                    return false
                end
                calculatedValue2 = 0
                for key2, item in ipairs(value2.w) do
                    calculatedValue2 = if argument3 >= item[1] then key2 else calculatedValue2
                end
                key = value3 * 100 + calculatedValue2
                if key ~= argument2.key then
                    argument2.key = key
                    local entries2 = {}
                    for key, item in ipairs(value2.w) do
                        local entry = item[2]
                        if key < calculatedValue2 then
                            entries2[key] = entry
                        elseif key == calculatedValue2 then
                            entries2[key] = '<font color="#FF4656">' .. entry .. "</font>"
                        else
                            entries2[key] = '<font transparency="0.6">' .. entry .. "</font>"
                        end
                    end
                    calculatedValue.Text = table.concat(entries2, " ")
                    if calculatedValue2 > 0 then
                        argument2.pop = os.clock()
                    end
                end
                calculatedValue2 = math.clamp((argument3 - (value2.w[1][1] - 0.3)) / 0.2, 0, 1)
                    * math.clamp((value2.t1 - argument3) / 0.2, 0, 1)
                calculatedValue.Visible = calculatedValue2 > 0
                calculatedValue.TextTransparency = 1 - calculatedValue2
                calculatedValue.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - calculatedValue2 * 0.65
                calculatedValue = argument2.pop and os.clock() - argument2.pop or 1
                argument.Scale = 1 + 0.14 * math.exp(-calculatedValue * 12)
                return calculatedValue2 > 0
            end
            pulseNpc.lyrStep = function(argument)
                pulseNpc.lyrDraw(pulseNpc.lyrL, pulseNpc.lyrScale, pulseNpc.lyrSt, argument, nil)
            end
            pulseNpc.step = function(argument)
                local hrp, home = pulseNpc.hrp, pulseNpc.home
                if hrp then
                    if hrp.Parent then
                        if not home then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                local dance = pulseNpc.dance
                if dance then
                    if dance.hrpCF then
                        hrp.CFrame = dance.hrpCF
                        return
                    end
                end
                if dance then
                    local position = pulseNpc.myRoot()
                    local calculatedValue = dance.faceAt or position and position.Position
                    if calculatedValue then
                        position = home.Position
                        local position2 = Vector3.new(calculatedValue.X - position.X, 0, calculatedValue.Z - position.Z)
                        if position2.Magnitude > 0.5 then
                            if position2.Magnitude < 60 then
                                dance.base = dance.base:Lerp(
                                    CFrame.lookAt(position, position + position2.Unit),
                                    math.clamp(argument * 2, 0, 1)
                                )
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    hrp.CFrame = dance.base * CFrame.Angles(0, dance.spin or 0, 0)
                    return
                end
                local calculatedValue, transform = pulseNpc.isOpen and (pulseNpc.faceAt or pulseNpc.myRoot())
                if calculatedValue then
                    dance = home.Position
                    local position =
                        Vector3.new(calculatedValue.Position.X - dance.X, 0, calculatedValue.Position.Z - dance.Z)
                    transform = if position.Magnitude > 0.5 then CFrame.lookAt(dance, dance + position.Unit) else home
                else
                    transform = home
                end
                dance = hrp.CFrame
                if dance ~= transform then
                    if
                        (dance.Position - transform.Position).Magnitude < 0.001
                        and dance.LookVector:Dot(transform.LookVector) > 0.999999
                        and dance.UpVector:Dot(transform.UpVector) > 0.999999
                    then
                        hrp.CFrame = transform
                    else
                        hrp.CFrame = dance:Lerp(transform, math.clamp(argument * 7, 0, 1))
                    end
                end
                local look = pulseNpc.anims.look
                if pulseNpc.isOpen then
                elseif look then
                    if not look.IsPlaying then
                        if os.clock() > (pulseNpc.nextLook or 0) then
                            pulseNpc.nextLook = os.clock() + 7 + math.random() * 6
                            pcall(function()
                                look:Play(0.4)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pulseNpc.neckStep = function()
                if pulseNpc.dance then
                    return
                end
                local camDist = pulseNpc.camDist
                if camDist then
                    if camDist > 150 then
                        if not pulseNpc.actorTalking then
                            if not pulseNpc.isOpen then
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local now, neck = os.clock(), pulseNpc.actorNeck
                if neck then
                    if neck.Parent then
                        if pulseNpc.actorTalking then
                            neck.Transform = neck.Transform
                                * CFrame.Angles(
                                    math.sin(now * 12) * 0.08 + 0.03,
                                    math.sin(now * 4.1) * 0.06,
                                    math.sin(now * 5.3) * 0.03
                                )
                        end
                    end
                end
                neck = pulseNpc.neck
                if neck then
                    if not neck.Parent then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                if pulseNpc.talking then
                    neck.Transform = neck.Transform
                        * CFrame.Angles(
                            math.sin(now * 13) * 0.07 + 0.03,
                            math.sin(now * 4.3) * 0.06,
                            math.sin(now * 6.1) * 0.03
                        )
                else
                    neck.Transform = neck.Transform * CFrame.Angles(
                        math.sin(now * 1.3) * 0.025,
                        math.sin(now * 0.7) * 0.05,
                        0
                    )
                end
            end

                        pulseNpc.sLyrF.Visible = false

            local function handleAction2()
                local newLobbyResult = entries.newLobby()
                for height, item in ipairs(entries.PIECES) do
                    item.height0 = item.height0 or item.height
                    height = item.height0
                    height = if newLobbyResult
                        then item.newHeight or item.hq and entries.NEW.face.size or entries.NEW.text.height
                        else height
                    if item.height ~= height then
                        item.height = height
                        local entry = entries.parts[item.name]
                        if entry then
                            pcall(function()
                                entry:Destroy()
                            end)
                            entries.parts[item.name] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
                local lbl = isActive2()
                if lbl then
                    if entries.lbl ~= lbl then
                        entries.lbl = lbl
                        connectSignal(lbl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
                            if lbl.Text == entries.orig then
                                lbl.Text = entries.text
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    if lbl.Text == entries.orig then
                        lbl.Text = entries.text
                    end
                end
                for unused, item in ipairs(entries.PIECES) do
                    newLobbyResult = entries.parts[item.name]
                    if newLobbyResult then
                        if not newLobbyResult.Parent then
                            pcall(handleAction, item)
                        end
                    else
                        pcall(handleAction, item)
                    end
                end
                pcall(pulseNpc.ensure)
            end
            callback(function()
                for unused, item in pairs(entries.parts) do
                    pcall(function()
                        item:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                for unused, item in pairs(entries.imgs or {}) do
                    for unused, item2 in ipairs(item) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item2.img:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                end
                pcall(function()
                    if entries.lbl then
                        if entries.lbl.Parent then
                            if entries.lbl.Text == entries.text then
                                entries.lbl.Text = entries.orig
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                while isActive() do
                    pcall(handleAction2)
                    task.wait(5)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
