    constructors.createFlightControls = function(connectSignal, parent, callback, settings, localPlayer, argument, uiPage, settings2)
        return function()
            local runService, userInputService, vel =
                game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("UserInputService"), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            local position = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            local humanoidStateType, enabled, enabled2, now = Enum.HumanoidStateType, false, false, 0
            connectSignal(userInputService.JumpRequest, function()
                now = os.clock()
            end)
            connectSignal(userInputService.InputBegan, function(argument2, argument3)
                if argument3 then
                    return
                elseif argument2.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                    return
                end
                if argument2.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
                    enabled = true
                elseif argument2.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
                    enabled2 = true
                end
            end)
            connectSignal(userInputService.InputEnded, function(argument2)
                if argument2.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
                    enabled = false
                elseif argument2.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
                    enabled2 = false
                end
            end)
            local entries, entries2, entries3 =
                { "Classic", "CFrame", "Swim", "Air Walk", "Glide" }, {}, { vel = vel, bank = 0, lastUp = 0 }
            local function callback2(calculatedValue)
                local camera, moveDirection, position2 =
                    parent.CurrentCamera, calculatedValue.MoveDirection, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
                calculatedValue = nil
                if camera then
                    local transform = camera.CFrame
                    local lookVector = transform.LookVector
                    local position3 = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z)
                    position2 = if position3.Magnitude > 0.01 then position3.Unit else position2
                    if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                        position3 = transform.RightVector
                        local position4 = Vector3.new(position3.X, 0, position3.Z)
                        position4 = if position4.Magnitude > 0.01 then position4.Unit else Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                        calculatedValue = lookVector * moveDirection:Dot(position2)
                            + position4 * moveDirection:Dot(position4)
                    else
                        calculatedValue = vel
                    end
                else
                    calculatedValue = vel
                end
                camera = if enabled then 1 else if os.clock() - now < 0.15 then 1 else 0
                camera = if enabled2 then camera - 1 else camera
                return calculatedValue, camera, position2
            end
            local function callback3(parent2)
                local bv = entries3.bv
                if if bv then entries3.bv.Parent ~= parent2 else not bv then
                    if entries3.bv then
                        pcall(function()
                            entries3.bv:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
                    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9000000000, 9000000000, 9000000000)
                    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
                    bodyVelocity:SetAttribute("PulseMine", true)
                    bodyVelocity.Parent = parent2
                    entries3.bv = bodyVelocity
                end
                bv = entries3.gyro
                if if bv then entries3.gyro.Parent ~= parent2 else not bv then
                    if entries3.gyro then
                        pcall(function()
                            entries3.gyro:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    local bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
                    bodyGyro.P = 90000
                    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9000000000, 9000000000, 9000000000)
                    bodyGyro.CFrame = parent2.CFrame
                    bodyGyro:SetAttribute("PulseMine", true)
                    bodyGyro.Parent = parent2
                    entries3.gyro = bodyGyro
                    entries3.gyroCF = parent2.CFrame
                end
            end
            local function callback4(argument2, argument3, argument4)
                entries3.states = entries3.states or {}
                local function callback5(argument5)
                    if entries3.states[argument5] ~= nil then
                        return
                    end
                    local success, result = pcall(function()
                        return argument2:GetStateEnabled(argument5)
                    end)
                    entries3.states[argument5] = not (success and result == false)
                end
                for unused, item in ipairs(argument3) do
                    callback5(item)
                    pcall(function()
                        argument2:SetStateEnabled(item, false)
                    end)
                end
                if argument4 then
                    callback5(argument4)
                    pcall(function()
                        argument2:SetStateEnabled(argument4, true)
                    end)
                end
            end
            local function callback5(argument2, argument3)
                local success, result = pcall(function()
                    return argument2:GetState()
                end)
                if success then
                    if result ~= argument3 then
                        pcall(function()
                            argument2:ChangeState(argument3)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            local function isActive()
                local hum = entries3.hum
                local states = entries3.states
                entries3.states = nil
                if not (hum and states) then
                    return
                end
                for key, item in pairs(states) do
                    pcall(function()
                        hum:SetStateEnabled(key, item)
                    end)
                end
                if hum.Parent then
                    if hum.Health > 0 then
                        pcall(function()
                            hum:ChangeState(humanoidStateType.Freefall)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            local function callback6(animator, argument2)
                if not argument2.PlatformStand then
                    pcall(function()
                        argument2.PlatformStand = true
                    end)
                end
                entries3.stand = true
                local animate = animator:FindFirstChild("Animate")
                if animate and not animate.Disabled then
                    pcall(function()
                        animate.Disabled = true
                    end)
                    entries3.animOff = true
                end
                animator = argument2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                if animator then
                    for unused, item in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        pcall(function()
                            item:Stop(0)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            local function callback7(argument2, calculatedValue, position2, argument3, argument4, argument5)
                local position3, position4 =
                    Vector3.new(calculatedValue.X, 0, calculatedValue.Z), Vector3.new(position2.X, 0, position2.Z)
                calculatedValue, position2 =
                    position3.Magnitude > 0.01 and position3.Unit
                        or (position4.Magnitude > 0.5 and position4.Unit or argument3),
                    argument2.Position
                position3 = CFrame.lookAt(position2, position2 + calculatedValue)
                position3 = if argument5 then position3 * argument5 else position3
                entries3.gyroCF = entries3.gyroCF and entries3.gyroCF:Lerp(position3, math.min(1, 8 * argument4))
                    or position3
                entries3.gyro.CFrame = entries3.gyroCF
            end
            local function callback8(argument2, argument3)
                if argument2.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
                    return argument3.Size.Y / 2 + 2
                end
                return argument2.HipHeight + argument3.Size.Y / 2
            end
            local function isActive2()
                local hum = entries3.hum
                local instance = hum and hum.Parent
                isActive()
                if entries3.bv then
                    pcall(function()
                        entries3.bv:Destroy()
                    end)
                    entries3.bv = nil
                end
                if entries3.gyro then
                    pcall(function()
                        entries3.gyro:Destroy()
                    end)
                    entries3.gyro = nil
                end
                if entries3.plat then
                    pcall(function()
                        entries3.plat:Destroy()
                    end)
                    entries3.plat = nil
                end
                if entries3.stand then
                    if hum then
                        pcall(function()
                            hum.PlatformStand = false
                        end)
                    end
                end
                if entries3.animOff and instance then
                    local animate = instance:FindFirstChild("Animate")
                    if animate then
                        pcall(function()
                            animate.Disabled = false
                        end)
                    end
                end
                entries3.stand = false
                entries3.animOff = false
                entries3.method = nil
                entries3.hum = nil
                entries3.hrp = nil
                entries3.gyroCF = nil
                entries3.level = nil
                entries3.pos = nil
                entries3.yaw = nil
                entries3.face = nil
                entries3.vel = vel
                entries3.bank = 0
                entries3.lastUp = 0
            end
            callback(function()
                pcall(isActive2)
            end)
            entries2.Classic = {
                start = function(argument2, argument3)
                    callback3(argument3)
                    callback4(argument2, { humanoidStateType.Freefall })
                    pcall(function()
                        argument2:ChangeState(humanoidStateType.Running)
                    end)
                end,
                step = function(
                    calculatedValue,
                    argument2,
                    argument3,
                    argument4,
                    argument5,
                    velocity,
                    argument6,
                    argument7
                )
                    callback3(argument2)
                    callback6(argument3, calculatedValue)
                    calculatedValue = argument5 + position * velocity
                    velocity = calculatedValue.Magnitude > 0.01 and calculatedValue.Unit * argument7 or vel
                    entries3.bv.Velocity = velocity
                    callback7(argument2, argument5, velocity, argument6, argument4)
                end,
            }
            entries2.CFrame = {
                start = function(argument2, argument3)
                    callback4(
                        argument2,
                        {
                            humanoidStateType.Freefall,
                            humanoidStateType.FallingDown,
                            humanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
                            humanoidStateType.Jumping,
                        }
                    )
                    entries3.pos = argument3.Position
                end,
                step = function(position2, argument2, pos, argument3, argument4, calculatedValue, argument5, argument6)
                    callback5(position2, humanoidStateType.Running)
                    pos = argument2.Position
                    if entries3.pos then
                        if (pos - entries3.pos).Magnitude > 8 then
                            entries3.pos = pos
                        end
                    else
                        entries3.pos = pos
                    end
                    position2 = argument4 + position * calculatedValue
                    if position2.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                        entries3.pos = entries3.pos + position2.Unit * argument6 * argument3
                    end
                    position2 = argument2.CFrame.LookVector
                    pos = Vector3.new(position2.X, 0, position2.Z)
                    pos = pos.Magnitude > 0.01 and pos.Unit or argument5
                    position2 = Vector3.new(argument4.X, 0, argument4.Z)
                    calculatedValue = position2.Magnitude > 0.01 and position2.Unit or pos
                    position2 = pos:Lerp(calculatedValue, math.min(1, 10 * argument3))
                    position2 = if position2.Magnitude < 0.01 then calculatedValue else position2
                    argument2.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(entries3.pos, entries3.pos + position2.Unit)
                    argument2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel
                    argument2.AssemblyAngularVelocity = vel
                end,
            }
            entries2.Swim = {
                start = function(argument2, argument3)
                    callback3(argument3)
                    callback4(
                        argument2,
                        {

                            humanoidStateType.Running,

                            humanoidStateType.Landed,
                            humanoidStateType.Jumping,
                            humanoidStateType.Climbing,
                            humanoidStateType.FallingDown,
                            humanoidStateType.GettingUp,
                            humanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
                        },
                        humanoidStateType.Swimming
                    )
                    callback5(argument2, humanoidStateType.Swimming)
                end,
                step = function(
                    calculatedValue,
                    argument2,
                    unused,
                    argument3,
                    argument4,
                    calculatedValue2,
                    argument5,
                    argument6
                )
                    callback3(argument2)
                    callback5(calculatedValue, humanoidStateType.Swimming)
                    calculatedValue = argument4 + position * calculatedValue2
                    calculatedValue2 = calculatedValue.Magnitude > 0.01 and calculatedValue.Unit * argument6 or vel
                    entries3.vel = entries3.vel:Lerp(calculatedValue2, math.min(1, 9 * argument3))
                    entries3.bv.Velocity = entries3.vel
                    callback7(argument2, argument4, entries3.vel, argument5, argument3)
                end,
            }
            entries2["Air Walk"] = {
                start = function(argument2, argument3)

                        argument2,

                        }

                    entries3.level = argument3.Position.Y - callback8(argument2, argument3)

                    callback3(argument2)

                    magnitude = atan2Result.Magnitude > 0.01 and 2.2 or 1.6

                            entries3.vel = vel
                        end

            connectSignal(runService.Stepped, function(pulseFlySpeed, clampedValue)
                if not (settings.fly and settings.fly.on) then

                    return

                    character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),

    constructors.createCharacterNoclip = function(connectSignal, argument, localPlayer, argument2, argument3)
        return function()
            local runService, entries = game:GetService("RunService"), {}
            local function pulseNoclipParts(instance)
                local entries2, entries3 = {}, {}
                local function callback(argument4)
                    if argument4 then
                        if not entries3[argument4] then
                            entries3[argument4] = true
                            entries2[#entries2 + 1] = argument4
                        end
                    end
                end
                for unused, instance2 in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
                    if instance2:IsA("BasePart") then
                        callback(instance2)
                    end
                end
                local rootPart = instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if rootPart then
                    local success, result = pcall(function()
                        return rootPart:GetConnectedParts(true)
                    end)
                    if success and type(result) == "table" then
                        for unused, item in ipairs(result) do
                            callback(item)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local entries3 = { "DisplayRefKnife", "DisplayRefGun" }
                for instance2, instance3 in ipairs(entries3) do
                    instance2 = instance:FindFirstChild(instance3)
                    instance3 = instance2 and instance2:IsA("ObjectValue") and instance2.Value
                    if instance3 and instance3.Parent then
                        if instance3:IsA("BasePart") then
                            callback(instance3)
                        end
                        for unused, instance in ipairs(instance3:GetDescendants()) do
                            if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                                callback(instance)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return entries2
            end
            getgenv().__pulseNoclipParts = pulseNoclipParts
            local value
            local entries2, entries3 = {}
            local enabled, counter = false, 0
            connectSignal(runService.Stepped, function()
                if argument.noclip and argument.noclip.on then
                    local character = localPlayer.Character
                    if character then
                        local now = os.clock()
                        if character ~= value or enabled or now - counter > 1 then
                            if character ~= value then
                                value = character
                                if entries3 then
                                    local value2 = entries3
                                    for unused, item in ipairs(value2) do
                                        pcall(function()
                                            item:Disconnect()
                                        end)
                                    end
                                end
                                local entries4, value, descendantRemoving =
                                    {}, connectSignal(character.DescendantAdded, function()
                                        enabled = true
                                    end), character.DescendantRemoving
                                appendValues(
                                    entries4,
                                    0,
                                    value,
                                    connectSignal(descendantRemoving, function()
                                        enabled = true
                                    end)
                                )
                                entries3 = entries4
                            end
                            enabled, counter = false, now
                            entries2 = pulseNoclipParts(character)
                        end
                        now = #entries2
                        for index = 1, now, 1 do
                            local entry = entries2[index]
                            if entry.CanCollide then
                                if entries[entry] == nil then
                                    entries[entry] = true
                                end
                                entry.CanCollide = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            local function isActive()
                for key, canCollide in pairs(entries) do
                    if key and key.Parent then
                        pcall(function()
                            key.CanCollide = canCollide
                        end)
                    end
                    entries[key] = nil
                end
            end
            local toggleKeyResult = argument2:ToggleKey({
                Text = "No Clip",
                Default = argument3.noclip.on,
                Bind = getgenv().__pulseBindFromName(argument.noclip.key or ""),
                Callback = function(argument4)
                    argument.noclip.on = argument4 and true or false
                    if not argument4 then
                        isActive()
                    end
                end,
                OnBind = function(argument4)
                    argument.noclip.key = argument4 and argument4.Name or ""
                end,
            })
            getgenv().__pulseSetNoclip = function(on)
                on = on and true or false
                if toggleKeyResult and toggleKeyResult.Set then
                    pcall(toggleKeyResult.Set, on)
                else
                    argument.noclip.on = on
                    if not on then
                        isActive()
                    end
                end
            end
            getgenv().__pulseGetNoclip = function()
                local calculatedValue = argument.noclip and argument.noclip.on and true or false
                return calculatedValue
            end
        end
    end
    
    return constructors
end

local function createRootBindings()
return function(M, page, cfg, env, connect, input, create, cleanup, notify)
    local sheriff = page("Sheriff")
    local settings = cfg.sheriff
    local function requireGunController()
        local ok, message = M.Load("24")
        if not ok then
            notify("Sheriff", message)
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    local function callOriginal(name)
        if not requireGunController() then
            return
        end
        local action = env[name]
        if type(action) ~= "function" then
            notify("Sheriff", "Original controller export unavailable: " .. name)
            return
        end
        return action()
    end
    sheriff:Header("Sheriff")
    sheriff:Toggle({
        Text = "Auto Pickup Gun",
        Default = settings.autoGun,
        Callback = function(on)
            settings.autoGun = on == true
        end,
        Settings = function()
            sheriff:Slider({
                Text = "Pickup Distance",
                Min = 10,
                Max = 5000,
                Default = settings.agDist,
                Callback = function(value)
                    settings.agDist = value
                end,
            })
        end,
    })
    local pickupKey
    sheriff:Keybind({
        Text = "Pick Up Gun",
        Default = nil,
        Callback = function(key)
            pickupKey = key
        end,
    })
    sheriff:Toggle({
        Text = "Silent Aim",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(on)
            settings.silentAim = on == true
            local aim = env.__pulseAim
            if type(aim) == "table" then
                aim.on = settings.silentAim
            end
        end,
        Settings = function()
            sheriff:Dropdown({
                Text = "Aim Version",
                Options = { "V1", "V2", "V3", "V4" },
                Default = settings.aimVer,
                Callback = function(value)
                    settings.aimVer = value
                end,
            })
            sheriff:Toggle({
                Text = "Auto Shoot",
                Default = false,
                Callback = function(on)
                    settings.autoShoot = on == true
                end,
            })
            sheriff:Toggle({
                Text = "Gun ESP",
                Default = false,
                Callback = function(on)
                    settings.gunEsp = on == true
                end,
            })
            sheriff:Toggle({
                Text = "Wallbang",
                Default = false,
                Callback = function(on)
                    settings.wallbang = on == true
                end,
            })
        end,
    })
    sheriff:Header("AimBot FOV")
    local ring = create("Frame", {
        Name = "PulseAimFOV",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = 30,
        Parent = M.Window.Gui,
    })
    create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0), Parent = ring })
    local ringStroke =
        create("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Color = settings.fov.color, Transparency = 0.15, Parent = ring })
    local function refreshFov()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        ring.Visible = M.Alive and settings.fov.on == true and camera ~= nil
        if camera then
            ring.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(camera.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, camera.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)
            ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(settings.fov.size * 2, settings.fov.size * 2)
        end
        ringStroke.Color = settings.fov.color
    end
    sheriff:Toggle({
        Text = "Show FOV Circle",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(on)
            settings.fov.on = on == true
            refreshFov()
        end,
        Settings = function()
            sheriff:Slider({
                Text = "FOV Radius",
                Min = 20,
                Max = 1500,
                Default = settings.fov.size,
                Suffix = " px",
                Callback = function(value)
                    settings.fov.size = value
                    refreshFov()
                end,
            })
            sheriff:Colorpicker({
                Text = "FOV Color",
                Default = settings.fov.color,
                Callback = function(value)
                    settings.fov.color = value
                    refreshFov()
                end,
            })
        end,
    })
    connect(game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped, refreshFov)
    cleanup(function()
        ring:Destroy()
    end)
    sheriff:Header("AimBot")
    local status = sheriff:Note({ Text = "Qwern X: controller not initialized" })
    M.RefreshAimStatus = function()
        local aim = env.__pulseAimX
        local stats = type(aim) == "table" and aim.stats
        if type(stats) == "table" and type(stats.fired) == "number" and type(stats.hit) == "number" then
            status.Text = "Qwern X  " .. tostring(stats.hit) .. "/" .. tostring(stats.fired)
        else
            status.Text = "Qwern X: controller not initialized"
        end
    end
    sheriff:Toggle({
        Text = "Resolver",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(on)
            settings.resolver = on == true
        end,
    })
    sheriff:Dropdown({
        Text = "AimBot Type",
        Default = "Universal",
        Options = { { code = "Universal", label = "Classic" }, { code = "Flick Shot", label = "Flick Shot" } },
        Callback = function(value)
            settings.aimType = value
        end,
    })
    sheriff:Slider({
        Text = "Flick Speed",
        Min = 1,
        Max = 10,
        Default = 6,
        Decimals = 0,
        Callback = function(value)
            settings.flickSpeed = value
        end,
    })
    sheriff:Toggle({
        Text = "Flick With Mouse",
        Default = true,
        Callback = function(on)
            settings.flickMouse = on == true
        end,
    })
    sheriff:Slider({
        Text = "Flick Return %",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 100,
        Default = 100,
        Decimals = 0,
        Callback = function(value)
            settings.flickReturn = value
        end,
    })
    sheriff:Slider({
        Text = "Prediction (ms)",
        Min = 0,
        Max = 300,
        Default = 0,
        Decimals = 0,
        Callback = function(value)
            settings.predEx = value / 1000
        end,
    })
    local shotKey
    sheriff:Keybind({
        Text = "Shot Murder",
        Default = nil,
        Callback = function(key)
            shotKey = key
        end,
    })
    connect(input.InputBegan, function(event, processed)
        if processed or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            return
        end
        if pickupKey and event.KeyCode == pickupKey then
            callOriginal("__pulsePickUpGun")
        end
        if shotKey and event.KeyCode == shotKey then
            callOriginal("__pulseShotMurder")
        end
    end)
end

end
referenceLayout.buildSheriff = createRootBindings()

local function createNetworkRuntimeFactory()
return function(context)
    local app, env, scope, http = context.app, context.env, context.scope or {}, context.http
    local runtime = {}
    local clock = context.clock or os.clock
    local previousPost = type(env.PulseSignedPost) == "function" and env.PulseSignedPost
        or type(env.__pulseTags) == "table" and type(env.__pulseTags.post) == "function" and env.__pulseTags.post
    local network = {
        attempts = 0,
        replies = 0,
        lastStatus = nil,
        lastError = nil,
        lastEndpoint = nil,
        executorAPI = nil,
        services = {},
        context = "Roblox client executor",
    }
    app.Network = network
    local function pulsePath(url)
        local host, path
        if type(url) == "string" then
            host, path = url:match("^https?://([^/:]+)(/[^?]*)")
        end
        if host == "pulsehub.gg" or host == "api.pulsehub.gg" then
            return path or "/"
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function serviceFor(path)
        if type(path) ~= "string" then
            return "external"
        end
        if path:match("^/pulse/chat/") then
            return "chat"
        end
        if path:match("^/pulse/cfg/") then
            return "configs"
        end
        if path == "/pulse/servers" or path == "/pulse/private" then
            return "users"
        end
        return "other"
    end
    local function record(path)
        local name = serviceFor(path)
        local value = network.services[name]
        if not value then
            value = { state = "not attempted", attempts = 0 }
            network.services[name] = value
        end
        return value
    end
    local function usable(fn)
        return type(fn) == "function" and fn ~= runtime.Request and fn ~= runtime.Post
    end
    function runtime.ResolveRequest()
        for _, source in ipairs({ env, scope }) do
            for _, key in ipairs({ "request", "http_request", "httprequest" }) do
                if usable(source[key]) then
                    network.executorAPI = key
                    app.RequestAPIReady = true
                    return source[key], key
                end
            end
            for _, namespace in ipairs({ "syn", "http", "fluxus" }) do
                local item = source[namespace]
                if type(item) == "table" and usable(item.request) then
                    network.executorAPI = namespace .. ".request"
                    app.RequestAPIReady = true
                    return item.request, network.executorAPI
                end
            end
        end
        app.RequestAPIReady = false
        network.executorAPI = nil
        return nil
    end
    function runtime.ResolveSignedRequest()
        for _, source in ipairs({ env, scope }) do
            if usable(source.PulseSignedRequest) then
                return source.PulseSignedRequest
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function runtime.ResolvePost()
        for _, source in ipairs({ env, scope }) do
            if usable(source.PulseSignedPost) then
                return source.PulseSignedPost
            end
            local tags = source.__pulseTags
            if type(tags) == "table" and usable(tags.post) then
                return tags.post
            end
        end
        if usable(previousPost) then
            return previousPost
        end
        return nil
    end
    function runtime.Refresh()
        runtime.ResolveRequest()
        app.OriginalTransportReady = runtime.ResolveSignedRequest() ~= nil or runtime.ResolvePost() ~= nil
    end
    local function issue(path, reason, state)
        reason = tostring(reason)
        network.lastStatus, network.lastError = 0, reason
        local current = record(path)
        current.state, current.status, current.error, current.time = state or "transport error", 0, reason, clock()
        return {
            Success = false,
            StatusCode = 0,
            Body = "",
            Error = reason,
            TransportFailure = true,
        }
    end
    local function ready(path)
        if not app.Alive then
            return issue(path, "Qwern session is unloaded", "unloaded")
        end
        if not app.Online then
            return issue(path, "HTTP is disabled by the explicit offline option", "paused")
        end
        if context.player == nil then
            return issue(path, "LocalPlayer is not ready", "waiting for game")
        end
        if context.game and type(context.game.IsLoaded) == "function" and not context.game:IsLoaded() then
            return issue(path, "Roblox client is still loading", "waiting for game")
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function begin(url, path)
        network.attempts += 1
        network.lastEndpoint = url:match("^[^?]+")
        network.lastStatus, network.lastError = nil, nil
        local current = record(path)
        current.attempts += 1
        current.state, current.error, current.status, current.time = "requesting", nil, nil, clock()
        return current
    end
    local function accept(current, reply, decoded)
        local status = tonumber(reply.StatusCode or reply.Status or reply.status_code)
        network.replies += 1
        network.lastStatus = status
        current.status, current.time = status, clock()
        if not decoded then
            local body = reply.Body or reply.body
            if type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
                local ok, value = pcall(http.JSONDecode, http, body)
                if ok and type(value) == "table" then
                    decoded = value
                end
            end
        end
        local rejected = status and status >= 400 or type(decoded) == "table" and decoded.ok == false
        if rejected then
            local reason = type(decoded) == "table" and (decoded.error or decoded.err) or nil
            current.state = "server rejected request"
            current.error = tostring(reason or "HTTP " .. tostring(status or "error"))
            network.lastError = current.error
        else
            current.state = type(decoded) == "table" and decoded.ok == true and "service replied" or "reply received"
            current.error, network.lastError = nil, nil
        end
        return reply
    end
    function runtime.Request(options)
        if type(options) ~= "table" or type(options.Url) ~= "string" then
            return issue(nil, "Invalid HTTP request")
        end
        local path = pulsePath(options.Url)
        local blocked = ready(path)
        if blocked then
            return blocked
        end
        runtime.Refresh()
        local current = begin(options.Url, path)
        local ok, reply = pcall(function()
            if path then
                local signed = runtime.ResolveSignedRequest()
                if signed then
                    return signed(options)
                end
                local post = runtime.ResolvePost()
                if post and (options.Method or "GET"):upper() == "POST" then
                    local data = http:JSONDecode(options.Body or "{}")
                    local value = post(path, data)
                    if type(value) ~= "table" then
                        error("Provided Qwern transport returned no data", 0)
                    end
                    return { Body = http:JSONEncode(value) }
                end
            end
            local fn = runtime.ResolveRequest()
            if not fn then
                error("This executor has no supported HTTP request API yet", 0)
            end
            return fn(options)
        end)
        if not ok then
            local failure = issue(path, reply)
            if not path then
                error(failure.Error, 0)
            end
            return failure
        end
        if type(reply) == "string" then
            reply = { Body = reply }
        end
        if type(reply) ~= "table" then
            return issue(path, "HTTP transport returned no response")
        end
        return accept(current, reply)
    end
    function runtime.Post(path, data)
        local blocked = ready(path)
        if blocked then
            return nil, blocked.Error
        end
        runtime.Refresh()
        local post = runtime.ResolvePost()
        if post then
            local current = begin("https://pulsehub.gg" .. path, path)
            local ok, value = pcall(post, path, data)
            if not ok then
                return nil, issue(path, value).Error
            end
            if type(value) ~= "table" then
                return nil, issue(path, "Provided Qwern transport returned no data").Error
            end
            accept(current, {}, value)
            return value
        end
        local encoded, body = pcall(http.JSONEncode, http, data)
        if not encoded then
            return nil, issue(path, body).Error
        end
        local reply = runtime.Request({
            Url = "https://pulsehub.gg" .. path,
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", Accept = "application/json" },
            Body = body,
        })
        if reply.TransportFailure then
            return nil, reply.Error
        end
        local ok, decoded = pcall(http.JSONDecode, http, reply.Body or reply.body or "")
        if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
            return decoded
        end
        return nil, "The service response was not JSON"
    end
    function runtime.Report()
        runtime.Refresh()
        local lines = {
            "Client HTTP API: "
                .. tostring(
                    network.executorAPI
                        or (app.OriginalTransportReady and "provided Qwern adapter" or "not available yet")
                ),
        }
        for _, name in ipairs({ "chat", "configs", "users" }) do
            local item = network.services[name]
            local text = item and item.state or "not attempted"
            if item and item.status then
                text ..= " / " .. tostring(item.status)
            end
            if item and item.error then
                text ..= " / " .. item.error
            end
            lines[#lines + 1] = name .. ": " .. text
        end
        return table.concat(lines, "\n")
    end
    runtime.Refresh()
    return runtime
end

end
referenceLayout.createNetworkRuntime = createNetworkRuntimeFactory()

local function createDiscordLauncherFactory()
return function(context)
    local app, env, scope = context.app, context.env, context.scope
    local url, code = context.url, context.code
    local state = { state = "not requested", method = nil, error = nil }
    app.DiscordStatus = state
    local function active()
        return app.Alive == true
    end
    local function member(root, name)
        if root == nil then
            return nil
        end
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return root[name]
        end)
        return ok and value or nil
    end
    local function resolve(name)
        local value = member(env, name)
        if type(value) ~= "function" then
            value = member(scope, name)
        end
        return type(value) == "function" and value or nil
    end
    local function report(method, message, err)
        state.method, state.state, state.error = method, message, err
        return message
    end
    local function invokeBrowser(fn, receiver, method)
        if type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return false
        end
        local ok, result
        if receiver then
            ok, result = pcall(fn, receiver, url)
        else
            ok, result = pcall(fn, url)
        end
        if ok and result ~= false then
            report(method, "Browser open requested")
            return true
        end
        state.error = tostring(ok and "Browser function rejected the URL" or result)
        return false
    end
    return function()
        if not active() then
            return false, report(nil, "Session is unloaded")
        end
        state.error = nil
        for _, name in ipairs({ "openurl", "open_url" }) do
            if invokeBrowser(resolve(name), nil, name) then
                return true, state.state
            end
        end
        for _, source in ipairs({ env, scope }) do
            local synApi = member(source, "syn")
            if invokeBrowser(member(synApi, "open_url"), nil, "syn.open_url") then
                return true, state.state
            end
        end
        local guiOk, gui = pcall(function()
            return context.game:GetService("GuiService")
        end)
        if guiOk and invokeBrowser(member(gui, "OpenBrowserWindow"), gui, "GuiService.OpenBrowserWindow") then
            return true, state.state
        end
        if app.Online == true then
            local request = context.resolveRequest()
            if type(request) == "function" then
                local ok, body = pcall(function()
                    return context.http:JSONEncode({
                        cmd = "INVITE_BROWSER",
                        args = { code = code },
                        nonce = context.http:GenerateGUID(false),
                    })
                end)
                if ok then
                    for port = 6463, 6472 do
                        if not active() then
                            return false, report(nil, "Session is unloaded")
                        end
                        local received, response = pcall(request, {
                            Url = ("http://127.0.0.1:%d/rpc?v=1"):format(port),
                            Method = "POST",
                            Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", Origin = "https://discord.com" },
                            Body = body,
                            Timeout = 1,
                        })
                        if received and type(response) == "table" and tonumber(response.StatusCode) == 200 then
                            local rejected = false
                            if type(response.Body) == "string" and response.Body ~= "" then
                                local parsed, decoded = pcall(context.http.JSONDecode, context.http, response.Body)
                                if parsed and type(decoded) == "table" and decoded.evt == "ERROR" then
                                    rejected = true
                                    state.error = tostring(decoded.data and decoded.data.message or "Discord RPC error")
                                end
                            end
                            if not rejected then
                                return true, report("Discord RPC", "Discord invite requested")
                            end
                        elseif not received then
                            state.error = tostring(response)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    state.error = tostring(body)
                end
            end
        end
        if not active() then
            return false, report(nil, "Session is unloaded")
        end
        local clipboard = resolve("setclipboard") or resolve("toclipboard")
        if clipboard then
            local copied, result = pcall(clipboard, url)
            if copied and result ~= false then
                return false, report("Clipboard", "Link copied: " .. url, state.error)
            end
            state.error = tostring(copied and "Clipboard rejected the URL" or result)
        end
        return false, report(nil, "Open this link: " .. url, state.error)
    end
end

end
referenceLayout.createDiscordLauncher = createDiscordLauncherFactory()

        local function serial(value)

        local requestCell = cell(nil)

        local currentRound
        local function roundClient()
            if currentRound then
                return currentRound
            end
            local folder = replicated:FindFirstChild("Modules")
            local module = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("CurrentRoundClient")
            if not module then
                error("MM2 CurrentRoundClient is unavailable", 0)
            end
            currentRound = require(module)
            assert(type(currentRound) == "table", "CurrentRoundClient did not return a table")
            return currentRound
        end
        local roundCell = cell(roundClient)
        local roleCache, roleTime, roleBusy, roleFailure = nil, -100, false, "Not requested"
        local function roles()
            if not roleBusy and os.clock() - roleTime > 0.5 then
                roleBusy = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok, value = pcall(function()
                        local success, client = pcall(roundClient)
                        if success and type(client.GetLatestPlayerData) == "function" then
                            local data = client.GetLatestPlayerData()
                            if type(data) == "table" then
                                return data
                            end
                        end
                        local remote = replicated:FindFirstChild("GetPlayerData", true)
                        assert(remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction"), "MM2 GetPlayerData remote is unavailable")
                        return remote:InvokeServer()
                    end)
                    roleTime, roleBusy = os.clock(), false
                    if ok and type(value) == "table" then
                        roleCache, roleFailure = value, nil
                        env.__pulseData = value
                    else
                        roleFailure = tostring(value)
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not roleCache then
                error("Role data unavailable: " .. tostring(roleFailure), 0)
            end
            return roleCache
        end
        local networkRuntime
        local requestScope = getfenv(1)
        local executorRequest
        local function resolveExecutorRequest()
            if networkRuntime then
                executorRequest = networkRuntime.ResolveRequest()
            else
                executorRequest = type(env.request) == "function" and env.request
                    or type(env.http_request) == "function" and env.http_request
                    or type(env.httprequest) == "function" and env.httprequest
                    or type(env.syn) == "table" and env.syn.request
                    or type(env.http) == "table" and env.http.request
                    or type(request) == "function" and request
                    or type(http_request) == "function" and http_request
                    or type(httprequest) == "function" and httprequest
                    or type(syn) == "table" and syn.request
                    or type(http) == "table" and http.request
            end
            return executorRequest
        end
        resolveExecutorRequest()
        local function request(options2)
            assert(M.Alive, "Qwern session is unloaded")
            assert(M.Online, "HTTP is disabled by the explicit offline option")
            local fn = resolveExecutorRequest()
            assert(type(fn) == "function", "This executor has no supported HTTP request API yet")
            assert(type(options2) == "table" and type(options2.Url) == "string", "Invalid HTTP request")
            return fn(options2)
        end
        setCell(requestCell, request)
        local function download(url)
            assert(M.Online, "Online asset downloads are disabled")
            local response = request({ Url = url, Method = "GET" })
            assert(type(response) == "table", "Invalid HTTP response")
            local status = tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.Status)
            if status and (status < 200 or status >= 300) then
                error("HTTP " .. tostring(status), 0)
            end
            local body = response.Body or response.body
            assert(type(body) == "string", "HTTP response has no body")
            return body
        end

            return (

                    return string.format("%02x", string.byte(byte))
                end)
            )
        end

                    target, sub = "Player", nil

                target, sub = "Troll", "Fling"

                    SkyFX = "Sky",
                    Random = "Effects",
                    WSkins = "Skins",

                    target, sub = "Settings", "Performance"

                target, sub = "Settings", "Performance"
            elseif name == "Mobile" then

            elseif name == "Sounds" or name == "SoundCloud" then
                target, sub = "Music", nil

            return target, sub, label
        end

            local function applyReferenceOrder(tab)
                for index, section in ipairs(tab.Sections) do
                    local title = section.TitleLabel and section.TitleLabel.Text
                    local rule = referenceLayout.cards[tab.Name] and referenceLayout.cards[tab.Name][title]
                    local node = section.Floating and section.Slot or section.Wrap
                    if node then
                        node.LayoutOrder = rule and rule.order or (1000 + index)
                    end
                end
            end
            local nativeBalance = target._balance
            target._balance = function(self, ...)
                local result = nativeBalance(self, ...)
                applyReferenceOrder(self)
                return result
            end
            local nativeSection = target.Section
            target.Section = function(self, properties)
                properties = type(properties) == "table" and table.clone(properties) or { Title = tostring(properties) }
                local rule = referenceLayout.cards[self.Name] and referenceLayout.cards[self.Name][properties.Title]
                if rule then
                    properties.Side = rule.side
                end
                properties.Icon = properties.Icon or referenceLayout.sectionIcons[properties.Title]
                if self.Name == "Player" and properties.Title == "Movement" then
                    for _, existing in ipairs(self.Sections) do
                        if existing.TitleLabel and existing.TitleLabel.Text == "Movement" then
                            return existing
                        end
                    end
                end
                local section = nativeSection(self, properties)
                applyReferenceOrder(self)
                return section
            end
        end

        function shared:Tab(name, icon)
            local requestedName = name
            if pages[name] then
                shared.NovaTabs[requestedName] = pages[name].Native
                return pages[name]
            end
            local page = adapt(self, name, icon or tabIcons[canonicalPage(name)] or "circle")
            assert(page and page.Native, "Cannot create real UI page: " .. tostring(name))
            for _, kind in ipairs({
                "Toggle",
                "ToggleKey",
                "Slider",
                "Button",
                "Dropdown",
                "Colorpicker",
                "Keybind",
                "Textbox",
            }) do
                local original = page[kind]
                if type(original) == "function" then
                    page[kind] = function(self2, properties, ...)
                        local ownerName = owner
                        if type(properties) == "table" then
                            properties = table.clone(properties)
                            if kind == "Button" and properties.Text == "Join Discord" then
                                properties.Callback = openDiscordFromUI
                                M.DiscordSettingsCallback = properties.Callback
                            end
                            if kind == "Dropdown" and type(properties.Options) == "table" then
                                local normalized = {}
                                for _, option in ipairs(properties.Options) do
                                    if type(option) == "string" or type(option) == "number" then
                                        normalized[#normalized + 1] = { code = option, label = tostring(option) }
                                    elseif type(option) == "table" and option.code ~= nil then
                                        normalized[#normalized + 1] = option
                                    end
                                end
                                properties.Options = normalized
                            end
                            for _, callbackName in ipairs({ "Callback", "OnBind", "OnSelect" }) do
                                if type(properties[callbackName]) == "function" then
                                    properties[callbackName] = guard(properties[callbackName], ownerName)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        local handle = original(self2, properties, ...)
                        for key, value in pairs(activeValues) do
                            if initialValues[key] == nil then
                                initialValues[key] = deepCopy(value)
                            end
                        end
                        local section = type(page.LastSection) == "function" and page:LastSection() or nil
                        local sectionOwner = section
                        if sectionOwner and not sectionOwner.Tab then
                            sectionOwner = sectionOwner.ParentSection
                        end
                        local actualPage = sectionOwner and sectionOwner.Tab and sectionOwner.Tab.Name
                            or canonicalPage(name)
                        local actualCard = sectionOwner and sectionOwner.TitleLabel and sectionOwner.TitleLabel.Text
                        if
                            actualPage == "Player"
                            and actualCard == "Movement"
                            and type(handle) == "table"
                            and handle.Row
                        then
                            local rank = table.find(
                                referenceLayout.movementRows,
                                type(properties) == "table" and properties.Text or ""
                            )
                            if rank then
                                handle.Row.LayoutOrder = rank * 100
                            end
                        end
                        M.Controls[#M.Controls + 1] = {
                            owner = ownerName,
                            kind = kind,
                            text = type(properties) == "table" and tostring(properties.Text or properties.Title or kind)
                                or tostring(properties),
                            handle = handle,
                            page = actualPage,
                            logicalPage = name,
                            card = actualCard,
                            side = sectionOwner and sectionOwner.Side,
                        }
                        return handle
                    end
                end
            end
            pages[name] = page
            shared.NovaTabs[requestedName] = page.Native
            return page
        end

        for _, definition in ipairs(definitions) do

                "Missing recovered constructor " .. definition[1]

                Id = definition[1],
                Name = definition[2],
                Page = definition[3],
                Dependencies = definition[4],
                Arguments = definition[5],
                State = "Not initialized",
                Definition = definition,
                Constructor = record.constructor,
                Arity = definition.arity or record.capture_count,
                Errors = 0,
                LiveVerified = false,
                NetworkRequired = definition.network or record.uses_HTTP_or_external_downloads,

        configApi.fetch = function(key)
            M.Load("13932")
            assert(env.__pulseCfgHub and env.__pulseCfgHub.fetch, "Config Hub is unavailable")
            return env.__pulseCfgHub.fetch(key)
        end
        configApi.upload = function(...)
            M.Load("13932")
            assert(env.__pulseCfgHub and env.__pulseCfgHub.upload, "Config Hub is unavailable")
            return env.__pulseCfgHub.upload(...)
        end
        local function setNote(note, text)
            if type(note) == "table" and type(note.Set) == "function" then
                pcall(note.Set, text)
            elseif typeof(note) == "Instance" then
                pcall(function()
                    note.Text = text
                end)
            end
        end
        local function addNewDefaults(destination, source)
            for key, value in pairs(source) do
                if destination[key] == nil then
                    destination[key] = deepCopy(value)
                elseif type(destination[key]) == "table" and type(value) == "table" then
                    addNewDefaults(destination[key], value)
                end
            end
        end
        function M.Load(id)
            assert(M.Alive, "Qwern restored is unloaded")
            local module = assert(M.Modules[tostring(id)], "Unknown application module")
            if
                (module.Id == "3000" or module.Id == "12033")
                and not M.OriginalTransportReady
                and not module.Definition.offlineUI
            then
                return false,
                    "Original Qwern online views require the real signed client transport. No signature was invented."
            end
            if module.State == "Initialized" or module.State == "Partial" then
                return true
            end
            if module.State == "Failed" then
                return false, "This module already failed. Copy Diagnostics, unload, and restart before retrying."
            end
            if module.State == "Initializing" then
                return false, "Initialization already running"
            end
            if module.Definition.network and not module.Definition.offlineUI and not M.Online then
                module.State = "Blocked: online permission"
                return false, module.State
            end
            if
                module.Definition.network
                and not module.Definition.offlineUI
                and type(executorRequest) ~= "function"
                and not ((module.Id == "3000" or module.Id == "12033") and M.OriginalTransportReady)
            then
                module.State = "Blocked: HTTP API missing"
                return false, module.State
            end
            if
                module.Definition.needsLobby
                and not (workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby") or workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby"))
            then
                module.State = "Blocked: live lobby missing"
                return false, module.State
            end
            for _, dependency in ipairs(module.Dependencies) do
                local success, message = M.Load(dependency)
                if not success then
                    module.State = "Blocked: " .. dependency
                    return false, message
                end
            end
            local previousOwner, before = owner, #M.Errors
            owner, module.State = module.Name, "Initializing"
            module.InitializerThread = coroutine.running()
            local environmentBefore = {}
            for key, value in pairs(env) do
                environmentBefore[key] = value
            end
            local success, message = xpcall(function()
                local captures = module.Arguments()
                local initializer = native[module.Constructor](unpackValues(captures, 1, module.Arity))
                assert(type(initializer) == "function", "Recovered constructor did not return an initializer")
                initializer()
                if module.Definition.after then
                    module.Definition.after()
                end
                if id == "24" and type(M.RefreshAimStatus) == "function" then
                    M.RefreshAimStatus()
                end
            end, function(value)
                return debug.traceback(tostring(value), 2)
            end)
            module.InitializerThread = nil
            for key, value in pairs(env) do
                if
                    type(key) == "string"
                    and (key:match("^__pulse") or key:match("^PULSE_"))
                    and environmentBefore[key] ~= value
                then
                    if oldGlobals[key] == nil then
                        oldGlobals[key] = { previous = environmentBefore[key], assigned = value }
                    else
                        oldGlobals[key].assigned = value
                    end
                end
            end
            owner = previousOwner
            if not success then
                log(message, "error", module.Name)
                module.State = "Failed"
                module.Failure = message
            else
                module.Errors = #M.Errors - before
                module.State = module.Errors > 0 and "Partial" or "Initialized"
                addNewDefaults(defaults, cfg)
                module.InterfaceOnly = module.Definition.offlineUI == true and not M.Online
            end
            if module.Note then
                setNote(module.Note, module.Name .. ": " .. module.State .. " — live gameplay not verified")
            end
            return success, message
        end
        function M.Check()
            local checks = {
                { name = "LocalPlayer", ok = player ~= nil },
                { name = "Recovered constructors", ok = #manifest == 59 },
                { name = "Native Nova UI", ok = window.Gui ~= nil and window.Gui.Parent ~= nil },
                {
                    name = "SHA256 known vector",
                    ok = crypto.sha256hex("abc") == "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad",
                },
                { name = "Current camera", ok = workspace.CurrentCamera ~= nil },
                { name = "HTTP API (not invoked)", ok = type(resolveExecutorRequest()) == "function", optional = true },
                {
                    name = "MM2 round module (not invoked)",
                    ok = replicated:FindFirstChild("Modules") ~= nil,
                    optional = true,
                },
                { name = "Character", ok = player.Character ~= nil, optional = true },
            }
            local character = player.Character
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if cfg.movement.speedOn then
                checks[#checks + 1] = {
                    name = "WalkSpeed local readback",
                    ok = humanoid ~= nil and math.abs(humanoid.WalkSpeed - cfg.movement.speed) < 0.01,
                }
            end
            if cfg.movement.jumpOn then
                checks[#checks + 1] = {
                    name = "JumpPower local readback",
                    ok = humanoid ~= nil
                        and humanoid.UseJumpPower
                        and math.abs(humanoid.JumpPower - cfg.movement.jump) < 0.01,
                }
            end
            if cfg.movement.fovOn then
                checks[#checks + 1] = {
                    name = "FOV local readback",
                    ok = workspace.CurrentCamera ~= nil
                        and math.abs(workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView - cfg.movement.fov) < 0.01,
                }
            end
            local total, ready, failed, pending = 0, 0, 0, 0
            for _, module in pairs(M.Modules) do
                total += 1
                if module.State == "Initialized" then
                    ready += 1
                elseif module.State == "Failed" or module.State == "Partial" then
                    failed += 1
                else
                    pending += 1
                end
            end
            return {
                build = M.Build,
                checks = checks,
                sourceModules = #manifest,
                sourceInnerFunctions = 7139,
                applicationModules = total,
                initialized = ready,
                failedOrPartial = failed,
                notInitializedOrBlocked = pending,
                controls = #M.Controls,
                errors = M.Errors,
                onlineEnabled = M.Online,
                roleDataFailure = roleFailure,
                network = M.Network,
                missingIcons = M.MissingIcons,
                liveGameplayVerified = false,
            }
        end
        function M.Report()
            local result = M.Check()
            local lines = {
                "Qwern / recovered original Nova UI",
                "59 recovered constructors; 7139 original inner functions",
                "Initialized: " .. result.initialized .. "/" .. result.applicationModules,
                "Failed/partial: " .. result.failedOrPartial,
                "Blocked/pending: " .. result.notInitializedOrBlocked,
                "Registered controls: " .. result.controls,
                "Live gameplay: NOT VERIFIED",
                "GUI: actual native constructor 35 plus adapter 38; no replacement shell",
                "HTTP: " .. (M.Online and "enabled" or "explicit offline mode"),
                "Original Qwern transport: "
                    .. (
                        M.OriginalTransportReady and "provided signing adapter"
                        or M.RequestAPIReady and "executor HTTP; server authorization is not bypassed"
                        or "HTTP API missing"
                    ),
                "Last backend status: " .. tostring(M.Network and M.Network.lastStatus or "not received"),
                "Last backend error: " .. tostring(M.Network and M.Network.lastError or "none"),
            }
            if type(M.GetOnlineStatus) == "function" then
                lines[#lines + 1] = M.GetOnlineStatus()
            end
            for _, check in ipairs(result.checks) do
                lines[#lines + 1] = (check.ok and "PRESENT: " or "MISSING: ") .. check.name
            end
            for _, definition in ipairs(definitions) do
                local module = M.Modules[definition[1]]
                lines[#lines + 1] = module.Id .. " " .. module.Name .. " — " .. module.State
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(M.Errors) do
                lines[#lines + 1] = "ERROR [" .. item.owner .. "] " .. item.message
            end
            return table.concat(lines, "\n")
        end
        function M.Unload()
            if not M.Alive then
                return
            end
            for _, key in ipairs({
                "__pulseSetNoclip",
                "__pulseSetInvis",
                "__pulseSetKillAll",
                "__pulseSetSGlitch",
                "__pulseSetSpeed",
            }) do
                local tracked = oldGlobals[key]
                if tracked and env[key] == tracked.assigned and type(tracked.assigned) == "function" then
                    pcall(tracked.assigned, false)
                end
            end
            M.Alive, shared.dead = false, true
            for _, module in pairs(M.Modules) do
                local thread = module.InitializerThread
                if type(thread) == "thread" and thread ~= coroutine.running() and type(task.cancel) == "function" then
                    pcall(task.cancel, thread)
                    module.InitializerThread = nil
                    module.State = "Cancelled: unloaded"
                end
            end
            if not nativeCleanupRunning then
                for index = #nativeCleanup, 2, -1 do
                    pcall(nativeCleanup[index])
                end
            end
            for index = #M.Cleanup, 1, -1 do
                pcall(M.Cleanup[index])
            end
            for _, connection in ipairs(M.Connections) do
                pcall(function()
                    connection:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            for name in pairs(M.RenderNames) do
                pcall(run.UnbindFromRenderStep, run, name)
            end
            if type(window.Destroy) == "function" then
                pcall(window.Destroy, window)
            elseif window.Gui then
                pcall(function()
                    window.Gui:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            for key, item in pairs(oldGlobals) do
                if env[key] == item.assigned then
                    env[key] = item.previous
                end
            end
            if env.PulseRestored == M then
                env.PulseRestored = nil
            end
            if env.QwernSourceDeobf == M then
                env.QwernSourceDeobf = nil
            end
        end
        env.PulseRestored = M
        env.QwernSourceDeobf = M
        owner = "Reconstructed startup controls"
        function M.Status(message)
            M.LastStatus = tostring(message or "Ready")
            notify("Pulse", M.LastStatus)
        end
        local pageBusy = {}
        function M.OpenPage(name)
            if pageBusy[name] then
                return
            end
            pageBusy[name] = true
            task.spawn(function()
                local initialized, blocked = 0, {}
                for _, id in ipairs(referenceLayout.pageModules[canonicalPage(name)] or {}) do
                    if not M.Alive then
                        break
                    end
                    local ok, message = M.Load(id)
                    if ok then
                        initialized += 1
                    else
                        blocked[#blocked + 1] = M.Modules[id].Name .. ": " .. tostring(message)
                    end
                end
                pageBusy[name] = nil
                if #blocked > 0 then
                    M.Status(
                        blocked[1] .. (#blocked > 1 and (" / " .. tostring(#blocked - 1) .. " more; see Diagnostics") or "")
                    )
                else
                    M.Status(name .. ": " .. tostring(initialized) .. " native modules available")
                end
            end)
        end
        assert(type(referenceLayout.createNetworkRuntime) == "function", "Client network runtime is missing")
        networkRuntime = referenceLayout.createNetworkRuntime({
            app = M,
            env = env,
            scope = requestScope,
            http = http,
            player = player,
            game = game,
        })
        M.NetworkRuntime = networkRuntime
        setCell(requestCell, networkRuntime.Request)
        do
            local originalTags = type(env.__pulseTags) == "table" and table.clone(env.__pulseTags) or {}
            originalTags.post = networkRuntime.Post
            if type(originalTags.job) ~= "function" then
                originalTags.job = function()
                    return tostring(game.JobId or "")
                end
            end
            publish("__pulseTags", originalTags)
        end
        local lastReconnect = -math.huge
        function M.ReconnectOnline(quiet)
            if not M.Alive then
                return false, "Session is unloaded"
            end
            if not M.Online then
                return false, "HTTP is disabled"
            end
            if os.clock() - lastReconnect < 3 then
                return false, "Reconnect is already scheduled"
            end
            lastReconnect = os.clock()
            networkRuntime.Refresh()
            local chat = env.__pulseChat
            if type(chat) == "table" then
                chat.kick = true
                chat.state = "connect"
                if type(chat.status) == "function" then
                    pcall(chat.status)
                end
            end
            local configs = env.__pulseCfgHub
            if type(configs) == "table" and type(configs.load) == "function" then
                configs.load(true)
            end
            local users = env.__pulseUsersTab
            if type(users) == "table" and type(users.fetch) == "function" then
                users.fetch(true)
            end
            if not quiet then
                M.Status("In-game connection retry scheduled; see online status below")
            end
            return true, "Read-only connection retry scheduled"
        end
        function M.GetOnlineStatus()
            return networkRuntime.Report()
        end
        if type(referenceLayout.buildSheriff) == "function" then
            referenceLayout.buildSheriff(M, page, cfg, env, connect, input, create, cleanup, notify)
        end
        local lastAimStatus = 0
        connect(run.Heartbeat, function()
            if os.clock() - lastAimStatus >= 1 and type(M.RefreshAimStatus) == "function" then
                lastAimStatus = os.clock()
                M.RefreshAimStatus()
            end
            if M.OnlineStatusNote and os.clock() - (M.LastNetworkPaint or -100) > 1 then
                M.LastNetworkPaint = os.clock()
                M.OnlineStatusNote.Text = M.GetOnlineStatus()
            end
        end)
        M._Test = {
            cell = cell,
            setCell = setCell,
            cfg = cfg,
            defaults = defaults,
            prefs = prefs,
            loc = loc,
            crypto = crypto,
            request = request,
            requestCell = requestCell,
            networkRuntime = networkRuntime,
            farmCell = farmCell,
            farmUiCell = farmUiCell,
            setters = setters,
            savedValues = savedValues,
            roles = roles,
            shared = shared,
            configApi = configApi,
            initialize = initialize,
        }
        if options.AutoCore == true then
            for _, id in ipairs({ "81", "124", "14", "21", "112", "15", "34", "25" }) do
                M.Load(id)
            end
        end
        local diagnostics = page("Diagnostics")
        diagnostics:Sub("Performance")
        diagnostics:Header("Source recovery and runtime status")
        diagnostics:Note({
            Text = "The actual recovered Nova window, widgets and appearance editor are used. Application startup bindings are reconstructed, not claimed author-original.",
        })
        diagnostics:Toggle({
            Text = "Allow external HTTP requests",
            Default = M.Online,
            Callback = function(on)
                local changed = M.Online ~= (on == true)
                M.Online = on == true
                if changed and M.Online then
                    M.ReconnectOnline(true)
                end
            end,
        })
        diagnostics:Button({
            Text = "Copy diagnostic report",
            Callback = function()
                local clipboard = env.setclipboard or env.toclipboard
                if type(clipboard) == "function" then
                    clipboard(M.Report())
                else
                    notify("Diagnostics", M.Report())
                end
            end,
        })
        diagnostics:Button({
            Text = "Reconnect Chat and Config Hub",
            Callback = function()
                M.ReconnectOnline(false)
            end,
        })
        M.OnlineStatusNote = diagnostics:Note({ Text = M.GetOnlineStatus() })
        local chatOk, chatError = M.Load("3000")
        if not chatOk then
            M.Status("Original chat interface: " .. tostring(chatError))
        end
        local usersOk, usersError = M.Load("12033")
        if not usersOk then
            M.Status("Original users interface: " .. tostring(usersError))
        end
        local hubOk, hubError = M.Load("13932")
        if not hubOk then
            M.Status("Original Config Hub interface: " .. tostring(hubError))
        end
        local farmUiOk, farmUiError = M.Load("1483")
        if not farmUiOk then
            M.Status("Original Farm interface: " .. tostring(farmUiError))
        end
        local previousTabChanged = window.OnTabChanged
        window.OnTabChanged = function(tab)
            if previousTabChanged then
                pcall(previousTabChanged, tab)
            end
            if tab and tab.Name then
                M.OpenPage(tab.Name)
            end
        end
        local settingsPage = page("Settings")
        settingsPage:SubTabs(window.Tabs.Settings.SubDefs)
        local settingsOk, settingsError = M.Load("12714")
        if not settingsOk then
            M.Status("Interface settings: " .. tostring(settingsError))
        end
        if type(window.Toggle) == "function" and not window.IsOpen then
            window:Toggle()
        end
        if type(window.SelectTab) == "function" then
            window:SelectTab(shared.NovaTabs.Murderer)
        end
        task.defer(function()
            if M.Alive and M.Online then
                M.ReconnectOnline(true)
            end
        end)
        print(
            "."
        )
        return M
    end
end

local initialize = createRecoveredBootstrap()
return initialize(native, nativeManifest, referenceLayout)
